# Gitleaks config for the Security Scan workflow. Keeps every default rule and allowlists only the
# placeholder keys used by tests and the e2e README; anything else that looks like a key still fails the scan.
[extend]
useDefault = true

[allowlist]
description = "Fake Paystack/Stripe-style keys in tests and docs"
regexes = [
  '''^sk_test_fake0+$''',
  '''^sk_test_abc123abc123$''',
  '''^sk_live_1234567890abcdef$''',
]

[END OF FILE: .gitleaks.toml]

FILE 4/379: Dockerfile.client

# Stage 1: Builder
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder

WORKDIR /app

COPY client/package*.json ./
RUN npm ci

COPY client/ .
RUN npm run build

# Stage 2: Runner
FROM node:20-alpine AS runner

WORKDIR /app

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1

RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 nodejs
RUN adduser --system --uid 1001 nextjs

COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public
COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/standalone ./
COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/static ./.next/static

USER nextjs

EXPOSE 3000

CMD ["node", "server.js"]

[END OF FILE: Dockerfile.client]

FILE 5/379: Dockerfile.node-agent
LANGUAGE: node-agent   LINES: 25
================================================================================
# AgentMesh Docker worker. Manages Ollama workload containers through the host Docker daemon.
# The worker itself runs as an unprivileged user with a read-only root filesystem; it needs the Docker
# socket (see docs/WORKER.md for what that implies). Workload containers never receive the socket.
FROM python:3.12-slim

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    AGENTMESH_MODE=docker \
    AGENTMESH_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/agentmesh

WORKDIR /opt/agentmesh
COPY server/requirements-worker.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements-worker.txt

COPY server/node_agent ./node_agent

RUN useradd --system --uid 10001 --home-dir /var/lib/agentmesh agentmesh \
    && mkdir -p /var/lib/agentmesh && chown agentmesh /var/lib/agentmesh && chmod 700 /var/lib/agentmesh
USER agentmesh
VOLUME ["/var/lib/agentmesh"]

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=60s --retries=3 \
  CMD ["python", "-m", "node_agent", "status", "--check"]

ENTRYPOINT ["python", "-m", "node_agent"]
CMD ["start"]

[END OF FILE: Dockerfile.node-agent]

FILE 6/379: Dockerfile.server
LANGUAGE: server   LINES: 26
================================================================================
FROM python:3.12-slim

WORKDIR /app

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    libpq-dev \
    curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY server/requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY server/app ./app
COPY server/alembic ./alembic
COPY server/alembic.ini .

RUN useradd -m agentmesh
USER agentmesh

EXPOSE 8000

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --retries=3 \
  CMD curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1

CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

# AgentMesh

AgentMesh lets developers deploy open-weight AI models on computers contributed by independent providers and
call them through an OpenAI-compatible API. Workloads run inside resource limits on the provider's machine; the
provider can see the data a workload handles
Billing is prepaid, with Paystack top-ups and provider payouts. These run in Paystack test mode and have not
yet been exercised against Paystack's live API.

## Documentation

The full documentation is in the dashboard at [agent-mesh-ten.vercel.app/docs](https://agent-mesh-ten.vercel.app/docs):

- [Getting started](https://agent-mesh-ten.vercel.app/docs/getting-started): roles, accounts, and what works today
- [Customer guide](https://agent-mesh-ten.vercel.app/docs/customers): deploy, call, and pay for models
- [Provider guide](https://agent-mesh-ten.vercel.app/docs/providers): install the worker and manage machines
- [API reference](https://agent-mesh-ten.vercel.app/docs/api): authentication, deployments, inference, errors
- [Operators & self-hosting](https://agent-mesh-ten.vercel.app/docs/operators) and [Security & limitations](https://agent-mesh-ten.vercel.app/docs/security)

The Markdown files in [docs/](docs/) hold the same material in more depth.

## Prerequisites

- Python 3.12+
- Node.js 20+
- Docker & Docker Compose
- PostgreSQL 16
- Redis 7

## Quick Start (Development)

1. Clone the repository
2. Copy environment variables:
   ```bash
   cp .env.example .env
   ```
3. Start infrastructure services:
   ```bash
   docker-compose up -d postgres redis
   ```
4. Setup Backend (Control Plane):
   ```bash
   cd server
   pip install -r requirements.txt
   alembic upgrade head
   uvicorn app.main:app --reload
   ```
5. Setup Frontend (Dashboard):
   ```bash
   cd client
   npm install
   npm run dev
   ```
6. Run a worker (in a new terminal). 
   ```bash
   cd server
   python -m node_agent enroll --token <token from POST /api/v1/nodes/enrollment-tokens>
   python -m node_agent run
   ```

For providers, `server/packaging/install.sh` installs the worker as a per-user background service (no root);

To call a deployed model,  For the customer, provider and
operator workflows (dashboard and API),
Running a network in production (configuration, Paystack, monitoring, backups, recovery):

Operators cannot self-register. Create the first operator account on the server:

```bash
cd server
python scripts/create_operator.py ops@example.com
```

### End-to-end check

```bash
cd server
DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///./dev.db python scripts/init_dev_db.py
DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///./dev.db uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 &
python scripts/e2e_ollama.py --api http://127.0.0.1:8000 --model smollm2:135m
```

Failover across two local workers (start the API with `WORKER_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS=3
HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=12 UNHEALTHY_GRACE_SECONDS=15` so it finishes quickly):

```bash
python scripts/e2e_failover.py --api http://127.0.0.1:8000 --model smollm2:135m
```

## Running tests

```bash
cd server
pytest                      # in-memory SQLite by default
TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://agentmesh:agentmesh@localhost:5432/agentmesh_test pytest

cd client
npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest && npm run build
```

The browser end-to-end test (real control plane, real worker, real model, all three dashboards) is described in
[client/e2e/README.md](client/e2e/README.md).

## Project status

What works, what is missing, and the phased plan are tracked in [docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md](docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md).

## Deployment

- Live dashboard: [https://agent-mesh-ten.vercel.app](https://agent-mesh-ten.vercel.app).
- Live API: [https://agentmesh-riuz.onrender.com/api/v1](https://agentmesh-riuz.onrender.com/api/v1).
- Documentation: [https://agent-mesh-ten.vercel.app/docs](https://agent-mesh-ten.vercel.app/docs) (customer, provider, API, operator and security guides).
- Worker releases: [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/meshach5667/AgentMeshh/releases). Pushing a tag `worker-v<version>` that matches `WORKER_VERSION` runs `.github/workflows/worker-release.yml`, which publishes the wheel, `install.sh`, `uninstall.sh` and `SHA256SUMS`. Providers then install without cloning, from the dashboard's **Add a machine** page. No release has been published yet; see [docs/WORKER.md](docs/WORKER.md#publishing-a-release-maintainers).
- To deploy your own instance, use Vercel for `client/` and any container host for `Dockerfile.server`, or `docker-compose up -d` for the full stack. Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` to that instance's API `/api/v1` URL.
  Set the variables in [.env.example](.env.example); a plain `postgresql://` `DATABASE_URL` is accepted.

Run `make help` for the development shortcuts.

# AgentMesh Docker worker for providers.
#
#   export AGENTMESH_CONTROL_PLANE_URL=https://agentmesh.example.com
#   export AGENTMESH_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN=am_enroll_...      # one-time token from the provider dashboard
#   export DOCKER_GID=$(getent group docker | cut -d: -f3)
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.worker.yml up -d
#
# After the first successful start the token is no longer needed (credentials live in the state volume).
# See docs/WORKER.md for resource limits, GPU notes, upgrades, and uninstalling.
services:
  worker:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.node-agent
    image: agentmesh/worker:local
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      AGENTMESH_CONTROL_PLANE_URL: ${AGENTMESH_CONTROL_PLANE_URL:?Set AGENTMESH_CONTROL_PLANE_URL}
      AGENTMESH_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN: ${AGENTMESH_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN:-}
      AGENTMESH_NODE_NAME: ${AGENTMESH_NODE_NAME:-docker-worker}
      AGENTMESH_ALLOW_INSECURE_CONTROL_PLANE: ${AGENTMESH_ALLOW_INSECURE_CONTROL_PLANE:-false}
      # Resources offered to AgentMesh. Unset: half the CPU and RAM, at most 20 GB disk, no GPU.
      AGENTMESH_MAX_CPU_CORES: ${AGENTMESH_MAX_CPU_CORES:-}
      AGENTMESH_MAX_RAM_MB: ${AGENTMESH_MAX_RAM_MB:-}
      AGENTMESH_MAX_DISK_MB: ${AGENTMESH_MAX_DISK_MB:-}
      AGENTMESH_ALLOW_GPU: ${AGENTMESH_ALLOW_GPU:-false}
      # Pin by digest in production, e.g. ollama/ollama@sha256:<digest>
      AGENTMESH_OLLAMA_IMAGE: ${AGENTMESH_OLLAMA_IMAGE:-ollama/ollama:0.12.3}
      AGENTMESH_WORKLOAD_NETWORK: agentmesh-workloads
      # Workloads join this network only while downloading their model, then lose internet access.
      AGENTMESH_EGRESS_NETWORK: agentmesh-egress
      AGENTMESH_MODELS_VOLUME: agentmesh-models
    volumes:
      - agentmesh-worker-state:/var/lib/agentmesh
      # Required to manage workload containers. This grants the worker root-equivalent control of the host
      # Docker daemon; prefer rootless Docker. Workload containers never get this socket.
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    group_add:
      - "${DOCKER_GID:-999}"
    networks:
      - agentmesh-workloads
      - egress
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    stop_grace_period: 30s

networks:
  agentmesh-workloads:
    name: agentmesh-workloads
    internal: true  # no route to the internet for serving workloads
  agentmesh-egress:
    name: agentmesh-egress
  egress: {}

volumes:
  agentmesh-worker-state:
  agentmesh-models:
    name: agentmesh-models

[END OF FILE: docker-compose.worker.yml]

# Control plane stack. Providers run workers separately with docker-compose.worker.yml.
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: agentmesh
      POSTGRES_USER: agentmesh
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: agentmesh
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U agentmesh -d agentmesh"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  api:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.server
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://agentmesh:agentmesh@postgres:5432/agentmesh
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
      - SECRET_KEY=${SECRET_KEY:?Set SECRET_KEY to a random value of at least 32 characters}
      - ENVIRONMENT=production
      - ALLOW_TEST_CREDITS=false
      # https URL customers and workers use to reach this API (behind your TLS-terminating proxy)
      - PUBLIC_BASE_URL=${PUBLIC_BASE_URL:?Set PUBLIC_BASE_URL to the public https URL of the API}
      - FRONTEND_URL=${FRONTEND_URL:?Set FRONTEND_URL to the public URL of the dashboard}
      - CORS_ORIGINS=["${FRONTEND_URL}"]
      # Paystack test key (sk_test_...). Payments stay disabled while unset.
      - PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY=${PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY:-}
      - BILLING_CURRENCY=${BILLING_CURRENCY:-NGN}
      - METRICS_TOKEN=${METRICS_TOKEN:-}
    # --proxy-headers: client addresses (rate limits, audit log, webhook IP checks) come from the TLS proxy.
    command: sh -c "alembic upgrade head && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips='*'"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8000/health/ready"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

  client:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.client
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy

volumes:
  postgres_data:

  migrations-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: agentmesh
          POSTGRES_USER: agentmesh
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: agentmesh
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r server/requirements.txt
          
      - name: Check migrations reversibility
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://agentmesh:agentmesh@localhost:5432/agentmesh
        run: |
          cd server
          alembic upgrade head
          alembic check
          alembic downgrade -1
          alembic upgrade head

      - name: Backup and restore round trip
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://agentmesh:agentmesh@localhost:5432/agentmesh
        run: |
          cd server
          # Dumps travel over stdin/stdout, so the container needs no volume; a bind mount would create the
          # backup directory as root and the runner user could not write the dump into it.
          mkdir -p /tmp/agentmesh-backups
          PG="docker run --rm -i --network host postgres:16-alpine"
          LIBPQ=postgresql://agentmesh:agentmesh@localhost:5432
          $PG psql "$LIBPQ/agentmesh" -c "insert into pricing_rules (id, version, currency, cpu_core_hour, ram_gb_hour, vram_gb_hour, input_tokens_per_million, output_tokens_per_million, platform_fee_rate, effective_from, created_at) values (gen_random_uuid(), 99, 'NGN', 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 0.1, now(), now())"
          PG_DUMP="$PG pg_dump" ops/backup_db.sh /tmp/agentmesh-backups
          $PG psql "$LIBPQ/agentmesh" -c "create database agentmesh_restore"
          DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://agentmesh:agentmesh@localhost:5432/agentmesh_restore \
            PG_RESTORE="$PG pg_restore" PSQL="$PG psql" ops/restore_db.sh /tmp/agentmesh-backups/agentmesh-*.dump
          test "$($PG psql "$LIBPQ/agentmesh_restore" -tAc 'select version from pricing_rules')" = "99"
          DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://agentmesh:agentmesh@localhost:5432/agentmesh_restore alembic check

  e2e-stub-runtime:
    # Full worker -> control plane -> gateway flow on PostgreSQL with real migrations. The model runtime is a
    # labelled stub (server/tests/fixtures/fake_ollama.py), so this proves the platform path, not inference.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: agentmesh
          POSTGRES_USER: agentmesh
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: agentmesh
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://agentmesh:agentmesh@localhost:5432/agentmesh
      ENVIRONMENT: test
      PUBLIC_BASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8000
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install -r server/requirements.txt
      - name: Migrate
        run: cd server && alembic upgrade head
      - name: Start control plane
        run: cd server && (uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 > ../cp.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 5 && curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
      - name: End-to-end (stub runtime)
        run: |
          cd server
          python scripts/e2e_ollama.py --api http://127.0.0.1:8000 --mode agent --model smollm2:135m \
            --ollama-binary tests/fixtures/fake_ollama.py
      - name: Control plane log
        if: always()
        run: cat cp.log

  e2e-multi-replica:
    # Two API replicas sharing PostgreSQL and Redis. The worker connects to replica A; every customer call,
    # including streaming inference, goes to replica B, so requests must cross replicas through Redis.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: agentmesh
          POSTGRES_USER: agentmesh
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: agentmesh
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://agentmesh:agentmesh@localhost:5432/agentmesh
      REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/0
      COORDINATION_BACKEND: redis
      ENVIRONMENT: test
      PUBLIC_BASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8001
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install -r server/requirements.txt
      - name: Migrate
        run: cd server && alembic upgrade head
      - name: Start two replicas
        run: |
          cd server
          (uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 > ../replica-a.log 2>&1 &)
          (uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 > ../replica-b.log 2>&1 &)
          sleep 6 && curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8000/health && curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8001/health
      - name: End-to-end across replicas (stub runtime)
        run: |
          cd server
          python scripts/e2e_ollama.py --api http://127.0.0.1:8000 --customer-api http://127.0.0.1:8001 \
            --mode agent --model smollm2:135m --ollama-binary tests/fixtures/fake_ollama.py
      - name: Replica logs
        if: always()
        run: cat replica-a.log replica-b.log

  installer:
    # Build the worker wheel, install it with packaging/install.sh (no service: CI has no systemd user
    # session), enroll, run the installed agentmesh-worker, deploy on it (stub runtime), then uninstall.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: sqlite+aiosqlite:///./ci.db
      ENVIRONMENT: test
      PUBLIC_BASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8000
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install -r server/requirements.txt
      - name: Build wheel
        run: cd server && python scripts/build_worker_wheel.py dist
      - name: Start control plane
        run: |
          cd server && python scripts/init_dev_db.py
          (uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 > ../cp.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 5
      - name: Install, run, deploy, uninstall
        run: |
          cd server
          TOKEN=$(python - <<'PY'
          import httpx
          r = httpx.post("http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/auth/register",
                         json={"email": "ci-provider@example.com", "password": "ci-password-1", "role": "provider"})
          h = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + r.json()["access_token"]}
          print(httpx.post("http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/nodes/enrollment-tokens", json={}, headers=h).json()["token"])
          PY
          )
          ./packaging/install.sh --control-plane http://127.0.0.1:8000 --token "$TOKEN" --wheel dist/agentmesh_worker-*.whl \
            --ollama "$PWD/tests/fixtures/fake_ollama.py" --max-ram-mb 2048 --max-disk-mb 2048 --no-service --yes
          export AGENTMESH_CONFIG_FILE=$HOME/.config/agentmesh/agentmesh-worker.env
          W=$HOME/.local/share/agentmesh/venv-agentmesh-worker/bin/agentmesh-worker
          $W doctor || true
          ($W run > ../worker.log 2>&1 &)
          timeout 60 bash -c "until $W status | grep -q '\"connected\": true'; do sleep 2; done"
          python - <<'PY'
          import httpx, time
          api = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1"
          r = httpx.post(f"{api}/auth/register", json={"email": "ci-c@example.com", "password": "ci-password-1", "role": "customer"})
          h = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + r.json()["access_token"]}
          m = next(m for m in httpx.get(f"{api}/models").json() if m["model_tag"] == "smollm2:135m")
          d = httpx.post(f"{api}/deployments", json={"model_id": m["id"]}, headers=h).json()
          for _ in range(60):
              d = httpx.get(f"{api}/deployments/{d['id']}", headers=h).json()
              if d["status"] in ("READY", "FAILED"):
                  break
              time.sleep(2)
          assert d["status"] == "READY", d
          out = httpx.post(f"{d['endpoint']}/api/generate", json={"prompt": "hi", "stream": False}, headers=h, timeout=60)
          assert out.status_code == 200 and "stub runtime" in out.json()["response"], out.text
          print("installed worker served a deployment")
          PY
          $W drain && sleep 8
          pkill -TERM -f "agentmesh-worker run" && sleep 5   # no service in CI: stop the foreground worker
          ./packaging/uninstall.sh --purge-models --yes
          test ! -e $HOME/.config/agentmesh && test ! -e $HOME/.local/share/agentmesh
      - name: Logs
        if: always()
        run: cat cp.log worker.log || true

name: Worker release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "worker-v*"

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Check the tag matches WORKER_VERSION
        id: version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(python -c "import re,pathlib; print(re.search(r'WORKER_VERSION = \"([^\"]+)\"', pathlib.Path('server/node_agent/config.py').read_text()).group(1))")
          TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#worker-v}"
          if [ "$VERSION" != "$TAG_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "::error::Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME does not match WORKER_VERSION $VERSION in server/node_agent/config.py"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Build release assets
        run: |
          mkdir -p release
          python server/scripts/build_worker_wheel.py release
          cp server/packaging/install.sh server/packaging/uninstall.sh release/
          chmod +x release/install.sh release/uninstall.sh
          bash -n release/install.sh
          bash -n release/uninstall.sh
          cd release && sha256sum agentmesh_worker-*.whl install.sh uninstall.sh > SHA256SUMS && cat SHA256SUMS

      - name: Check the wheel installs
        run: |
          python -m venv /tmp/worker-venv
          /tmp/worker-venv/bin/pip install --quiet release/agentmesh_worker-${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}-py3-none-any.whl
          /tmp/worker-venv/bin/agentmesh-worker --help > /dev/null
          /tmp/worker-venv/bin/agentmesh-worker hardware

      - name: Publish the GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          cat > notes.md <<EOF
          AgentMesh worker $VERSION for Linux and macOS (Python 3.11+, venv, and Ollama required).

          Install it from the provider dashboard (Add a machine), which fills in the control-plane URL and a
          one-time enrollment token. Verify downloads with \`SHA256SUMS\` before running \`install.sh\`.
          See docs/WORKER.md for details.
          EOF
          gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" release/* \
            --title "AgentMesh worker $VERSION" --notes-file notes.md --verify-tag

FILE 29/379: client/e2e/README.md
LANGUAGE: markdown   LINES: 41
================================================================================
# End-to-end product test

`product.spec.ts` drives the dashboards in a real browser against a real control plane, a real installable-agent
worker and a real model (SmolLM2 135M through an isolated Ollama instance started by the worker; your own Ollama
service is not used). It downloads the model (about 270 MB) into a temporary worker data directory.

```bash
# 1. Control plane on a throwaway SQLite database
cd server
export DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:////tmp/agentmesh-e2e.db
venv/bin/python scripts/init_dev_db.py
AGENTMESH_OPERATOR_PASSWORD=e2e-operator-password venv/bin/python scripts/create_operator.py ops@example.com
venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000

# 2. Dashboard (production build)
cd client && npm run build && npm run start

# 3. The test (uses installed Google Chrome; omit PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL to use Playwright's Chromium)
cd client
E2E_OPERATOR_EMAIL=ops@example.com E2E_OPERATOR_PASSWORD=e2e-operator-password \
  PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=chrome npx playwright test
```

Billing and payments: also start `tests/fixtures/fake_paystack_server.py` and point the API at it. The
operator then publishes prices, the customer tops up (Paystack's hosted page is stubbed in the browser, and
the payment is confirmed by a signed webhook), the deployment is charged, and the provider is paid out after
operator approval:

```bash
cd server
FAKE_PAYSTACK_SECRET=sk_test_fake0000000000000000000000 \
  FAKE_PAYSTACK_WEBHOOK=http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/payments/paystack/webhook \
  venv/bin/uvicorn tests.fixtures.fake_paystack_server:app --port 8090
# start the API with these as well:
PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_fake0000000000000000000000 PAYSTACK_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8090 \
  BILLING_INTERVAL_SECONDS=60 MONITOR_INTERVAL_SECONDS=5 PAYOUT_MIN_AMOUNT=1 venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000
# and run the test with E2E_FAKE_PAYSTACK=http://127.0.0.1:8090
```

Optional: `E2E_API` (default `http://localhost:8000`), `E2E_PYTHON` (default `../server/venv/bin/python`),
`E2E_MODEL` (catalog name, default `SmolLM2 135M`).

[END OF FILE: client/e2e/README.md]

FILE 30/379: client/e2e/product.spec.ts
LANGUAGE: typescript   LINES: 281

import { expect, test, type Browser, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { spawn, spawnSync, type ChildProcess } from 'node:child_process';
import { mkdtempSync, openSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';

const API = process.env.E2E_API || 'http://localhost:8000';
const SERVER_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../server');
const PYTHON = process.env.E2E_PYTHON || path.join(SERVER_DIR, 'venv/bin/python');
const MODEL = process.env.E2E_MODEL || 'SmolLM2 135M';
const OPERATOR = { email: process.env.E2E_OPERATOR_EMAIL ?? '', password: process.env.E2E_OPERATOR_PASSWORD ?? '' };
const PASSWORD = 'e2e-password-123';
const run = Date.now().toString(36);
// Base URL of tests/fixtures/fake_paystack_server.py; enables the billing and payment steps.
const FAKE_PAYSTACK = process.env.E2E_FAKE_PAYSTACK ?? '';

let worker: ChildProcess | undefined;
let workerLog = '';
let deploymentUrl = '';

test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });

async function signUp(browser: Browser, role: 'customer' | 'provider'): Promise<Page> {
  const page = await (await browser.newContext()).newPage();
  await page.goto(role === 'provider' ? '/register?role=provider' : '/register');
  await page.locator('input[type="email"]').fill(`e2e-${role}-${run}@example.com`);
  const pw = page.locator('input[type="password"]');
  await pw.nth(0).fill(PASSWORD);
  await pw.nth(1).fill(PASSWORD);
  await page.locator('button[type="submit"]').click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/${role}$`));
  return page;
}

async function signIn(browser: Browser, email: string, password: string): Promise<Page> {
  const page = await (await browser.newContext()).newPage();
  await page.goto('/login');
  await page.locator('input[type="email"]').fill(email);
  await page.locator('input[type="password"]').fill(password);
  await page.locator('button[type="submit"]').click();
  return page;
}

const nav = (page: Page, label: string) => page.getByRole('complementary').getByRole('link', { name: label, exact: true }).click();

let provider: Page;
let customer: Page;
let ops: Page | undefined;

async function operator(browser: Browser): Promise<Page> {
  if (!ops) {
    ops = await signIn(browser, OPERATOR.email, OPERATOR.password);
    await expect(ops).toHaveURL(/\/operator$/);
  }
  return ops;
}

test.afterAll(async () => {
  if (worker && worker.exitCode === null) {
    worker.kill('SIGTERM');
    await new Promise((r) => worker!.once('exit', r));
  }
});

test('provider enrolls a real machine from the dashboard', async ({ browser }) => {
  provider = await signUp(browser, 'provider');
  await expect(provider.getByText('You have no nodes yet.')).toBeVisible();

  await nav(provider, 'Add a Machine');
  await provider.getByLabel('Name (optional)').fill(`e2e-node-${run}`);
  await provider.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create token' }).click();
  const token = (await provider.locator('code').filter({ hasText: /^am_enroll_/ }).first().textContent())!.trim();
  await expect(provider.locator('pre').first()).toContainText(`--token ${token}`);

  const dataDir = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'agentmesh-e2e-ui-'));
  const env = {
    ...process.env,
    AGENTMESH_CONTROL_PLANE_URL: API,
    AGENTMESH_DATA_DIR: dataDir,
    AGENTMESH_MODE: 'agent',
    AGENTMESH_NODE_NAME: `e2e-node-${run}`,
    AGENTMESH_MAX_CPU_CORES: '2',
    AGENTMESH_MAX_RAM_MB: '3072',
    AGENTMESH_MAX_DISK_MB: '4096',
    AGENTMESH_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS: '5',
  };
  const enroll = spawnSync(PYTHON, ['-m', 'node_agent', 'enroll', '--token', token], { cwd: SERVER_DIR, env, encoding: 'utf8' });
  expect(enroll.status, enroll.stderr).toBe(0);
  workerLog = path.join(dataDir, 'worker.log');
  const log = openSync(workerLog, 'a');
  worker = spawn(PYTHON, ['-m', 'node_agent', 'run'], { cwd: SERVER_DIR, env, stdio: ['ignore', log, log] });

  await nav(provider, 'My Nodes');
  const row = provider.getByTestId('node-row').filter({ hasText: `e2e-node-${run}` });
  await expect(row.getByText('Accepting work')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 60000 });
  await expect(row).toContainText('Ollama');
});

test('customer deploys a model and it becomes ready on the real node', async ({ browser }) => {
  customer = await signUp(browser, 'customer');
  if (FAKE_PAYSTACK) {
    // Prepaid: top up through the Paystack flow. Paystack's hosted page is stubbed; the payment is confirmed by a
    // signed webhook from the fake Paystack server, then verified when the customer returns.
    await nav(customer, 'Wallet');
    await expect(customer.getByText('Paystack test mode: no real money')).toBeVisible();
    await customer.route('https://checkout.paystack.com/**', (route) => route.fulfill({ body: '<h1>Paystack checkout (stub)</h1>', contentType: 'text/html' }));
    await customer.getByLabel(/^Amount/).fill('2000');
    await customer.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay with Paystack' }).click();
    await customer.waitForURL(/checkout\.paystack\.com\/fake-am-top-/);
    const reference = customer.url().split('fake-')[1];
    const paid = await (await customer.request.post(`${FAKE_PAYSTACK}/_test/pay/${reference}`)).json();
    expect(paid.webhook_status).toBe(200);
    await customer.goto(`/customer/wallet?reference=${reference}&trxref=${reference}`);
    await expect(customer.getByTestId('stat-Balance')).toHaveText(/2,000\.00/);
    await expect(customer).toHaveURL(/\/customer\/wallet$/);
  }
  await nav(customer, 'Models');
  await customer.getByLabel('Search models').fill(MODEL);
  const card = customer.getByTestId('model-card').filter({ hasText: MODEL });
  await card.getByRole('link', { name: 'Configure and deploy' }).click();

  await customer.getByRole('radio', { name: /^Ollama/ }).check();
  if (FAKE_PAYSTACK) await expect(customer.getByTestId('hourly-ollama')).toContainText('per hour while');
  const deploy = customer.getByRole('button', { name: 'Deploy' });
  await expect(deploy).toBeDisabled();
  await customer.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /I understand the provider can see/ }).check();
  await deploy.click();

  await expect(customer).toHaveURL(/\/customer\/deployments\/[0-9a-f-]{36}$/);
  deploymentUrl = customer.url();
  await expect(customer.getByTestId('deployment-events')).toContainText('SCHEDULED');
  await expect(customer.locator('[data-status="READY"]').first()).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15 * 60 * 1000 });
  await expect(customer.getByText('Verified digest')).toBeVisible();
  // Ollama reports the manifest digest as bare hex; llama.cpp as sha256:<hex>.
  await expect(customer.getByText(/^(sha256:)?[0-9a-f]{64}$/)).toBeVisible();
});

  await customer.getByLabel('Prompt').fill('What is the capital of France? Answer in one word.');
  await customer.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send' }).click();

test('customer creates a scoped API key and calls the deployment with it', async ({ request }) => {
  const deploymentId = deploymentUrl.split('/').at(-1)!;
  await nav(customer, 'API Keys');
  await customer.getByLabel('Name').fill('e2e-app');
  await customer.getByLabel('Deployment').selectOption(deploymentId);
  await customer.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create key' }).click();
  await expect(customer.getByText('Copy this key now. It will not be shown again.')).toBeVisible();
  const key = (await customer.locator('code').filter({ hasText: /^am_sk_/ }).first().textContent())!.trim();

  const resp = await request.post(`${API}/api/v1/deployments/${deploymentId}/v1/chat/completions`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${key}` },
    data: { model: 'ignored', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Say hi' }], max_tokens: 8 },
    timeout: 120000,
  });
  expect(resp.status()).toBe(200);
  expect((await resp.json()).choices.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

  await customer.getByRole('button', { name: 'I have saved it' }).click();
  await customer.reload();
  const row = customer.getByTestId('api-key-row').filter({ hasText: 'e2e-app' });
  await expect(row).toContainText(`Deployment ${deploymentId.slice(0, 8)}`);
  await expect(row).not.toContainText('never');

  await nav(customer, 'Usage');
  await expect(customer.getByTestId('usage-chart')).toBeVisible();
  // One playground request and one API-key request.
  await expect(customer.getByTestId('stat-Requests')).toHaveText('2');
});

test('the running deployment is charged and the provider is paid out', async ({ browser }) => {
  test.skip(!FAKE_PAYSTACK || !OPERATOR.email, 'billing steps need E2E_FAKE_PAYSTACK and operator credentials');
  await customer.goto(deploymentUrl);
  // The billing job rates READY time every BILLING_INTERVAL_SECONDS (60 s in this run).
  await expect(customer.getByTestId('cost-so-far')).not.toHaveText(/^(—|NGN\s?0\.00)$/, { timeout: 4 * 60 * 1000 });
  await expect(customer.getByTestId('charge-row').first()).toBeVisible();

  await provider.goto('/provider/earnings');
  await expect(provider.getByTestId('stat-Earned in total')).not.toHaveText(/^NGN\s?0\.00$/);
  await provider.getByLabel('Bank').selectOption('001');
  await provider.getByLabel('Account number').fill('0123456789');
  await provider.getByRole('button', { name: 'Verify and save' }).click();
  await expect(provider.getByTestId('payout-account')).toContainText('••••6789');
  await provider.getByLabel('Payout amount').fill('1');
  await provider.getByRole('button', { name: 'Request payout' }).click();
  const row = provider.getByTestId('payout-row').first();
  await expect(row).toContainText('REQUESTED');
  const payoutRef = (await row.locator('td').nth(1).textContent())!.trim();

  const page = await operator(browser);
  await nav(page, 'Payouts');
  const pending = page.getByTestId('admin-payout-row').filter({ hasText: payoutRef });
  await pending.getByRole('button', { name: 'Approve' }).click();
  await pending.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send transfer' }).click();
  await page.getByLabel('Filter by status').selectOption('');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('admin-payout-row').filter({ hasText: payoutRef })).toContainText('PENDING');
  const done = await (await page.request.post(`${FAKE_PAYSTACK}/_test/transfer/${payoutRef}/success`)).json();
  expect(done.webhook_status).toBe(200);
  await provider.reload();
  await expect(provider.getByTestId('payout-row').filter({ hasText: payoutRef })).toContainText('SUCCEEDED');

  await nav(page, 'Reconciliation');
  await expect(page.getByText('Ledger consistent')).toBeVisible();
});

test('operator sees the whole network and the audit trail', async ({ browser }) => {
  test.skip(!OPERATOR.email, 'Set E2E_OPERATOR_EMAIL and E2E_OPERATOR_PASSWORD (see e2e/README.md)');

  await nav(ops, 'All Deployments');
  await expect(ops.getByText(`e2e-customer-${run}@example.com`)).toBeVisible();
  await nav(ops, 'All Nodes');
  await expect(ops.getByText(`e2e-provider-${run}@example.com`)).toBeVisible();
  await nav(ops, 'Audit Log');
  await ops.getByLabel('Action').fill('node.paused');
  await expect(ops.locator('td', { hasText: 'node.paused' }).first()).toBeVisible();

  // A customer cannot open operator pages; the guard sends them home (and the API refuses anyway).
  await customer.goto('/operator');
  await expect(customer).toHaveURL(/\/customer$/);
});

test('customer deletes the deployment and the node releases its capacity', async () => {
  await customer.goto(deploymentUrl);
  await customer.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete' }).click();
  await customer.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete and revoke its keys' }).click();
  await expect(customer).toHaveURL(/\/customer\/deployments$/);

  await provider.goto('/provider/nodes');
  const row = provider.getByTestId('node-row').filter({ hasText: `e2e-node-${run}` });
  await expect(row).toContainText('0 MB / 3 GB', { timeout: 120000 });
  // The worker received the stop for this deployment (it removes the runtime before acknowledging).
  await expect(() => expect(readFileSync(workerLog, 'utf8')).toMatch(new RegExp(`type=STOP deployment=${deploymentUrl.split('/').at(-1)}`))).toPass({ timeout: 60000 });
});

import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { Geist, Geist_Mono } from 'next/font/google';
import './globals.css';
import { QueryProvider } from '@/providers/QueryProvider';
import { ThemeProvider } from '@/providers/ThemeProvider';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const sans = Geist({ subsets: ['latin'], variable: '--font-geist-sans' });
const mono = Geist_Mono({ subsets: ['latin'], variable: '--font-geist-mono' });

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: { default: 'AgentMesh — Open-weight models on community compute', template: '%s · AgentMesh' },
  description: 'Deploy open-weight AI models on machines contributed by independent providers, behind an OpenAI-compatible API.',
};

// Applied before first paint so the page never flashes the wrong theme.
const themeScript = `try{var t=localStorage.getItem('theme');if(!t){t=matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches?'light':'dark'}document.documentElement.classList.add(t)}catch(e){document.documentElement.classList.add('dark')}`;

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning className={cn(sans.variable, mono.variable)}>
      <head>
        <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeScript }} />
      </head>
      <body className="min-h-screen bg-background text-foreground antialiased">
        <ThemeProvider>
          <QueryProvider>{children}</QueryProvider>
        </ThemeProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}

import { AuthGuard } from '@/components/auth/AuthGuard';
import { DashboardLayout } from '@/components/layout/DashboardLayout';

export default function CustomerLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {

'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { Activity, Box, KeyRound, MessageSquare } from 'lucide-react';
import { buttonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { StatCard } from '@/components/common/StatCard';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useDeployments } from '@/hooks/useDeployments';
import { useApiKeys } from '@/hooks/useApiKeys';
import { useModels } from '@/hooks/useModels';
import { useUsageSummary } from '@/hooks/useUsage';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { ago, count, runtimeLabel } from '@/lib/format';
import { TERMINAL_STATUSES } from '@/types';

export default function CustomerOverview() {
  const deployments = useDeployments();
  const models = useModels();
  const keys = useApiKeys();
  const usage = useUsageSummary(7);

  if (deployments.isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (deployments.error) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(deployments.error)} retry={() => deployments.refetch()} />;

  const all = deployments.data ?? [];
  const live = all.filter((d) => !TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(d.status));
  const ready = all.filter((d) => d.status === 'READY');
  const modelName = (id: string) => models.data?.find((m) => m.id === id)?.name;
  const activeKeys = (keys.data ?? []).filter((k) => !k.revoked_at).length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Overview"
        description="Your model deployments and their usage."
        actions={
          <Link href="/customer/models" className={buttonVariants()}>
            Deploy a model
          </Link>
        }
      />
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <StatCard title="Ready deployments" value={ready.length} hint={`${live.length} not stopped`} icon={Activity} />
        <StatCard title="Models in catalog" value={models.data?.length ?? '—'} icon={Box} />
        <StatCard title="Active API keys" value={keys.data ? activeKeys : '—'} icon={KeyRound} />
        <StatCard
          title="Requests (7 days)"
          value={usage.data ? count(usage.data.totals.requests) : '—'}
          hint={usage.data ? `${count(usage.data.totals.output_tokens)} output tokens` : undefined}
          icon={MessageSquare}
        />
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
          <CardTitle>Current deployments</CardTitle>
          <Link href="/customer/deployments" className="text-sm underline underline-offset-4">
            View all
          </Link>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {live.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState action={{ href: '/customer/models', label: 'Browse models' }}>You have no running deployments.</EmptyState>
          ) : (
            <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
              {live.slice(0, 6).map((d) => (
                <li key={d.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 py-3">
                  <Link href={`/customer/deployments/${d.id}`} className="font-medium hover:underline">
                    {modelName(d.model_id) ?? d.model_tag ?? d.id.slice(0, 8)}
                  </Link>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {runtimeLabel(d.runtime)} · created {ago(d.created_at)}
                    <StatusBadge status={d.status} />
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useParams } from 'next/navigation';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { AiHealthBadge } from '@/components/ai/AiHealthBadge';
import { AiRunTimeline } from '@/components/ai/AiRunTimeline';
import { InlineValue } from '@/components/common/CodeBlock';
import { ConfirmButton } from '@/components/common/ConfirmButton';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { ErrorState, Notice, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useAiRun, useAiRunEvents, useCancelAiRun } from '@/hooks/useAiDeployments';
import { AI_STATUS_HELP, STOP_REASON_TEXT } from '@/lib/ai';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { dateTime, money, runtimeLabel, shortId } from '@/lib/format';
import { AI_TERMINAL_STATUSES } from '@/types';

export default function AiRunPage() {
  const id = useParams<{ id: string }>().id;
  const { data: run, isLoading, error, refetch } = useAiRun(id);
  const live = !!run && !AI_TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(run.status);
  const events = useAiRunEvents(id, live);
  const cancel = useCancelAiRun();

  if (isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (error || !run) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error, 'AI deployment not found')} retry={() => refetch()} />;

  const currency = run.currency ?? undefined;
  const tone = run.status === 'FAILED' ? 'danger' : run.status === 'RECOVERING' || run.waiting_for_ai ? 'warning' : 'info';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title={run.model_name ?? 'AI deployment'}
        description={run.request}
        actions={
          <>
            <AiHealthBadge />
            {live && run.status !== 'STOPPING' && (
              <ConfirmButton
                confirmLabel="Cancel and stop everything"
                onConfirm={() =>
                  cancel.mutateAsync(run.id).then(
                    () => toast.success('Cancellation requested'),
                    (e) => toast.error(errorMessage(e)),
                  )
                }
              >
                Cancel
              </ConfirmButton>
            )}
          </>
        }
      />

      <Card>
        <CardContent className="grid gap-4 pt-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
          <Field label="Status">
            <StatusBadge status={run.status} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Deployment">
            {run.deployment_id ? (
              <Link href={`/customer/deployments/${run.deployment_id}`} className="font-mono underline underline-offset-4">
                {shortId(run.deployment_id)}
              </Link>
            ) : (
              '—'
            )}
            {run.deployment_status && <span className="text-muted-foreground"> · {run.deployment_status}</span>}
          </Field>
          <Field label="Runtime">{runtimeLabel(run.runtime ?? run.plan?.runtime ?? null)}</Field>
          <Field label="Stops at">{dateTime(run.deadline_at, 'after submission')}</Field>
          <Field label="Estimated cost">
            {run.estimated_total ? (
              <>
                {money(run.estimated_total, currency)}
                <span className="text-muted-foreground"> ({money(run.estimated_hourly, currency)}/h)</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              '—'
            )}
          </Field>
          <Field label="Actual cost">
            <span data-testid="ai-actual-cost">{money(run.actual_cost, currency)}</span>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Authorized maximum">
            {money(run.limits.max_spend, currency)} · {run.limits.max_duration_hours} h
          </Field>
          <Field label="Recovery attempts">
            {run.recovery_attempts} of {run.limits.max_recovery_attempts}
          </Field>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Notice tone={tone} title={run.status}>
        {AI_STATUS_HELP[run.status]}
        {run.waiting_for_ai && (
          <span className="mt-1 block">
            Waiting for the AI service. If it is offline, this step waits until it reconnects or the request expires; nothing is
            decided without it.
          </span>
        )}
        {run.stop_reason && <span className="mt-1 block">{STOP_REASON_TEXT[run.stop_reason] ?? run.stop_reason}.</span>}
        {run.error_message && (
          <span className="mt-1 block">
            <span className="font-mono text-xs">{run.error_code}</span> {run.error_message}
          </span>
        )}
      </Notice>

      {run.explanation && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Agent&apos;s explanation</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Written by the AI model. Informational only: AgentMesh verified the facts shown above.</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap" data-testid="ai-explanation">
              {run.explanation}
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {run.status === 'READY' && run.openai_base_url && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Verified endpoint</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Published after a real test request succeeded. Authenticate with an{' '}
              <Link href="/customer/api-keys" className="underline underline-offset-4">
                API key
              </Link>
              ; see the{' '}
              <Link href={`/customer/deployments/${run.deployment_id}`} className="underline underline-offset-4">
                deployment page
              </Link>{' '}
              for examples and a playground.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-3">
            <InlineValue value={run.openai_base_url} />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {run.plan && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Accepted plan</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Proposed by the agent and validated by AgentMesh against your limits.</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>

            <Field label="Runtime">{run.plan.runtime ? runtimeLabel(run.plan.runtime) : 'Any allowed'}</Field>
            <Field label="Context window">{run.plan.num_ctx.toLocaleString()} tokens</Field>
            <Field label="Duration">{run.plan.duration_hours} h</Field>
          </CardContent>

          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {events.error ? <p className="text-sm text-rose-500">{errorMessage(events.error)}</p> : <AiRunTimeline events={events.data ?? []} />}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

function Field({ label, children }: { label: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {

    <div className="space-y-1">
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
      <div className="text-sm">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );

'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { InlineValue } from '@/components/common/CodeBlock';
import { ConfirmButton } from '@/components/common/ConfirmButton';
import { Pill } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, Notice, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { TableSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useApiKeys, useCreateApiKey, useRevokeApiKey } from '@/hooks/useApiKeys';
import { useDeployments } from '@/hooks/useDeployments';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { ago, dateTime, parseApiDate, shortId } from '@/lib/format';
import { TERMINAL_STATUSES, type ApiKey, type CreatedApiKey } from '@/types';

export default function ApiKeysPage() {
  const keys = useApiKeys();
  const deployments = useDeployments();
  const create = useCreateApiKey();
  const revoke = useRevokeApiKey();
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [deploymentId, setDeploymentId] = useState('');
  const [expiresInDays, setExpiresInDays] = useState('');
  const [created, setCreated] = useState<CreatedApiKey | null>(null);

  const usable = (deployments.data ?? []).filter((d) => !TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(d.status));

  const submit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const days = Number(expiresInDays);
    create.mutate(
      {
        name: name.trim(),
        deployment_id: deploymentId || undefined,
        expires_at: days > 0 ? new Date(Date.now() + days * 86400000).toISOString() : undefined,
      },
      {
        onSuccess: (key) => {
          setCreated(key);
          setName('');
        },
      },
    );
  };

  const state = (k: ApiKey) => {
    if (k.revoked_at) return <Pill tone="red">Revoked</Pill>;
    const exp = parseApiDate(k.expires_at);
    if (exp && exp < new Date()) return <Pill tone="amber">Expired</Pill>;
    return <Pill tone="green">Active</Pill>;
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="API keys"
        description="Keys authenticate your applications to the inference gateway."
        actions={
          <Link href="/docs/api" className="inline-flex h-8 items-center rounded-lg border border-border px-3 text-[13px] font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-muted">
            API docs
          </Link>
        }
      />

      {created && (
        <Notice tone="warning" title="Copy this key now. It will not be shown again.">
          <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
            <InlineValue value={created.key} />
            <p>
              Use it as <code className="font-mono">Authorization: Bearer &lt;key&gt;</code>. AgentMesh stores only a
              hash of it.
            </p>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setCreated(null)}>
              I have saved it
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Notice>
      )}

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Create a key</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Limit a key to one deployment where you can. Deleting that deployment revokes the key.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <form onSubmit={submit} className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_10rem_auto] sm:items-end">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="key-name">Name</Label>
              <Input id="key-name" required maxLength={100} value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="my-app" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="key-scope">Deployment</Label>
              <select
                id="key-scope"
                value={deploymentId}
                onChange={(e) => setDeploymentId(e.target.value)}
                className="h-8 w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-transparent px-2 text-sm"
              >
                <option value="">All my deployments</option>
                {usable.map((d) => (
                  <option key={d.id} value={d.id}>
                    {d.model_tag ?? 'deployment'} ({shortId(d.id)}, {d.status})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="key-expiry">Expires in (days)</Label>
              <Input id="key-expiry" type="number" min={1} max={3650} value={expiresInDays} onChange={(e) => setExpiresInDays(e.target.value)} placeholder="Never" />
            </div>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={create.isPending || !name.trim()}>
              Create key
            </Button>
          </form>
          {create.error && <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-rose-500">{errorMessage(create.error)}</p>}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Your keys</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {keys.error ? (
            <ErrorState message={errorMessage(keys.error)} retry={() => keys.refetch()} />
          ) : keys.isLoading ? (
            <TableSkeleton rows={2} />
          ) : (keys.data ?? []).length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState>No API keys yet.</EmptyState>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>Name</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Key</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Scope</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Last used</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Expires</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>State</TableHead>
                  <TableHead />
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {(keys.data ?? []).map((k) => (
                  <TableRow key={k.id} data-testid="api-key-row">
                    <TableCell className="font-medium">{k.name}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{k.prefix}…</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-xs">{k.deployment_id ? `Deployment ${shortId(k.deployment_id)}` : 'All deployments'}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-xs">{ago(k.last_used_at)}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-xs">{dateTime(k.expires_at, 'Never')}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell>{state(k)}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right">
                      {!k.revoked_at && (
                        <ConfirmButton
                          size="sm"
                          variant="ghost"
                          confirmLabel="Revoke"
                          onConfirm={() =>
                            revoke.mutateAsync(k.id).then(
                              () => toast.success('Key revoked'),
                              (e) => toast.error(errorMessage(e)),
                            )
                          }
                        >
                          Revoke
                        </ConfirmButton>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button, buttonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { ConfirmButton } from '@/components/common/ConfirmButton';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useDeleteDeployment, useDeployments, useStopDeployment } from '@/hooks/useDeployments';
import { useCommunityModels, useModels } from '@/hooks/useModels';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { ago, runtimeLabel, shortId } from '@/lib/format';
import { TERMINAL_STATUSES } from '@/types';

export default function DeploymentsPage() {
  const { data, isLoading, error, refetch, isFetching } = useDeployments();
  const models = useModels();
  const community = useCommunityModels();
  const stop = useStopDeployment();
  const remove = useDeleteDeployment();
  const [showEnded, setShowEnded] = useState(false);

  if (isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (error) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error)} retry={() => refetch()} />;

  const all = data ?? [];
  const rows = showEnded ? all : all.filter((d) => !TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(d.status));
  const modelName = (id: string) => [...(models.data ?? []), ...(community.data ?? [])].find((m) => m.id === id)?.name;
  const act = (p: Promise<unknown>, ok: string) => p.then(() => toast.success(ok)).catch((e) => toast.error(errorMessage(e)));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Deployments"
        description="Each deployment is one model running on one provider node, with its own endpoint."
        actions={
          <>
            <Button variant="outline" size="icon" aria-label="Refresh" onClick={() => refetch()}>
              <RefreshCw className={isFetching ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
            </Button>
            <Link href="/customer/models" className={buttonVariants()}>
              New deployment
            </Link>
          </>
        }
      />
      <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        <input type="checkbox" checked={showEnded} onChange={(e) => setShowEnded(e.target.checked)} />
        Show stopped, failed and cancelled ({all.length - all.filter((d) => !TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(d.status)).length})
      </label>
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="pt-6">
          {rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState action={{ href: '/customer/models', label: 'Deploy a model' }}>No deployments to show.</EmptyState>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>Model</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Runtime</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Node</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Created</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {rows.map((d) => {
                  const ended = TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(d.status);
                  return (
                    <TableRow key={d.id} data-testid="deployment-row">
                      <TableCell>
                        <Link href={`/customer/deployments/${d.id}`} className="font-medium hover:underline">
                          {modelName(d.model_id) ?? d.model_tag ?? shortId(d.id)}
                        </Link>
                        <div className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{shortId(d.id)}</div>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{runtimeLabel(d.runtime)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <StatusBadge status={d.status} />
                        {d.error_code && <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-rose-500">{d.error_code}</div>}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{shortId(d.node_id)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{ago(d.created_at)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        {ended ? (
                          <ConfirmButton size="sm" variant="ghost" confirmLabel="Delete" onConfirm={() => act(remove.mutateAsync(d.id), 'Deployment deleted')}>
                            Delete
                          </ConfirmButton>
                        ) : (
                          d.status !== 'STOPPING' && (
                            <ConfirmButton size="sm" variant="ghost" confirmLabel="Stop" onConfirm={() => act(stop.mutateAsync(d.id), 'Stop requested')}>
                              Stop
                            </ConfirmButton>
                          )
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  );
                })}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { ApiExamples } from '@/components/deployments/ApiExamples';

import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';

  useDeleteDeployment,

  useStopDeployment,

import { IN_PROGRESS_STATUSES, TERMINAL_STATUSES } from '@/types';

export default function DeploymentDetailPage() {
  const id = useParams<{ id: string }>().id;
  const router = useRouter();
  const { data: dep, isLoading, error, refetch } = useDeployment(id);
  const live = !!dep && IN_PROGRESS_STATUSES.includes(dep.status);
  const events = useDeploymentEvents(id, live);
  const usage = useDeploymentUsage(id);
  const model = useModel(dep?.model_id ?? null);
  const charges = useCharges(id);
  const stop = useStopDeployment();
  const restart = useRestartDeployment();
  const remove = useDeleteDeployment();

  if (isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (error || !dep) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error, 'Deployment not found')} retry={() => refetch()} />;

  const ended = TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(dep.status);
  const act = (p: Promise<unknown>, ok: string) => p.then(() => toast.success(ok)).catch((e) => toast.error(errorMessage(e)));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title={model.data?.name ?? dep.model_tag ?? 'Deployment'}
        description={`Deployment ${dep.id}`}
        actions={
          <>
            {(dep.status === 'READY' || dep.status === 'UNHEALTHY') && (
              <Button variant="outline" disabled={restart.isPending} onClick={() => act(restart.mutateAsync(dep.id), 'Restart requested')}>
                Restart
              </Button>
            )}
            {!ended && dep.status !== 'STOPPING' && (
              <ConfirmButton confirmLabel="Stop deployment" onConfirm={() => act(stop.mutateAsync(dep.id), 'Stop requested')}>
                Stop
              </ConfirmButton>
            )}
            <ConfirmButton
              variant="outline"
              confirmLabel="Delete and revoke its keys"
              onConfirm={() =>
                remove.mutateAsync(dep.id).then(
                  () => {
                    toast.success('Deployment deleted');
                    router.push('/customer/deployments');
                  },
                  (e) => toast.error(errorMessage(e)),
                )
              }
            >
              Delete
            </ConfirmButton>
          </>
        }
      />

      <Card>
        <CardContent className="grid gap-4 pt-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
          <Field label="Status">
            <StatusBadge status={dep.status} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Runtime">{runtimeLabel(dep.runtime)}</Field>
          <Field label="Node">
            <span className="font-mono">{shortId(dep.node_id)}</span>
            {dep.schedule_attempts > 1 && <span className="text-muted-foreground"> · attempt {dep.schedule_attempts}</span>}
          </Field>
          <Field label={dep.ready_at ? 'Ready since' : 'Created'}>{dateTime(dep.ready_at ?? dep.created_at)}</Field>
          <Field label="Model reference">
            <span className="break-all font-mono text-xs">{dep.model_tag ?? '—'}</span>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Verified digest">
            <span className="break-all font-mono text-xs">{dep.model_digest ?? 'not yet'}</span>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Context window">{dep.config?.num_ctx?.toLocaleString() ?? '—'} tokens</Field>
          <Field label="Restarts">{dep.restart_count}</Field>
          <Field label="Charged so far">
            <span data-testid="cost-so-far">
              {charges.data ? money(sumAmounts(charges.data), charges.data[0]?.currency) : '—'}
            </span>
          </Field>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Notice tone={dep.status === 'FAILED' ? 'danger' : dep.status === 'UNHEALTHY' ? 'warning' : 'info'} title={dep.status}>
        {STATUS_HELP[dep.status]}
        {dep.error_message && (
          <span className="mt-1 block">
            <span className="font-mono text-xs">{dep.error_code}</span> {dep.error_message}
          </span>
        )}
      </Notice>

                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Ollama-native API (Ollama deployments only)</p>
                  <InlineValue value={dep.endpoint} />
                </div>
              )}
              <ApiExamples deployment={dep} />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>

            </CardHeader>

'use client';

import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useModel } from '@/hooks/useModels';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';

function NewDeployment() {
  const modelId = useSearchParams().get('model');
  const { data: model, isLoading, error } = useModel(modelId);

  if (!modelId) return <EmptyState action={{ href: '/customer/models', label: 'Choose a model' }}>No model selected.</EmptyState>;
  if (isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (error || !model) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error, 'Model not found')} />;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl space-y-6">
      <PageHeader title={`Deploy ${model.name}`} description="AgentMesh picks a node with enough free capacity and starts the model there." />
      {model.is_community && (
        <Notice tone="warning" title="Unreviewed community model">
          You imported this model from Hugging Face. It runs only on nodes whose providers accept community models, so
          there may be fewer nodes with room for it. Memory figures are estimated from the file size.
        </Notice>
      )}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Configuration</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            <Link href="/customer/models" className="underline underline-offset-4">
              Back to the catalog
            </Link>
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <DeployForm model={model} />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { ago, mb, runtimeLabel } from '@/lib/format';

export default function ModelCatalogPage() {
  const { data: models, isLoading, error, refetch } = useModels();
  const stats = usePublicStats();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return (models ?? []).filter((m) =>
      !q
        ? true
        : [m.name, m.family, m.publisher, m.parameter_size, ...m.artifacts.map((a) => a.reference)]
            .filter(Boolean)
            .some((v) => v!.toLowerCase().includes(q)),
    );
  }, [models, query]);

  if (isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (error) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error)} retry={() => refetch()} />;

  const online = stats.data?.runtimes_online ?? null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Model catalog"
        description="Open-weight models approved by AgentMesh operators. Each runtime serves a pinned copy of the model."
        actions={
          <div className="relative w-full sm:w-72">
            <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-2 size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              type="search"
              aria-label="Search models"
              placeholder="Search models"
              className="pl-8"
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        }
      />
      {stats.data && (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {stats.data.nodes_online} node{stats.data.nodes_online === 1 ? '' : 's'} accepting work now
          {online && online.length > 0 ? `, offering ${online.map(runtimeLabel).join(', ')}` : ''}. Being listed here
          does not guarantee a node has room for a model.
        </p>
      )}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState>{query ? 'No models match your search.' : 'No models are approved for deployment yet.'}</EmptyState>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          {filtered.map((m) => {
            const artifacts = deployableArtifacts(m.artifacts);
            const smallest = artifacts.reduce<number | null>((min, a) => (min == null || a.min_ram_mb < min ? a.min_ram_mb : min), null);
            const lastReady = artifacts.map((a) => a.last_ready_at).filter(Boolean).sort().at(-1);
            return (
              <Card key={m.id} className="flex flex-col" data-testid="model-card">
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle>{m.name}</CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription>
                    {[m.publisher, m.parameter_size && `${m.parameter_size} parameters`, m.license].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
                  </CardDescription>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="flex-1 space-y-3 text-sm">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                    {artifacts.map((a) => (
                      <Pill key={a.id} tone={online?.includes(a.runtime) ? 'green' : 'gray'}>
                        {runtimeLabel(a.runtime)}
                        {a.quantization ? ` ${a.quantization}` : ''}
                        {a.gpu_required ? ' · GPU' : ''}
                      </Pill>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-1 text-muted-foreground">
                    <dt>Smallest reservation</dt>
                    <dd className="text-right text-foreground">{smallest ? `${mb(smallest)} RAM` : '—'}</dd>
                    <dt>Context length</dt>
                    <dd className="text-right text-foreground">{m.context_length?.toLocaleString() ?? '—'}</dd>
                    <dt>Last served on AgentMesh</dt>
                    <dd className="text-right text-foreground">{lastReady ? ago(lastReady) : 'not yet'}</dd>
                  </dl>
                </CardContent>
                <CardFooter>
                  {artifacts.length > 0 ? (
                    <Link href={`/customer/deployments/new?model=${m.id}`} className={buttonVariants({ className: 'w-full' })}>
                      Configure and deploy
                    </Link>
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No runtime is enabled for this model.</p>
                  )}
                </CardFooter>
              </Card>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        Green runtimes are offered by at least one online node right now. Resource figures are estimates.
      </p>
      <CommunityModels />
    </div>
  );
}
