'use client';

import { Suspense, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { ChargesTable } from '@/components/billing/ChargesTable';
import { PricingCard } from '@/components/billing/PricingCard';
import { StatCard } from '@/components/common/StatCard';
import { Pill, StatusBadge } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { ErrorState, Notice, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useCharges, useCreateTopup, usePaymentsConfig, useTopups, useVerifyTopup } from '@/hooks/useBilling';
import { useAddTestCredits, useWallet } from '@/hooks/useWallet';
import { isPaystackCheckout, returnedReference, sumAmounts } from '@/lib/billing';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { dateTime, money } from '@/lib/format';

function Wallet() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const wallet = useWallet();
  const config = usePaymentsConfig();
  const topups = useTopups();
  const charges = useCharges();
  const createTopup = useCreateTopup();
  const verify = useVerifyTopup();
  const addCredits = useAddTestCredits();
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState('');
  const [testAmount, setTestAmount] = useState('1000');
  const verifiedRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  // Returning from Paystack checkout: ask the server to confirm with Paystack, then clean the URL.
  const reference = returnedReference(params);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!reference || verifiedRef.current === reference) return;
    verifiedRef.current = reference;
    verify.mutate(reference, {
      onSuccess: (p) => {
        if (p.status === 'SUCCEEDED') toast.success(`${money(p.amount, p.currency)} added to your wallet`);
        else if (p.status === 'INITIALIZED') toast('Payment not confirmed yet. It will be credited when Paystack confirms it.');
        else toast.error(`Payment ${p.status.toLowerCase()}${p.failure_reason ? `: ${p.failure_reason}` : ''}`);
        router.replace('/customer/wallet');
      },
      onError: (e) => toast.error(errorMessage(e)),
    });
  }, [reference, verify, router]);

  if (wallet.isLoading || config.isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (wallet.error || !wallet.data) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(wallet.error)} retry={() => wallet.refetch()} />;
  const cfg = config.data;
  const currency = wallet.data.currency;
  const spent = sumAmounts(charges.data ?? []);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader title="Wallet" description="Prepaid balance for your deployments." />
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <StatCard title="Balance" value={money(wallet.data.balance, currency)} hint={Number(wallet.data.balance) < 0 ? 'Top up to deploy again' : currency} />
        <StatCard title="Charged (recent)" value={money(spent, currency)} hint="Sum of the charges listed below" />
      </div>

      {cfg?.enabled ? (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              Add funds {cfg.mode === 'test' && <Pill tone="amber">Paystack test mode: no real money</Pill>}
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              You pay on Paystack&apos;s checkout page. Your balance is credited once Paystack confirms the payment.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <form
              className="flex max-w-md items-end gap-2"
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                createTopup.mutate(amount, {
                  onSuccess: (p) => {
                    if (isPaystackCheckout(p.authorization_url)) window.location.assign(p.authorization_url);
                    else toast.error('Paystack did not return a valid checkout link');
                  },
                  onError: (err) => toast.error(errorMessage(err)),
                });
              }}
            >
              <div className="flex-1 space-y-1">
                <label htmlFor="topup" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Amount ({cfg.currency}, {cfg.topup_min} to {cfg.topup_max})
                </label>
                <Input id="topup" type="number" min={cfg.topup_min} max={cfg.topup_max} step="0.01" value={amount} onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)} required />
              </div>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={createTopup.isPending || !amount}>
                {createTopup.isPending ? 'Opening Paystack…' : 'Pay with Paystack'}
              </Button>
            </form>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <Notice title="Card payments are not configured on this network">
          An operator must set a Paystack secret key before customers can add funds.
        </Notice>
      )}

      {cfg?.test_credits && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Add test credits</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Development environments only. Unpaid and without value.</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <form
              className="flex max-w-sm items-end gap-2"
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                addCredits.mutate(Number(testAmount), {
                  onSuccess: () => toast.success('Test credits added'),
                  onError: (err) => toast.error(errorMessage(err)),
                });
              }}
            >
              <Input aria-label="Test credit amount" type="number" min={1} value={testAmount} onChange={(e) => setTestAmount(e.target.value)} />
              <Button type="submit" variant="outline" disabled={addCredits.isPending}>
                Add test credits
              </Button>
            </form>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      <PricingCard />

      {(topups.data ?? []).length > 0 && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Top-ups</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>Date</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Reference</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
                  <TableHead />
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {(topups.data ?? []).map((p) => (
                  <TableRow key={p.id}>
                    <TableCell className="text-xs">{dateTime(p.created_at)}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{p.reference}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <StatusBadge status={p.status} />
                      {p.failure_reason && <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{p.failure_reason}</div>}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-xs">{money(p.amount, p.currency)}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right">
                      {p.status === 'INITIALIZED' && (
                        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={verify.isPending} onClick={() => verify.mutate(p.reference, { onError: (e) => toast.error(errorMessage(e)) })}>
                          Check status
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Recent charges</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <ChargesTable charges={charges.data ?? []} empty="No charges yet." />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function WalletPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<PageSkeleton />}>
      <Wallet />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

          ]}

        <P>

            'Maximum duration: the deployment is stopped when it is reached.',
            'Maximum CPU cores, memory, and GPU memory (0 = no GPU).',
            'Maximum automatic recovery attempts (platform ceiling 3).',
            'Allowed runtimes (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) and model sources (Ollama registry, Hugging Face).',

            'The memory figures for each variant are estimates.',
            'The end-to-end flow was tested with scripted model answers and a simulated worker tunnel, not with a real provider node running a model.',
          ]}
        />
      </Section>
    </DocPage>
  );
}

        />
        <Code
          title="Sign in and keep the token"
          code={`JWT=$(curl -s -X POST ${API_URL}/auth/login \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"email": "you@example.com", "password": "your-password"}' | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["access_token"])')`}
        />
        <P>
          Register with <C>POST /auth/register</C> and <C>{'{"email", "password", "role"}'}</C>, where <C>role</C> is <C>customer</C> or{' '}
          <C>provider</C> and the password has at least 8 characters. Both endpoints return <C>access_token</C> and the <C>user</C>. Send the token
          as <C>Authorization: Bearer $JWT</C>. <C>GET /auth/me</C> returns the signed-in user. Login and registration are rate limited (429 with{' '}
          <C>Retry-After</C>).
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="models" title="Models">
        <Code code={`curl ${API_URL}/models`} />
        <P>
          Lists approved models. Each has <C>artifacts</C>: one per runtime that can serve it, pinned to an Ollama tag or a Hugging Face commit, with
          estimated <C>min_ram_mb</C>, <C>min_disk_mb</C>, <C>min_vram_mb</C> and <C>gpu_required</C>. <C>last_ready_at</C> shows when a deployment of
          it last passed its readiness test. <C>GET /models/&#123;id&#125;</C> returns one model.
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="deployments" title="Deployments">
        <Code
          title="Create"
          code={`curl -X POST ${API_URL}/deployments \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $JWT" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model_id": "<model-id>", "config": {"num_ctx": 4096}, "idempotency_key": "my-retry-key"}'`}
        />
        <List
          items={[
            <>Add <C>&quot;runtime&quot;: &quot;ollama&quot;</C> (or <C>llamacpp</C>, <C>vllm</C>) to choose one; otherwise they are tried in that order.</>,
            <><C>config</C> accepts only <C>num_ctx</C> (512–8192), <C>region</C> and <C>require_gpu</C>. Anything else is rejected.</>,
            <>Retrying with the same <C>idempotency_key</C> returns the same deployment.</>,
            <>No node available: <C>503</C> with <C>{'{"detail": {"code": "no_eligible_node", "reasons": {...}, "by_runtime": {...}}}'}</C>.</>,
            <>Not enough balance: <C>402</C> with <C>{'{"detail": {"code": "insufficient_balance", "required": ..., "balance": ...}}'}</C>.</>,
          ]}
        />
        <Table
          head={['Method and path', 'Purpose']}
          rows={[
            [<C key="1">GET /deployments</C>, 'Your deployments.'],
            [<C key="2">GET /deployments/&#123;id&#125;</C>, <>One deployment. Poll until <C>status</C> is <C>READY</C>; it then has <C>openai_base_url</C> and <C>endpoint</C>.</>],
            [<C key="3">GET /deployments/&#123;id&#125;/events</C>, 'Lifecycle events (progress, moves, errors).'],
            [<C key="4">POST /deployments/&#123;id&#125;/stop</C>, 'Stop it.'],
            [<C key="5">POST /deployments/&#123;id&#125;/restart</C>, 'Reload it on its current node from the cached model.'],
            [<C key="6">DELETE /deployments/&#123;id&#125;</C>, 'Stop, hide, and revoke its scoped keys. Usage records are kept.'],
          ]}
        />
        <P>
          Statuses: <C>SCHEDULED</C> → <C>PROVISIONING</C> → <C>STARTING</C> → <C>READY</C>, plus <C>UNHEALTHY</C>, <C>STOPPING</C>, <C>STOPPED</C>,{' '}
          <C>CANCELLED</C> and <C>FAILED</C> (with <C>error_code</C> and <C>error_message</C>). See the{' '}
          <A href="/docs/customers#lifecycle">customer guide</A> for what each means.
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="api-keys" title="API keys">
        <Code
          code={`curl -X POST ${API_URL}/api-keys -H "Authorization: Bearer $JWT" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name": "my-app", "deployment_id": "<deployment-id>"}'`}
        />
        <P>
          The <C>key</C> is returned once. Omit <C>deployment_id</C> to allow all your deployments. <C>GET /api-keys</C> lists keys (without
          secrets); <C>DELETE /api-keys/&#123;id&#125;</C> revokes one.
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="inference" title="Inference">
        <P>
          Every deployment has <C>openai_base_url</C>, <C>…/deployments/&#123;id&#125;/v1</C>, which works for every runtime: <C>/chat/completions</C>,{' '}
          <C>/completions</C> and <C>/models</C>.
        </P>
        <Code
          code={`curl ${DEP}/v1/chat/completions \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMESH_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model": "any", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}'`}
        />
        <H3>Ollama&apos;s native API</H3>
        <P>
          Ollama deployments also expose <C>endpoint</C>, <C>…/deployments/&#123;id&#125;/ollama</C>, with <C>/api/chat</C> and <C>/api/generate</C>.
          Calling it on a llama.cpp or vLLM deployment returns 404. Model-management routes (<C>api/pull</C>, <C>api/delete</C>, …) are never exposed.
        </P>
        <Code
          code={`curl ${DEP}/ollama/api/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMESH_API_KEY" \\
  -d '{"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}'`}
        />
        <H3>Behaviour to know</H3>
        <List
          items={[
            <>The <C>model</C> field is always replaced with the deployment&apos;s model.</>,
            <>For Ollama, <C>keep_alive</C> is ignored and <C>options.num_ctx</C> is set to the deployment&apos;s context size.</>,
            'Prompts and responses pass through the provider’s machine and are not stored by AgentMesh.',
          ]}
        />
      </Section>

      <Section id="streaming" title="Streaming">
        <P>
          Set <C>&quot;stream&quot;: true</C> for server-sent events on <C>/v1</C>. AgentMesh adds <C>stream_options.include_usage</C> unless you set it, so the
          final chunk carries a <C>usage</C> object used for metering. The Ollama native API streams NDJSON.
        </P>
        <Code
          code={`curl -N ${DEP}/v1/chat/completions \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMESH_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model": "any", "stream": true, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Write a haiku"}]}'`}
        />
      </Section>

      <Section id="sdks" title="SDK examples">
        <P>Any OpenAI-compatible client works. Point its base URL at your deployment.</P>
        <Code
          title="Python: pip install openai"
          code={`import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="${API_URL}/deployments/<deployment-id>/v1",
    api_key=os.environ["AGENTMESH_API_KEY"],
)

stream = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="any",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain DNS in one paragraph"}],
    stream=True,
)
for chunk in stream:
    if chunk.choices and chunk.choices[0].delta.content:
        print(chunk.choices[0].delta.content, end="", flush=True)`}
        />
        <Code
          title="JavaScript / TypeScript: npm install openai"
          code={`import OpenAI from 'openai';

const client = new OpenAI({
  baseURL: '${API_URL}/deployments/<deployment-id>/v1',
  apiKey: process.env.AGENTMESH_API_KEY,
});

const reply = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'any',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }],
});
console.log(reply.choices[0].message.content);`}
        />
        <Callout tone="warning">
          Keep API keys on your server. Do not ship them in browser or mobile code.
        </Callout>
      </Section>

      <Section id="errors" title="Errors and limits">
        <P>
          Gateway errors use <C>{'{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}'}</C>. Account endpoints use FastAPI&apos;s <C>{'{"detail": ...}'}</C>.
        </P>
        <Table
          head={['Code', 'Meaning', 'What to do']}
          rows={[
            [<C key="1">unauthorized</C>, '401: missing, wrong, expired or revoked credentials.', 'Check the key.'],
            [<C key="2">deployment_not_found</C>, '404: no such deployment for you, or the key is scoped to a different deployment.', 'Check the id and the key’s scope.'],
            [<C key="3">deployment_not_ready</C>, '409: still starting, or moving to another node.', 'Retry with backoff.'],
            [<C key="4">deployment_unhealthy</C>, '503: health checks failing.', 'Retry with backoff; it moves after 3 minutes.'],
            [<C key="5">node_unavailable</C>, '503: the node went away.', 'Retry with backoff; failover is automatic.'],
            [<C key="6">rate_limited</C>, '429: over 60 requests per minute per key.', <>Honour <C key="r">Retry-After</C>.</>],
            [<C key="6b">too_many_concurrent_requests</C>, '429: the deployment already has 4 requests in flight.', 'Retry shortly, or deploy another replica of the model.'],
            [<C key="6c">timeout</C>, '504: the runtime did not start responding in time.', 'Retry; try a smaller prompt or model.'],
            [<C key="7">request_too_large</C>, '413: body over 1 MB.', 'Send less.'],
            [<C key="8">unsupported_endpoint</C>, '404: route not served by this runtime.', <>Use <C key="v">/v1</C>.</>],
          ]}
        />
        <P>Limits apply per control-plane process.</P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="usage" title="Usage and billing">
        <Table
          head={['Method and path', 'Returns']}
          rows={[
            [<C key="1">GET /usage/&#123;deployment_id&#125;</C>, <>One record per request: endpoint, status, duration, bytes, token counts. Newest 200 by default (<C>?limit=</C> up to 1000).</>],
            [<C key="2">GET /usage/summary?days=30</C>, 'Requests, successes, failures and tokens per day and per deployment (1–90 days).'],
            [<C key="3">GET /billing/pricing</C>, 'The price list in force.'],
            [<C key="4">GET /billing/charges?deployment_id=…</C>, 'What each billing window cost.'],
            [<C key="5">GET /wallets</C>, 'Your balance.'],
            [<C key="6">POST /payments/topups</C>, <>Start a Paystack checkout (test mode): <C>{'{"amount": 5000}'}</C>.</>],
            [<C key="7">GET /stats/public</C>, 'Network counts; no authentication.'],
          ]}
        />
        <P>
          Token counts are <C>runtime_reported</C>: they come from the provider&apos;s machine and are not independently verified. When the runtime does
          not report them they are <C>null</C>; they are never estimated.
        </P>
      </Section>
    </DocPage>
  );
}

import { A, C, Callout, DocPage, List, P, Section, StatusPill, Table } from '@/components/docs/DocsContent';

            ['Developers', 'Integrate deployments with the API and OpenAI SDKs.', <A key="a" href="/docs/api">API reference</A>],
            ['Operators', 'Run the network: catalog, prices, payouts, monitoring. Or self-host a separate instance.', <A key="o" href="/docs/operators">Operator guide</A>],

              be both a customer and a provider.
            </>,

          head={['Area', 'Status', 'Notes']}

            ['Deploying approved models on Ollama or llama.cpp, OpenAI-compatible API with streaming', <StatusPill key="1" status="working" />, 'Verified end to end on real models.'],

            ['Installable worker on macOS', <StatusPill key="5" status="unverified" />, 'Service files are generated and unit-tested but not run on a Mac. Resource limits are advisory on macOS.'],
            ['Docker worker', <StatusPill key="6" status="unverified" />, 'Unit-tested with a fake Docker client; not yet run against a real Docker daemon.'],
            ['Prebuilt worker downloads (GitHub Releases)', <StatusPill key="7" status="planned" />, <>The release workflow exists; downloads work once the first <C>worker-v*</C> release is published on <A href={RELEASES_URL}>GitHub Releases</A>.</>],
            ['vLLM on GPU nodes', <StatusPill key="8" status="unverified" />, 'Built and unit-tested; not run on real GPU hardware.'],
            ['Prepaid billing, Paystack top-ups, provider payouts, reconciliation', <StatusPill key="9" status="test-mode" />, 'Paystack test mode only. Verified against a stand-in for Paystack’s API, not yet against Paystack itself.'],
            ['Live (real-money) payments', <StatusPill key="10" status="planned" />, <>Needs a live key, <C>PAYSTACK_ALLOW_LIVE=true</C>, and a review.</>],
            ['Confidential computing', <StatusPill key="11" status="planned" />, 'Not implemented. Providers can see the data their machines process.'],
          ]}
        />
        <Callout tone="warning" title="Trust model">
          Deployments run on computers owned by independent providers. A provider can inspect the model files, the process memory,
          and every prompt and response its node handles. Do not send confidential data to community nodes. See{' '}
          <A href="/docs/security">Security &amp; limitations</A>.
        </Callout>
      </Section>

      <Section id="links" title="Live links">
        <Table
          head={['What', 'URL']}
          rows={[
            ['Dashboard', <A key="d" href="/login">{DASHBOARD_URL}</A>],
            ['Provider registration', <A key="r" href="/register?role=provider">{`${DASHBOARD_URL}/register?role=provider`}</A>],
            ['API base URL', <C key="a">{API_URL}</C>],
            ['Interactive API reference (OpenAPI)', <A key="o" href={`${API_URL}/docs`}>{`${API_URL}/docs`}</A>],
            ['Worker releases', <A key="w" href={RELEASES_URL}>{RELEASES_URL}</A>],
            ['Source code', <A key="s" href={REPO_URL}>{REPO_URL}</A>],
          ]}
        />
      </Section>

            [<C key="8">METRICS_TOKEN</C>, 'Bearer token for GET /metrics; empty disables it.'],
            [<C key="9">MIGRATE_ON_STARTUP</C>, 'Default true: the API applies database migrations when it starts (PostgreSQL only).'],
            [<C key="10">NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL</C>, 'Dashboard build setting: your API’s /api/v1 URL. Baked in at build time.'],
          ]}
        />
        <P>
          <C>.env.example</C> lists the minimum set. Billing intervals, payment limits and rate limits have sensible defaults; see{' '}
          <C>server/app/core/config.py</C> and <C>docs/OPERATIONS.md</C> for every setting.
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="deploy" title="Deploy">
        <P>Either run the whole stack with Docker Compose:</P>
        <Code
          code={`git clone ${REPO_URL}.git && cd AgentMeshh
export SECRET_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
export PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://api.example.com FRONTEND_URL=https://app.example.com
docker compose up -d`}
        />
        <P>
          or deploy the parts separately: the API from <C>Dockerfile.server</C> (or <C>uvicorn app.main:app</C> in <C>server/</C>) on any host with
          PostgreSQL, and the dashboard from <C>client/</C> on Vercel with <C>NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL</C> set. Put the API behind TLS, run uvicorn with{' '}
          <C>--proxy-headers</C>, and restrict <C>--forwarded-allow-ips</C> to your proxy. Change the default database credentials in{' '}
          <C>docker-compose.yml</C>.
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="migrations" title="Database migrations">
        <P>
          With PostgreSQL, the API runs <C>alembic upgrade head</C> on startup, holding a database lock so several replicas cannot migrate at once.
          If a migration fails, the API does not start. To run them yourself instead, set <C>MIGRATE_ON_STARTUP=false</C> and run:
        </P>
        <Code code="cd server && alembic upgrade head" />

        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="first-operator" title="First operator">

python scripts/create_operator.py lead@example.com --role admin`}

          Operator accounts have no multi-factor authentication yet; protect them carefully.
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="catalog" title="Model catalog">
        <P>
          Under <strong>Model Catalog</strong>, approve models and enable or disable their artifacts (one per runtime). New catalog entries start
          unapproved. Adding an artifact, which needs a pinned source (an Ollama tag, or a Hugging Face commit and, for llama.cpp, a file SHA-256),
          is done with <C>POST /models/&#123;id&#125;/artifacts</C>; there is no dashboard form for it yet.
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="pricing" title="Pricing">
        <P>
          Under <strong>Pricing</strong>, publish an immutable price version, effective now or later: CPU core-hour, memory GB-hour, GPU-memory
          GB-hour, input and output tokens per million, and the platform fee. Until a price list exists, usage is measured but not charged. You
          can set token prices to zero to charge for resources only.
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="paystack" title="Payments (Paystack)">
        <Callout tone="warning" title="Test mode only">
          AgentMesh uses Paystack test mode unless a live key is explicitly allowed. It has been verified against a stand-in for Paystack&apos;s
          API but not against Paystack itself. Run the smoke script below before relying on it.
        </Callout>
        <List
          ordered
          items={[
            <>In the Paystack dashboard (test mode), copy the secret key into <C>PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY</C> and set the webhook URL to <C>https://&lt;your-api&gt;/api/v1/payments/paystack/webhook</C>.</>,
            <>Check the integration against Paystack&apos;s real test API: <C>PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_... python scripts/paystack_smoke.py</C> (add <C>--pay</C> to pay with a test card).</>,
            'Make a top-up from the dashboard and confirm that the webhook arrives: Reconciliation should show no open top-ups, and Ledger should show the deposit.',
            <>Payouts use Paystack Transfers: they need a funded balance and transfer OTP turned off, or they stop at <C>OTP_REQUIRED</C>.</>,
          ]}
        />
        <P>
          Top-ups are credited once, only after Paystack reports success with a matching amount and currency. Payouts are held at request time and
          need operator approval (<strong>Payouts</strong>). Reconciliation runs every 10 minutes when payments are enabled.
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="monitoring" title="Monitoring">
        <Table
          head={['Endpoint', 'Use']}
          rows={[
            [<C key="1">GET /health</C>, 'Liveness.'],
            [<C key="2">GET /health/ready</C>, 'Database (and Redis) readiness; 503 if either fails. Use for load balancers.'],
            [<C key="3">GET /metrics</C>, <>Prometheus, with <C>Authorization: Bearer $METRICS_TOKEN</C>.</>],
            [<C key="4">GET /api/v1/admin/overview</C>, 'Operator dashboard figures, including nodes with overdue heartbeats.'],
            [<C key="5">GET /api/v1/admin/reconciliation</C>, 'Ledger invariants and open payment items.'],
          ]}
        />
        <P>
          Logs are JSON lines with a request id; API keys, node credentials, bearer tokens and Paystack keys are redacted. Alert on readiness
          failing, rising 5xx, payouts stuck <C>PENDING</C> or <C>OTP_REQUIRED</C>, reconciliation reporting <C>ok: false</C>, and{' '}

      </Section>

      <Section id="backups" title="Backups and recovery">
        <Code

DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://… KEEP=14 ops/backup_db.sh /var/backups/agentmesh
DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://…/agentmesh_restore ops/restore_db.sh /var/backups/agentmesh/agentmesh-<ts>.dump`}
        />
        <List
          items={[

            'After a restore: point DATABASE_URL at it, start the API (migrations run), then run reconciliation to re-check open top-ups and payouts with Paystack.',
            'API restarts lose nothing: workers reconnect and billing resumes from each deployment’s watermark without double charging.',
            'Never refund a pending payout by hand; the transfer may still complete. Ledger corrections and refunds need a code path that does not exist yet.',

            <>Commit, then tag and push: <C>git tag worker-v0.3.0 && git push origin worker-v0.3.0</C>.</>,
            <>The <C>Worker release</C> workflow checks the tag matches, builds the wheel, checks it installs, writes <C>SHA256SUMS</C>, and creates the GitHub release with the wheel, <C>install.sh</C>, <C>uninstall.sh</C> and <C>SHA256SUMS</C>.</>,
            'Redeploy the dashboard so Add a machine points at the new version.',

import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { A, C, Callout, Code, DocPage, H3, List, P, Section, Table } from '@/components/docs/DocsContent';
import { ReleaseStatus } from '@/components/docs/ReleaseStatus';
import { API_URL, RELEASES_URL, WORKER_VERSION } from '@/lib/config';
import {
  WORKER_BIN,
  agentInstallCommand,
  dockerInstallCommand,

  statusCommand,
  uninstallCommand,
  workerTag,
  workerWheel,

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Provider guide' };

export default function ProviderGuide() {
  return (
    <DocPage href="/docs/providers">
      <Section id="how-it-works" title="How hosting works">
        <P>
          The AgentMesh worker runs open-weight models on your machine for customers&apos; deployments. It connects <strong>outbound</strong> to
          the control plane over HTTPS and a WebSocket, so you do not open any ports. You earn a share of what customers pay while your
          node serves their deployments.
        </P>
        <List
          items={[
            'It only uses the CPU, memory, disk and GPU you allocate. Defaults are half your CPU cores and RAM, at most 20 GB of disk, and no GPU.',
            'It never touches your own Ollama install: not port 11434, not ~/.ollama, not your models. Workloads get their own port, model directory and process.',
            'It never runs commands from customers. The control plane can only ask it to deploy an approved model with set limits, or to stop one.',
            'Hardware reports contain CPU model, cores, RAM, free disk, OS, architecture, and GPU model and VRAM. Nothing else is uploaded.',
          ]}
        />
        <Callout tone="warning" title="You can see customer data">
          As the machine owner you can inspect model files, process memory, and the prompts and responses your node handles. Customers are
          told this. Do not use your machine to inspect their data.
        </Callout>
      </Section>

      <Section id="prerequisites" title="Prerequisites">
        <Table
          head={['', 'Installable agent', 'Docker worker']}
          rows={[
            ['OS', 'Linux or macOS', 'Linux (Docker Engine 24+)'],
            ['Software', <>Python 3.11+ with <C>venv</C> (Debian/Ubuntu: <C>apt install python3-venv</C>), <A href="https://ollama.com/download">Ollama</A>, <C>curl</C></>, <>Docker Engine 24+ with Compose; NVIDIA Container Toolkit for GPUs; <C>git</C></>],
            ['Rights', 'No admin rights; installs for your user only', 'Access to the Docker socket (root-equivalent)'],
            ['Network', 'Outbound HTTPS to the control plane, GitHub and PyPI; Hugging Face/Ollama registry for models', 'Same'],
            ['Status', 'Verified on Linux; macOS not yet run on a real Mac', 'Not yet run against a real Docker daemon'],
          ]}
        />
      </Section>

      <Section id="enroll" title="Create an enrollment token">
        <List
          ordered
          items={[
            <>Sign up at <A href="/register?role=provider">provider registration</A> (or sign in).</>,
            <>Open <A href="/provider/nodes/register">Add a machine</A>, optionally name the machine and its region, and press <strong>Create token</strong>.</>,
            'The token works once and expires after 60 minutes. Create a new one for each machine. The page fills it into the install command for you.',
          ]}
        />
        <P>With the API, using your provider sign-in token:</P>
        <Code
          code={`curl -X POST ${API_URL}/nodes/enrollment-tokens \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROVIDER_JWT" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name": "my-box"}'`}
        />
      </Section>

      <Section id="install-release" title="Install from a GitHub release">
        <ReleaseStatus />
        <P>
          Each worker release on <A href={RELEASES_URL}>GitHub Releases</A> is tagged <C>{workerTag()}</C> and contains{' '}
          <C>{workerWheel()}</C>, <C>install.sh</C>, <C>uninstall.sh</C> and <C>SHA256SUMS</C>. The command below downloads the release into{' '}
          <C>~/agentmesh-worker-{WORKER_VERSION}</C>, verifies every file against <C>SHA256SUMS</C> (stopping if any does not match), and only
          then runs the installer. Paste your token in place of <C>&lt;enrollment-token&gt;</C>; it is passed to the installer only, never put in
          a URL.
        </P>
        <Code title="Linux and macOS" code={agentInstallCommand()} />
        <P>The installer:</P>
        <List
          ordered
          items={[
            'checks your OS, Python and Ollama;',
            <>creates a private Python environment in <C>~/.local/share/agentmesh/venv-agentmesh-worker</C> and installs the wheel (its dependencies come from PyPI);</>,
            <>writes <C>~/.config/agentmesh/agentmesh-worker.env</C> with permissions 0600;</>,
            'enrolls the machine with the one-time token;',
            'starts a per-user background service: a systemd user unit on Linux, a launchd agent on macOS.',
          ]}
        />
        <H3>Useful options</H3>
        <Table
          head={['Option', 'Effect']}
          rows={[
            [<C key="1">--max-ram-mb / --max-cpu / --max-disk-mb</C>, 'The most AgentMesh will ever reserve on this machine.'],
            [<C key="2">--schedule &quot;mon-fri 18:00-08:00&quot;</C>, 'Only take work in these local-time windows. Also “weekends 00:00-24:00”, “daily 22:00-07:00”.'],
            [<C key="3">--outside-schedule pause|drain</C>, 'Outside the schedule, keep running deployments (pause, default) or move them away (drain).'],
            [<C key="4">--linger</C>, 'Linux: keep the worker running while you are logged out.'],
            [<C key="5">--no-service</C>, <>Do not install a service; run <C>agentmesh-worker run</C> under your own supervisor.</>],
            [<C key="6">--update-public-key KEY</C>, 'Pin the operator’s release-signing key so signed self-updates are accepted.'],
            [<><C>--token</C> omitted</>, 'The installer prompts for the token without echoing it.'],
          ]}
        />
        <Callout title="What the checksum protects against">
          <C>SHA256SUMS</C> comes from the same release, so it catches corrupted or partial downloads, not a compromised GitHub account. Signed
          self-updates (below) use an offline key that GitHub never sees.
        </Callout>
        <P>
          On Linux, each model runs in its own systemd scope with hard memory and CPU limits. On macOS the limits are advisory: the scheduler
          never reserves more than you allow, but the OS does not enforce it.
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="install-source" title="Install from source">

      </Section>

      <Section id="docker" title="Docker worker">
        <P>
          The Docker worker runs each deployment in its own container. It needs the Compose file from the repository, so it uses a checkout
          rather than the release downloads.
        </P>
        <Code code={dockerInstallCommand()} />
        <Callout tone="danger" title="Docker socket access is root-equivalent">
          The worker needs the Docker socket to create workload containers, which is equivalent to root on the host. Prefer rootless Docker
          and a machine dedicated to this purpose. Workload containers never get the socket.
        </Callout>
        <P>Each workload container runs with:</P>
        <List
          items={[

            'all Linux capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, and a read-only root filesystem;',
            'no host bind mounts, only the agentmesh-models volume;',
            'a private network with no internet access once the model is downloaded;',

          ]}
        />
        <P>
          Known gaps: the Docker worker has not yet been run against a real Docker daemon, and it does not detect GPUs inside its container,

        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="status-checks" title="Check the worker">

          The machine appears under <A href="/provider/nodes">My Nodes</A> a few seconds after it enrolls. On the machine
          (installable agent), the worker command lives in its private environment:
        </P>
        <Code code={statusCommand} />
        <Table
          head={['Platform', 'Service status and logs']}
          rows={[
            ['Linux', <pre key="l" className="whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono text-xs">{serviceLogCommands.linux}</pre>],
            ['macOS', <pre key="m" className="whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono text-xs">{serviceLogCommands.macos}</pre>],
          ]}
        />
        <P>
          <C>doctor</C> checks the platform, Python, config, control plane, credential, Ollama, resource limits, disk, memory, GPUs and schedule,
          and prints a fix for each problem. <C>doctor --deep</C> also starts a throwaway Ollama instance.
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="manage" title="Manage machines">
        <Table
          head={['Action', 'Where', 'Effect']}
          rows={[
            ['Pause new work', 'Dashboard, or worker pause', 'No new placements; running deployments keep serving.'],
            ['Drain', <C key="d">{`${WORKER_BIN.split('/').pop()} drain`}</C>, 'Stop taking work and stop running deployments; AgentMesh moves them to other nodes when possible.'],
            ['Resume', 'Dashboard, or worker resume', 'Take work again (within your schedule). Dashboard and local pause are independent; both must be off.'],
            ['Revoke', 'Dashboard', 'Disables the node’s credential at once; deployments move elsewhere when possible.'],
          ]}
        />
        <P>
          A node is shown as <strong>Accepting work</strong>, <strong>Paused</strong>, <strong>Unavailable</strong> (paused, draining or outside its
          schedule on the machine), <strong>Offline</strong> (no heartbeats) or <strong>Revoked</strong>. The node page shows each runtime the worker
          reported, whether its limits are enforced or advisory, how much of your allocation is reserved, and the last reported load.
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="community-models" title="Community models (opt-in)">

        </P>
        <List
          items={[

            'What the model generates is not reviewed.',
            'Turning it off stops new placements. Community deployments already running keep running until they stop or move.',
          ]}

      <Section id="earnings" title="Earnings and payouts">
        <Callout tone="warning" title="Paystack test mode">Payouts run through Paystack in test mode. No real money is transferred yet.</Callout>

          items={[

            'The amount is held from your balance at once. An operator approves the payout and Paystack transfers it. A failed or rejected payout returns the money.',
            'Served Usage shows the requests your nodes answered.',
          ]}

      <Section id="troubleshooting" title="Troubleshooting">
        <P>Start with <C>agentmesh-worker doctor</C> (see <A href="#status-checks">Check the worker</A>).</P>
        <Table
          head={['Problem', 'What to do']}
          rows={[
            ['python3 venv module missing', <><C key="a">sudo apt install python3-venv</C> (Debian/Ubuntu), then rerun the installer.</>],
            ['Ollama not found', <>Install it from <A href="https://ollama.com/download">ollama.com/download</A>, or pass <C>--ollama /path/to/ollama</C>.</>],
            ['…agentmesh-worker.env already exists', <>A worker with that name is installed. Run <C>./uninstall.sh</C> first, or use <C>--name</C> for a second worker.</>],
            ['sha256sum: … FAILED', 'A download is corrupt or incomplete. Delete the folder and download again; do not run install.sh.'],
            ['Enrollment fails', 'Tokens work once and expire after 60 minutes. Create a new token in the dashboard.'],
            ['Node shows Offline', <>Check the service status and logs above, and that the machine can reach <C>{API_URL.replace('/api/v1', '')}</C>.</>],
          ]}
        />
        <Table
          head={['Deployment error', 'Meaning']}
          rows={[
            [<C key="1">INSUFFICIENT_DISK / INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY</C>, 'The machine does not currently have the reserved resources free. Lower your allocation if it happens often.'],
            [<C key="2">MODEL_PULL_FAILED / MODEL_PULL_STALLED</C>, 'Download failed. Transient errors are retried 3 times first.'],
            [<C key="3">MODEL_INTEGRITY_FAILED</C>, 'The downloaded file did not match the catalog’s SHA-256 or size; it was deleted.'],
            [<C key="4">HEALTHCHECK_FAILED</C>, <>The model could not answer a test prompt. Check the log in the data directory&apos;s <C>logs/</C>.</>],
            [<C key="5">RUNTIME_START_FAILED</C>, 'Ollama (or the container) did not start.'],
            [<C key="6">NODE_UNAVAILABLE</C>, 'You paused or drained the machine, or its schedule ended. The deployment moves elsewhere if possible.'],
          ]}
        />
      </Section>

      <Section id="uninstall" title="Uninstall">
        <Code title="Installable agent" code={uninstallCommand()} />
        <P>
          This stops the service and every managed workload, and deletes the credential, config, private environment and (with{' '}
          <C>--purge-models</C>) downloaded models. Your own Ollama is left untouched. For the Docker worker run{' '}
          <C>docker compose -f docker-compose.worker.yml down -v</C>. Then revoke the node in the dashboard.
        </P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="releases" title="How worker releases are made">
        <P>
          Releases are built by GitHub Actions when a maintainer pushes a tag <C>worker-v&lt;version&gt;</C> matching <C>WORKER_VERSION</C> in{' '}
          <C>server/node_agent/config.py</C>. The workflow builds the wheel reproducibly, checks it installs, writes <C>SHA256SUMS</C>, and attaches
          the assets to the release. See <A href="/docs/operators#worker-releases">Publishing worker releases</A>.
        </P>
        <P>
          Signed self-updates are separate: operators sign release manifests with an offline Ed25519 key, and workers installed with{' '}
          <C>--update-public-key</C> accept only releases signed by it, so even a compromised control plane cannot push code to your machine.
          That key is never stored in GitHub Actions.
        </P>
      </Section>
    </DocPage>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { TrustNotice } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { A, C, Callout, DocPage, List, P, Section, StatusPill, Table } from '@/components/docs/DocsContent';
import { REPO_URL } from '@/lib/config';

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Security & limitations' };

export default function SecurityGuide() {
  return (
    <DocPage href="/docs/security">
      <Section id="trust-model" title="Trust model">
        <TrustNotice />
        <P>
          AgentMesh runs models on computers owned by independent providers. Container and process isolation protect the{' '}
          <em>provider&apos;s</em> machine from the workload; they do not protect the workload from the provider. A provider can read the model files,
          the process memory, and every prompt and response their node handles. Confidential computing (hardware-isolated nodes with attestation) is
          not implemented.
        </P>
        <P>Use community nodes only for data you would be comfortable sharing with a stranger.</P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="data" title="What data is stored">
        <Table
          head={['Data', 'Stored?']}
          rows={[
            ['Prompts and responses', 'No. They are not stored or logged by AgentMesh (they do pass through the provider’s machine).'],
            ['Per-request usage', 'Yes: endpoint, status, duration, response bytes, token counts and a request id.'],
            ['API keys and node credentials', 'Only as hashes. API keys are shown once.'],
            ['Passwords', 'Only as password hashes.'],
            ['Bank accounts (providers)', 'Only the last four digits; Paystack holds the rest.'],
            ['Paystack webhook payloads', 'No. They contain customer contact and card details.'],
            ['Provider hardware', 'CPU model and cores, RAM, free disk, OS, architecture, GPU model and VRAM. Public statistics show counts only.'],
          ]}
        />
        <P>Logs redact API keys, node credentials, bearer tokens and Paystack keys.</P>
      </Section>

      <Section id="worker-safety" title="Worker safety for providers">
        <List
          items={[
            'The worker only accepts “deploy an approved model with these limits” and “stop” from the control plane, and validates both. It never runs customer commands.',
            'Model weights come only from allowed hosts (Ollama registry, Hugging Face), pinned to exact versions and checked by digest; every redirect is checked.',
            'Workloads use their own ports, model directories and processes; your own Ollama install is never used or modified.',
            'On Linux, each workload runs in a systemd user scope with hard memory and CPU limits. On macOS limits are advisory.',
            'Signed self-updates accept only releases signed with the operator’s offline key, so a compromised control plane cannot push code.',
            <>The Docker worker needs the Docker socket, which is <strong>root-equivalent</strong> on the host. Prefer rootless Docker on a dedicated machine.</>,
          ]}
        />
      </Section>

      <Section id="controls" title="Platform controls">
        <List
          items={[
            'Login and registration are rate limited per client address and per email.',
            'Production startup refuses insecure settings: weak SECRET_KEY, wildcard CORS, non-https public URL, or an unapproved live Paystack key.',
            'Security headers on the API and dashboard (nosniff, frame denial, referrer policy; HSTS on the API in production).',
            'Paystack webhooks are checked with an HMAC-SHA512 signature in constant time, processed once, and credited only on matching amount and currency.',
            'All balance changes go through ledger entries with idempotency keys; reconciliation checks balances against the ledger.',
            'The dashboard redirects to checkout only on Paystack’s own domain.',
            'Billable output tokens are capped by the response bytes the gateway counted itself.',
          ]}
        />
      </Section>

      <Section id="risks" title="Known risks">
        <P>These are recorded in the project&apos;s security review and are not fixed yet:</P>
        <List
          items={[
            'Token counts come from the provider’s machine. The byte cap bounds output-token inflation but does not prevent it; input tokens are not bounded.',
            'A provider could keep a broken runtime “READY”: customers see failed requests, but resource time is still charged. Refunds need a ledger correction feature that does not exist yet.',
            'Session tokens are kept in the browser’s localStorage and there is no Content-Security-Policy yet, so an XSS bug could steal a session.',
            'No multi-factor authentication for anyone, including operators who approve payouts.',
            'Per-email login throttling lets someone who knows your address delay your sign-in by up to a minute.',
            'Customer balances can go below zero by up to one billing interval before deployments stop.',
            'The audit log is not tamper-evident, and secrets live in environment variables rather than a secret manager.',
          ]}
        />
      </Section>

      <Section id="not-verified" title="Not yet verified">
        <Table
          head={['Feature', 'Status', 'Detail']}
          rows={[
            ['Paystack payments and payouts', <StatusPill key="1" status="test-mode" />, 'Built against Paystack’s documented API and tested against a stand-in; not yet run against Paystack itself.'],
            ['Live (real-money) payments', <StatusPill key="2" status="planned" />, 'Disabled unless PAYSTACK_ALLOW_LIVE=true is set after a review.'],
            ['vLLM on GPUs', <StatusPill key="3" status="unverified" />, 'Unit-tested; not run on real GPU hardware. Default image tags are unverified.'],
            ['Docker worker', <StatusPill key="4" status="unverified" />, 'Unit-tested with a fake Docker client; not run against a real Docker daemon. No GPU detection in the container.'],
            ['Installable worker on macOS', <StatusPill key="5" status="unverified" />, 'launchd service files are generated and unit-tested but not run on a Mac.'],
            ['Prebuilt worker releases', <StatusPill key="6" status="planned" />, 'The release workflow and install flow are built and the install was tested on Linux against locally served assets; no release is published yet.'],
            ['Multi-replica billing with Redis', <StatusPill key="7" status="unverified" />, 'Concurrency safety rests on database compare-and-set; tested on SQLite only.'],
            ['Confidential computing', <StatusPill key="8" status="planned" />, 'Not implemented.'],
          ]}
        />
      </Section>

      <Section id="reporting" title="Reporting a vulnerability">
        <Callout tone="warning" title="Please do not open public issues for security problems">
          Report privately through GitHub&apos;s <A href={`${REPO_URL}/security/advisories/new`}>private vulnerability reporting</A>, with a description,
          steps to reproduce, and the impact. See <A href={`${REPO_URL}/blob/main/SECURITY.md`}>SECURITY.md</A>.
        </Callout>
        <P>
          Providers: if you suspect your node&apos;s credential was exposed, revoke the node in the dashboard; the worker stops its workloads and deletes
          its credentials when it learns it was revoked. Customers: revoke exposed API keys under <C>API Keys</C>.
        </P>
      </Section>
    </DocPage>
  );

'use client';

import { Activity, Box, MessageSquare, Server } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { StatCard } from '@/components/common/StatCard';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { ErrorState, Notice, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useOperatorOverview } from '@/hooks/useAdmin';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { count, dateTime, money, runtimeLabel } from '@/lib/format';

const sum = (o: Record<string, number>, keys?: string[]) =>
  Object.entries(o).reduce((t, [k, v]) => (!keys || keys.includes(k) ? t + v : t), 0);

export default function OperatorOverview() {
  const { data, isLoading, error, refetch } = useOperatorOverview();
  if (isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (error || !data) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error)} retry={() => refetch()} />;

  const online = sum(data.nodes_by_status, ['ONLINE', 'AVAILABLE', 'BUSY']);
  const u = data.usage_24h;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader title="Network overview" description={`Live from the database · ${dateTime(data.generated_at)}`} />
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <StatCard title="Nodes online" value={`${online} / ${sum(data.nodes_by_status)}`} hint={`${data.nodes_paused} paused`} icon={Server} />
        <StatCard
          title="Deployments ready"
          value={data.deployments_by_status.READY ?? 0}
          hint={Object.entries(data.deployments_by_runtime).map(([r, n]) => `${runtimeLabel(r)} ${n}`).join(' · ') || undefined}
          icon={Activity}
        />
        <StatCard
          title="Requests (24 h)"
          value={count(u.requests)}
          hint={`${count(u.failed)} failed · ${count(u.output_tokens)} output tokens`}
          icon={MessageSquare}
        />
        <StatCard title="Deployable models" value={data.models.deployable} hint={`${data.models.approved} approved of ${data.models.total}`} icon={Box} />
      </div>

      {data.nodes_heartbeat_overdue > 0 && (
        <Notice tone="warning" title="Heartbeats overdue">
          {data.nodes_heartbeat_overdue} node(s) are marked online but have not reported within the heartbeat timeout. The
          health monitor will mark them offline and move their deployments; if this persists, check that the monitor is
          running (it needs the leader lock when several replicas run).
        </Notice>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <BreakdownCard title="Nodes by status" data={data.nodes_by_status} badges />
        <BreakdownCard title="Deployments by status" data={data.deployments_by_status} badges />
        <BreakdownCard title="Users by role" data={data.users_by_role} />
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Ledger totals</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {data.ledger.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No ledger entries.</p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="divide-y divide-border text-sm">
              {data.ledger.map((l) => (
                <li key={`${l.type}-${l.status}`} className="flex items-center justify-between py-2">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {l.type} <StatusBadge status={l.status} />
                  </span>
                  <span className="tabular-nums">
                    {l.count} · {money(l.amount)}
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
          <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Deposits are Paystack top-ups, or unpaid test credits in development. See Reconciliation for consistency checks.
          </p>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

function BreakdownCard({ title, data, badges }: { title: string; data: Record<string, number>; badges?: boolean }) {
  const entries = Object.entries(data).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="text-base">{title}</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {entries.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">None.</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="space-y-2 text-sm">
            {entries.map(([k, n]) => (
              <li key={k} className="flex items-center justify-between">
                {badges ? <StatusBadge status={k} /> : <span className="capitalize">{k}</span>}
                <span className="tabular-nums">{n}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';

import { useAuditLogs } from '@/hooks/useAdmin';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { dateTime, shortId } from '@/lib/format';

export default function AuditLogPage() {
  const [action, setAction] = useState('');
  const [resourceType, setResourceType] = useState('');
  const [resourceId, setResourceId] = useState('');
  const { data, isLoading, error, refetch } = useAuditLogs({
    action: action.trim(),
    resource_type: resourceType.trim(),
    resource_id: resourceId.trim(),
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader title="Audit log" description="Security-relevant actions by customers, providers, operators and workers. Secrets are redacted." />

        <Input aria-label="Resource type" placeholder="Resource type, e.g. deployment" value={resourceType} onChange={(e) => setResourceType(e.target.value)} />
        <Input aria-label="Resource id" placeholder="Resource id" value={resourceId} onChange={(e) => setResourceId(e.target.value)} />
      </div>
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="pt-6">
          {error ? (
            <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error)} retry={() => refetch()} />
          ) : isLoading ? (
            <TableSkeleton />
          ) : (data ?? []).length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState>No matching entries.</EmptyState>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>When</TableHead>

                  <TableHead>Actor</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Details</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {(data ?? []).map((a) => (
                  <TableRow key={a.id}>
                    <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs">{dateTime(a.created_at)}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{a.action}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-xs">
                      {a.resource_type} <span className="font-mono">{shortId(a.resource_id)}</span>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{a.user_id ? shortId(a.user_id) : 'system'}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="max-w-md truncate font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground" title={JSON.stringify(a.details)}>
                      {a.details ? JSON.stringify(a.details) : ''}
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Pill } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useAdminModels, useSetArtifactEnabled, useSetModelApproval } from '@/hooks/useAdmin';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { ago, bytes, mb, runtimeLabel } from '@/lib/format';

export default function OperatorModelsPage() {
  const { data, isLoading, error, refetch } = useAdminModels();
  const approve = useSetModelApproval();
  const toggle = useSetArtifactEnabled();
  const act = (p: Promise<unknown>, ok: string) => p.then(() => toast.success(ok)).catch((e) => toast.error(errorMessage(e)));

  if (isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (error) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error)} retry={() => refetch()} />;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Model catalog"
        description="Approve models and enable the runtime artifacts customers may deploy. Adding artifacts is done through the API (POST /models/{id}/artifacts), which validates pinned sources."
      />
      {(data ?? []).length === 0 && <EmptyState>The catalog is empty.</EmptyState>}
      {(data ?? []).map((m) => (
        <Card key={m.id} data-testid="operator-model">
          <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-start justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {m.name} {m.is_approved ? <Pill tone="green">approved</Pill> : <Pill tone="amber">not approved</Pill>}
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>{[m.publisher, m.parameter_size, m.license].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}</CardDescription>
            </div>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant={m.is_approved ? 'outline' : 'default'}
              disabled={approve.isPending}
              onClick={() => act(approve.mutateAsync({ id: m.id, approved: !m.is_approved }), m.is_approved ? 'Approval withdrawn' : 'Model approved')}
            >
              {m.is_approved ? 'Withdraw approval' : 'Approve'}
            </Button>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {m.artifacts.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No artifacts: this model cannot be deployed.</p>
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Runtime</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Source</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Size</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Reservation</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Last ready</TableHead>
                    <TableHead />
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {m.artifacts.map((a) => (
                    <TableRow key={a.id}>
                      <TableCell>{runtimeLabel(a.runtime)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="max-w-sm text-xs">
                        <span className="break-all font-mono">{a.reference}</span>
                        {a.revision && <div className="font-mono text-muted-foreground">@{a.revision.slice(0, 12)}</div>}
                        {a.file && <div className="break-all font-mono text-muted-foreground">{a.file}</div>}
                        {a.sha256 && <div className="font-mono text-muted-foreground">sha256 {a.sha256.slice(0, 12)}…</div>}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-xs">{bytes(a.size_bytes)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-xs">
                        {mb(a.min_ram_mb)} RAM{a.gpu_required ? `, ${mb(a.min_vram_mb)} GPU` : ''}
                        {a.requirements_estimated && <div className="text-muted-foreground">estimate</div>}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-xs">{ago(a.last_ready_at)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        <Button
                          size="sm"
                          variant="ghost"
                          disabled={toggle.isPending}
                          onClick={() =>
                            act(toggle.mutateAsync({ modelId: m.id, artifactId: a.id, enabled: !a.is_enabled }), a.is_enabled ? 'Artifact disabled' : 'Artifact enabled')
                          }
                        >
                          {a.is_enabled ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}
                        </Button>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { ConfirmButton } from '@/components/common/ConfirmButton';
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { NodeTable } from '@/components/nodes/NodeTable';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useAdminNodes } from '@/hooks/useAdmin';
import { useRevokeNode, useSetAccepting } from '@/hooks/useNodes';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';

const STATUSES = ['', 'ONLINE', 'OFFLINE', 'DEGRADED', 'REVOKED'];

export default function OperatorNodesPage() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const { data, isLoading, error, refetch } = useAdminNodes(status);
  const setAccepting = useSetAccepting();
  const revoke = useRevokeNode();
  const act = (p: Promise<unknown>, ok: string) => p.then(() => toast.success(ok)).catch((e) => toast.error(errorMessage(e)));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="All nodes"
        description="Every enrolled machine. Pausing stops new placements; revoking disables the credential and moves its deployments."
        actions={
          <select aria-label="Filter by status" value={status} onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value)} className="h-8 rounded-lg border border-input bg-transparent px-2 text-sm">
            {STATUSES.map((s) => (
              <option key={s} value={s}>
                {s || 'All statuses'}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        }
      />
      {isLoading ? (
        <PageSkeleton />
      ) : error ? (
        <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error)} retry={() => refetch()} />
      ) : (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="pt-6">
            {(data ?? []).length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState>No nodes.</EmptyState>
            ) : (
              <NodeTable
                nodes={data ?? []}
                actions={(n) =>
                  n.status === 'REVOKED' ? null : (
                    <span className="inline-flex gap-1">
                      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => act(setAccepting.mutateAsync({ id: n.id, accepting: !n.accepting_workloads }), n.accepting_workloads ? 'Paused' : 'Resumed')}>
                        {n.accepting_workloads ? 'Pause' : 'Resume'}
                      </Button>
                      <ConfirmButton size="sm" variant="ghost" confirmLabel="Revoke" onConfirm={() => act(revoke.mutateAsync(n.id), 'Node revoked')}>
                        Revoke
                      </ConfirmButton>
                    </span>
                  )
                }
              />
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { ConfirmButton } from '@/components/common/ConfirmButton';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useAdminPayouts, useDecidePayout } from '@/hooks/useBilling';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { dateTime, money, shortId } from '@/lib/format';

const STATUSES = ['REQUESTED', '', 'PENDING', 'OTP_REQUIRED', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'REVERSED', 'REJECTED'];

export default function OperatorPayoutsPage() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('REQUESTED');
  const { data, isLoading, error, refetch } = useAdminPayouts(status);
  const decide = useDecidePayout();
  const act = (id: string, approve: boolean) => {
    const reason = approve ? undefined : window.prompt('Reason shown to the provider (optional)') ?? undefined;
    decide.mutate(
      { id, approve, reason },
      {
        onSuccess: (p) => toast.success(`Payout ${p.status.toLowerCase()}`),
        onError: (e) => toast.error(errorMessage(e)),
      },
    );
  };
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Payouts"
        description="Approving sends a Paystack transfer from the platform balance. Rejecting returns the held amount to the provider."
        actions={
          <select aria-label="Filter by status" value={status} onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value)} className="h-8 rounded-lg border border-input bg-transparent px-2 text-sm">
            {STATUSES.map((s) => (
              <option key={s} value={s}>
                {s || 'All'}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        }
      />
      {isLoading ? (
        <PageSkeleton />
      ) : error ? (
        <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error)} retry={() => refetch()} />
      ) : (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="pt-6">
            {(data ?? []).length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState>No payouts.</EmptyState>
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Requested</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Provider</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Reference</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
                    <TableHead />
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {(data ?? []).map((p) => (
                    <TableRow key={p.id} data-testid="admin-payout-row">
                      <TableCell className="text-xs">{dateTime(p.created_at)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{shortId(p.user_id)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{p.reference}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <StatusBadge status={p.status} />
                        {p.failure_reason && <div className="max-w-xs text-xs text-muted-foreground">{p.failure_reason}</div>}
                        {p.reconciled_at && <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">reconciled {dateTime(p.reconciled_at)}</div>}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-xs">{money(p.amount, p.currency)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        {p.status === 'REQUESTED' && (
                          <span className="inline-flex gap-1">
                            <ConfirmButton size="sm" variant="default" confirmLabel="Send transfer" disabled={decide.isPending} onConfirm={() => act(p.id, true)}>
                              Approve
                            </ConfirmButton>
                            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={decide.isPending} onClick={() => act(p.id, false)}>
                              Reject
                            </Button>
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Pill } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useCreatePricing, usePricing, usePricingVersions, type PricingInput } from '@/hooks/useBilling';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { dateTime, money } from '@/lib/format';

const FIELDS: { key: keyof PricingInput; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'cpu_core_hour', label: 'CPU core, per hour' },
  { key: 'ram_gb_hour', label: 'Memory, per GB-hour' },
  { key: 'vram_gb_hour', label: 'GPU memory, per GB-hour' },
  { key: 'input_tokens_per_million', label: 'Input tokens, per million' },
  { key: 'output_tokens_per_million', label: 'Output tokens, per million' },
  { key: 'platform_fee_rate', label: 'Platform fee (0 to 0.5)' },
];

export default function OperatorPricingPage() {
  const versions = usePricingVersions();
  const pricing = usePricing();
  const create = useCreatePricing();
  const current = pricing.data?.current;
  const [form, setForm] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [effective, setEffective] = useState('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');

  if (versions.isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (versions.error) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(versions.error)} retry={() => versions.refetch()} />;
  const currency = pricing.data?.currency;
  const value = (k: keyof PricingInput) => form[k] ?? (current ? String(current[k as keyof typeof current] ?? '') : k === 'platform_fee_rate' ? '0.1' : '0');

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Pricing"
        description={`Prices are versioned and immutable. A new version applies from its start time; earlier usage keeps the price it was rated at. Currency: ${currency ?? ''}.`}
      />
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Publish a new version</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Pre-filled with the version in force. Customers see the change on their wallet page.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <form
            className="space-y-4"
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              const body = Object.fromEntries(FIELDS.map(({ key }) => [key, value(key)])) as PricingInput;
              if (effective) body.effective_from = new Date(effective).toISOString();
              if (notes.trim()) body.notes = notes.trim();
              create.mutate(body, {
                onSuccess: (r) => {
                  toast.success(`Version ${r.version} published`);
                  setForm({});
                  setNotes('');
                  setEffective('');
                },
                onError: (err) => toast.error(errorMessage(err)),
              });
            }}
          >
            <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
              {FIELDS.map(({ key, label }) => (
                <div key={key} className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor={key}>{label}</Label>
                  <Input id={key} type="number" min={0} step="any" required value={value(key)} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, [key]: e.target.value })} />
                </div>
              ))}
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <Label htmlFor="effective">Takes effect (local time, optional)</Label>
                <Input id="effective" type="datetime-local" value={effective} onChange={(e) => setEffective(e.target.value)} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1 sm:col-span-2">
                <Label htmlFor="notes">Notes</Label>
                <Input id="notes" maxLength={500} value={notes} onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)} placeholder="Why prices changed" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={create.isPending}>
              Publish version
            </Button>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Versions</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {(versions.data ?? []).length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState>No prices yet: usage is measured but not charged.</EmptyState>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>Version</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>From</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">CPU/h</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">GB-h</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">VRAM GB-h</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">In/1M</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Out/1M</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Fee</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Notes</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {(versions.data ?? []).map((r) => (
                  <TableRow key={r.id}>
                    <TableCell>
                      {r.version} {current?.id === r.id && <Pill tone="green">in force</Pill>}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-xs">{dateTime(r.effective_from)}</TableCell>
                    {[r.cpu_core_hour, r.ram_gb_hour, r.vram_gb_hour, r.input_tokens_per_million, r.output_tokens_per_million].map((v, i) => (
                      <TableCell key={i} className="text-right font-mono text-xs">
                        {money(v, r.currency)}
                      </TableCell>
                    ))}
                    <TableCell className="text-right text-xs">{(Number(r.platform_fee_rate) * 100).toFixed(1)}%</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="max-w-xs truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.notes}</TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
