'use client';

import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { StatCard } from '@/components/common/StatCard';
import { CodeBlock } from '@/components/common/CodeBlock';
import { ErrorState, Notice, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useReconciliation, useRunReconciliation } from '@/hooks/useBilling';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { dateTime } from '@/lib/format';

const KIND_HELP: Record<string, string> = {
  wallet_balance: 'A wallet balance differs from its ledger entries. Investigate before any payout from this wallet.',
  charge_split: 'A charge’s ledger postings do not add up (debit ≠ provider credit + fee).',
  payment_not_credited_once: 'A successful top-up was not credited exactly once.',
  deposit_without_success: 'A deposit exists for a top-up that is not marked successful.',
  payment_needs_review: 'Paystack reported a different amount or currency than requested; not credited.',
  payout_hold: 'A payout’s held funds do not match its state.',
};

export default function ReconciliationPage() {
  const { data, isLoading, error, refetch, isFetching } = useReconciliation();
  const run = useRunReconciliation();
  if (isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (error || !data) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error)} retry={() => refetch()} />;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Reconciliation"
        description={`Ledger invariants, checked ${dateTime(data.generated_at)}. Read-only: nothing is corrected automatically.`}
        actions={
          <>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => refetch()} disabled={isFetching}>
              Recheck ledger
            </Button>
            <Button
              disabled={run.isPending}
              onClick={() =>
                run.mutate(undefined, {
                  onSuccess: (r) => toast.success(`Checked with Paystack: ${JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 120)}`),
                  onError: (e) => toast.error(errorMessage(e)),
                })
              }
            >
              Check open items with Paystack
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      />
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <StatCard title="Top-ups awaiting payment" value={data.open.payments_initialized} />
        <StatCard title="Payouts awaiting approval" value={data.open.payouts_awaiting_approval} />
        <StatCard title="Payouts in flight" value={data.open.payouts_in_flight} />
      </div>
      {data.ok ? (
        <Notice title="Ledger consistent">
          {data.checked.wallets} wallets and {data.checked.charges} charges checked; no discrepancies.
        </Notice>
      ) : (
        <Card className="border-rose-500/40">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{data.issues.length} discrepancies</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-3">
            {data.issues.map((issue, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="space-y-1" data-testid="reconciliation-issue">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">{KIND_HELP[issue.kind] ?? issue.kind}</p>
                <CodeBlock code={JSON.stringify(issue, null, 2)} />
              </div>
            ))}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
      {run.data && <CodeBlock code={JSON.stringify(run.data, null, 2)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { Activity, MessageSquare, Server, Wallet } from 'lucide-react';
import { buttonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { StatCard } from '@/components/common/StatCard';
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, Notice, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { NodeTable } from '@/components/nodes/NodeTable';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useEarnings } from '@/hooks/useEarnings';
import { useNodes } from '@/hooks/useNodes';
import { useUsageSummary } from '@/hooks/useUsage';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { count, money } from '@/lib/format';
import { nodeAvailability } from '@/lib/nodes';

export default function ProviderOverview() {
  const nodes = useNodes();
  const earnings = useEarnings();
  const usage = useUsageSummary(7);

  if (nodes.isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (nodes.error) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(nodes.error)} retry={() => nodes.refetch()} />;

  const list = (nodes.data ?? []).filter((n) => n.status !== 'REVOKED');
  const accepting = list.filter((n) => nodeAvailability(n).tone === 'green').length;
  const attention = list.filter((n) => nodeAvailability(n).tone === 'red');

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Overview"
        description="Your machines on AgentMesh and the work they serve."
        actions={
          <Link href="/provider/nodes/register" className={buttonVariants()}>
            Add a machine
          </Link>
        }
      />
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <StatCard title="Nodes accepting work" value={`${accepting} / ${list.length}`} icon={Server} />
        <StatCard
          title="Deployments hosted now"
          value={earnings.data?.active_deployments ?? '—'}
          hint={earnings.data ? `${earnings.data.total_deployments} hosted in total` : undefined}
          icon={Activity}
        />
        <StatCard
          title="Requests served (7 days)"
          value={usage.data ? count(usage.data.totals.requests) : '—'}
          hint={usage.data ? `${count(usage.data.totals.output_tokens)} output tokens` : undefined}
          icon={MessageSquare}
        />
        <StatCard
          title="Earnings"
          value={earnings.data ? money(earnings.data.total_earnings) : '—'}
          hint="Settled provider credits"
          icon={Wallet}
        />
      </div>
      {attention.length > 0 && (
        <Notice tone="warning" title={`${attention.length} node${attention.length === 1 ? ' needs' : 's need'} attention`}>
          {attention.map((n) => `${n.name ?? n.id.slice(0, 8)}: ${nodeAvailability(n).detail}`).join(' ')}
        </Notice>
      )}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Nodes</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {list.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState action={{ href: '/provider/nodes/register', label: 'Enroll your first machine' }}>
              You have no nodes yet.
            </EmptyState>
          ) : (
            <NodeTable nodes={list} href={(n) => `/provider/nodes/${n.id}`} />
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { ChargesTable } from '@/components/billing/ChargesTable';
import { StatCard } from '@/components/common/StatCard';
import { Pill, StatusBadge } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, Notice, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import {
  useBanks,
  useCharges,
  usePaymentsConfig,
  usePayoutAccount,
  usePayouts,
  useRequestPayout,
  useSetPayoutAccount,
} from '@/hooks/useBilling';
import { useEarnings } from '@/hooks/useEarnings';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { dateTime, money } from '@/lib/format';


export default function EarningsPage() {
  const earnings = useEarnings();
  const config = usePaymentsConfig();
  const charges = useCharges();
  const account = usePayoutAccount();
  const payouts = usePayouts();
  const enabled = !!config.data?.enabled;
  const banks = useBanks(enabled);
  const setAccount = useSetPayoutAccount();
  const requestPayout = useRequestPayout();
  const [bank, setBank] = useState('');
  const [accountNumber, setAccountNumber] = useState('');
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState('');

  if (earnings.isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (earnings.error || !earnings.data) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(earnings.error)} retry={() => earnings.refetch()} />;
  const e = earnings.data;
  const currency = config.data?.currency;
  const held = (payouts.data ?? []).filter((p) => ['REQUESTED', 'PENDING', 'OTP_REQUIRED'].includes(p.status));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader title="Earnings" description="Your share of what customers paid for deployments your nodes served." />
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <StatCard title="Available to withdraw" value={money(e.available_balance, currency)} />
        <StatCard title="Earned in total" value={money(e.total_earnings, currency)} hint="Settled provider credits" />
        <StatCard title="Payouts in progress" value={money(held.reduce((t, p) => t + Number(p.amount), 0), currency)} hint={`${held.length} payout(s)`} />
      </div>

      {!enabled ? (
        <Notice title="Payouts are not configured on this network">An operator must set up Paystack before payouts can be made.</Notice>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                Payout account {config.data?.mode === 'test' && <Pill tone="amber">test mode</Pill>}
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Verified with your bank through Paystack. AgentMesh keeps only the last four digits.</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              {account.data && !editing ? (
                <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                  <p data-testid="payout-account">
                    {account.data.account_name} · {account.data.bank_name ?? account.data.bank_code} · ••••{account.data.account_last4}
                  </p>
                  <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setEditing(true)}>
                    Change
                  </Button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <form
                  className="space-y-3"
                  onSubmit={(ev) => {
                    ev.preventDefault();
                    setAccount.mutate(
                      { bank_code: bank, account_number: accountNumber },
                      {
                        onSuccess: () => {
                          toast.success('Payout account verified');
                          setEditing(false);
                          setAccountNumber('');
                        },
                        onError: (err) => toast.error(errorMessage(err)),
                      },
                    );
                  }}
                >
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="bank">Bank</Label>
                    <select id="bank" required value={bank} onChange={(ev) => setBank(ev.target.value)} className="h-8 w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-transparent px-2 text-sm">
                      <option value="">{banks.isLoading ? 'Loading banks…' : 'Choose your bank'}</option>
                      {(banks.data ?? []).map((b) => (
                        <option key={b.code} value={b.code}>
                          {b.name}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                    {banks.error && <p className="text-xs text-rose-500">{errorMessage(banks.error)}</p>}
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="acct">Account number</Label>
                    <Input id="acct" inputMode="numeric" pattern="\d{6,20}" required value={accountNumber} onChange={(ev) => setAccountNumber(ev.target.value.trim())} />
                  </div>
                  <Button type="submit" disabled={setAccount.isPending}>
                    {setAccount.isPending ? 'Verifying…' : 'Verify and save'}
                  </Button>
                </form>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Request a payout</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                The amount is held from your balance at once.{' '}
                {config.data?.payouts_require_approval ? 'An operator approves each payout before it is sent.' : 'It is sent right away.'} Minimum{' '}
                {money(config.data?.payout_min ?? 0, currency)}.
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <form
                className="flex items-end gap-2"
                onSubmit={(ev) => {
                  ev.preventDefault();
                  requestPayout.mutate(amount, {
                    onSuccess: () => {
                      toast.success('Payout requested');
                      setAmount('');
                    },
                    onError: (err) => toast.error(errorMessage(err)),
                  });
                }}
              >
                <Input aria-label="Payout amount" type="number" min={config.data?.payout_min} step="0.01" value={amount} onChange={(ev) => setAmount(ev.target.value)} required />
                <Button type="submit" disabled={!account.data || requestPayout.isPending || !amount}>
                  Request payout
                </Button>
              </form>
              {!account.data && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Add a payout account first.</p>}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Payouts</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {(payouts.data ?? []).length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState>No payouts yet.</EmptyState>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>Requested</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Reference</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {(payouts.data ?? []).map((p) => (
                  <TableRow key={p.id} data-testid="payout-row">
                    <TableCell className="text-xs">{dateTime(p.created_at)}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{p.reference}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <StatusBadge status={p.status} />
                      {p.failure_reason && <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{p.failure_reason}</div>}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-xs">{money(p.amount, p.currency)}</TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Earnings by charge</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Your share after the platform fee, for each billing window your nodes served.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {charges.error ? (
            <ErrorState message={errorMessage(charges.error)} />
          ) : (
            <ChargesTable charges={charges.data ?? []} side="provider" empty="No earnings yet." />
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button, buttonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { NodeTable } from '@/components/nodes/NodeTable';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useNodes } from '@/hooks/useNodes';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';

export default function ProviderNodesPage() {
  const { data, isLoading, error, refetch, isFetching } = useNodes();
  const [showRevoked, setShowRevoked] = useState(false);

  if (isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (error) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error)} retry={() => refetch()} />;

  const all = data ?? [];
  const revoked = all.filter((n) => n.status === 'REVOKED').length;
  const rows = showRevoked ? all : all.filter((n) => n.status !== 'REVOKED');

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="My nodes"
        description="Machines you have enrolled. Each runs the AgentMesh worker and reports every 15 seconds."
        actions={
          <>
            <Button variant="outline" size="icon" aria-label="Refresh" onClick={() => refetch()}>
              <RefreshCw className={isFetching ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
            </Button>
            <Link href="/provider/nodes/register" className={buttonVariants()}>
              Add a machine
            </Link>
          </>
        }
      />
      {revoked > 0 && (
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={showRevoked} onChange={(e) => setShowRevoked(e.target.checked)} />
          Show revoked ({revoked})
        </label>
      )}
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="pt-6">
          {rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState action={{ href: '/provider/nodes/register', label: 'Enroll a machine' }}>No nodes to show.</EmptyState>
          ) : (
            <NodeTable nodes={rows} href={(n) => `/provider/nodes/${n.id}`} />
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useParams } from 'next/navigation';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { ConfirmButton } from '@/components/common/ConfirmButton';
import { Pill, StatusBadge } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { ErrorState, Notice, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { CapacityBars } from '@/components/nodes/CapacityBars';
import { PageSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useNode, useRevokeNode, useSetAccepting, useSetAcceptsCommunity } from '@/hooks/useNodes';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { ago, dateTime, runtimeLabel } from '@/lib/format';
import { nodeAvailability } from '@/lib/nodes';

export default function NodeDetailPage() {
  const id = useParams<{ id: string }>().id;
  const { data: node, isLoading, error, refetch } = useNode(id);
  const setAccepting = useSetAccepting();
  const setCommunity = useSetAcceptsCommunity();
  const revoke = useRevokeNode();

  if (isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (error || !node) return <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error, 'Node not found')} retry={() => refetch()} />;

  const availability = nodeAvailability(node);
  const revoked = node.status === 'REVOKED';
  const metrics = node.last_metrics ?? {};
  const act = (p: Promise<unknown>, ok: string) => p.then(() => toast.success(ok)).catch((e) => toast.error(errorMessage(e)));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title={node.name ?? 'Node'}
        description={`Node ${node.id}`}
        actions={
          !revoked && (
            <>
              {node.accepting_workloads ? (
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  disabled={setAccepting.isPending}
                  onClick={() => act(setAccepting.mutateAsync({ id: node.id, accepting: false }), 'Node paused')}
                >
                  Pause new work
                </Button>
              ) : (
                <Button
                  disabled={setAccepting.isPending}
                  onClick={() => act(setAccepting.mutateAsync({ id: node.id, accepting: true }), 'Node resumed')}
                >
                  Resume
                </Button>
              )}
              <ConfirmButton
                confirmLabel="Revoke: stops its deployments"
                onConfirm={() => act(revoke.mutateAsync(node.id), 'Node revoked')}
              >
                Revoke
              </ConfirmButton>
            </>
          )
        }
      />

      <Notice tone={availability.tone === 'green' ? 'info' : availability.tone === 'amber' ? 'warning' : 'danger'} title={availability.label}>
        {availability.detail}
      </Notice>

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Worker</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-[10rem_1fr] gap-y-2 text-sm">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Status</dt>
              <dd>
                <StatusBadge status={node.status} />
              </dd>
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Type</dt>
              <dd>{node.mode === 'agent' ? 'Installable agent' : node.mode === 'docker' ? 'Docker worker' : (node.mode ?? '—')}</dd>
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Version</dt>
              <dd className="font-mono text-xs">
                {node.worker_version ?? '—'} (protocol {node.protocol_version ?? '—'})
              </dd>
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Region</dt>
              <dd>{node.region ?? 'not set'}</dd>
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Last heartbeat</dt>
              <dd>{ago(node.last_heartbeat)}</dd>
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Enrolled</dt>
              <dd>{dateTime(node.created_at)}</dd>
            </dl>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Capacity</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Reserved by deployments, out of the limits you set when installing the worker.</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <CapacityBars node={node} />
            {Object.keys(metrics).length > 0 && (
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Whole machine, last reported:
                {metrics.cpu_percent != null && ` CPU ${Math.round(metrics.cpu_percent)}%`}
                {metrics.ram_percent != null && ` · memory ${Math.round(metrics.ram_percent)}%`}
                {metrics.gpu_utilization != null && ` · GPU ${Math.round(metrics.gpu_utilization)}%`}
              </p>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Runtimes</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Reported by the worker at each heartbeat.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {(node.runtimes ?? []).length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No runtimes reported.</p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
              {(node.runtimes ?? []).map((r) => (
                <li key={`${r.name}-${r.backend}`} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 py-2 text-sm">
                  <span>
                    <span className="font-medium">{runtimeLabel(r.name)}</span>{' '}
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {r.version ? `v${r.version}` : ''} {r.backend ? `· ${r.backend}` : ''}
                    </span>
                    {r.detail && <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.detail}</span>}
                  </span>
                  <span className="flex gap-1">
                    {r.gpu && <Pill tone="blue">GPU</Pill>}
                    {r.limits_enforced === false && <Pill tone="amber">limits advisory</Pill>}
                    <Pill tone={r.available ? 'green' : 'gray'}>{r.available ? 'available' : 'unavailable'}</Pill>
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {!revoked && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              Community models <Pill tone={node.accepts_community_models ? 'amber' : 'gray'}>{node.accepts_community_models ? 'accepted' : 'off'}</Pill>
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Customers can import public GGUF models from Hugging Face for their own use. No operator reviews them.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <ul className="list-disc space-y-1 pl-5 text-muted-foreground">
              <li>They run only with llama.cpp, from a file pinned to a Hugging Face commit and checked against its SHA-256 before loading.</li>
              <li>Gated, private, and non-commercially licensed models are refused. Pickle and other code-carrying formats are never accepted.</li>
              <li>The model&apos;s output is not reviewed. Turning this on means your machine may serve models AgentMesh has not vetted.</li>
              <li>Turning it off stops new placements. Community deployments already running keep running until they stop or move.</li>
            </ul>
            {node.accepts_community_models ? (
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                disabled={setCommunity.isPending}
                onClick={() => act(setCommunity.mutateAsync({ id: node.id, accept: false }), 'Community models turned off')}
              >
                Stop accepting community models
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <ConfirmButton
                variant="outline"
                disabled={setCommunity.isPending}
                confirmLabel="Yes, accept unreviewed models"
                onConfirm={() => act(setCommunity.mutateAsync({ id: node.id, accept: true }), 'Community models accepted')}
              >
                Accept community models
              </ConfirmButton>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        &quot;Pause new work&quot; stops AgentMesh from placing new deployments here; running ones keep serving. To stop
        running deployments too, run <code className="font-mono">agentmesh-worker drain</code> on the machine.
        &quot;Revoke&quot; disables the node&apos;s credential and stops its deployments immediately; AgentMesh moves them to
        other nodes when it can.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { CodeBlock, InlineValue } from '@/components/common/CodeBlock';
import { Notice, PageHeader } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { useCreateEnrollmentToken } from '@/hooks/useNodes';
import { useWorkerRelease } from '@/hooks/useWorkerRelease';
import { RELEASES_URL, WORKER_VERSION } from '@/lib/config';
import { agentInstallCommand, dockerInstallCommand, sourceInstallCommand, statusCommand, uninstallCommand, workerReleaseUrl } from '@/lib/worker';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { dateTime } from '@/lib/format';

export default function EnrollNodePage() {
  const create = useCreateEnrollmentToken();
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [region, setRegion] = useState('');
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'agent' | 'docker'>('agent');
  const token = create.data?.token;

  const release = useWorkerRelease();
  const published = release.data === 'published';

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl space-y-6">
      <PageHeader title="Add a machine" description="Enroll a computer as an AgentMesh node. The worker only makes outbound connections; you do not need to open any ports." />

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>1. Create a one-time enrollment token</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>The token works once and expires after 60 minutes. Create a new one for each machine.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <form
            className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_auto] sm:items-end"
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              create.mutate({ name: name.trim() || undefined, region: region.trim() || undefined });
            }}
          >
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="node-name">Name (optional)</Label>
              <Input id="node-name" maxLength={100} value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="office-desktop" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="node-region">Region (optional)</Label>
              <Input id="node-region" maxLength={100} value={region} onChange={(e) => setRegion(e.target.value)} placeholder="eu-west" />
            </div>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={create.isPending}>
              {token ? 'Create another' : 'Create token'}
            </Button>
          </form>
          {create.error && <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-rose-500">{errorMessage(create.error)}</p>}
          {create.data && (
            <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
              <InlineValue value={create.data.token} />
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Expires {dateTime(create.data.expires_at)}. It is shown only now.</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>2. Install the worker</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            The limits you pass are the most AgentMesh will ever reserve on the machine. See the{' '}
            <Link href="/docs/providers" className="underline underline-offset-4">provider guide</Link> for every option.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div role="tablist" className="flex gap-1">
            {(['agent', 'docker'] as const).map((m) => (
              <button
                key={m}
                role="tab"
                type="button"
                aria-selected={mode === m}
                onClick={() => setMode(m)}
                className={`rounded-md px-3 py-1 text-sm ${mode === m ? 'bg-muted font-medium' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`}
              >
                {m === 'agent' ? 'Installable agent (Linux, macOS)' : 'Docker worker'}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {mode === 'agent' ? (
            <>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Linux or macOS with Python 3.11+ (including <code className="font-mono">venv</code>) and{' '}
                <a href="https://ollama.com/download" className="underline underline-offset-4" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Ollama</a>{' '}
                installed. No admin rights: it runs as a per-user service and starts its own isolated model servers, never
                touching your own Ollama service or models.
              </p>
              {release.isPending ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Checking for the worker {WORKER_VERSION} release…</p>
              ) : published ? (
                <>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    Downloads the{' '}
                    <a href={workerReleaseUrl()} className="underline underline-offset-4" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                      worker {WORKER_VERSION} release
                    </a>
                    , verifies it against <code className="font-mono">SHA256SUMS</code>, then installs. Your token is only
                    passed to the installer, never put in a URL.
                  </p>
                  <CodeBlock code={agentInstallCommand({ token })} />
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    Keep the <code className="font-mono">~/agentmesh-worker-{WORKER_VERSION}</code> folder: it holds the
                    uninstaller (<code className="font-mono">{uninstallCommand()}</code>).
                  </p>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Notice tone="warning" title={`Worker ${WORKER_VERSION} has not been published yet`}>
                    Prebuilt downloads will appear on the{' '}
                    <a href={RELEASES_URL} className="underline underline-offset-4" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                      GitHub Releases page
                    </a>
                    . Until then, build the worker from the source repository:
                  </Notice>
                  <CodeBlock code={sourceInstallCommand({ token })} />
                </>
              )}
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Needs Docker Engine 24+ and the Compose file from the repository, so this option still uses a checkout.
              </p>
              <CodeBlock code={dockerInstallCommand({ token })} />
              <Notice tone="warning">
                The worker uses the Docker socket, which is equivalent to root access on the machine. Prefer rootless
                Docker and a machine dedicated to this purpose.
              </Notice>
            </>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>3. Check it appears</CardTitle>

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Notice, TrustNotice } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { useCreateAiRun } from '@/hooks/useAiDeployments';
import { DEFAULT_LIMITS, MAX_DURATION_HOURS, MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS, MAX_REQUEST_CHARS, validateAiRequest } from '@/lib/ai';
import { RUNTIME_PREFERENCE, newIdempotencyKey } from '@/lib/deployments';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { BILLING_CURRENCY, runtimeLabel } from '@/lib/format';
import type { AutonomyLimits, ModelSource, Runtime } from '@/types';

const SOURCES: { id: ModelSource; label: string }[] = [
  { id: 'ollama', label: 'Ollama registry' },
  { id: 'huggingface', label: 'Hugging Face (pinned revisions)' },
];

function toggle<T>(list: T[], item: T): T[] {
  return list.includes(item) ? list.filter((x) => x !== item) : [...list, item];
}

export function AiDeployForm() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const create = useCreateAiRun();
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [limits, setLimits] = useState<AutonomyLimits>(DEFAULT_LIMITS);
  const [acknowledged, setAcknowledged] = useState(false);
  const [touched, setTouched] = useState(false);
  // One key per form instance: a double submit returns the same run.
  const [idempotencyKey] = useState(newIdempotencyKey);
  const problems = validateAiRequest(text, limits);
  const set = <K extends keyof AutonomyLimits>(key: K, value: AutonomyLimits[K]) => setLimits((l) => ({ ...l, [key]: value }));
  const num = (v: string) => (v === '' ? NaN : Number(v));

  const submit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setTouched(true);
    if (problems.length || !acknowledged) return;
    create.mutate(
      { request: text.trim(), limits, idempotency_key: idempotencyKey },
      { onSuccess: (run) => router.push(`/customer/ai/${run.id}`) },
    );
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-6" noValidate>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="ai-request">What should be deployed?</Label>
        <Textarea
          id="ai-request"
          value={text}
          maxLength={MAX_REQUEST_CHARS}
          onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="A small, fast chat model for answering customer questions in English. Keep it cheap; no GPU."
          className="min-h-24"
        />
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          The AI agent picks a model from the approved catalog. It cannot exceed the limits below: AgentMesh checks every
          plan against them, your wallet, and current prices before anything runs.
        </p>
      </div>

      <fieldset className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <legend className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium">Limits you authorize</legend>
        <NumberField
          id="max-spend"
          label={`Maximum spend (${BILLING_CURRENCY})`}
          value={limits.max_spend}
          onChange={(v) => set('max_spend', v)}
          hint="Stopped automatically when reached"
        />
        <NumberField
          id="max-hours"
          label="Maximum duration (hours)"
          value={String(limits.max_duration_hours)}
          onChange={(v) => set('max_duration_hours', num(v))}
          hint={`Up to ${MAX_DURATION_HOURS} h`}
        />
        <NumberField
          id="max-recovery"
          label="Automatic recovery attempts"
          value={String(limits.max_recovery_attempts)}
          onChange={(v) => set('max_recovery_attempts', num(v))}
          hint={`0-${MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS}`}
        />
        <NumberField id="max-cpu" label="Maximum CPU cores" value={String(limits.max_cpu_cores)} onChange={(v) => set('max_cpu_cores', num(v))} />
        <NumberField id="max-ram" label="Maximum memory (MB)" value={String(limits.max_ram_mb)} onChange={(v) => set('max_ram_mb', num(v))} />
        <NumberField
          id="max-vram"
          label="Maximum GPU memory (MB)"
          value={String(limits.max_vram_mb)}
          onChange={(v) => set('max_vram_mb', num(v))}
          hint="0 means no GPU"
        />
      </fieldset>

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <fieldset className="space-y-2">
          <legend className="text-sm font-medium">Allowed runtimes</legend>
          {RUNTIME_PREFERENCE.map((r: Runtime) => (
            <label key={r} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={limits.allowed_runtimes.includes(r)}
                onChange={() => set('allowed_runtimes', toggle(limits.allowed_runtimes, r))}
              />
              {runtimeLabel(r)}
            </label>
          ))}
        </fieldset>
        <fieldset className="space-y-2">
          <legend className="text-sm font-medium">Allowed model sources</legend>
          {SOURCES.map((s) => (
            <label key={s.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={limits.allowed_sources.includes(s.id)}
                onChange={() => set('allowed_sources', toggle(limits.allowed_sources, s.id))}
              />
              {s.label}
            </label>
          ))}
        </fieldset>
      </div>

      <TrustNotice />
      <label className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
        <input type="checkbox" className="mt-0.5" checked={acknowledged} onChange={(e) => setAcknowledged(e.target.checked)} />
        <span>I understand, and I authorize the agent to deploy and spend within these limits without asking again.</span>
      </label>

      {touched && problems.length > 0 && (
        <Notice tone="warning" title="Check the form">
          <ul className="list-disc pl-4">
            {problems.map((p) => (
              <li key={p}>{p}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </Notice>
      )}
      {create.error && <Notice tone="danger">{errorMessage(create.error)}</Notice>}

      <Button type="submit" disabled={create.isPending || !acknowledged}>
        {create.isPending ? 'Starting…' : 'Start autonomous deployment'}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

function NumberField({
  id,
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  hint,
}: {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  hint?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <Label htmlFor={id}>{label}</Label>
      <Input id={id} inputMode="decimal" value={Number.isNaN(Number(value)) ? '' : value} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} />
      {hint && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{hint}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { Pill } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { useAiHealth } from '@/hooks/useAiDeployments';
import { AI_SERVICE_TEXT } from '@/lib/ai';

/** Availability of the AI agent. Shows no machine names, addresses, or credentials (the API returns none). */
export function AiHealthBadge() {
  const { data, isError } = useAiHealth();
  if (isError) return <Pill tone="gray">AI agent status unknown</Pill>;
  if (!data) return null;
  const tone = data.status === 'available' ? 'green' : data.status === 'degraded' ? 'amber' : 'red';
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2" title={data.message} data-testid="ai-health">
      <Pill tone={tone}>{AI_SERVICE_TEXT[data.status]}</Pill>
      {data.queue_depth > 0 && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{data.queue_depth} queued</span>}
    </span>
  );
}

import { StatusBadge, Pill } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { dateTime } from '@/lib/format';
import type { AiRunEvent } from '@/types';

const KIND_LABEL: Record<AiRunEvent['kind'], string> = {
  state: 'status',
  tool: 'tool',
  ai: 'AI',
  info: 'note',
  error: 'error',
};

export function AiRunTimeline({ events }: { events: AiRunEvent[] }) {
  if (events.length === 0) return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No events yet.</p>;
  return (
    <ol className="relative space-y-4 border-l border-border pl-5" data-testid="ai-run-events">
      {events.map((e, i) => (
        <li key={`${e.created_at}-${i}`} className="relative">
          <span className="absolute -left-[1.6rem] top-1.5 size-2.5 rounded-full border-2 border-background bg-muted-foreground" />
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            {e.to_status ? (
              <StatusBadge status={e.to_status} />
            ) : (
              <Pill tone={e.kind === 'error' ? 'red' : e.kind === 'ai' ? 'blue' : 'gray'}>{KIND_LABEL[e.kind]}</Pill>
            )}
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{dateTime(e.created_at)}</span>
          </div>
          {e.message && <p className="mt-1 text-sm break-words text-muted-foreground">{e.message}</p>}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { LogoMark } from '@/components/brand/Logo';
import { useAuth } from '../../hooks/useAuth';
import { homeFor } from '@/lib/roles';
import type { UserRole } from '@/types';

/** Sends signed-out users to /login and users of another role to their own dashboard. This is navigation only;
 * the API authorizes every request. */
export function AuthGuard({ children, roles }: { children: React.ReactNode; roles?: UserRole[] }) {
  const { user, token, isAuthenticated, isLoading, error, initialize } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const allowed = !roles || (!!user && roles.includes(user.role));

  useEffect(() => {
    initialize();
  }, [initialize]);

  // A token we could not verify yet (API unreachable) is not a sign-out: offer a retry instead of /login.
  const unverified = !isLoading && !isAuthenticated && !!token;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoading || unverified) return;
    if (!isAuthenticated) router.replace('/login');
    else if (!allowed) router.replace(homeFor(user?.role));
  }, [isAuthenticated, isLoading, unverified, allowed, user, router]);

  if (unverified) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-background px-6">
        <div className="flex max-w-sm flex-col items-center gap-4 text-center">
          <LogoMark className="size-10" />
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{error ?? 'Could not reach the server'}. You are still signed in.</p>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => initialize()}
            className="inline-flex h-9 items-center rounded-lg bg-foreground px-4 text-[13px] font-medium text-background transition-opacity hover:opacity-85"
          >
            Try again
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (isLoading || !isAuthenticated || !allowed) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-background">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
          <LogoMark className="size-10 animate-pulse" />
          <p className="animate-pulse text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading…</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return <>{children}</>;
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ArrowRight, Eye, EyeOff, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { homeFor } from '@/lib/roles';
import { useAuth } from '../../hooks/useAuth';
import { Field, inputClass, submitClass } from './AuthShell';

export function LoginForm() {
  const { login, error, clearError } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    clearError();
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await login(email, password);
      const { useAuthStore } = await import('../../stores/authStore');
      router.push(homeFor(useAuthStore.getState().user?.role));
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Login failed');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <p className="mb-3 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Your workspace</p>
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-[-0.045em] sm:text-[34px]">Welcome back</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Sign in to continue to AgentMesh.</p>
      {error && (
        <div role="alert" className="mt-6 border-l-2 border-destructive/70 py-1 pl-3 text-sm text-destructive">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="mt-9 space-y-5">
        <Field label="Email">
          <input type="email" autoComplete="email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} required placeholder="you@company.com" className={inputClass} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Password">
          <span className="relative block">
            <input
              type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
              autoComplete="current-password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              required
              className={`${inputClass} pr-10`}
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
              aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
            >
              {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="size-4" /> : <Eye className="size-4" />}
            </button>
          </span>
        </Field>
        <button type="submit" disabled={submitting} className={submitClass}>
          {submitting ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : null}
          {submitting ? 'Signing in…' : 'Sign in'}
          {!submitting && <ArrowRight className="size-4" />}
        </button>
      </form>
      <p className="mt-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        New to AgentMesh?{' '}
        <Link href="/register" className="font-medium text-foreground underline underline-offset-4 decoration-border hover:decoration-foreground">
          Create an account
        </Link>

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ArrowRight, Box, Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, Server } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import type { UserRole } from '@/types/user';
import { useAuth } from '../../hooks/useAuth';
import { Field, inputClass, submitClass } from './AuthShell';

const ROLES = [
  { value: 'customer' as const, icon: Box, title: 'Deploy models', body: 'Run open-weight models behind an API' },
  { value: 'provider' as const, icon: Server, title: 'Provide compute', body: 'Earn from your idle machines' },
];

export function RegisterForm({ initialRole = 'customer' }: { initialRole?: 'provider' | 'customer' }) {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [role, setRole] = useState<'provider' | 'customer'>(initialRole);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const { register, error, clearError } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    clearError();
    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      toast.error('Passwords do not match');
      return;
    }
    if (password.length < 8) {
      toast.error('Password must be at least 8 characters');
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await register(email, password, role as UserRole);
      toast.success('Account created');
      router.push(role === 'provider' ? '/provider' : '/customer');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Registration failed');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <p className="mb-3 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Get started</p>
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-[-0.045em] sm:text-[34px]">Create your account</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Free to join. Pay only for what you deploy.</p>
      {error && (
        <div role="alert" className="mt-6 border-l-2 border-destructive/70 py-1 pl-3 text-sm text-destructive">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="mt-8 space-y-5">
        <fieldset>
          <legend className="mb-2 text-[13px] font-medium text-foreground/85">Choose how you&apos;ll use AgentMesh</legend>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            {ROLES.map(({ value, icon: Icon, title, body }) => (
              <button
                key={value}
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={role === value}
                onClick={() => setRole(value)}
                className={cn(
                  'min-h-[92px] rounded-lg border px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors',
                  role === value ? 'border-foreground bg-card text-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:border-foreground/30 hover:text-foreground',
                )}
              >
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Icon className={cn('size-4', role === value ? 'text-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground')} />
                  <span className="text-[13px] font-semibold">{title}</span>
                </span>
                <span className="mt-2 block text-[11px] leading-snug text-muted-foreground">{body}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </fieldset>
        <Field label="Email">
          <input type="email" autoComplete="email" placeholder="you@company.com" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} required className={inputClass} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Password">
          <span className="relative block">
            <input
              type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
              autoComplete="new-password"
              placeholder="At least 8 characters"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              required
              className={`${inputClass} pr-10`}
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
              aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
            >
              {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="size-4" /> : <Eye className="size-4" />}
            </button>
          </span>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Confirm password">
          <input type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={confirmPassword} onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)} required className={inputClass} />
        </Field>
        <button type="submit" disabled={submitting} className={submitClass}>
          {submitting ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : null}
          {submitting ? 'Creating account…' : 'Create account'}
          {!submitting && <ArrowRight className="size-4" />}
        </button>
      </form>
      <p className="mt-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Already have an account?{' '}
        <Link href="/login" className="font-medium text-foreground underline underline-offset-4 decoration-border hover:decoration-foreground">
          Sign in
        </Link>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useStoredSession } from '@/hooks/useStoredSession';

/** On /login and /register: a user who is already signed in goes straight to their dashboard. */
export function RedirectIfSignedIn() {
  const home = useStoredSession();
  const router = useRouter();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (home) router.replace(home);
  }, [home, router]);
  return null;
}

/** Goes to the signed-in user's dashboard, or to `signedOutHref` when no session is stored. */
export function DashboardLink({ className, signedOutHref = '/login', children }: { className?: string; signedOutHref?: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const home = useStoredSession();
  return <Link href={home ?? signedOutHref} className={className}>{children}</Link>;
}

import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';

import { count, dateTime, money, shortId } from '@/lib/format';

export function ChargesTable({ charges, side = 'customer', empty }: { charges: Charge[]; side?: 'customer' | 'provider'; empty: string }) {
  if (charges.length === 0) return <EmptyState>{empty}</EmptyState>;
  return (
    <Table>
      <TableHeader>
        <TableRow>

        </TableRow>
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {charges.map((c) => (
          <TableRow key={c.id} data-testid="charge-row">
            <TableCell className="text-xs">{dateTime(c.period_start)}</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{shortId(c.deployment_id)}</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right text-xs tabular-nums">{Math.round(c.ready_seconds / 60)} min</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right text-xs tabular-nums">
              {count(c.input_tokens)} / {count(c.output_tokens)}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-xs" title={`resources ${c.resource_amount}, tokens ${c.token_amount}`}>
              {money(side === 'customer' ? c.amount : c.provider_amount, c.currency)}
            </TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        ))}
      </TableBody>
    </Table>
  );
}

            <dd>{money(r.ram_gb_hour, r.currency)}</dd>
            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">GPU memory, per GB-hour</dt>
            <dd>{money(r.vram_gb_hour, r.currency)}</dd>
            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Input tokens, per million</dt>
            <dd>{money(r.input_tokens_per_million, r.currency)}</dd>
            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Output tokens, per million</dt>
            <dd>{money(r.output_tokens_per_million, r.currency)}</dd>
          </dl>
          <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Resource charges use the capacity reserved for the deployment, for the time it is READY (not while unhealthy).
            Token counts are reported by the model runtime on the provider&apos;s node. A deployment needs a balance
            covering {data.min_prepaid_hours} h of its reservation; when the balance runs out, deployments are stopped.
          </p>
          {data.upcoming.length > 0 && (
            <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
              Version {data.upcoming[0].version} takes effect {dateTime(data.upcoming[0].effective_from)}.
            </p>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Check, Copy } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export function CopyButton({ text, label = 'Copy', className }: { text: string; label?: string; className?: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const copy = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
    } catch {
      // Clipboard access can be denied (insecure origin); the text stays selectable.
    }
  };
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={copy}
      aria-label={label}
      className={cn(
        'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground',
        className,
      )}
    >
      {copied ? <Check className="size-3.5" /> : <Copy className="size-3.5" />}
      {copied ? 'Copied' : label}
    </button>
  );
}

export function CodeBlock({ code, className }: { code: string; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className={cn('relative rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/40', className)}>
      <CopyButton text={code} className="absolute right-2 top-2" />
      <pre className="overflow-x-auto p-4 pr-20 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed">
        <code>{code}</code>
      </pre>
    </div>
  );
}

export function InlineValue({ value }: { value: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/40 px-3 py-2">
      <code className="flex-1 truncate font-mono text-xs">{value}</code>
      <CopyButton text={value} />
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

type ButtonProps = React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>;

/** Two-step button for destructive actions: the first click asks, the second performs. */
export function ConfirmButton({
  onConfirm,
  confirmLabel = 'Confirm',
  children,
  disabled,
  variant = 'destructive',
  ...props
}: Omit<ButtonProps, 'onClick'> & { onConfirm: () => void; confirmLabel?: string }) {
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState(false);
  if (asking) {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
        <Button
          {...props}
          variant="destructive"
          disabled={disabled}
          onClick={() => {
            setAsking(false);
            onConfirm();
          }}
        >
          {confirmLabel}
        </Button>
        <Button size={props.size} variant="ghost" onClick={() => setAsking(false)}>
          Cancel
        </Button>
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Button {...props} variant={variant} disabled={disabled} onClick={() => setAsking(true)}>
      {children}
    </Button>
  );
}

import Link from 'next/link';
import { AlertTriangle, Inbox, Info, ShieldAlert } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export function Notice({
  tone = 'info',
  title,
  children,
  className,
}: {
  tone?: 'info' | 'warning' | 'danger';
  title?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const Icon = tone === 'info' ? Info : tone === 'warning' ? AlertTriangle : ShieldAlert;
  return (
    <div
      role={tone === 'info' ? 'note' : 'alert'}
      className={cn(
        'flex gap-3 rounded-xl border p-4 text-sm',
        tone === 'info' && 'border-brand/25 bg-brand-soft/60',
        tone === 'warning' && 'border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/[0.06]',
        tone === 'danger' && 'border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/[0.06]',
        className,
      )}
    >
      <Icon
        className={cn(
          'mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0',
          tone === 'info' && 'text-brand',
          tone === 'warning' && 'text-amber-500',
          tone === 'danger' && 'text-rose-500',
        )}
      />
      <div className="space-y-1">
        {title && <p className="font-medium">{title}</p>}
        <div className="text-muted-foreground">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const TONE: Record<string, string> = {
  green: 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30',
  blue: 'bg-brand-soft text-brand border-brand/25',
  amber: 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30',
  red: 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border-rose-500/30',
  gray: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border',
};

const STATUS_TONE: Record<string, keyof typeof TONE> = {
  // deployments
  READY: 'green',
  REQUESTED: 'blue',
  SCHEDULED: 'blue',
  PROVISIONING: 'blue',
  STARTING: 'blue',
  STOPPING: 'amber',
  UNHEALTHY: 'amber',
  FAILED: 'red',
  STOPPED: 'gray',
  CANCELLED: 'gray',
  // AI deployment runs
  PLANNING: 'blue',
  SUBMITTING: 'blue',
  DEPLOYING: 'blue',
  VERIFYING: 'blue',
  RECOVERING: 'amber',
  COMPLETED: 'gray',
  // nodes
  ONLINE: 'green',
  AVAILABLE: 'green',
  BUSY: 'blue',
  REGISTERING: 'blue',
  DEGRADED: 'amber',
  OFFLINE: 'red',
  SUSPENDED: 'red',
  REVOKED: 'red',
  // ledger
  SETTLED: 'green',
  PENDING: 'amber',
  AUTHORIZED: 'blue',
  REFUNDED: 'gray',
  // payments and payouts
  INITIALIZED: 'blue',
  SUCCEEDED: 'green',
  ABANDONED: 'gray',
  REVIEW: 'amber',
  OTP_REQUIRED: 'amber',
  REVERSED: 'red',
  REJECTED: 'red',
};

const PULSE = new Set(['REQUESTED', 'SCHEDULED', 'PROVISIONING', 'STARTING', 'STOPPING', 'PLANNING', 'SUBMITTING', 'DEPLOYING', 'VERIFYING', 'RECOVERING']);

export function StatusBadge({ status, className }: { status: string; className?: string }) {
  const tone = TONE[STATUS_TONE[status] ?? 'gray'];
  return (
    <span
      data-status={status}
      className={cn(
        'inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium tracking-wide whitespace-nowrap',
        tone,
        className,
      )}
    >
      <span className={cn('size-1.5 rounded-full bg-current', PULSE.has(status) && 'animate-pulse')} />
      {status}
    </span>
  );
}

export function Pill({ children, tone = 'gray', className }: { children: React.ReactNode; tone?: keyof typeof TONE; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <span className={cn('inline-flex items-center rounded-md border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium', TONE[tone], className)}>
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { CodeBlock } from '@/components/common/CodeBlock';
import { apiExamples } from '@/lib/deployments';
import type { Deployment } from '@/types';

export function ApiExamples({ deployment }: { deployment: Deployment }) {
  const examples = apiExamples(deployment);
  const [active, setActive] = useState(examples[0]?.id);
  const current = examples.find((e) => e.id === active) ?? examples[0];
  if (!current) return null;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div role="tablist" className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
        {examples.map((e) => (
          <button
            key={e.id}
            role="tab"
            type="button"
            aria-selected={e.id === current.id}
            onClick={() => setActive(e.id)}
            className={`rounded-md px-3 py-1 text-sm ${e.id === current.id ? 'bg-muted font-medium' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}
          >
            {e.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <CodeBlock code={current.code} />
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Notice, TrustNotice } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { Pill } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { useCreateDeployment } from '@/hooks/useDeployments';
import { usePricing } from '@/hooks/useBilling';
import { hourlyResourcePrice, isFree } from '@/lib/billing';
import {
  DEFAULT_NUM_CTX,
  MAX_NUM_CTX,
  MIN_NUM_CTX,
  deployableArtifacts,
  estimateRequirements,
  newIdempotencyKey,
} from '@/lib/deployments';
import { errorMessage, noCapacityDetail, reasonText } from '@/lib/errors';
import { ago, mb, money, runtimeLabel } from '@/lib/format';
import type { Model, Runtime } from '@/types';

export function DeployForm({ model }: { model: Model }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const create = useCreateDeployment();
  const pricing = usePricing();
  const rule = pricing.data?.current ?? null;
  const artifacts = useMemo(() => deployableArtifacts(model.artifacts), [model.artifacts]);
  const [runtime, setRuntime] = useState<Runtime | 'auto'>('auto');
  const [numCtx, setNumCtx] = useState(DEFAULT_NUM_CTX);
  const [requireGpu, setRequireGpu] = useState(false);
  const [region, setRegion] = useState('');
  const [acknowledged, setAcknowledged] = useState(false);
  // One key per form instance: a double-submit or retry after a network error returns the same deployment.
  const [idempotencyKey] = useState(newIdempotencyKey);

  const ctxValid = Number.isInteger(numCtx) && numCtx >= MIN_NUM_CTX && numCtx <= MAX_NUM_CTX;
  const shown = runtime === 'auto' ? artifacts : artifacts.filter((a) => a.runtime === runtime);
  const capacity = create.error ? noCapacityDetail(create.error) : null;

  const submit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!acknowledged || !ctxValid) return;
    create.mutate(
      {
        model_id: model.id,
        runtime: runtime === 'auto' ? undefined : runtime,
        config: { num_ctx: numCtx, require_gpu: requireGpu, ...(region.trim() ? { region: region.trim() } : {}) },
        idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,
      },
      { onSuccess: (dep) => router.push(`/customer/deployments/${dep.id}`) },
    );
  };

  if (artifacts.length === 0) {
    return <Notice tone="danger">This model has no enabled runtime artifact, so it cannot be deployed.</Notice>;
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-6">
      <fieldset className="space-y-3">
        <legend className="text-sm font-medium">Runtime</legend>
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <RuntimeOption
            checked={runtime === 'auto'}
            onChange={() => setRuntime('auto')}
            title="Automatic"
            detail={`Try ${artifacts.map((a) => runtimeLabel(a.runtime)).join(', then ')} and use the first that fits on a node.`}
          />
          {artifacts.map((a) => (
            <RuntimeOption
              key={a.id}
              checked={runtime === a.runtime}
              onChange={() => setRuntime(a.runtime)}
              title={runtimeLabel(a.runtime)}
              detail={
                <>
                  <span className="font-mono">{a.reference}</span>
                  {a.quantization && <> · {a.quantization}</>}
                  {a.gpu_required && <> · GPU required</>}
                  {' · '}
                  {a.last_ready_at ? `last served successfully ${ago(a.last_ready_at)}` : 'not yet served on AgentMesh'}
                </>
              }
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </fieldset>

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="num_ctx">Context window (tokens)</Label>
          <Input
            id="num_ctx"
            type="number"
            min={MIN_NUM_CTX}
            max={MAX_NUM_CTX}
            step={512}
            value={Number.isNaN(numCtx) ? '' : numCtx}
            onChange={(e) => setNumCtx(e.target.valueAsNumber)}
            aria-invalid={!ctxValid}
          />
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {MIN_NUM_CTX} to {MAX_NUM_CTX}. Larger windows reserve more memory.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="region">Region (optional)</Label>
          <Input id="region" value={region} maxLength={100} onChange={(e) => setRegion(e.target.value)} placeholder="Any" />
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Only nodes whose provider set this exact region are used.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
        <input type="checkbox" checked={requireGpu} onChange={(e) => setRequireGpu(e.target.checked)} />
        Require a GPU
      </label>

      <div className="rounded-lg border border-border p-4">
        <p className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium">Resources reserved on the node (estimate)</p>
        <ul className="space-y-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {shown.map((a) => {
            const r = estimateRequirements(a, ctxValid ? numCtx : DEFAULT_NUM_CTX, requireGpu);
            return (
              <li key={a.id}>
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{runtimeLabel(a.runtime)}:</span> {r.cpu_cores} CPU,{' '}
                {mb(r.ram_mb)} RAM, {mb(r.disk_mb)} disk{r.gpu_required ? `, ${mb(r.vram_mb)} GPU memory` : ''}
                {rule && !isFree(rule) && (
                  <span data-testid={`hourly-${a.runtime}`}>
                    {' '}
                    · {money(hourlyResourcePrice(rule, r.cpu_cores, r.ram_mb, r.vram_mb), rule.currency)} per hour while
                    ready, plus tokens
                  </span>
                )}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {rule && !isFree(rule)
            ? `Figures come from the catalog and are estimates. You need a wallet balance covering ${pricing.data?.min_prepaid_hours ?? 1} h of the reservation to deploy; charges are taken from your wallet while the deployment is ready.`
            : 'Figures come from the catalog and are estimates. No prices are set on this network, so usage is measured but not charged.'}
        </p>
      </div>

      <TrustNotice />
      <label className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          className="mt-0.5"
          checked={acknowledged}
          onChange={(e) => setAcknowledged(e.target.checked)}
          name="acknowledge"
        />
        I understand the provider can see the prompts and responses this deployment handles.
      </label>

      {create.error && (
        <Notice tone="danger" title={capacity ? 'No node can run this deployment right now' : 'Deployment was not created'}>
          {capacity?.by_runtime ? (
            <ul className="space-y-1">
              {Object.entries(capacity.by_runtime).map(([rt, info]) => (
                <li key={rt}>
                  <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{runtimeLabel(rt)}:</span>{' '}
                  {Object.entries(info.reasons ?? {}).length
                    ? Object.entries(info.reasons ?? {})
                        .map(([reason, n]) => `${n} node${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}: ${reasonText(reason)}`)
                        .join('; ')
                    : info.message}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          ) : (
            errorMessage(create.error)
          )}
        </Notice>
      )}

      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button type="submit" size="lg" disabled={!acknowledged || !ctxValid || create.isPending}>
          {create.isPending ? 'Scheduling…' : 'Deploy'}
        </Button>
        {!acknowledged && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Confirm the notice above to deploy.</span>}
        {model.license && <Pill>{model.license}</Pill>}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

function RuntimeOption({
  checked,
  onChange,
  title,
  detail,
}: {
  checked: boolean;
  onChange: () => void;
  title: string;
  detail: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <label
      className={`flex cursor-pointer gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3 text-sm ${checked ? 'border-foreground' : 'border-border'}`}
    >
      <input type="radio" name="runtime" checked={checked} onChange={onChange} className="mt-1" />
      <span>
        <span className="font-medium">{title}</span>
        <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{detail}</span>
      </span>
    </label>
  );
}

import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { dateTime } from '@/lib/format';
import type { DeploymentEvent } from '@/types';

export function DeploymentTimeline({ events }: { events: DeploymentEvent[] }) {
  if (events.length === 0) return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No events yet.</p>;
  return (
    <ol className="relative space-y-4 border-l border-border pl-5" data-testid="deployment-events">
      {events.map((e, i) => (
        <li key={`${e.created_at}-${i}`} className="relative">
          <span className="absolute -left-[1.6rem] top-1.5 size-2.5 rounded-full border-2 border-background bg-muted-foreground" />
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            {e.to_status && <StatusBadge status={e.to_status} />}
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {dateTime(e.created_at)} · {e.actor}
            </span>
          </div>
          {e.message && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{e.message}</p>}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Notice } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import api from '@/lib/api';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import type { Deployment } from '@/types';

interface ChatCompletion {
  choices?: { message?: { content?: string } }[];
  usage?: { prompt_tokens?: number; completion_tokens?: number };
}

/** Sends one real, non-streaming request through the gateway with the signed-in user's session. It is metered
 * like any other request and is answered by the model on the provider's node. */
export function Playground({ deployment }: { deployment: Deployment }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState('');
  const run = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (text: string) => {
      const started = performance.now();
      const { data } = await api.post<ChatCompletion>(
        `${deployment.openai_base_url}/chat/completions`,
        { model: deployment.model_tag, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: text }], max_tokens: 256, stream: false },
        { timeout: 120000 },
      );
      return { data, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - started) };
    },
    onSettled: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['usage'] }),
  });
  const answer = run.data?.data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;
  const usage = run.data?.data.usage;

  return (
    <form
      className="space-y-3"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (prompt.trim()) run.mutate(prompt.trim());
      }}
    >
      <Textarea
        aria-label="Prompt"
        value={prompt}
        onChange={(e) => setPrompt(e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Ask the model something (do not include anything confidential)"
        rows={3}
        maxLength={4000}
      />
      <Button type="submit" disabled={run.isPending || !prompt.trim()}>
        {run.isPending ? 'Waiting for the model…' : 'Send'}
      </Button>
      {run.error && <Notice tone="danger">{errorMessage(run.error)}</Notice>}
      {run.data && (
        <div className="space-y-2 rounded-lg border border-border p-4" data-testid="playground-answer">
          <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm">{answer ?? '(the model returned no text)'}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {run.data.ms} ms
            {usage?.completion_tokens != null &&
              ` · ${usage.prompt_tokens ?? '?'} input / ${usage.completion_tokens} output tokens (reported by the runtime)`}
            {' · max 256 output tokens'}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { AxiosError, AxiosHeaders } from 'axios';
import { DeployForm } from '../DeployForm';
import api from '@/lib/api';
import type { Model, ModelArtifact } from '@/types';

const push = jest.fn();
jest.mock('next/navigation', () => ({ useRouter: () => ({ push }) }));
jest.mock('@/lib/api', () => ({ __esModule: true, default: { post: jest.fn() } }));
const post = api.post as jest.Mock;

const artifact = (runtime: ModelArtifact['runtime'], over: Partial<ModelArtifact> = {}): ModelArtifact => ({
  id: runtime,
  runtime,
  source_type: runtime === 'ollama' ? 'ollama' : 'huggingface',
  reference: runtime === 'ollama' ? 'qwen2.5:0.5b' : 'Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF',
  revision: null,
  file: null,
  sha256: null,
  size_bytes: null,
  format: null,
  quantization: null,
  min_ram_mb: runtime === 'ollama' ? 1024 : 768,
  min_disk_mb: 768,
  min_vram_mb: 0,
  min_cpu_cores: 1,
  gpu_required: false,
  requirements_estimated: true,
  is_enabled: true,
  last_ready_at: null,
  ...over,
});

const model = { id: 'm1', name: 'Qwen', license: 'Apache-2.0', artifacts: [artifact('llamacpp'), artifact('ollama')] } as Model;

function renderForm(m: Model = model) {
  const qc = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { mutations: { retry: false } } });
  return render(
    <QueryClientProvider client={qc}>
      <DeployForm model={m} />
    </QueryClientProvider>,
  );
}

  post.mockReset();
  push.mockReset();
});
