  renderForm();
  const deploy = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Deploy' });
  expect(deploy).toBeDisabled();
  expect(screen.getByText(/provider can see the model, its memory, and every prompt/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /I understand the provider can see/ }));
  expect(deploy).toBeEnabled();
});

it('submits the chosen runtime and config with an idempotency key, then opens the deployment', async () => {
  post.mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 'dep-1' } });
  renderForm();
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: /^llama\.cpp/ }));
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Context window (tokens)'), { target: { value: '4096' } });
  // Only the chosen runtime is estimated: 768 MB + 128 MB for the larger context.
  expect(screen.getByText(/896 MB RAM/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(screen.queryByText(/1 GB RAM/)).toBeNull();
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /I understand/ }));
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Deploy' }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(push).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/customer/deployments/dep-1'));
  const [url, body] = post.mock.calls[0];

  expect(body.idempotency_key).toEqual(expect.any(String));

it('lists automatic runtimes in preference order and omits runtime for automatic', async () => {
  post.mockResolvedValue({ data: { id: 'dep-2' } });
  renderForm();
  expect(screen.getByText(/Try Ollama, then llama\.cpp/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /I understand/ }));
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Deploy' }));

  const headers = new AxiosHeaders();
  post.mockRejectedValue(

      status: 503,

  expect(push).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
});

it('refuses models without an enabled artifact', () => {
  renderForm({ ...model, artifacts: [artifact('ollama', { is_enabled: false })] });
  expect(screen.getByText(/no enabled runtime artifact/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Deploy' })).toBeNull();

import Link from 'next/link';
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Link2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { CodeBlock } from '@/components/common/CodeBlock';
import { Notice } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { DOC_PAGES } from '@/lib/docs';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export function DocPage({ href, children }: { href: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const index = DOC_PAGES.findIndex((p) => p.href === href);
  const page = DOC_PAGES[index];
  const prev = DOC_PAGES[index - 1];
  const next = DOC_PAGES[index + 1];
  return (
    <article className="max-w-3xl">
      <p className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Documentation</p>
      <h1 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-[-0.03em] md:text-4xl">{page.title}</h1>
      <p className="mt-3 text-lg text-muted-foreground">{page.summary}</p>
      <div className="mt-10 space-y-14">{children}</div>
      <nav className="mt-16 grid gap-3 border-t border-border pt-8 sm:grid-cols-2" aria-label="Pagination">
        {prev ? (
          <Link href={prev.href} className="rounded-lg border border-border p-4 transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground"><ArrowLeft className="size-3" /> Previous</span>
            <span className="mt-1 block text-sm font-medium">{prev.title}</span>
          </Link>
        ) : (
          <Link href="/docs" className="rounded-lg border border-border p-4 transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground"><ArrowLeft className="size-3" /> Previous</span>
            <span className="mt-1 block text-sm font-medium">Overview</span>
          </Link>
        )}
        {next && (
          <Link href={next.href} className="rounded-lg border border-border p-4 text-right transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50 sm:col-start-2">
            <span className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Next <ArrowRight className="size-3" /></span>
            <span className="mt-1 block text-sm font-medium">{next.title}</span>
          </Link>
        )}
      </nav>
    </article>
  );
}

export function Section({ id, title, children }: { id: string; title: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section id={id} className="scroll-mt-24 space-y-4">
      <h2 className="group flex items-center gap-2 text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight md:text-2xl">
        {title}
        <a href={`#${id}`} aria-label={`Link to ${title}`} className="text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100">
          <Link2 className="size-4" />
        </a>
      </h2>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

export function H3({ id, children }: { id?: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <h3 id={id} className="scroll-mt-24 pt-2 text-base font-semibold">
      {children}
    </h3>
  );
}

export function P({ children, className }: { children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  return <p className={cn('leading-7 text-foreground/85', className)}>{children}</p>;
}

export function List({ items, ordered }: { items: React.ReactNode[]; ordered?: boolean }) {
  const Tag = ordered ? 'ol' : 'ul';
  return (
    <Tag className={cn('space-y-2 pl-5 leading-7 text-foreground/85', ordered ? 'list-decimal' : 'list-disc')}>
      {items.map((item, i) => (
        <li key={i} className="pl-1">{item}</li>
      ))}
    </Tag>
  );
}

export function C({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <code className="rounded border border-border bg-muted/60 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[0.85em]">{children}</code>;
}

export function A({ href, children }: { href: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const cls = 'font-medium underline decoration-border underline-offset-4 transition-colors hover:decoration-foreground';
  return href.startsWith('/') || href.startsWith('#') ? (
    <Link href={href} className={cls}>{children}</Link>
  ) : (
    <a href={href} className={cls} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{children}</a>
  );
}

export function Code({ code, title }: { code: string; title?: string }) {
  return (
    <div>
      {title && <p className="mb-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{title}</p>}
      <CodeBlock code={code} />
    </div>
  );
}

export function Callout({ tone = 'info', title, children }: { tone?: 'info' | 'warning' | 'danger'; title?: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <Notice tone={tone} title={title}>{children}</Notice>;
}

export function Table({ head, rows }: { head: string[]; rows: React.ReactNode[][] }) {
  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-border">
      <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
        <thead className="bg-muted/50">
          <tr>
            {head.map((h) => (
              <th key={h} className="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{h}</th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody className="divide-y divide-border">
          {rows.map((row, i) => (
            <tr key={i}>
              {row.map((cell, j) => (
                <td key={j} className="px-3 py-2 align-top leading-6">{cell}</td>
              ))}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

export function StatusPill({ status }: { status: 'working' | 'test-mode' | 'unverified' | 'planned' }) {
  const label = { working: 'Working', 'test-mode': 'Test mode', unverified: 'Not verified', planned: 'Planned' }[status];
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        'inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium',
        status === 'working' && 'border-brand/30 text-foreground',
        status === 'test-mode' && 'border-amber-500/40 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300',
        status === 'unverified' && 'border-amber-500/40 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300',
        status === 'planned' && 'border-border text-muted-foreground',
      )}
    >
      <span
        className={cn(
          'size-1.5 rounded-full',
          status === 'working' && 'bg-brand',
          (status === 'test-mode' || status === 'unverified') && 'bg-amber-500',
          status === 'planned' && 'bg-muted-foreground/50',
        )}
      />
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ArrowUpRight, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { Logo } from '@/components/brand/Logo';
import { ThemeToggle } from '@/components/ui/ThemeToggle';
import { DashboardLink } from '@/components/auth/SessionLinks';
import { REPO_URL } from '@/lib/config';
import { DOC_PAGES, searchDocs } from '@/lib/docs';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

function DocsSearch() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const hits = searchDocs(query);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
      if (e.key === '/' && !['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA'].includes(target.tagName)) {
        e.preventDefault();
        input.current?.focus();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, []);

  const go = (href: string) => {
    setOpen(false);
    setQuery('');
    input.current?.blur();
    router.push(href);
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full max-w-xs">
      <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 size-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
      <input
        ref={input}
        type="search"
        value={query}
        placeholder="Search docs"
        aria-label="Search documentation"
        onChange={(e) => {
          setQuery(e.target.value);
          setActive(0);
          setOpen(true);
        }}
        onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
        onBlur={() => setTimeout(() => setOpen(false), 120)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
            e.preventDefault();
            setActive((i) => Math.min(i + 1, hits.length - 1));
          } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
            e.preventDefault();
            setActive((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
          } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && hits[active]) {
            go(hits[active].href);
          } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            input.current?.blur();
          }
        }}
        className="h-8 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background pl-8 pr-8 text-[13px] outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-muted-foreground/70 focus:border-foreground/40"
      />
      <kbd className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2 top-1/2 hidden -translate-y-1/2 rounded border border-border px-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground sm:block">/</kbd>
      {open && query && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-10 z-50 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border bg-popover shadow-lifted sm:right-auto sm:w-80">
          {hits.length ? (
            <ul role="listbox">
              {hits.map((h, i) => (
                <li key={h.href} role="option" aria-selected={i === active}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                    onClick={() => go(h.href)}
                    onMouseEnter={() => setActive(i)}
                    className={cn('block w-full px-3 py-2 text-left', i === active && 'bg-accent')}
                  >
                    <span className="block text-[13px] font-medium">{h.title}</span>
                    <span className="block text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{h.page}</span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          ) : (
            <p className="px-3 py-3 text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">No results for &ldquo;{query}&rdquo;</p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function DocsNav({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate?: () => void }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Documentation" className="space-y-0.5">
      <Link
        href="/docs"
        onClick={onNavigate}
        className={cn('block rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[13px] transition-colors', pathname === '/docs' ? 'bg-accent font-medium text-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground')}
      >
        Overview
      </Link>
      {DOC_PAGES.map((p) => {
        const active = pathname === p.href;
        return (
          <div key={p.href}>
            <Link
              href={p.href}
              onClick={onNavigate}
              className={cn('block rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[13px] transition-colors', active ? 'bg-accent font-medium text-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground')}
            >
              {p.title}
            </Link>
            {active && (
              <ul className="mb-2 ml-2.5 mt-1 space-y-0.5 border-l border-border pl-3">
                {p.sections.map((s) => (
                  <li key={s.id}>
                    <a href={`#${s.id}`} onClick={onNavigate} className="block py-0.5 text-[12.5px] text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground">
                      {s.title}
                    </a>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </nav>
  );
}

export function DocsShell({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false);
  const current = DOC_PAGES.find((p) => p.href === pathname);
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background">
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 border-b border-border bg-background/90 backdrop-blur">
        <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 max-w-7xl items-center gap-4 px-4 sm:px-6">
          <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
            <Logo />
            <span className="text-border">/</span>
            <Link href="/docs" className="text-[13px] font-medium">Docs</Link>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-1 justify-end md:justify-start md:pl-8">
            <DocsSearch />
          </div>
          <div className="hidden items-center gap-1 md:flex">
            <a href={REPO_URL} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-2.5 text-[13px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
              GitHub <ArrowUpRight className="size-3.5" />
            </a>
            <ThemeToggle />
            <DashboardLink className="ml-1 inline-flex h-8 items-center rounded-md bg-foreground px-3 text-[13px] font-medium text-background transition-opacity hover:opacity-85">
              Dashboard
            </DashboardLink>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="border-t border-border px-4 md:hidden">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setMenu((m) => !m)} aria-expanded={menu} className="flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between text-[13px]">
            <span className="font-medium">{current?.title ?? 'Overview'}</span>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">{menu ? 'Close' : 'Menu'}</span>
          </button>
          {menu && (
            <div className="max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto pb-4">
              <DocsNav onNavigate={() => setMenu(false)} />
              <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-border pt-3">
                <ThemeToggle />
                <a href={REPO_URL} className="text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">GitHub</a>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </header>
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-7xl gap-10 px-4 sm:px-6">
        <aside className="sticky top-14 hidden h-[calc(100vh-3.5rem)] w-56 shrink-0 overflow-y-auto py-8 md:block">
          <DocsNav />
        </aside>
        <main className="min-w-0 flex-1 py-10 md:py-12">{children}</main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { Notice } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { useWorkerRelease } from '@/hooks/useWorkerRelease';
import { RELEASES_URL, WORKER_VERSION } from '@/lib/config';
import { workerReleaseUrl } from '@/lib/worker';

export function ReleaseStatus() {
  const { data, isPending } = useWorkerRelease();
  if (isPending) return <Notice title={`Checking for the worker ${WORKER_VERSION} release…`}>Looking it up on GitHub.</Notice>;
  if (data === 'published') {
    return (
      <Notice title={`Worker ${WORKER_VERSION} is published`}>
        Assets are on the{' '}
        <a href={workerReleaseUrl()} className="underline underline-offset-4" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
          worker {WORKER_VERSION} release page
        </a>
        .
      </Notice>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Notice tone="warning" title={data === 'unpublished' ? `Worker ${WORKER_VERSION} has not been published yet` : 'Could not check the release'}>
      {data === 'unpublished' ? 'The download URLs below will work once the release appears on ' : 'Check '}
      <a href={RELEASES_URL} className="underline underline-offset-4" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
        GitHub Releases
      </a>
      {data === 'unpublished' ? '. Until then, install from source.' : ' before using the download commands.'}
    </Notice>
  );
}

'use client';

import { usePublicStats } from '@/hooks/useUsage';
import { runtimeLabel } from '@/lib/format';

/** Live counts from the AgentMesh database. Nothing here is simulated. */
export function LiveStats() {
  const { data, isError } = usePublicStats();
  const items = [
    { label: 'Nodes online', value: data?.nodes_online },
    { label: 'GPU nodes online', value: data?.gpu_nodes_online },
    { label: 'Deployable models', value: data?.models_deployable },
    { label: 'Deployments serving', value: data?.deployments_ready },
  ];
  return (
    <section className="border-y border-border bg-muted/30" aria-label="Network right now">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-10">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-border md:grid-cols-4">
          {items.map(({ label, value }) => (
            <div key={label} className="bg-background px-6 py-6">
              <div className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight tabular-nums" data-testid={`stat-${label}`}>
                {value == null ? '—' : value.toLocaleString()}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">{label}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <p className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {!isError && data && (
            <span className="relative flex size-2">
              <span className="absolute inline-flex size-full animate-ping rounded-full bg-emerald-400 opacity-60" />
              <span className="relative inline-flex size-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
            </span>
          )}
          {isError
            ? 'Live network figures are unavailable right now.'
            : data
              ? `Live from this AgentMesh network${data.runtimes_online.length ? ` · runtimes online: ${data.runtimes_online.map(runtimeLabel).join(', ')}` : ''}.`
              : 'Loading live network figures…'}
        </p>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePricing } from '@/hooks/useBilling';
import { money } from '@/lib/format';

/** Live price list from GET /billing/pricing. */
export function PricingSection() {
  const { data } = usePricing();
  const r = data?.current;
  const rows = r
    ? [
        ['CPU core', money(r.cpu_core_hour, r.currency), 'per hour'],
        ['Memory', money(r.ram_gb_hour, r.currency), 'per GB-hour'],
        ['GPU memory', money(r.vram_gb_hour, r.currency), 'per GB-hour'],
        ['Input tokens', money(r.input_tokens_per_million, r.currency), 'per million'],
        ['Output tokens', money(r.output_tokens_per_million, r.currency), 'per million'],
      ]
    : [];
  return (
    <section id="pricing" className="py-28">
      <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-6xl gap-12 px-6 lg:grid-cols-2 lg:items-center">
        <div>
          <p className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Pricing</p>
          <h2 className="mt-3 text-balance text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight md:text-[2.75rem] md:leading-[1.1]">Pay for what serves.</h2>
          <p className="mt-4 text-lg text-muted-foreground">
            Prepaid and transparent. You&apos;re charged for the resources reserved for your deployment only while it is
            ready, plus the tokens it processes. Downloads, startup and unhealthy time are free.
          </p>
          <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Providers receive {r ? `${Math.round((1 - Number(r.platform_fee_rate)) * 100)}%` : 'most'} of every charge.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-2 shadow-soft">
          {r ? (
            <>
              <div className="divide-y divide-border">
                {rows.map(([label, price, unit]) => (
                  <div key={label} className="flex items-baseline justify-between px-5 py-4">
                    <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
                    <span>
                      <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{price}</span>{' '}
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{unit}</span>
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <p className="px-5 pb-4 pt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Live price list, version {r.version}.</p>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="px-6 py-10 text-center">
              <p className="font-medium">No prices published yet</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                The network operator hasn&apos;t set a price list, so usage is currently measured but not charged.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="p-3">
            <Link href="/register" className="flex h-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground transition-opacity hover:opacity-90">
              Start deploying
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import { Sidebar } from './Sidebar';

let pathname = '/provider/nodes/register';
let role = 'provider';
jest.mock('next/navigation', () => ({ usePathname: () => pathname }));
jest.mock('../../hooks/useAuth', () => ({ useAuth: () => ({ user: { role, email: 'p@example.com' }, logout: jest.fn() }) }));
jest.mock('@/providers/ThemeProvider', () => ({ useTheme: () => ({ theme: 'dark', toggleTheme: jest.fn() }) }));

describe('Sidebar', () => {
  it('shows provider links and marks only the most specific match as current', () => {
    render(<Sidebar />);
    expect(screen.getByText('My Nodes')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Add a Machine' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'My Nodes' })).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-current');
  });

  it('shows operator links for admins, grouped, and only pages that exist', () => {
    role = 'admin';
    pathname = '/operator';
    render(<Sidebar />);
    expect(screen.getByText('Audit Log')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Finance')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Admin')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Network Map')).toBeNull();
  });
});

FILE 117/379: client/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx
LANGUAGE: typescript (tsx)   LINES: 209

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  Activity, Banknote, BarChart3, BookOpen, Box, CreditCard, KeyRound, LayoutDashboard, LogOut, PlusCircle, Receipt, Scale,
  ScrollText, Server, Settings, Sparkles, Tag, Wallet, type LucideIcon,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useAuth } from '../../hooks/useAuth';
import { Logo } from '@/components/brand/Logo';
import { ThemeToggle } from '@/components/ui/ThemeToggle';

export interface NavLink {
  href: string;
  label: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
}
type Section = { title?: string; links: NavLink[] };

export const customerSections: Section[] = [
  {
    links: [
      { href: '/customer', label: 'Overview', icon: LayoutDashboard },
      { href: '/customer/models', label: 'Models', icon: Box },
      { href: '/customer/deployments', label: 'Deployments', icon: Activity },
      { href: '/customer/ai', label: 'AI Deploy', icon: Sparkles },
      { href: '/customer/api-keys', label: 'API Keys', icon: KeyRound },
    ],
  },
  {
    title: 'Billing',
    links: [
      { href: '/customer/usage', label: 'Usage', icon: BarChart3 },
      { href: '/customer/wallet', label: 'Wallet', icon: CreditCard },
      { href: '/customer/transactions', label: 'Transactions', icon: Receipt },
    ],
  },
  { title: 'Account', links: [{ href: '/customer/settings', label: 'Settings', icon: Settings }] },
];

export const providerSections: Section[] = [
  {
    links: [
      { href: '/provider', label: 'Overview', icon: LayoutDashboard },
      { href: '/provider/nodes', label: 'My Nodes', icon: Server },
      { href: '/provider/nodes/register', label: 'Add a Machine', icon: PlusCircle },
      { href: '/provider/usage', label: 'Served Usage', icon: BarChart3 },
    ],
  },
  {
    title: 'Money',
    links: [
      { href: '/provider/earnings', label: 'Earnings & Payouts', icon: Wallet },
      { href: '/provider/transactions', label: 'Ledger', icon: Receipt },
    ],
  },
  { title: 'Account', links: [{ href: '/provider/settings', label: 'Settings', icon: Settings }] },
];

export const operatorSections: Section[] = [
  {
    links: [
      { href: '/operator', label: 'Overview', icon: LayoutDashboard },
      { href: '/operator/nodes', label: 'All Nodes', icon: Server },
      { href: '/operator/deployments', label: 'All Deployments', icon: Activity },
      { href: '/operator/models', label: 'Model Catalog', icon: Box },
      { href: '/operator/usage', label: 'Network Usage', icon: BarChart3 },
    ],
  },
  {
    title: 'Finance',
    links: [
      { href: '/operator/pricing', label: 'Pricing', icon: Tag },
      { href: '/operator/payouts', label: 'Payouts', icon: Banknote },
      { href: '/operator/reconciliation', label: 'Reconciliation', icon: Scale },
      { href: '/operator/transactions', label: 'Ledger', icon: Receipt },
    ],
  },
  { title: 'Security', links: [{ href: '/operator/audit', label: 'Audit Log', icon: ScrollText }] },
];

const ROLE_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { customer: 'Customer', provider: 'Provider', operator: 'Operator', admin: 'Admin' };

export function useNavLinks() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const role = user?.role;
  const sections = role === 'provider' ? providerSections : role === 'customer' ? customerSections : operatorSections;
  const links = sections.flatMap((s) => s.links);
  // Most specific match wins, so /provider/nodes/register does not also highlight /provider/nodes.
  const active = links
    .filter((l) => pathname === l.href || pathname.startsWith(l.href + '/'))
    .sort((a, b) => b.href.length - a.href.length)[0];
  return { user, role, sections, links, active, logout, roleLabel: ROLE_LABEL[role ?? ''] ?? '' };
}

function NavItem({ link, active }: { link: NavLink; active: boolean }) {
  const Icon = link.icon;
  return (
    <Link
      href={link.href}
      aria-current={active ? 'page' : undefined}
      className={cn(
        'group flex h-8 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-md px-2.5 text-[13px] transition-colors',
        active
          ? 'bg-sidebar-accent font-medium text-sidebar-accent-foreground'
          : 'text-sidebar-foreground/80 hover:bg-sidebar-accent/70 hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground',
      )}
    >
      <Icon className={cn('size-[17px] shrink-0', active ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-60 group-hover:opacity-100')} />
      <span className="truncate">{link.label}</span>
    </Link>
  );
}

export function Sidebar() {
  const { user, role, sections, active, logout, roleLabel } = useNavLinks();
  return (
    <aside className="hidden h-full w-[244px] shrink-0 flex-col border-r border-sidebar-border bg-sidebar md:flex">
      <div className="flex h-14 items-center border-b border-sidebar-border px-4">
        <Logo />
      </div>
      <nav className="flex-1 space-y-6 overflow-y-auto px-3 py-5">
        {sections.map((section, i) => (
          <div key={section.title ?? i}>
            {section.title && (
              <p className="mb-1.5 px-2.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">{section.title}</p>
            )}
            <ul className="space-y-0.5">
              {section.links.map((link) => (
                <li key={link.href}>
                  <NavItem link={link} active={link.href === active?.href} />
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        ))}
      </nav>
      <div className="border-t border-sidebar-border p-3">

          <span className="flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border bg-muted text-xs font-medium uppercase text-foreground">

          </span>

            <p className="truncate text-[13px] font-medium">{user?.email}</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{roleLabel}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between pl-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <ThemeToggle className="size-8 rounded-md" />
            <Link href={role === 'provider' ? '/docs/providers' : role === 'customer' ? '/docs/customers' : '/docs/operators'} aria-label="Documentation" title="Documentation" className="inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-foreground">
              <BookOpen className="size-4" />
            </Link>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => logout()}
            aria-label="Sign out"
            title="Sign out"
            className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-foreground"
          >
            <LogOut className="size-3.5" />
            Sign out
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button, buttonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { ConfirmButton } from '@/components/common/ConfirmButton';
import { Pill } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { Notice } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import {
  useCommunityModels,
  useImportCommunityModel,
  usePreviewCommunityModel,
  useWithdrawCommunityModel,
} from '@/hooks/useModels';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { bytes, mb } from '@/lib/format';
import type { CommunityModelPreview } from '@/types';

/** Import a public GGUF file from Hugging Face. Two steps: look the repository up, then pick a file and accept. */
function ImportForm() {
  const [repo, setRepo] = useState('');
  const [revision, setRevision] = useState('');
  const [file, setFile] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [accepted, setAccepted] = useState(false);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<CommunityModelPreview | null>(null);
  const lookUp = usePreviewCommunityModel();
  const importModel = useImportCommunityModel();

  const onLookUp = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setPreview(null);
    setFile(null);
    setAccepted(false);
    lookUp
      .mutateAsync({ repo: repo.trim(), revision: revision.trim() })
      .then((p) => {
        setPreview(p);
        setFile(p.files.find((f) => !f.problem)?.name ?? null);
      })
      .catch((err) => toast.error(errorMessage(err)));
  };

  const onImport = () => {
    if (!preview || !file) return;
    importModel
      // Import the exact commit that was previewed, not whatever the branch points to by now.
      .mutateAsync({ repo: preview.repo, file, revision: preview.revision, accept_terms: accepted })
      .then((m) => {
        toast.success(`Imported ${m.name}`);
        setPreview(null);
        setRepo('');
        setRevision('');
      })
      .catch((err) => toast.error(errorMessage(err)));
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <form onSubmit={onLookUp} className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_10rem_auto] sm:items-end">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <Label htmlFor="hf-repo">Hugging Face repository or link</Label>
          <Input
            id="hf-repo"
            required
            placeholder="bartowski/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct-GGUF"
            value={repo}
            onChange={(e) => setRepo(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <Label htmlFor="hf-revision">Branch or commit</Label>
          <Input id="hf-revision" placeholder="main" value={revision} onChange={(e) => setRevision(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
        <Button type="submit" disabled={lookUp.isPending || !repo.trim()}>
          {lookUp.isPending ? 'Looking up…' : 'Look up'}
        </Button>
      </form>

      {preview && (
        <div className="space-y-3 rounded-md border border-border p-4 text-sm">
          <p>
            <span className="font-medium">{preview.repo}</span>{' '}
            <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">@ {preview.revision.slice(0, 12)}</span>
            <span className="block text-muted-foreground">
              {[preview.license && `License: ${preview.license}`, preview.architecture, preview.context_length && `${preview.context_length.toLocaleString()} token context`]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join(' · ')}
            </span>
          </p>
          {preview.license_problem ? (
            <Notice tone="danger" title="Cannot be imported">
              {preview.license_problem}
            </Notice>
          ) : preview.files.length === 0 ? (
            <Notice tone="warning" title="No GGUF files">
              This repository has no .gguf files at its top level. Look for a repository that publishes GGUF quantizations.
            </Notice>
          ) : (
            <>
              <fieldset className="space-y-1">
                <legend className="mb-1 font-medium">Choose a file</legend>
                {preview.files.map((f) => (
                  <label
                    key={f.name}
                    className={`flex items-start gap-2 rounded px-2 py-1 ${f.problem ? 'text-muted-foreground' : 'cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted'}`}
                  >
                    <input
                      type="radio"
                      name="gguf-file"
                      className="mt-1"
                      disabled={!!f.problem}
                      checked={file === f.name}
                      onChange={() => setFile(f.name)}
                    />
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="break-all font-mono text-xs">{f.name}</span>
                      <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {f.problem ?? `${bytes(f.size_bytes)} download · reserves about ${mb(f.min_ram_mb)} RAM`}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                  </label>
                ))}
              </fieldset>
              <label className="flex items-start gap-2">
                <input type="checkbox" className="mt-1" checked={accepted} onChange={(e) => setAccepted(e.target.checked)} />
                <span>
                  I may use this model under its license{preview.license ? ` (${preview.license})` : ''}, and I am responsible
                  for how I use it and its output. AgentMesh has not reviewed it.
                </span>
              </label>
              <Button onClick={onImport} disabled={!file || !accepted || importModel.isPending}>
                {importModel.isPending ? 'Importing…' : 'Import model'}
              </Button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function CommunityModels() {
  const { data: models } = useCommunityModels();
  const withdraw = useWithdrawCommunityModel();

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Your models from Hugging Face</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          Import a public GGUF model for your own deployments. Only you can see or deploy it. It runs with llama.cpp on
          nodes whose providers accept community models, from a file pinned to one commit and checked by SHA-256. Gated,
          private, and non-commercially licensed models cannot be imported.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-6">
        <ImportForm />
        {models && models.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
            {models.map((m) => {
              const art = m.artifacts[0];
              return (
                <li key={m.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3 text-sm" data-testid="community-model">
                  <span className="min-w-0">
                    <span className="font-medium">{m.name}</span>{' '}
                    {m.is_community ? <Pill tone="amber">unreviewed</Pill> : <Pill tone="green">in catalog</Pill>}
                    <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {[m.license, m.download_size_mb && `${mb(m.download_size_mb)} file`, art && `reserves ${mb(art.min_ram_mb)} RAM`]
                        .filter(Boolean)
                        .join(' · ')}
                      {m.source_url && (
                        <>
                          {' · '}
                          <a href={m.source_url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener" className="underline underline-offset-4">
                            source
                          </a>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="flex gap-2">
                    {art?.is_enabled ? (
                      <Link href={`/customer/deployments/new?model=${m.id}`} className={buttonVariants({ size: 'sm' })}>
                        Deploy
                      </Link>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Disabled by an operator</span>
                    )}
                    {m.is_community && (
                      <ConfirmButton
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        confirmLabel="Remove"
                        disabled={withdraw.isPending}
                        onConfirm={() =>
                          withdraw
                            .mutateAsync(m.id)
                            .then(() => toast.success('Model removed'))
                            .catch((e) => toast.error(errorMessage(e)))
                        }
                      >
                        Remove
                      </ConfirmButton>
                    )}
                  </span>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

import { capacityRows } from '@/lib/nodes';
import { mb } from '@/lib/format';
import type { Node } from '@/types';

/** Reserved (by AgentMesh deployments) versus allocated (the limit the provider set on the machine). */
export function CapacityBars({ node }: { node: Node }) {
  const rows = capacityRows(node);
  if (rows.length === 0) return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">The worker has not reported its limits yet.</p>;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {rows.map((r) => {
        const pct = r.allocated > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((r.reserved / r.allocated) * 100)) : 0;
        const fmt = (v: number) => (r.unit === 'mb' ? mb(v) : String(v));
        return (
          <div key={r.label} className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
              <span>{r.label}</span>
              <span className="tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                {fmt(r.reserved)} of {fmt(r.allocated)} reserved
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted" role="progressbar" aria-label={r.label} aria-valuenow={pct}>
              <div className={`h-full rounded-full ${pct >= 90 ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-brand'}`} style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from 'next/link';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { NodeAvailabilityBadge } from './NodeAvailabilityBadge';
import { ago, mb, runtimeLabel, shortId } from '@/lib/format';
import type { AdminNode, Node } from '@/types';

export function NodeTable({
  nodes,
  href,
  actions,
}: {
  nodes: (Node | AdminNode)[];
  href?: (n: Node) => string;
  actions?: (n: Node) => React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const showOwner = nodes.some((n) => 'owner_email' in n);
  return (
    <Table>
      <TableHeader>
        <TableRow>
          <TableHead>Node</TableHead>
          {showOwner && <TableHead>Owner</TableHead>}
          <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Availability</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Runtimes</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Memory reserved</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Last heartbeat</TableHead>
          {actions && <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>}
        </TableRow>
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {nodes.map((n) => (
          <TableRow key={n.id} data-testid="node-row">
            <TableCell>
              {href ? (
                <Link href={href(n)} className="font-medium hover:underline">
                  {n.name ?? shortId(n.id)}
                </Link>
              ) : (
                <span className="font-medium">{n.name ?? shortId(n.id)}</span>
              )}
              <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {n.mode === 'agent' ? 'Installable agent' : n.mode === 'docker' ? 'Docker worker' : (n.mode ?? '—')}
                {n.region ? ` · ${n.region}` : ''}
              </div>
            </TableCell>
            {showOwner && <TableCell className="text-xs">{(n as AdminNode).owner_email ?? '—'}</TableCell>}
            <TableCell>
              <StatusBadge status={n.status} />
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell>
              <NodeAvailabilityBadge node={n} />
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-xs">
              {(n.runtimes ?? []).filter((r) => r.available).map((r) => runtimeLabel(r.name)).join(', ') || '—'}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-xs tabular-nums">
              {mb(n.reserved_ram_mb)} / {mb(n.allocated_ram_mb)}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-xs">{ago(n.last_heartbeat)}</TableCell>
            {actions && <TableCell className="text-right">{actions(n)}</TableCell>}
          </TableRow>
        ))}
      </TableBody>
    </Table>
  );
}

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export function ThemeToggle({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={toggleTheme}
      aria-label="Toggle theme"
      title={`Switch to ${theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'} mode`}

  );

const buttonVariants = cva(

function Button({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  loading,
  ...props
}: ButtonPrimitive.Props & VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> & { loading?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <ButtonPrimitive
      data-slot="button"
      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
      disabled={loading || props.disabled}
      {...props}
    >
      {loading && (
        <svg className="animate-spin -ml-1 mr-2 h-4 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
          <circle className="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="4" />
          <path className="opacity-75" fill="currentColor" d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z" />
        </svg>
      )}
      {props.children}
    </ButtonPrimitive>
  )
}

'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { Bar, BarChart, CartesianGrid, Legend, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from 'recharts';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { StatCard } from '@/components/common/StatCard';
import { EmptyState, ErrorState } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { TableSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { useUsageSummary } from '@/hooks/useUsage';
import { errorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { count, shortId } from '@/lib/format';
import type { UsageSummary } from '@/types';

const DAY_OPTIONS = [7, 30, 90];

export function UsageSummaryView({
  days,
  onDaysChange,
  scope,
  deploymentHref,
  deploymentLabel,
}: {
  days: number;
  onDaysChange: (d: number) => void;
  scope?: UsageSummary['scope'];
  deploymentHref?: (id: string) => string;
  deploymentLabel?: (id: string) => string;
}) {
  const { data, isLoading, error, refetch } = useUsageSummary(days, scope);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
        <span className="text-muted-foreground">Period</span>
        {DAY_OPTIONS.map((d) => (
          <button
            key={d}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onDaysChange(d)}
            aria-pressed={d === days}
            className={`rounded-md border px-2.5 py-1 ${d === days ? 'border-foreground font-medium' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground'}`}
          >
            {d} days
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {error ? (
        <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error)} retry={() => refetch()} />
      ) : isLoading || !data ? (
        <TableSkeleton rows={3} />
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
            <StatCard
              title="Requests"
              value={count(data.totals.requests)}
              hint={`${count(data.totals.succeeded)} succeeded, ${count(data.totals.failed)} failed`}
            />
            <StatCard title="Input tokens" value={count(data.totals.input_tokens)} />
            <StatCard title="Output tokens" value={count(data.totals.output_tokens)} />
            <StatCard
              title="Requests without token counts"
              value={count(data.totals.requests_without_token_counts)}
              hint="The runtime did not report counts (for example, a failed or cancelled request). Never estimated."
            />
          </div>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Per day</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Token counts are reported by the model runtime on the provider&apos;s node and are not independently
                verified.
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              {data.by_day.length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyState>No inference requests in the last {days} days.</EmptyState>
              ) : (
                <div className="h-64 w-full" data-testid="usage-chart">
                  <ResponsiveContainer>
                    <BarChart data={data.by_day}>
                      <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" className="stroke-border" />
                      <XAxis dataKey="date" fontSize={12} />
                      <YAxis fontSize={12} allowDecimals={false} />
                      <Tooltip />
                      <Legend />
                      <Bar dataKey="input_tokens" name="Input tokens" stackId="t" fill="#60a5fa" />
                      <Bar dataKey="output_tokens" name="Output tokens" stackId="t" fill="#2563eb" />
                    </BarChart>
                  </ResponsiveContainer>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {data.by_deployment.length > 0 && (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle>By deployment</CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableHead>Deployment</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="text-right">Requests</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="text-right">Failed</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="text-right">Input tokens</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="text-right">Output tokens</TableHead>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {data.by_deployment.map((row) => {
                      const label = deploymentLabel?.(row.deployment_id) ?? shortId(row.deployment_id);
                      return (
                        <TableRow key={row.deployment_id}>
                          <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">
                            {deploymentHref ? (
                              <Link className="underline underline-offset-4" href={deploymentHref(row.deployment_id)}>
                                {label}
                              </Link>
                            ) : (
                              label
                            )}
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{count(row.requests)}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{count(row.failed)}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{count(row.input_tokens)}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{count(row.output_tokens)}</TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      );
                    })}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/common/StatusBadge';
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/common/Notices';
import { dateTime, money, shortId } from '@/lib/format';
import type { Transaction } from '@/types';

const TYPE_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  DEPOSIT: 'Deposit',
  COMPUTE_CHARGE: 'Compute charge',
  PROVIDER_CREDIT: 'Provider credit',
  PLATFORM_FEE: 'Platform fee',
  REFUND: 'Refund',
  PAYOUT: 'Payout',
};

/** Ledger rows. `walletId` decides the sign: money into that wallet is positive. */
export function LedgerTable({ rows, walletId, empty }: { rows: Transaction[]; walletId?: string; empty: string }) {
  if (rows.length === 0) return <EmptyState>{empty}</EmptyState>;
  return (
    <Table>
      <TableHeader>
        <TableRow>
          <TableHead>Date</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Type</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Description</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Deployment</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
        </TableRow>
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {rows.map((tx) => {
          const incoming = walletId ? tx.to_wallet === walletId : true;
          return (
            <TableRow key={tx.id}>
              <TableCell className="text-sm">{dateTime(tx.created_at)}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-sm">{TYPE_LABEL[tx.type] ?? tx.type}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="max-w-xs truncate text-sm text-muted-foreground">{tx.description ?? '—'}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{tx.deployment_id ? shortId(tx.deployment_id) : '—'}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                <StatusBadge status={tx.status} />
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell className={`text-right font-mono text-sm ${incoming ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : ''}`}>
                {walletId ? (incoming ? '+' : '−') : ''}
                {money(tx.amount)}
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          );
        })}
      </TableBody>
    </Table>
  );
}

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import api from '../lib/api';
import { AI_TERMINAL_STATUSES, type AiHealth, type AiRun, type AiRunEvent, type AutonomyLimits } from '../types';

const active = (r?: AiRun) => !!r && !AI_TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(r.status);

export const useAiHealth = () =>
  useQuery({
    queryKey: ['ai', 'health'],
    queryFn: async () => (await api.get<AiHealth>('/ai/health')).data,
    refetchInterval: 15000,
  });

export const useAiRuns = () =>
  useQuery({
    queryKey: ['ai', 'runs'],
    queryFn: async () => (await api.get<AiRun[]>('/ai/deployments')).data,
    refetchInterval: (q) => (q.state.data?.some(active) ? 4000 : 20000),
  });

export const useAiRun = (id: string) =>
  useQuery({
    queryKey: ['ai', 'runs', id],
    queryFn: async () => (await api.get<AiRun>(`/ai/deployments/${id}`)).data,
    enabled: !!id,
    refetchInterval: (q) => (active(q.state.data) ? 3000 : 15000),
  });

export const useAiRunEvents = (id: string, live: boolean) =>
  useQuery({
    queryKey: ['ai', 'runs', id, 'events'],
    queryFn: async () => (await api.get<AiRunEvent[]>(`/ai/deployments/${id}/events`)).data,
    enabled: !!id,
    refetchInterval: live ? 3000 : 15000,
  });

export interface CreateAiRunInput {
  request: string;
  limits: AutonomyLimits;
  idempotency_key: string;
}

export const useCreateAiRun = () => {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (payload: CreateAiRunInput) => (await api.post<AiRun>('/ai/deployments', payload)).data,
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['ai', 'runs'] }),
  });
};

export const useCancelAiRun = () => {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (id: string) => (await api.post<AiRun>(`/ai/deployments/${id}/cancel`)).data,
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['ai', 'runs'] });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['deployments'] });
    },
  });
};

import { useAuthStore } from '../stores/authStore';
import { useCallback } from 'react';

export const useAuth = () => {
  const user = useAuthStore((state) => state.user);
  const token = useAuthStore((state) => state.token);
  const isAuthenticated = useAuthStore((state) => state.isAuthenticated);
  const isLoading = useAuthStore((state) => state.isLoading);
  const error = useAuthStore((state) => state.error);
  const loginFn = useAuthStore((state) => state.login);
  const registerFn = useAuthStore((state) => state.register);
  const logoutFn = useAuthStore((state) => state.logout);
  const initialize = useAuthStore((state) => state.initialize);
  const clearError = useAuthStore((state) => state.clearError);

  const handleLogout = useCallback(() => {
    logoutFn();
  }, [logoutFn]);

  return {
    user, token, isAuthenticated, isLoading, error,
    login: loginFn,
    register: registerFn,
    logout: handleLogout,
    initialize,
    clearError,
  };
};

function useDeploymentAction(action: 'stop' | 'restart' | 'delete') {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (id: string) =>

    },
  });

import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { getCachedUser, hasSession } from '../lib/auth';
import { homeFor } from '../lib/roles';

function subscribe(onChange: () => void) {
  window.addEventListener('storage', onChange);
  return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', onChange);
}

/** The signed-in user's dashboard path, read from storage without an API call; null when signed out and during
 * server rendering, so pages hydrate as signed out and switch once the browser has read the session. */
export function useStoredSession(): string | null {
  return useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribe,
    () => (hasSession() ? homeFor(getCachedUser()?.role) : null),
    () => null,
  );
}

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { WORKER_VERSION } from '../lib/config';
import { workerTag } from '../lib/worker';

export type WorkerReleaseState = 'published' | 'unpublished' | 'unknown';

/** Asks GitHub whether the worker release this dashboard points at has been published. */
export const useWorkerRelease = (version = WORKER_VERSION) =>
  useQuery({
    queryKey: ['worker-release', version],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<WorkerReleaseState> => {
      const res = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/meshach5667/AgentMeshh/releases/tags/${workerTag(version)}`, {
        headers: { Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json' },
      });
      if (res.ok) return 'published';
      if (res.status === 404) return 'unpublished';
      return 'unknown';
    },
    staleTime: 10 * 60 * 1000,
    retry: false,
  });

import type { AiRunStatus, AiServiceStatus, AutonomyLimits } from '@/types';

// Platform ceilings, mirroring server settings AI_MAX_DEPLOYMENT_HOURS and AI_MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS.
export const MAX_DURATION_HOURS = 168;
export const MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS = 3;
export const MIN_REQUEST_CHARS = 5;
export const MAX_REQUEST_CHARS = 2000;

export const DEFAULT_LIMITS: AutonomyLimits = {
  max_spend: '1000',
  max_duration_hours: 2,
  max_cpu_cores: 4,
  max_ram_mb: 8192,
  max_vram_mb: 0,
  max_recovery_attempts: 1,
  allowed_runtimes: ['ollama', 'llamacpp', 'vllm'],
  allowed_sources: ['ollama', 'huggingface'],
};

/** Problems with a request before it is sent; the server enforces the same rules. */
export function validateAiRequest(text: string, limits: AutonomyLimits): string[] {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  const t = text.trim();
  if (t.length < MIN_REQUEST_CHARS) problems.push('Describe what you want to deploy.');
  if (t.length > MAX_REQUEST_CHARS) problems.push(`Keep the description under ${MAX_REQUEST_CHARS} characters.`);
  const spend = Number(limits.max_spend);
  if (!Number.isFinite(spend) || spend <= 0) problems.push('Maximum spend must be more than zero.');
  if (!(limits.max_duration_hours > 0) || limits.max_duration_hours > MAX_DURATION_HOURS)
    problems.push(`Maximum duration must be between 0 and ${MAX_DURATION_HOURS} hours.`);
  if (!Number.isInteger(limits.max_cpu_cores) || limits.max_cpu_cores < 1) problems.push('Allow at least 1 CPU core.');
  if (!Number.isInteger(limits.max_ram_mb) || limits.max_ram_mb < 512) problems.push('Allow at least 512 MB of memory.');
  if (!Number.isInteger(limits.max_vram_mb) || limits.max_vram_mb < 0) problems.push('GPU memory cannot be negative.');
  if (
    !Number.isInteger(limits.max_recovery_attempts) ||
    limits.max_recovery_attempts < 0 ||
    limits.max_recovery_attempts > MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS
  )
    problems.push(`Recovery attempts must be between 0 and ${MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS}.`);
  if (limits.allowed_runtimes.length === 0) problems.push('Allow at least one runtime.');
  if (limits.allowed_sources.length === 0) problems.push('Allow at least one model source.');
  return problems;
}

export const AI_STATUS_HELP: Record<AiRunStatus, string> = {
  PLANNING: 'The AI agent is choosing a model and a deployment plan from the approved catalog.',
  SUBMITTING: 'AgentMesh accepted the plan and is reserving capacity on a provider node.',
  DEPLOYING: 'A provider node is downloading and starting the model.',
  VERIFYING: 'The model reports ready. AgentMesh is sending it a real test request before publishing the endpoint.',
  READY: 'Verified with a real test request. The endpoint is live and is stopped automatically at your limits.',
  RECOVERING: 'The deployment failed. The AI agent is diagnosing it and may retry within your recovery limit.',
  STOPPING: 'Stopping the deployment and releasing its resources.',
  COMPLETED: 'Finished. The deployment was stopped (limit reached or stopped elsewhere).',
  FAILED: 'Failed. See the reason below. Nothing keeps running.',
  CANCELLED: 'Cancelled. Nothing keeps running.',
};

import axios from 'axios';
import { removeToken } from './auth';
import { API_URL } from './config';

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: API_URL,
});

api.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    if (token) {
      config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    }
  }
  return config;
});

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  (error) => {
    if (error.response?.status === 401 && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      removeToken();
      if (window.location.pathname !== '/login' && window.location.pathname !== '/register') {
        window.location.href = '/login';
      }
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export default api;

import type { User } from '../types/user';

const TOKEN_KEY = 'token';
const USER_KEY = 'user';

export function getToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  return window.localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
}

export function setToken(token: string): void {
  window.localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token);
}

export function removeToken(): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  window.localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
  window.localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
}

/** The signed-in user, cached so a reload or a slow API (Render cold start) does not sign the user out. */
export function getCachedUser(): User | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as User) : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function setCachedUser(user: User): void {
  window.localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
}

/** True when the JWT's `exp` claim is in the past. A token that cannot be decoded is left for the API to judge. */
export function isTokenExpired(token: string, now = Date.now()): boolean {
  try {
    const payload = token.split('.')[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const { exp } = JSON.parse(atob(payload)) as { exp?: number };
    return typeof exp === 'number' && exp * 1000 <= now;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** A stored, unexpired token: what the UI treats as "signed in" before the API confirms it. */
export function hasSession(): boolean {
  const token = getToken();
  return !!token && !isTokenExpired(token);
}

import type { Charge, PricingRule } from '@/types';

/** Same formula as billing_service.hourly_resource_price (decimal strings are parsed as numbers for display). */
export function hourlyResourcePrice(rule: PricingRule, cpuCores: number, ramMb: number, vramMb: number): number {
  return (
    Number(rule.cpu_core_hour) * cpuCores +
    (Number(rule.ram_gb_hour) * ramMb) / 1024 +
    (Number(rule.vram_gb_hour) * vramMb) / 1024
  );
}

export function isFree(rule: PricingRule | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!rule) return true;
  return [rule.cpu_core_hour, rule.ram_gb_hour, rule.vram_gb_hour, rule.input_tokens_per_million, rule.output_tokens_per_million].every(
    (v) => Number(v) === 0,
  );
}

export function sumAmounts(charges: Charge[], field: 'amount' | 'provider_amount' = 'amount'): number {
  return charges.reduce((t, c) => t + Number(c[field]), 0);
}

/** Paystack appends ?reference=...&trxref=... when it returns the customer to the callback URL. */
export function returnedReference(params: URLSearchParams): string | null {
  const ref = params.get('reference') || params.get('trxref');
  return ref && /^am-top-[0-9a-f]{24}$/.test(ref) ? ref : null;
}

/** Only send customers to Paystack's own checkout (never to a URL an attacker could have planted). */
export function isPaystackCheckout(url: string | null | undefined): url is string {
  if (!url) return false;
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    return u.protocol === 'https:' && (u.hostname === 'checkout.paystack.com' || u.hostname.endsWith('.paystack.com'));
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

import type { Deployment, DeploymentStatus, ModelArtifact, Runtime } from '@/types';

// Mirrors server/app/services/catalog_service.py.
export const RUNTIME_PREFERENCE: Runtime[] = ['ollama', 'llamacpp', 'vllm'];
export const DEFAULT_NUM_CTX = 2048;
export const MIN_NUM_CTX = 512;
export const MAX_NUM_CTX = 8192;

export interface Requirements {
  cpu_cores: number;
  ram_mb: number;
  disk_mb: number;
  vram_mb: number;
  gpu_required: boolean;
}

/** Same formula as the scheduler's reservation (estimate_requirements): +128 MB per extra 2048 tokens. */
export function estimateRequirements(a: ModelArtifact, numCtx: number, requireGpu: boolean): Requirements {
  const extra = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((numCtx - DEFAULT_NUM_CTX) / 2048)) * 128;
  const gpu = a.gpu_required || requireGpu;
  return {
    cpu_cores: Math.max(1, a.min_cpu_cores || 1),
    ram_mb: a.min_ram_mb + extra,
    disk_mb: a.min_disk_mb,
    vram_mb: gpu ? (a.min_vram_mb || 0) + extra : 0,
    gpu_required: gpu,
  };
}

/** Enabled artifacts in the order "automatic" runtime selection tries them. */
export function deployableArtifacts(artifacts: ModelArtifact[]): ModelArtifact[] {
  return artifacts
    .filter((a) => a.is_enabled && RUNTIME_PREFERENCE.includes(a.runtime))
    .sort((x, y) => RUNTIME_PREFERENCE.indexOf(x.runtime) - RUNTIME_PREFERENCE.indexOf(y.runtime));
}

export function newIdempotencyKey(): string {
  const c = globalThis.crypto;
  if (c?.randomUUID) return c.randomUUID();
  return `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
}

export interface ApiExample {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  code: string;
}

/** Copy-paste examples for calling a deployment. Uses an API key from the environment, never a real secret. */
export function apiExamples(dep: Pick<Deployment, 'openai_base_url' | 'endpoint' | 'runtime' | 'model_tag'>): ApiExample[] {
  const base = dep.openai_base_url;
  const model = dep.model_tag ?? 'model';
  if (!base) return [];
  const examples: ApiExample[] = [
    {
      id: 'curl',
      label: 'curl',
      code: [
        `curl ${base}/chat/completions \\`,
        `  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMESH_API_KEY" \\`,
        `  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\`,
        `  -d '{"model": "${model}", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}'`,
      ].join('\n'),
    },
    {
      id: 'python',
      label: 'Python (openai)',
      code: [
        'import os',
        'from openai import OpenAI',
        '',
        `client = OpenAI(base_url="${base}", api_key=os.environ["AGENTMESH_API_KEY"])`,
        'reply = client.chat.completions.create(',
        `    model="${model}",`,
        '    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],',
        ')',
        'print(reply.choices[0].message.content)',
      ].join('\n'),
    },
    {
      id: 'stream',
      label: 'Streaming',
      code: [
        `curl -N ${base}/chat/completions \\`,
        `  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMESH_API_KEY" \\`,
        `  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\`,
        `  -d '{"model": "${model}", "stream": true, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}'`,
      ].join('\n'),
    },
  ];
  if (dep.runtime === 'ollama' && dep.endpoint) {
    examples.push({
      id: 'ollama',
      label: 'Ollama API',
      code: [
        `curl ${dep.endpoint}/api/chat \\`,
        `  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMESH_API_KEY" \\`,
        `  -d '{"model": "${model}", "stream": false, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}'`,
      ].join('\n'),
    });
  }
  return examples;
}

export interface SearchHit {
  href: string;
  title: string;
  page: string;
}

export function searchDocs(query: string, limit = 8): SearchHit[] {
  const terms = query.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (!terms.length) return [];
  const hits: (SearchHit & { score: number })[] = [];
  for (const page of DOC_PAGES) {
    const entries = [
      { href: page.href, title: page.title, text: `${page.title} ${page.summary}`, boost: 1 },
      ...page.sections.map((s) => ({ href: `${page.href}#${s.id}`, title: s.title, text: `${s.title} ${s.keywords ?? ''}`, boost: 0 })),
    ];
    for (const e of entries) {
      const text = e.text.toLowerCase();
      if (!terms.every((t) => text.includes(t))) continue;
      const score = terms.reduce((n, t) => n + (e.title.toLowerCase().includes(t) ? 2 : 1), e.boost);
      hits.push({ href: e.href, title: e.title, page: page.title, score });
    }
  }
  return hits.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, limit).map(({ href, title, page }) => ({ href, title, page }));
}

import { isAxiosError } from 'axios';

/** Placement failure returned with HTTP 503 by POST /deployments. */
export interface NoCapacityDetail {
  code: string;
  message?: string;
  reasons?: Record<string, number>;
  by_runtime?: Record<string, { message?: string; reasons?: Record<string, number> }>;
  requirements?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

// Reason codes from server/app/services/scheduler_service.py.
const REASON_TEXT: Record<string, string> = {
  provider_unavailable: 'node offline, paused, or outside its availability schedule',
  unsupported_runtime: 'runtime not installed on the node',
  incompatible_hardware: 'hardware does not match (for example, a GPU is required)',
  insufficient_capacity: 'not enough free CPU, memory, disk or GPU memory',
  region_mismatch: 'not in the requested region',
  previously_failed: 'this deployment already failed on the node',
  community_not_accepted: 'the provider has not opted in to community models',
};

export function reasonText(reason: string): string {
  return REASON_TEXT[reason] ?? reason.replace(/_/g, ' ');
}

export function noCapacityDetail(err: unknown): NoCapacityDetail | null {
  if (!isAxiosError(err) || err.response?.status !== 503) return null;
  const detail = err.response.data?.detail;
  return detail && typeof detail === 'object' && 'code' in detail ? (detail as NoCapacityDetail) : null;
}

/** Human-readable message for an API error (FastAPI `detail` as string, validation list, or object). */
export function errorMessage(err: unknown, fallback = 'Something went wrong'): string {
  if (isAxiosError(err)) {
    if (!err.response) return 'Cannot reach the AgentMesh API. Check that the server is running.';
    const detail = err.response.data?.detail ?? err.response.data?.error;
    if (typeof detail === 'string') return detail;
    if (Array.isArray(detail)) {
      return detail
        .map((d: { loc?: unknown[]; msg?: string }) => {
          const field = (d.loc ?? []).filter((p) => p !== 'body').join('.');
          return field ? `${field}: ${d.msg}` : d.msg;
        })
        .join('; ');
    }
    if (detail && typeof detail === 'object') {
      const d = detail as NoCapacityDetail;
      if (d.reasons && Object.keys(d.reasons).length) {
        const why = Object.entries(d.reasons)
          .map(([r, n]) => `${reasonText(r)} (${n})`)
          .join(', ');
        return `${d.message ?? 'No node can run this deployment right now'}: ${why}`;
      }
      return d.message ?? d.code ?? fallback;
    }
    return `Request failed (HTTP ${err.response.status})`;
  }
  return err instanceof Error ? err.message : fallback;
}

import { formatDistanceToNowStrict } from 'date-fns';

/** API timestamps are naive UTC (no offset); parse them as UTC. */
export function parseApiDate(value: string | null | undefined): Date | null {
  if (!value) return null;
  const hasZone = /[zZ]|[+-]\d\d:?\d\d$/.test(value);
  const d = new Date(hasZone ? value : `${value}Z`);
  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
}

export function ago(value: string | null | undefined, never = 'never'): string {
  const d = parseApiDate(value);
  return d ? `${formatDistanceToNowStrict(d)} ago` : never;
}

export function dateTime(value: string | null | undefined, empty = '—'): string {
  const d = parseApiDate(value);
  return d ? d.toLocaleString(undefined, { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }) : empty;
}

export function mb(value: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (value == null) return '—';
  return value >= 1024 ? `${(value / 1024).toFixed(value % 1024 === 0 ? 0 : 1)} GB` : `${value} MB`;
}

export function bytes(value: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (value == null) return '—';
  return mb(Math.round(value / 2 ** 20));
}

export function count(value: number | null | undefined): string {
  return value == null ? '—' : value.toLocaleString();
}

export function shortId(id: string | null | undefined): string {
  return id ? id.slice(0, 8) : '—';
}

/** Display default; amounts from the API carry their own currency, which callers pass when they have it. */
export const BILLING_CURRENCY = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BILLING_CURRENCY || 'NGN';

/** Ledger amounts arrive as decimal strings. */
export function money(value: string | number | null | undefined, currency = BILLING_CURRENCY): string {
  const n = typeof value === 'string' ? Number(value) : (value ?? 0);
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency, maximumFractionDigits: 4 }).format(n);
}

export const RUNTIME_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { ollama: 'Ollama', llamacpp: 'llama.cpp', vllm: 'vLLM' };

export function runtimeLabel(runtime: string | null | undefined): string {
  return runtime ? (RUNTIME_LABEL[runtime] ?? runtime) : '—';
}

import { parseApiDate } from './format';
import type { Node } from '@/types';

export type NodeAvailability = { label: string; tone: 'green' | 'amber' | 'red' | 'gray'; detail: string };

const WORKER_REASON: Record<string, string> = {
  paused: 'paused on the machine (agentmesh-worker pause)',
  draining: 'draining on the machine (agentmesh-worker drain)',
  schedule: 'outside the availability schedule set on the machine',
};

/** Whether new deployments can be placed on the node, and why not. Mirrors the scheduler's checks. */
export function nodeAvailability(node: Node, heartbeatTimeoutSeconds = 90): NodeAvailability {
  if (node.status === 'REVOKED') return { label: 'Revoked', tone: 'red', detail: 'Its credential no longer works. Enroll the machine again to reuse it.' };
  if (node.status === 'SUSPENDED') return { label: 'Suspended', tone: 'red', detail: 'Suspended by an operator.' };
  const beat = parseApiDate(node.last_heartbeat);
  if (node.status === 'OFFLINE' || !beat || Date.now() - beat.getTime() > heartbeatTimeoutSeconds * 1000) {
    return { label: 'Offline', tone: 'red', detail: 'The worker is not sending heartbeats. Check that it is running (agentmesh-worker doctor).' };
  }
  if (!node.accepting_workloads) return { label: 'Paused', tone: 'amber', detail: 'Paused in AgentMesh. Running deployments continue; no new ones are placed.' };
  if (!node.worker_available) {
    const why = node.worker_unavailable_reason ?? '';
    return { label: 'Unavailable', tone: 'amber', detail: `Not taking work: ${WORKER_REASON[why] ?? why ?? 'reported by the worker'}.` };
  }
  return { label: 'Accepting work', tone: 'green', detail: 'New deployments can be placed here when they fit.' };
}

export function capacityRows(node: Node) {
  return [
    { label: 'CPU cores', reserved: node.reserved_cpu_cores, allocated: node.allocated_cpu_cores, unit: '' },
    { label: 'Memory', reserved: node.reserved_ram_mb, allocated: node.allocated_ram_mb, unit: 'mb' },
    { label: 'Disk', reserved: node.reserved_disk_mb, allocated: node.allocated_disk_mb, unit: 'mb' },
    { label: 'GPU memory', reserved: node.reserved_vram_mb, allocated: node.allocated_vram_mb, unit: 'mb' },
  ].filter((r) => r.allocated > 0 || r.reserved > 0);
}

import { CONTROL_PLANE_URL, REPO_URL, WORKER_VERSION } from './config';

export const workerTag = (version = WORKER_VERSION) => `worker-v${version}`;
export const workerWheel = (version = WORKER_VERSION) => `agentmesh_worker-${version}-py3-none-any.whl`;
export const workerReleaseUrl = (version = WORKER_VERSION) => `${REPO_URL}/releases/tag/${workerTag(version)}`;
export const workerDownloadBase = (version = WORKER_VERSION) => `${REPO_URL}/releases/download/${workerTag(version)}`;

export interface InstallOptions {
  token?: string;
  version?: string;
  controlPlane?: string;
  maxRamMb?: number;
  maxCpu?: number;
  maxDiskMb?: number;
}

const TOKEN_PLACEHOLDER = '<enrollment-token>';

/** Downloads the versioned release, checks it against SHA256SUMS, then installs. The token is only ever a CLI argument. */
export function agentInstallCommand({
  token,
  version = WORKER_VERSION,
  controlPlane = CONTROL_PLANE_URL,
  maxRamMb = 8192,
  maxCpu = 4,
  maxDiskMb = 30000,
}: InstallOptions = {}): string {
  return [
    `VERSION=${version}`,
    `BASE=${workerDownloadBase(version)}`,
    'mkdir -p ~/agentmesh-worker-$VERSION && cd ~/agentmesh-worker-$VERSION',
    'for f in install.sh uninstall.sh agentmesh_worker-$VERSION-py3-none-any.whl SHA256SUMS; do',
    '  curl -fsSLO "$BASE/$f" || break',
    'done',
    'if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null; then sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS; else shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS; fi \\',
    '  && chmod +x install.sh uninstall.sh \\',
    '  && ./install.sh --wheel ./agentmesh_worker-$VERSION-py3-none-any.whl \\',
    `       --control-plane ${controlPlane} --token ${token ?? TOKEN_PLACEHOLDER} \\`,
    `       --max-ram-mb ${maxRamMb} --max-cpu ${maxCpu} --max-disk-mb ${maxDiskMb}`,
  ].join('\n');
}

export function sourceInstallCommand({ token, controlPlane = CONTROL_PLANE_URL }: InstallOptions = {}): string {
  return [

  });
});

function axiosError(status: number, data: unknown): AxiosError {
  const headers = new AxiosHeaders();
  return new AxiosError('failed', 'ERR', undefined, undefined, {
    status,
    statusText: '',
    headers,
    config: { headers },
    data,
  });
}

    ).toBe('config.num_ctx: too large');

      'Not ready yet',
    );
  });
