      detail: { code: 'no_eligible_node', message: 'No node fits', reasons: { insufficient_capacity: 2 } },
    });
    expect(noCapacityDetail(err)?.reasons).toEqual({ insufficient_capacity: 2 });
    expect(errorMessage(err)).toBe('No node fits: not enough free CPU, memory, disk or GPU memory (2)');
    expect(noCapacityDetail(axiosError(500, { detail: 'boom' }))).toBeNull();
  });

  it('reports an unreachable API distinctly', () => {
    expect(errorMessage(new AxiosError('Network Error'))).toMatch(/Cannot reach the AgentMesh API/);
  });
});

    expect(list.map((a) => a.id)).toEqual(['l', 'v']);

'use client';

import React, { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';

type Theme = 'dark' | 'light';

interface ThemeContextType {
  theme: Theme;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextType | undefined>(undefined);

// The <html> class (set before paint by the inline script in app/layout.tsx) is the source of truth.
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
const subscribe = (cb: () => void) => {
  listeners.add(cb);
  return () => listeners.delete(cb);
};
const read = (): Theme => (document.documentElement.classList.contains('light') ? 'light' : 'dark');

function apply(theme: Theme) {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  root.classList.remove('dark', 'light');
  root.classList.add(theme);
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);
  } catch {
    // storage may be unavailable (private mode); the class still applies for this visit
  }
  listeners.forEach((l) => l());
}

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const theme = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, read, () => 'dark' as Theme);
  const setTheme = useCallback((t: Theme) => apply(t), []);
  const toggleTheme = useCallback(() => apply(read() === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'), []);
  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, toggleTheme, setTheme }}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>;
}

export const useTheme = () => {
  const ctx = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!ctx) return { theme: 'dark' as Theme, toggleTheme: () => {}, setTheme: () => {} };
  return ctx;
};

LANGUAGE: typescript   LINES: 112

import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { User, UserRole } from '../types/user';
import api from '../lib/api';
import { errorMessage } from '../lib/errors';
import { setToken, removeToken, getToken, getCachedUser, setCachedUser, isTokenExpired } from '../lib/auth';

interface AuthState {
  user: User | null;
  token: string | null;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
  register: (email: string, password: string, role: UserRole) => Promise<void>;
  logout: () => void;
  initialize: () => Promise<void>;
  clearError: () => void;
}

const signedOut = { user: null, token: null, isAuthenticated: false, isLoading: false };

// One /auth/me check at a time, however many guards mount while it is in flight.
let verifying: Promise<void> | null = null;

export const useAuthStore = create<AuthState>((set) => ({
  user: null,
  token: null,
  isAuthenticated: false,
  isLoading: true,
  error: null,

  login: async (email: string, password: string) => {
    set({ isLoading: true, error: null });
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post('/auth/login', { email, password });
      setToken(data.access_token);
      setCachedUser(data.user);
      set({
        token: data.access_token,
        user: data.user,
        isAuthenticated: true,
        isLoading: false,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      const message = errorMessage(err, 'Login failed');
      set({ error: message, isLoading: false });
      throw new Error(message);
    }
  },

  register: async (email: string, password: string, role: UserRole) => {
    set({ isLoading: true, error: null });
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post('/auth/register', { email, password, role });
      setToken(data.access_token);
      setCachedUser(data.user);
      set({
        token: data.access_token,
        user: data.user,
        isAuthenticated: true,
        isLoading: false,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      const message = errorMessage(err, 'Registration failed');
      set({ error: message, isLoading: false });
      throw new Error(message);
    }
  },

  logout: () => {
    removeToken();
    set({ ...signedOut, error: null });
  },

  /** Restores the stored session at once from the cached user, then confirms it with /auth/me. Only a 401/403
   * signs the user out; a network error or 5xx (for example the API waking up) keeps the session. */
  initialize: async () => {
    const token = getToken();
    if (!token || isTokenExpired(token)) {
      removeToken();
      set(signedOut);
      return;
    }
    const cached = getCachedUser();
    if (cached) set({ token, user: cached, isAuthenticated: true, isLoading: false });
    else set({ token });

    if (verifying) return verifying;
    verifying = (async () => {
      try {
        const { data } = await api.get('/auth/me', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
        if (getToken() !== token) return; // signed out or switched accounts meanwhile
        setCachedUser(data);
        set({ user: data, isAuthenticated: true, isLoading: false });
      } catch (err) {
        const status = (err as { response?: { status?: number } }).response?.status;
        if (status === 401 || status === 403) {
          removeToken();
          set(signedOut);
        } else if (!cached) {
          // No cached user to fall back on, so the dashboard cannot pick a role yet; keep the token for a retry.
          set({ isLoading: false, error: errorMessage(err, 'Could not reach the server') });
        }
      } finally {
        verifying = null;
      }
    })();
    return verifying;
  },

  clearError: () => set({ error: null }),
}));

import api from '../../lib/api';
import { getToken, isTokenExpired, setCachedUser, setToken } from '../../lib/auth';
import { useAuthStore } from '../authStore';

jest.mock('../../lib/api', () => ({ __esModule: true, default: { get: jest.fn(), post: jest.fn() } }));
const get = api.get as jest.Mock;

const user = { id: 'u1', email: 'c@example.com', role: 'customer' as const, is_active: true, created_at: '2026-01-01' };
const jwt = (exp: number) => `h.${btoa(JSON.stringify({ sub: 'u1', exp })).replace(/=+$/, '')}.s`;
const future = () => jwt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600);

beforeEach(() => {
  localStorage.clear();
  get.mockReset();
  useAuthStore.setState({ user: null, token: null, isAuthenticated: false, isLoading: true, error: null });
});

describe('auth session', () => {
  it('restores the cached user immediately and keeps the session when the API is unreachable', async () => {
    setToken(future());
    setCachedUser(user);
    get.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Network Error'));
    const pending = useAuthStore.getState().initialize();
    expect(useAuthStore.getState()).toMatchObject({ isAuthenticated: true, isLoading: false, user });
    await pending;
    expect(useAuthStore.getState().isAuthenticated).toBe(true);
    expect(getToken()).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('signs out only when the API rejects the token', async () => {
    setToken(future());
    setCachedUser(user);
    get.mockRejectedValue({ response: { status: 401 } });
    await useAuthStore.getState().initialize();
    expect(useAuthStore.getState().isAuthenticated).toBe(false);
    expect(getToken()).toBeNull();
  });

  it('keeps the token for a retry when there is no cached user and the API is down', async () => {
    setToken(future());
    get.mockRejectedValue({ response: { status: 503 } });
    await useAuthStore.getState().initialize();
    expect(useAuthStore.getState()).toMatchObject({ isAuthenticated: false, isLoading: false });
    expect(useAuthStore.getState().token).not.toBeNull();
    expect(getToken()).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('drops an expired token without calling the API', async () => {
    setToken(jwt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) - 10));
    await useAuthStore.getState().initialize();
    expect(get).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(getToken()).toBeNull();
  });

  it('shares one /auth/me call between guards that mount together', async () => {
    setToken(future());
    get.mockResolvedValue({ data: user });
    await Promise.all([useAuthStore.getState().initialize(), useAuthStore.getState().initialize()]);
    expect(get).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(useAuthStore.getState().user).toEqual(user);
  });

  it('treats undecodable tokens as not expired so the API decides', () => {
    expect(isTokenExpired('not-a-jwt')).toBe(false);

FILE 190/379: server/ai_adapter/cli.py
LANGUAGE: python   LINES: 161
================================================================================
"""AgentMesh AI inference adapter (`python -m ai_adapter`). Runs on the internal inference machine.

    python -m ai_adapter doctor        hardware, Ollama, and model check with a recommendation (changes nothing)
    python -m ai_adapter check         one small structured generation with the configured model; prints latency
    python -m ai_adapter pull --yes    download OLLAMA_MODEL after checking disk space and RAM
    python -m ai_adapter run           serve the control plane (the systemd unit runs this)

Configuration: environment variables or ~/.config/agentmesh/ai-adapter.env (see docs/AI_INFERENCE_SETUP.md).
"""

import argparse
import asyncio
import json
import logging
import signal
import sys

import httpx
from pydantic import ValidationError

from .config import config_file, load_settings
from .ollama import OllamaProvider, ProviderError
from .system import hardware, pull_problems, recommend

CHECK_SCHEMA = {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["ok"]}, "model_family": {"type": "string"}},
    "required": ["status"],
}


def _print(obj) -> None:
    print(json.dumps(obj, indent=2, default=str))


async def _doctor(s) -> int:
    hw = hardware()
    rec = recommend(hw)
    status = await OllamaProvider(s).status()
    _print(
        {
            "hardware": hw.as_dict(),
            "inference": "GPU: " + ",".join(hw.accelerators) if hw.accelerators else "CPU only",
            "recommended_model": rec.tag,
            "recommendation": rec.reason,
            "configured_model": s.OLLAMA_MODEL,
            "configured_model_pull_problems": pull_problems(hw, s.OLLAMA_MODEL),
            "ollama": {
                "reachable": status.ok,
                "version": status.version,
                "model_present": status.model_present,
                "model_loaded": status.model_loaded,
                "capabilities": status.capabilities,
                "error": status.error,
            },
            "config_file": str(config_file()),
        }
    )
    return 0 if status.ready else 1


async def _check(s) -> int:
    provider = OllamaProvider(s)
    status = await provider.status()
    if not status.ready:
        print(f"Not ready: {status.error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    messages = [{"role": "user", "content": 'Reply with the JSON object {"status": "ok"} and your model family.'}]
    try:
        out = await provider.chat(
            messages, schema=CHECK_SCHEMA, options={"num_predict": 64}, timeout=s.AI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
        )
    except ProviderError as exc:
        print(f"Generation failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(out.content)
    except ValueError:
        print(f"Model did not return JSON: {out.content[:200]!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    _print(
        {
            "ok": parsed.get("status") == "ok",
            "reply": parsed,
            "model": out.model,
            "latency_ms": out.latency_ms,
            "prompt_tokens": out.prompt_tokens,
            "output_tokens": out.output_tokens,
        }
    )
    return 0 if parsed.get("status") == "ok" else 1


async def _pull(s, yes: bool) -> int:
    hw = hardware()
    problems = pull_problems(hw, s.OLLAMA_MODEL)
    if problems:
        print("Refusing to pull: " + "; ".join(problems), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    if not yes:
        print(f"Would pull {s.OLLAMA_MODEL} into {hw.models_dir}. Re-run with --yes to download.")
        return 0
    print(f"Pulling {s.OLLAMA_MODEL} through {s.ollama} ...")
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(base_url=s.ollama, timeout=httpx.Timeout(None, connect=10.0)) as client:
        async with client.stream("POST", "/api/pull", json={"model": s.OLLAMA_MODEL, "stream": True}) as resp:
            last = ""
            async for line in resp.aiter_lines():
                if not line.strip():
                    continue
                msg = json.loads(line)
                if "error" in msg:
                    print(f"Pull failed: {msg['error']}", file=sys.stderr)
                    return 1
                status = msg.get("status", "")
                if msg.get("total"):
                    status += f" {int(100 * msg.get('completed', 0) / msg['total'])}%"
                if status != last:
                    print(status)
                    last = status
    return 0


async def _run(s) -> int:
    from .service import Adapter

    if not s.AI_INFERENCE_TOKEN:
        print("AI_INFERENCE_TOKEN is not set", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    adapter = Adapter(s)
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    for sig in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
        try:
            loop.add_signal_handler(sig, adapter.stop_event.set)
        except NotImplementedError:
            pass
    return await adapter.run()


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m ai_adapter", description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("doctor")
    sub.add_parser("check")
    pull = sub.add_parser("pull")
    pull.add_argument("--yes", action="store_true", help="actually download")
    sub.add_parser("run")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        s = load_settings()
    except ValidationError as exc:
        print(f"Invalid configuration: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    logging.basicConfig(level=s.LOG_LEVEL, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
    logging.getLogger("httpx").setLevel(logging.WARNING)
    if args.cmd == "doctor":
        return asyncio.run(_doctor(s))
    if args.cmd == "check":
        return asyncio.run(_check(s))
    if args.cmd == "pull":
        return asyncio.run(_pull(s, args.yes))
    return asyncio.run(_run(s))

"""Configuration of the AI inference adapter that runs on the internal inference machine (e.g. the HP 15).

Variables are read from the environment and from ~/.config/agentmesh/ai-adapter.env.
"""

import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from pydantic import model_validator
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict

ADAPTER_VERSION = "0.1.0"
LOCAL_HOSTS = {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"}
NODE_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$")


def config_file() -> Path:
    return Path(os.environ.get("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", Path.home() / ".config")) / "agentmesh" / "ai-adapter.env"


class AdapterSettings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_file=None, extra="ignore")

    # Local Ollama. Loopback only unless explicitly allowed: Ollama has no authentication of its own.
    OLLAMA_BASE_URL: str = "http://127.0.0.1:11434"
    ALLOW_REMOTE_OLLAMA: bool = False
    OLLAMA_MODEL: str = "gemma4:e2b-it-qat"
    # How long Ollama keeps the model in memory after a request, so it is loaded once and reused.
    OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE: str = "30m"

    # AgentMesh control plane, reached outbound (no public address or open port needed here).
    AGENTMESH_CONTROL_PLANE_URL: str = "http://localhost:8000"
    ALLOW_INSECURE_CONTROL_PLANE: bool = False
    AI_INFERENCE_TOKEN: str = ""
    AI_INFERENCE_NODE_ID: str = "hp15"

    # Conservative laptop defaults.
    AI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT: int = 180  # seconds per model call
    AI_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS: int = 1
    AI_NUM_CTX: int = 4096
    AI_MAX_TOKENS: int = 512
    # Stop taking work when the machine is busy with other things.
    AI_MIN_AVAILABLE_MEMORY_MB: int = 1024  # once the model is loaded
    AI_MAX_LOAD_PER_CPU: float = 1.5  # 1-minute load average divided by logical CPUs
    AI_MAX_RETRIES: int = 1  # extra attempts when Ollama cannot be reached; never after a timeout

    LOG_LEVEL: str = "INFO"

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _check(self) -> "AdapterSettings":
        ollama = urlparse(self.OLLAMA_BASE_URL)
        if ollama.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not ollama.hostname:
            raise ValueError("OLLAMA_BASE_URL must be an http(s) URL")
        if ollama.hostname not in LOCAL_HOSTS and not self.ALLOW_REMOTE_OLLAMA:
            raise ValueError("OLLAMA_BASE_URL must be on this machine (set ALLOW_REMOTE_OLLAMA=true to override)")
        cp = urlparse(self.AGENTMESH_CONTROL_PLANE_URL)
        if cp.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not cp.hostname:
            raise ValueError("AGENTMESH_CONTROL_PLANE_URL must be an http(s) URL")
        if cp.scheme == "http" and cp.hostname not in LOCAL_HOSTS and not self.ALLOW_INSECURE_CONTROL_PLANE:
            raise ValueError("AGENTMESH_CONTROL_PLANE_URL must use https (the inference token travels in headers)")
        if not NODE_ID_RE.fullmatch(self.AI_INFERENCE_NODE_ID):
            raise ValueError("AI_INFERENCE_NODE_ID must be letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' (max 64)")
        if not 1 <= self.AI_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS <= 4:
            raise ValueError("AI_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS must be 1-4 on a single machine")
        if not 10 <= self.AI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT <= 3600:
            raise ValueError("AI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT must be 10-3600 seconds")
        if not 1024 <= self.AI_NUM_CTX <= 32768 or not 16 <= self.AI_MAX_TOKENS <= 4096:
            raise ValueError("AI_NUM_CTX must be 1024-32768 and AI_MAX_TOKENS 16-4096")
        return self

    @property
    def control_plane(self) -> str:
        return self.AGENTMESH_CONTROL_PLANE_URL.rstrip("/")

    @property
    def ollama(self) -> str:
        return self.OLLAMA_BASE_URL.rstrip("/")


def load_settings(**overrides) -> AdapterSettings:
    path = config_file()
    return AdapterSettings(_env_file=str(path) if path.exists() else None, **overrides)  # type: ignore[call-arg]

"""Inference providers. ``OllamaProvider`` talks to the local Ollama HTTP API; anything implementing
``InferenceProvider`` can replace it (another runtime, or the same adapter on another machine).

Only these Ollama endpoints are used: /api/version, /api/tags, /api/ps, /api/show, /api/chat. Pulling a model
is a separate, explicit command (see cli.py) and never happens implicitly.
"""

import asyncio
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Protocol

import httpx

from .config import AdapterSettings


class ProviderError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str, retryable: bool = False):
        self.code = code
        self.message = message
        self.retryable = retryable
        super().__init__(f"{code}: {message}")


@dataclass
class ProviderStatus:
    ok: bool  # the runtime answers
    version: str | None = None
    model_present: bool = False  # pulled locally
    model_loaded: bool = False  # resident in memory right now
    model_size_bytes: int | None = None
    capabilities: list[str] | None = None
    error: str | None = None

    @property
    def ready(self) -> bool:
        return self.ok and self.model_present and (self.capabilities is None or "completion" in self.capabilities)


@dataclass
class ChatResult:
    content: str
    model: str
    latency_ms: int
    prompt_tokens: int | None
    output_tokens: int | None


class InferenceProvider(Protocol):
    model: str

    async def status(self) -> ProviderStatus: ...

    async def chat(
        self, messages: list[dict], *, schema: dict | None, options: dict[str, Any], timeout: float
    ) -> ChatResult: ...


def _names(tag: str) -> set[str]:
    return {tag, f"{tag}:latest"} if ":" not in tag else {tag}


class OllamaProvider:
    def __init__(self, settings: AdapterSettings, transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None):
        self.settings = settings
        self.model = settings.OLLAMA_MODEL
        self.base = settings.ollama
        self._transport = transport

    def _client(self, timeout: httpx.Timeout | float) -> httpx.AsyncClient:
        return httpx.AsyncClient(base_url=self.base, timeout=timeout, transport=self._transport)

    async def status(self) -> ProviderStatus:
        try:
            async with self._client(5.0) as client:
                version = (await client.get("/api/version")).json().get("version")
                tags = (await client.get("/api/tags")).json().get("models", [])
                present = next((m for m in tags if {m.get("name"), m.get("model")} & _names(self.model)), None)
                ps = (await client.get("/api/ps")).json().get("models", [])
                loaded = any({m.get("name"), m.get("model")} & _names(self.model) for m in ps)
                caps = None
                if present is not None:
                    show = await client.post("/api/show", json={"model": self.model})
                    if show.status_code == 200:
                        caps = show.json().get("capabilities")
                        caps = [str(c) for c in caps] if isinstance(caps, list) else None
        except (httpx.HTTPError, ValueError, AttributeError) as exc:
            return ProviderStatus(ok=False, error=f"Ollama is not reachable ({type(exc).__name__})")
        return ProviderStatus(
            ok=True,
            version=str(version) if version else None,
            model_present=present is not None,
            model_loaded=loaded,
            model_size_bytes=int(present.get("size") or 0) if present else None,
            capabilities=caps,
            error=None if present is not None else f"model {self.model} is not pulled",
        )

    def _options(self, requested: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """The control plane's options, clamped to this machine's own limits."""
        s = self.settings
        return {
            "num_ctx": min(int(requested.get("num_ctx") or s.AI_NUM_CTX), s.AI_NUM_CTX),
            "num_predict": min(int(requested.get("num_predict") or s.AI_MAX_TOKENS), s.AI_MAX_TOKENS),
            "temperature": float(requested.get("temperature", 0)),
        }

    async def chat(
        self, messages: list[dict], *, schema: dict | None, options: dict[str, Any], timeout: float
    ) -> ChatResult:
        body: dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": self.model,
            "messages": [{"role": str(m.get("role")), "content": str(m.get("content"))} for m in messages],
            "stream": False,
            "think": False,
            "keep_alive": self.settings.OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE,
            "options": self._options(options),
        }
        if schema:
            body["format"] = schema
        attempts = 1 + max(0, self.settings.AI_MAX_RETRIES)
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        for attempt in range(attempts):
            try:
                # Cancelling the calling task closes the connection, and Ollama stops generating.
                async with self._client(httpx.Timeout(timeout, connect=5.0)) as client:
                    resp = await client.post("/api/chat", json=body)
                break
            except httpx.ConnectError:
                if attempt + 1 >= attempts:
                    raise ProviderError("OLLAMA_UNREACHABLE", "Ollama is not reachable", retryable=True) from None
                await asyncio.sleep(2.0 * (attempt + 1))
            except httpx.TimeoutException:
                # Not retried here: a second long generation would double the load on a busy machine.
                raise ProviderError("TIMEOUT", f"no answer within {timeout:g}s", retryable=True) from None
            except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
                raise ProviderError("OLLAMA_ERROR", type(exc).__name__, retryable=True) from None
        latency = int((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000)
        if resp.status_code == 404:
            raise ProviderError("MODEL_UNAVAILABLE", f"model {self.model} is not available in Ollama")
        if resp.status_code != 200:
            text = resp.text[:200]
            raise ProviderError("OLLAMA_ERROR", f"HTTP {resp.status_code}: {text}", retryable=resp.status_code >= 500)
        try:
            data = resp.json()
            content = data["message"]["content"]
        except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
            raise ProviderError("BAD_RESPONSE", "Ollama returned an unexpected response") from None
        if not isinstance(content, str) or not data.get("done", True):
            raise ProviderError("BAD_RESPONSE", "generation did not complete")
        return ChatResult(
            content=content,
            model=str(data.get("model") or self.model),
            latency_ms=latency,
            prompt_tokens=data.get("prompt_eval_count"),
            output_tokens=data.get("eval_count"),
        )

"""The adapter loop: report health, lease inference requests from the control plane, answer them with the
local model, and post results back. All connections are outbound.

Load protection: the adapter takes work only while Ollama answers, the configured model is present, and the
machine has memory and CPU to spare. When it is busy it simply stops leasing (requests wait in the control
plane's queue); it never restarts Ollama and never runs more than AI_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS calls at once.
"""

import asyncio
import contextlib
import logging
import random
from typing import Any

import httpx

from .config import ADAPTER_VERSION, AdapterSettings
from .ollama import InferenceProvider, OllamaProvider, ProviderError, ProviderStatus
from .system import GEMMA4_CHOICES, LoadMonitor

logger = logging.getLogger("ai_adapter")

LOAD_HEADROOM_MB = 1536  # beyond the weights, when the model still has to be loaded


class Adapter:
    def __init__(
        self,
        settings: AdapterSettings,
        provider: InferenceProvider | None = None,
        transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None,
        monitor: LoadMonitor | None = None,
    ):
        self.s = settings
        self.provider = provider or OllamaProvider(settings)
        self.monitor = monitor or LoadMonitor()
        self.stop_event = asyncio.Event()
        self.in_flight: set[asyncio.Task] = set()
        self.status = ProviderStatus(ok=False)
        self.accepting = False
        self.reason: str | None = "starting"
        self.heartbeat_interval = 15.0
        self._http = httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=settings.control_plane,
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(40.0, connect=10.0),
            transport=transport,
            headers={
                "Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.AI_INFERENCE_TOKEN}",
                "X-AgentMesh-Inference-Node": settings.AI_INFERENCE_NODE_ID,
                "User-Agent": f"agentmesh-ai-adapter/{ADAPTER_VERSION}",
            },
        )

    # --- health ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _model_bytes(self) -> int:
        if self.status.model_size_bytes:
            return self.status.model_size_bytes
        return next((size for tag, size, _ in GEMMA4_CHOICES if tag == self.s.OLLAMA_MODEL), 0)

    def evaluate(self, status: ProviderStatus, metrics: dict) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
        """Whether to take new work now, and why not."""
        if not status.ok:
            return False, status.error or "Ollama is not reachable"
        if not status.ready:
            return False, status.error or f"model {self.s.OLLAMA_MODEL} cannot generate text"
        if len(self.in_flight) >= self.s.AI_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS:
            return False, "busy"
        available = metrics.get("mem_available_mb")
        if available is not None:
            needed = self.s.AI_MIN_AVAILABLE_MEMORY_MB
            if not status.model_loaded:
                needed = self._model_bytes() // 2**20 + LOAD_HEADROOM_MB
            if available < needed:
                return False, f"low memory: {available} MB available, {needed} MB wanted"
        load = metrics.get("load_per_cpu")
        if load is not None and load > self.s.AI_MAX_LOAD_PER_CPU:
            return False, f"CPU busy: load {load} per CPU"
        return True, None

    async def refresh(self) -> dict:
        self.status = await self.provider.status()
        metrics = self.monitor.sample()
        self.accepting, self.reason = self.evaluate(self.status, metrics)
        return metrics

    async def heartbeat(self) -> None:
        metrics = await self.refresh()
        body = {
            "model": self.s.OLLAMA_MODEL,
            "ollama_version": self.status.version,
            "ollama_ok": self.status.ok,
            "model_ready": self.status.ready,
            "accepting": self.accepting,
            "reason": (self.reason or "")[:200] or None,
            "in_flight": len(self.in_flight),
            "metrics": {k: v for k, v in metrics.items() if k != "sampled_at" and v is not None},
        }
        resp = await self._http.post("/api/v1/ai/inference/heartbeat", json=body)
        if resp.status_code == 401:
            raise PermissionError("The control plane rejected the inference token (AI_INFERENCE_TOKEN)")
        resp.raise_for_status()
        data = resp.json()
        self.heartbeat_interval = float(data.get("heartbeat_interval_seconds") or 15)
        if not data.get("accepted"):
            self.accepting = False
            self.reason = data.get("reason") or self.reason

    # --- work ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def handle(self, job: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        result: dict[str, Any]
        if job.get("model") != self.s.OLLAMA_MODEL:
            # Never answer with a different model than the one requested.
            result = {"error_code": "MODEL_MISMATCH", "error": f"this machine serves {self.s.OLLAMA_MODEL}"}
        else:
            timeout = max(10.0, min(float(job.get("timeout_seconds") or 0) - 5, self.s.AI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT))
            try:
                out = await self.provider.chat(
                    job.get("messages") or [],
                    schema=job.get("format"),
                    options=job.get("options") or {},
                    timeout=timeout,
                )
                result = {
                    "content": out.content,
                    "model": out.model,
                    "latency_ms": out.latency_ms,
                    "prompt_tokens": out.prompt_tokens,
                    "output_tokens": out.output_tokens,
                }
                logger.info("Answered request %s in %d ms", job["id"], out.latency_ms)
            except ProviderError as exc:
                logger.warning("Request %s failed: %s", job["id"], exc.code)
                result = {"error_code": exc.code, "error": exc.message[:500], "retryable": exc.retryable}
        await self._post_result(job["id"], result)

    async def _post_result(self, request_id: str, result: dict) -> None:
        for attempt in range(5):
            try:
                resp = await self._http.post(f"/api/v1/ai/inference/requests/{request_id}/result", json=result)
                if resp.status_code < 500:
                    return
            except httpx.HTTPError:
                pass
            await asyncio.sleep(min(30.0, 2.0**attempt))
        logger.error("Could not deliver the result of %s; the control plane will re-queue it", request_id)

    async def lease_once(self, wait_seconds: float = 20.0) -> int:
        free = self.s.AI_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS - len(self.in_flight)
        if free <= 0 or not self.accepting:
            return 0
        resp = await self._http.post(
            "/api/v1/ai/inference/lease", json={"max_requests": free, "wait_seconds": wait_seconds}
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        jobs = resp.json()
        for job in jobs:
            task = asyncio.create_task(self.handle(job))
            self.in_flight.add(task)
            task.add_done_callback(self.in_flight.discard)
        return len(jobs)

    # --- main loop -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def _heartbeat_loop(self) -> None:
        backoff = 1.0
        while not self.stop_event.is_set():
            try:
                await self.heartbeat()
                backoff = 1.0
                wait = self.heartbeat_interval
            except PermissionError:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                logger.warning("Heartbeat failed (%s); retrying", type(exc).__name__)
                self.accepting = False
                wait = backoff + random.random()
                backoff = min(60.0, backoff * 2)
            with contextlib.suppress(TimeoutError):
                await asyncio.wait_for(self.stop_event.wait(), timeout=wait)

    async def _work_loop(self) -> None:
        backoff = 1.0
        while not self.stop_event.is_set():
            try:
                if self.accepting and len(self.in_flight) < self.s.AI_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS:
                    await self.lease_once()
                    backoff = 1.0
                    continue
                wait = 2.0
            except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
                logger.warning("Lease failed (%s); retrying", type(exc).__name__)
                wait = backoff + random.random()
                backoff = min(60.0, backoff * 2)
            with contextlib.suppress(TimeoutError):
                await asyncio.wait_for(self.stop_event.wait(), timeout=wait)

    async def run(self) -> int:
        logger.info(
            "AI adapter %s serving %s for %s as %s",
            ADAPTER_VERSION,
            self.s.OLLAMA_MODEL,
            self.s.control_plane,
            self.s.AI_INFERENCE_NODE_ID,
        )
        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(self._heartbeat_loop()), asyncio.create_task(self._work_loop())]
        try:
            done, _ = await asyncio.wait(
                [*tasks, asyncio.create_task(self.stop_event.wait())], return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED
            )
            for t in done:
                if t in tasks and t.exception():
                    logger.error("%s", t.exception())
                    return 2
            return 0
        finally:
            self.stop_event.set()
            for t in tasks:
                t.cancel()
            # Let answers in progress finish (bounded by the request timeout); unfinished leases are re-queued.
            if self.in_flight:
                await asyncio.wait(self.in_flight, timeout=self.s.AI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT)
            await self._http.aclose()

"""What this machine has and how busy it is. Linux /proc and /sys only; nothing is assumed about the CPU,
memory, disk, or GPU."""

import os
import shutil
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

# Gemma 4 variants that fit a CPU-only laptop, with download sizes verified against the Ollama registry
# manifests (2026-10-21). Memory needed is the weights plus about 1.5 GB for a 4096-token context and the
# runtime; treat it as an estimate and confirm with `python -m ai_adapter check`.
GEMMA4_CHOICES = [
    # tag, download bytes, estimated RAM needed (MB)
    ("gemma4:e2b-it-qat", 4_336_357_640, 6_000),
    ("gemma4:e4b-it-qat", 6_146_501_256, 8_000),
]
DISK_MARGIN = 1.2  # free space wanted relative to the download


@dataclass
class Hardware:
    cpu_model: str | None
    logical_cpus: int
    cpu_flags: list[str]
    mem_total_mb: int
    mem_available_mb: int
    swap_free_mb: int
    disk_free_mb: int
    models_dir: str
    accelerators: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # "nvidia", "amd-rocm"; empty means CPU inference
    integrated_gpu: str | None = None  # present but not used by Ollama for acceleration by default

    def as_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)


def _meminfo() -> dict[str, int]:
    out = {}
    try:
        for line in Path("/proc/meminfo").read_text().splitlines():
            key, _, rest = line.partition(":")
            out[key] = int(rest.split()[0]) // 1024  # kB -> MB
    except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError):
        pass
    return out


def _cpuinfo() -> tuple[str | None, list[str]]:
    model: str | None = None
    flags: list[str] = []
    try:
        for line in Path("/proc/cpuinfo").read_text().splitlines():
            if line.startswith("model name") and model is None:
                model = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
            elif line.startswith("flags") and not flags:
                wanted = {"avx", "avx2", "avx512f", "avx512_vnni", "f16c", "fma"}
                flags = sorted(wanted & set(line.split(":", 1)[1].split()))
    except OSError:
        pass
    return model, flags


def models_dir() -> Path:
    """Where Ollama stores models: OLLAMA_MODELS, the system service's home, or the user's."""
    if os.environ.get("OLLAMA_MODELS"):
        return Path(os.environ["OLLAMA_MODELS"])
    # The system service's directory is usually unreadable to other users; its parent tells us the disk.
    if Path("/usr/share/ollama").exists():
        return Path("/usr/share/ollama/.ollama/models")
    return Path.home() / ".ollama" / "models"


def _free_mb(path: Path) -> int:
    probe = path
    while not probe.exists() and probe != probe.parent:
        probe = probe.parent
    try:
        return shutil.disk_usage(probe).free // (1024 * 1024)
    except OSError:
        return 0


def _accelerators() -> tuple[list[str], str | None]:
    found = []
    # A GPU device, not just installed tools: nvidia-smi and /dev/nvidiactl can exist without any GPU.
    if Path("/dev/nvidia0").exists() or any(Path("/proc/driver/nvidia/gpus").glob("*")):
        found.append("nvidia")
    if Path("/dev/kfd").exists():
        found.append("amd-rocm")
    igpu = None
    for vendor in Path("/sys/class/drm").glob("card*/device/vendor"):
        try:
            if vendor.read_text().strip() == "0x8086":
                igpu = "intel"
        except OSError:
            pass
    return found, igpu


def hardware() -> Hardware:
    mem = _meminfo()
    model, flags = _cpuinfo()
    accel, igpu = _accelerators()
    mdir = models_dir()
    return Hardware(
        cpu_model=model,
        logical_cpus=os.cpu_count() or 1,
        cpu_flags=flags,
        mem_total_mb=mem.get("MemTotal", 0),
        mem_available_mb=mem.get("MemAvailable", 0),
        swap_free_mb=mem.get("SwapFree", 0),
        disk_free_mb=_free_mb(mdir),
        models_dir=str(mdir),
        accelerators=accel,
        integrated_gpu=igpu,
    )


@dataclass
class Recommendation:
    tag: str | None
    reason: str
    download_mb: int = 0
    ram_needed_mb: int = 0


def recommend(hw: Hardware) -> Recommendation:
    """Largest verified Gemma 4 variant that fits in total RAM with room left for the rest of the machine."""
    if "avx2" not in hw.cpu_flags and not hw.accelerators:
        return Recommendation(None, "the CPU lacks AVX2; CPU inference would be very slow")
    budget = hw.mem_total_mb * 0.6  # leave 40% for the desktop, browser, and other applications
    fitting = [c for c in GEMMA4_CHOICES if c[2] <= budget]
    if not fitting:
        return Recommendation(None, f"{hw.mem_total_mb} MB RAM is not enough for any verified Gemma 4 variant")
    # On CPU-only machines prefer the smallest: e4b is roughly twice as slow per token.
    tag, size, ram = fitting[0] if not hw.accelerators else fitting[-1]
    return Recommendation(tag, "CPU inference" if not hw.accelerators else "GPU available", size // 2**20, ram)


def pull_problems(hw: Hardware, tag: str) -> list[str]:
    """Reasons not to download ``tag`` now. Unknown tags are refused rather than guessed."""
    match = next((c for c in GEMMA4_CHOICES if c[0] == tag), None)
    if match is None:
        return [f"{tag} is not a verified variant for this adapter ({', '.join(c[0] for c in GEMMA4_CHOICES)})"]
    _, size, ram = match
    problems = []
    need_disk = int(size * DISK_MARGIN) // 2**20
    if hw.disk_free_mb < need_disk:
        problems.append(f"needs {need_disk} MB free disk in {hw.models_dir}, {hw.disk_free_mb} MB available")
    if hw.mem_total_mb < ram:
        problems.append(f"needs about {ram} MB RAM, the machine has {hw.mem_total_mb} MB")
    return problems


class LoadMonitor:
    """CPU and memory pressure, sampled from /proc between calls."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._last: tuple[int, int] | None = None

    @staticmethod
    def _cpu_times() -> tuple[int, int] | None:
        try:
            parts = Path("/proc/stat").read_text().splitlines()[0].split()[1:]
            values = [int(v) for v in parts]
            idle = values[3] + (values[4] if len(values) > 4 else 0)
            return sum(values), idle
        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError):
            return None

    def sample(self) -> dict:
        mem = _meminfo()
        try:
            load1 = os.getloadavg()[0]
        except OSError:
            load1 = 0.0
        cpu_percent = None
        now = self._cpu_times()
        if now and self._last:
            total, idle = now[0] - self._last[0], now[1] - self._last[1]
            if total > 0:
                cpu_percent = round(100.0 * (total - idle) / total, 1)
        self._last = now
        return {
            "cpu_percent": cpu_percent,
            "load_per_cpu": round(load1 / (os.cpu_count() or 1), 2),
            "mem_available_mb": mem.get("MemAvailable"),
            "mem_total_mb": mem.get("MemTotal"),
            "sampled_at": time.time(),
        }

import asyncio
import sys
from logging.config import fileConfig
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy import pool
from sqlalchemy.engine import Connection
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import async_engine_from_config

# Add server directory to sys.path
BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(BASE_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

from alembic import context  # noqa: E402
from app.core.config import settings  # noqa: E402
from app.models import Base  # noqa: E402

config = context.config
config.set_main_option("sqlalchemy.url", settings.DATABASE_URL)
if config.config_file_name is not None:
    if config.file_config.has_section("loggers"):
        fileConfig(config.config_file_name)

target_metadata = Base.metadata


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    url = config.get_main_option("sqlalchemy.url")
    context.configure(
        url=url, target_metadata=target_metadata, literal_binds=True, dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"}
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


MIGRATION_LOCK_ID = 7_242_031


def do_run_migrations(connection: Connection) -> None:
    context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=target_metadata)
    with context.begin_transaction():
        if connection.dialect.name == "postgresql":
            # Several API instances may start at once; only one applies migrations at a time.
            connection.exec_driver_sql(f"SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock({MIGRATION_LOCK_ID})")
        context.run_migrations()


async def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    connectable = async_engine_from_config(
        config.get_section(config.config_ini_section, {}), prefix="sqlalchemy.", poolclass=pool.NullPool
    )
    async with connectable.connect() as connection:
        await connection.run_sync(do_run_migrations)
    await connectable.dispose()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    asyncio.run(run_migrations_online())

"""rescheduling and restarts: placement history on deployments, reservation history

A deployment moved to another node keeps its id, endpoint, and API keys, so a deployment may now have several
reservation rows over time. The per-deployment unique constraint becomes a partial unique index on ACTIVE rows.

Revision ID: 006
Revises: 005
"""

import sqlalchemy as sa
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import JSON

from alembic import op

revision = "006"
down_revision = "005"
branch_labels = None
depends_on = None


def upgrade() -> None:
    op.add_column("deployments", sa.Column("schedule_attempts", sa.Integer(), nullable=False, server_default="0"))
    op.add_column("deployments", sa.Column("excluded_node_ids", JSON(), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("deployments", sa.Column("restart_count", sa.Integer(), nullable=False, server_default="0"))
    # Deployments created before this migration were placed once if they ever reached a node.
    op.execute("UPDATE deployments SET schedule_attempts = 1 WHERE node_id IS NOT NULL")

    # Constraint name generated by PostgreSQL for the inline UNIQUE in migration 005.
    op.drop_constraint("resource_reservations_deployment_id_key", "resource_reservations", type_="unique")
    op.create_index("ix_resource_reservations_deployment_id", "resource_reservations", ["deployment_id"])
    op.create_index(
        "uq_resource_reservations_active",
        "resource_reservations",
        ["deployment_id"],
        unique=True,
        postgresql_where=sa.text("status = 'ACTIVE'"),
    )


def downgrade() -> None:
    # Keep only the newest reservation per deployment so the old unique constraint can be restored.
    op.execute(
        """
        DELETE FROM resource_reservations r
        USING resource_reservations newer
        WHERE r.deployment_id = newer.deployment_id AND r.created_at < newer.created_at
        """
    )
    op.drop_index("uq_resource_reservations_active", table_name="resource_reservations")
    op.drop_index("ix_resource_reservations_deployment_id", table_name="resource_reservations")
    op.create_unique_constraint("resource_reservations_deployment_id_key", "resource_reservations", ["deployment_id"])
    op.drop_column("deployments", "restart_count")
    op.drop_column("deployments", "excluded_node_ids")
    op.drop_column("deployments", "schedule_attempts")

def _literal(column: str, value):
    """SQL literal that also renders in offline mode (alembic upgrade --sql)."""
    if value is None:
        return sa.null()
    if isinstance(value, uuid.UUID):
        return sa.cast(sa.literal(str(value)), UUID(as_uuid=True))
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return sa.func.now()
    return sa.literal(value, type_=artifacts_table.c[column].type)

import asyncio
import logging
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from app.api import ops
from app.api.ops import SecurityHeadersMiddleware
from app.api.router import api_router
from app.background.monitors import monitor_loop
from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.exceptions import AgentMeshException, agentmesh_exception_handler
from app.core.logging import RequestIdMiddleware, setup_logging
from app.core.middleware import BodySizeLimitMiddleware
from app.core.migrations import migrate_database

setup_logging(settings.LOG_LEVEL, settings.LOG_JSON)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    """Application lifespan: start background tasks on startup, clean up on shutdown."""
    logger.info("AgentMesh API starting up...")
    if settings.MIGRATE_ON_STARTUP:
        await migrate_database()
    tasks = []
    coordinator = None
    redis = None
    if settings.COORDINATION_BACKEND == "redis":
        from redis.asyncio import from_url

        from app.core.ratelimit import limiters
        from app.services.tunnel import RedisCoordinator, broker

        redis = from_url(settings.REDIS_URL, decode_responses=True)
        await redis.ping()
        limiters.use_redis(redis)
        coordinator = RedisCoordinator(redis, broker)
        broker.coordinator = coordinator
        await coordinator.start()
        logger.info("Redis coordination enabled (replica %s)", coordinator.replica_id)
    if settings.BACKGROUND_JOBS_ENABLED:
        tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(monitor_loop(redis)))
        logger.info("Background monitors started")
    yield
    logger.info("AgentMesh API shutting down...")
    if coordinator is not None:
        await coordinator.stop()
    for task in tasks:
        task.cancel()
        try:
            await task
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass


app = FastAPI(
    title="AgentMesh API",
    description="AgentMesh control plane: deployments, inference gateway, worker protocol, billing",
    version="0.1.0",
    openapi_url=f"{settings.API_V1_PREFIX}/openapi.json",
    docs_url=f"{settings.API_V1_PREFIX}/docs",
    redoc_url=f"{settings.API_V1_PREFIX}/redoc",
    lifespan=lifespan,
)

app.add_middleware(

"""Operational endpoints outside /api/v1: liveness, readiness, and Prometheus metrics."""

import hmac
import time
from collections import Counter

from fastapi import APIRouter, Header, HTTPException, Response
from sqlalchemy import func, select, text

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.database import session_scope
from app.models.billing import Payment, Payout
from app.models.deployment import Deployment
from app.models.node import Node

router = APIRouter()
STARTED = time.time()
# Filled by the request middleware in app.main: (method, status class) -> count.
http_requests: Counter = Counter()


@router.get("/health", tags=["Health"])
async def health_check():
    """Liveness: the process is serving. Does not touch dependencies."""
    return {"status": "ok", "service": "agentmesh-api", "version": "0.1.0"}


@router.get("/health/ready", tags=["Health"])
async def readiness():
    """Readiness: the database (and Redis, when used for coordination) answer. 503 otherwise."""
    checks: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        async with session_scope() as db:
            await db.execute(text("SELECT 1"))
        checks["database"] = "ok"
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        checks["database"] = f"error: {type(exc).__name__}"
    if settings.COORDINATION_BACKEND == "redis":
        from app.services.tunnel import broker

        try:
            redis = getattr(broker.coordinator, "redis", None)
            checks["redis"] = "ok" if redis is not None and await redis.ping() else "error: not connected"
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            checks["redis"] = f"error: {type(exc).__name__}"
    ok = all(v == "ok" for v in checks.values())
    if not ok:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail={"status": "unavailable", "checks": checks})
    return {"status": "ready", "checks": checks}


def _line(name: str, value: float, **labels: str) -> str:
    lab = ",".join(f'{k}="{v}"' for k, v in sorted(labels.items()))
    return f"{name}{{{lab}}} {value}" if lab else f"{name} {value}"


@router.get("/metrics", include_in_schema=False)
async def metrics(authorization: str = Header(default="")):
    """Prometheus text format. Requires ``Authorization: Bearer <METRICS_TOKEN>``; disabled when unset."""
    if not settings.METRICS_TOKEN:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Not found")
    token = authorization.removeprefix("Bearer ").strip()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(token.encode(), settings.METRICS_TOKEN.encode()):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Unauthorized")
    out = [
        "# TYPE agentmesh_up gauge",
        "agentmesh_up 1",
        "# TYPE agentmesh_uptime_seconds gauge",
        _line("agentmesh_uptime_seconds", round(time.time() - STARTED, 1)),
        "# TYPE agentmesh_http_requests_total counter",
    ]
    out += [
        _line("agentmesh_http_requests_total", n, method=m, status=s) for (m, s), n in sorted(http_requests.items())
    ]
    async with session_scope() as db:
        for metric, column in (
            ("agentmesh_nodes", Node.status),
            ("agentmesh_deployments", Deployment.status),
            ("agentmesh_payments", Payment.status),
            ("agentmesh_payouts", Payout.status),
        ):
            out.append(f"# TYPE {metric} gauge")
            rows = (await db.execute(select(column, func.count()).group_by(column))).all()
            out += [_line(metric, n, status=str(getattr(k, "value", k))) for k, n in rows if k is not None]
    return Response("\n".join(out) + "\n", media_type="text/plain; version=0.0.4")


SECURITY_HEADERS = [
    (b"x-content-type-options", b"nosniff"),
    (b"x-frame-options", b"DENY"),
    (b"referrer-policy", b"no-referrer"),
    (b"cross-origin-opener-policy", b"same-origin"),
]
HSTS = (b"strict-transport-security", b"max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains")


class SecurityHeadersMiddleware:
    """Adds security headers and counts responses. Pure ASGI, so streaming responses pass through untouched."""

    def __init__(self, app):
        self.app = app

    async def __call__(self, scope, receive, send):
        if scope["type"] != "http":
            await self.app(scope, receive, send)
            return

        async def send_with_headers(message):
            if message["type"] == "http.response.start":
                headers = list(message.get("headers") or [])
                present = {k.lower() for k, _ in headers}
                extra = SECURITY_HEADERS + ([] if settings.is_dev else [HSTS])
                headers += [(k, v) for k, v in extra if k not in present]
                message["headers"] = headers
                http_requests[(scope["method"], f"{message['status'] // 100}xx")] += 1
            await send(message)

        await self.app(scope, receive, send_with_headers)

"""AI deployment agent API.

Customers:
    POST /ai/deployments               describe a deployment and authorize limits (starts a run)
    GET  /ai/deployments               list runs
    GET  /ai/deployments/{id}          progress, plan, estimated and actual cost, verified endpoint
    POST /ai/deployments/{id}/cancel   stop the run and any deployment it created
    GET  /ai/deployments/{id}/events   run history
    GET  /ai/health                    whether the AI service is available (no infrastructure details)

Internal inference machines (bearer AI_INFERENCE_TOKEN, X-AgentMesh-Inference-Node: <AI_INFERENCE_NODE_ID>):

import asyncio

NODE_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$")


async def _advance_quietly(run_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    try:
        await workflow.advance(run_id)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        pass  # logged by advance; the background monitor retries


# --- Customers -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@router.post("/deployments", response_model=AiRunOut, status_code=202)
async def create_ai_deployment(
    body: AiDeploymentCreate,
    background: BackgroundTasks,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: User = Depends(require_roles(UserRole.customer)),
):
    allowed, retry_after = await limiters.requests.allow(f"ai-run:{user.id}", settings.AI_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE)
    if not allowed:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=429,
            detail="Too many AI deployment requests",
            headers={"Retry-After": str(max(1, int(retry_after)))},
        )
    run = await workflow.create_run(db, user, body.request, body.limits, body.idempotency_key)
    background.add_task(_advance_quietly, run.id)
    return await workflow.view(db, run)


@router.get("/deployments", response_model=list[AiRunOut])
async def list_ai_deployments(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    customer = (await db.execute(select(Customer).where(Customer.user_id == user.id))).scalar_one_or_none()
    if customer is None:
        return []
    runs = (
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(AiRun).where(AiRun.customer_id == customer.id).order_by(AiRun.created_at.desc()).limit(100)
            )
        )
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )
    return [await workflow.view(db, r) for r in runs]


@router.get("/deployments/{run_id}", response_model=AiRunOut)
async def get_ai_deployment(run_id: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    return await workflow.view(db, await workflow.get_run_for_user(db, run_id, user))


@router.post("/deployments/{run_id}/cancel", response_model=AiRunOut)
async def cancel_ai_deployment(run_id: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    run = await workflow.get_run_for_user(db, run_id, user)
    await workflow.request_cancel(db, run, user)
    await workflow.advance(run.id)
    return await workflow.view(db, await workflow.get_run_for_user(db, run_id, user))


@router.get("/deployments/{run_id}/events", response_model=list[AiRunEventOut])
async def ai_deployment_events(run_id: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    run = await workflow.get_run_for_user(db, run_id, user)
    rows = (
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(AiRunEvent).where(AiRunEvent.run_id == run.id).order_by(AiRunEvent.created_at, AiRunEvent.id)
            )
        )
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )
    return rows[-500:]


@router.get("/health", response_model=AiHealthOut)
async def ai_health(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    h = await inference_queue.health(db)
    nodes = None
    if is_staff(user):
        nodes = [
            {
                "id": n.id,
                "last_seen": n.last_seen,
                "fresh": inference_queue.node_is_fresh(n),
                "model": n.model,
                "ollama_version": n.ollama_version,
                "ollama_ok": n.ollama_ok,
                "model_ready": n.model_ready,
                "accepting": n.accepting,
                "reason": n.reason,
                "in_flight": n.in_flight,
                "metrics": n.metrics,
            }
            for n in h.nodes
        ]
    return AiHealthOut(
        status=h.status, available=h.available, model=h.model, queue_depth=h.queue_depth, message=h.message, nodes=nodes
    )


# --- Inference machines --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def inference_node(
    request: Request,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    node_id: str | None = Header(None, alias="X-AgentMesh-Inference-Node"),
) -> str:
    """Authenticate an inference machine. Disabled entirely unless AI_INFERENCE_TOKEN is set."""
    expected = settings.AI_INFERENCE_TOKEN
    auth = request.headers.get("authorization", "")
    token = auth[7:].strip() if auth.lower().startswith("bearer ") else ""
    if not expected or not token or not hmac.compare_digest(token.encode(), expected.encode()):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid inference credentials")
    if not node_id or not NODE_ID_RE.fullmatch(node_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="X-AgentMesh-Inference-Node must be a simple identifier")
    return node_id


@router.post("/inference/heartbeat")
async def inference_heartbeat(
    body: InferenceHeartbeat, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), node_id: str = Depends(inference_node)
):
    report = body.model_dump()
    metrics = body.metrics.model_dump() if body.metrics else {}
    report["metrics"] = {k: v for k, v in metrics.items() if v is not None}
    node = await inference_queue.heartbeat(db, node_id, report)
    return {
        "accepted": node.accepting,
        "expected_model": settings.OLLAMA_MODEL,
        "reason": node.reason,
        "heartbeat_interval_seconds": max(5, settings.AI_NODE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS // 3),
    }


@router.post("/inference/lease", response_model=list[InferenceJob])
async def inference_lease(
    body: InferenceLeaseRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), node_id: str = Depends(inference_node)
):
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    deadline = loop.time() + body.wait_seconds
    while True:
        node = await db.get(AiInferenceNode, node_id)
        if node is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Send a heartbeat first")
        await db.refresh(node)
        leased = await inference_queue.lease(db, node, body.max_requests)
        if leased or loop.time() >= deadline:
            break
        await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
    return [
        InferenceJob(
            id=r.id,
            model=r.model,
            messages=(r.payload or {}).get("messages", []),
            format=(r.payload or {}).get("format"),
            options=(r.payload or {}).get("options", {}),
            timeout_seconds=settings.AI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
        )
        for r in leased
    ]


@router.post("/inference/requests/{request_id}/result")
async def inference_result(
    request_id: str,
    body: InferenceResult,
    background: BackgroundTasks,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    node_id: str = Depends(inference_node),
):
    req = await inference_queue.complete(
        db,
        node_id,
        parse_uuid(request_id, "Inference request"),
        content=body.content,
        error_code=body.error_code,
        error=body.error,
        retryable=body.retryable,
        latency_ms=body.latency_ms,
        prompt_tokens=body.prompt_tokens,
        output_tokens=body.output_tokens,
        model=body.model,
    )
    if req is None:
        await db.rollback()
        return {"accepted": False}
    await db.commit()
    if req.run_id is not None and req.status in ("COMPLETED", "FAILED"):
        background.add_task(_advance_quietly, req.run_id)
    return {"accepted": True, "status": req.status}

import uuid
from datetime import datetime

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.database import get_db
from app.core.dependencies import require_roles
from app.models.user import UserRole
from app.services import api_key_service

router = APIRouter()


class ApiKeyCreate(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)
    scopes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=lambda: ["inference"], max_length=10)
    deployment_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
    expires_at: datetime | None = None

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.database import get_db
from app.core.dependencies import get_current_user
from app.core.ratelimit import limiters
from app.schemas.auth import AuthResponse, UserCreate, UserLogin, UserOut
from app.services import auth_service

router = APIRouter()


async def _throttle(request: Request, email: str) -> None:
    """Limit password attempts per client address and per account (slows credential stuffing and guessing)."""
    client = request.client.host if request.client else "unknown"
    for key in (f"auth:ip:{client}", f"auth:email:{email.strip().lower()}"):
        allowed, retry_after = await limiters.requests.allow(key, settings.AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE)
        if not allowed:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=429,
                detail="Too many attempts. Try again shortly.",
                headers={"Retry-After": str(max(1, int(retry_after)))},
            )


@router.post("/register", response_model=AuthResponse)
async def register(user: UserCreate, request: Request, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    await _throttle(request, user.email)
    return await auth_service.register_user(db, user)


@router.post("/login", response_model=AuthResponse)
async def login(user: UserLogin, request: Request, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    await _throttle(request, user.email)
    return await auth_service.login(db, user)


@router.get("/me", response_model=UserOut)
async def get_me(current_user=Depends(get_current_user)):
    return current_user

"""Pricing (public) and rated charges (customers see what they paid, providers what they earned)."""

import uuid

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query
from sqlalchemy import or_, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.database import get_db
from app.core.dependencies import get_current_user, is_staff
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.billing import Charge, PricingRule
from app.schemas.billing import ChargeOut, PricingOut, PricingRuleOut
from app.services import billing_service, ledger_service

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/pricing", response_model=PricingOut)
async def pricing(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    """The price list in force (null when none is set: usage is then measured but not charged)."""
    upcoming = (
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(PricingRule).where(PricingRule.effective_from > utcnow()).order_by(PricingRule.effective_from)
            )
        )
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )
    current = await billing_service.active_rule(db)
    return PricingOut(
        current=PricingRuleOut.model_validate(current) if current else None,
        upcoming=[PricingRuleOut.model_validate(r) for r in upcoming],
        currency=settings.BILLING_CURRENCY,
        min_prepaid_hours=settings.BILLING_MIN_PREPAID_HOURS,
        billing_interval_seconds=settings.BILLING_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
    )


@router.get("/charges", response_model=list[ChargeOut])
async def charges(
    deployment_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=1000),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    current_user=Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """Charges against the caller's wallet (as customer) or credited to it (as provider). Staff see all."""
    query = select(Charge).order_by(Charge.created_at.desc()).limit(limit)
    if not is_staff(current_user):
        wallet = await ledger_service.wallet_for_user(db, current_user.id)
        query = query.where(or_(Charge.customer_wallet_id == wallet.id, Charge.provider_wallet_id == wallet.id))
    if deployment_id:
        query = query.where(Charge.deployment_id == deployment_id)
    rows = (await db.execute(query)).scalars().all()
    await db.commit()
    return rows

from decimal import Decimal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.database import get_db
from app.core.dependencies import get_current_user
from app.models.deployment import Deployment
from app.models.node import Node
from app.models.transaction import Transaction, TransactionStatus, TransactionType
from app.models.user import Provider
from app.models.wallet import Wallet
from app.schemas.earnings import EarningsSummary
from app.schemas.transaction import TransactionResponse
from app.services.deployment_lifecycle import ACTIVE

router = APIRouter()


async def _hosted_deployments(db: AsyncSession, user_id) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Deployments ever placed on, and currently active on, the caller's nodes."""
    owned = select(Node.id).join(Provider, Node.owner_id == Provider.id).where(Provider.user_id == user_id)
    on_nodes = Deployment.node_id.in_(owned)
    total = (await db.execute(select(func.count(Deployment.id)).where(on_nodes))).scalar() or 0
    active = (
        await db.execute(
            select(func.count(Deployment.id)).where(on_nodes, Deployment.status.in_([s.value for s in ACTIVE]))
        )
    ).scalar() or 0
    return int(total), int(active)


@router.get("", response_model=EarningsSummary)
async def get_earnings(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user=Depends(get_current_user)):
    total_deployments, active_deployments = await _hosted_deployments(db, current_user.id)
    result = await db.execute(select(Wallet).filter(Wallet.user_id == current_user.id))
    wallet = result.scalars().first()
    if not wallet:
        return EarningsSummary(
            total_earnings=Decimal(0),
            pending_earnings=Decimal(0),
            available_balance=Decimal(0),
            total_deployments=total_deployments,
            active_deployments=active_deployments,
        )

    settled = await db.execute(
        select(func.coalesce(func.sum(Transaction.amount), 0)).filter(
            Transaction.to_wallet == wallet.id,
            Transaction.type == TransactionType.PROVIDER_CREDIT,
            Transaction.status == TransactionStatus.SETTLED,
        )
    )
    total_earnings = settled.scalar() or 0

    pending = await db.execute(
        select(func.coalesce(func.sum(Transaction.amount), 0)).filter(
            Transaction.to_wallet == wallet.id,
            Transaction.type == TransactionType.PROVIDER_CREDIT,
            Transaction.status == TransactionStatus.PENDING,
        )
    )
    pending_earnings = pending.scalar() or 0

    return EarningsSummary(
        total_earnings=Decimal(total_earnings),
        pending_earnings=Decimal(pending_earnings),
        available_balance=Decimal(wallet.balance or 0),
        total_deployments=total_deployments,
        active_deployments=active_deployments,
    )


@router.get("/history", response_model=list[TransactionResponse])
async def get_history(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user=Depends(get_current_user)):
    result = await db.execute(select(Wallet).filter(Wallet.user_id == current_user.id))
    wallet = result.scalars().first()
    if not wallet:
        return []
    result = await db.execute(
        select(Transaction)
        .filter(Transaction.to_wallet == wallet.id, Transaction.type == TransactionType.PROVIDER_CREDIT)
        .order_by(Transaction.created_at.desc())
    )
    return result.scalars().all()
