from datetime import datetime

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.ids import parse_uuid
from app.core.security import generate_secret, hash_secret
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.api_key import ApiKey
from app.models.user import User
from app.services import audit_service

API_KEY_PREFIX = "am_sk_"
SCOPES = frozenset({"inference"})


async def create_api_key(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, name: str, scopes: list[str], deployment_id: str | None, expires_at: datetime | None
) -> tuple[ApiKey, str]:
    unknown = set(scopes) - SCOPES
    if unknown or not scopes:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"Scopes must be a non-empty subset of {sorted(SCOPES)}")
    dep_uuid = None
    if deployment_id:
        from app.services.deployment_service import get_deployment_for_user

        dep_uuid = (await get_deployment_for_user(db, deployment_id, user)).id
    secret = generate_secret(API_KEY_PREFIX)
    key = ApiKey(
        user_id=user.id,
        name=name,
        prefix=secret[: len(API_KEY_PREFIX) + 6],
        key_hash=hash_secret(secret),
        scopes=sorted(set(scopes)),
        deployment_id=dep_uuid,
        expires_at=expires_at,
    )
    db.add(key)
    await db.flush()
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=user.id,
        action="api_key.created",
        resource_type="api_key",
        resource_id=key.id,
        details={"name": name, "scopes": key.scopes, "deployment_id": str(dep_uuid) if dep_uuid else None},
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(key)
    return key, secret


async def list_api_keys(db: AsyncSession, user: User) -> list[ApiKey]:
    result = await db.execute(select(ApiKey).where(ApiKey.user_id == user.id).order_by(ApiKey.created_at.desc()))
    return list(result.scalars().all())


async def revoke_api_key(db: AsyncSession, user: User, key_id: str) -> ApiKey:
    key = await db.get(ApiKey, parse_uuid(key_id, "API key"))
    if key is None or key.user_id != user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="API key not found")
    if key.revoked_at is None:
        key.revoked_at = utcnow()
        audit_service.record(
            db, actor_id=user.id, action="api_key.revoked", resource_type="api_key", resource_id=key.id
        )
        await db.commit()
    return key


async def resolve_api_key(db: AsyncSession, secret: str) -> ApiKey | None:
    """Return the active key for ``secret``, or None. Lookup is by hash; the plaintext is never stored."""
    if not secret.startswith(API_KEY_PREFIX):
        return None
    key = (await db.execute(select(ApiKey).where(ApiKey.key_hash == hash_secret(secret)))).scalar_one_or_none()
    if key is None or key.revoked_at is not None:
        return None
    if key.expires_at is not None and key.expires_at <= utcnow():
        return None
    return key

"""Audit trail for security-relevant actions by customers, providers, operators, and workers.

Rows are added to the caller's transaction (no commit here), so an action and its audit record are saved
together or not at all. Secrets and prompt contents never go into ``details``.
"""

import uuid
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.logging import client_ip_var, redact, request_id_var
from app.models.audit import AuditLog


def record(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
    action: str,
    resource_type: str,
    resource_id: Any,
    details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> AuditLog:
    safe = {k: redact(v) if isinstance(v, str) else v for k, v in (details or {}).items()}
    if request_id_var.get():
        safe["request_id"] = request_id_var.get()
    entry = AuditLog(
        user_id=actor_id,
        action=action,
        resource_type=resource_type,
        resource_id=str(resource_id) if resource_id is not None else None,
        details=safe,
        ip_address=client_ip_var.get(),
    )
    db.add(entry)
    return entry


async def search(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    action: str | None = None,
    resource_type: str | None = None,
    resource_id: str | None = None,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    limit: int = 100,
) -> list[AuditLog]:
    query = select(AuditLog).order_by(AuditLog.created_at.desc()).limit(min(max(limit, 1), 500))
    if action:
        query = query.where(AuditLog.action == action)
    if resource_type:
        query = query.where(AuditLog.resource_type == resource_type)
    if resource_id:
        query = query.where(AuditLog.resource_id == resource_id)
    if actor_id:
        query = query.where(AuditLog.user_id == actor_id)
    return list((await db.execute(query)).scalars().all())

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.future import select

from app.core.security import create_access_token, get_password_hash, verify_password
from app.models.user import Customer, Provider, User, UserRole
from app.schemas.auth import UserCreate, UserLogin
from app.services import audit_service


async def register_user(db: AsyncSession, user_data: UserCreate):
    result = await db.execute(select(User).filter(User.email == user_data.email))
    if result.scalars().first():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Email already registered")

    user = User(email=user_data.email, hashed_password=get_password_hash(user_data.password), role=user_data.role.value)
    db.add(user)
    await db.flush()  # assign user.id without committing, so user + profile are created atomically

    if user.role == UserRole.provider.value:
        db.add(Provider(user_id=user.id))
    elif user.role == UserRole.customer.value:
        db.add(Customer(user_id=user.id))
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=user.id,
        action="user.registered",
        resource_type="user",
        resource_id=user.id,
        details={"role": user.role},
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(user)
    access_token = create_access_token(subject=user.id)
    return {"access_token": access_token, "token_type": "bearer", "user": user}


async def login(db: AsyncSession, user_data: UserLogin):
    result = await db.execute(select(User).filter(User.email == user_data.email))
    user = result.scalars().first()
    if not user or not verify_password(user_data.password, user.hashed_password):
        audit_service.record(
            db,
            actor_id=user.id if user else None,
            action="auth.login_failed",
            resource_type="user",
            resource_id=user.id if user else None,
            details={"email": user_data.email},
        )
        await db.commit()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid credentials")
    if not user.is_active:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Account disabled")
    audit_service.record(db, actor_id=user.id, action="auth.login", resource_type="user", resource_id=user.id)
    await db.commit()

    access_token = create_access_token(subject=user.id)
    return {"access_token": access_token, "token_type": "bearer", "user": user}

"""Pricing and rating: turns measured usage into charges and ledger postings.

What is charged, per deployment and node:

* READY time x reserved resources (CPU cores, RAM, VRAM) at the pricing version in force. READY intervals come
  from the control plane's own lifecycle events, not from the worker. UNHEALTHY time is not charged.
* Input/output tokens at the per-million prices. Counts are runtime-reported (see UsageRecord.token_source);
  requests without counts are not charged for tokens.

A background job rates each deployment's window [metered_until, now) at most every BILLING_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
splitting at pricing-version boundaries and node changes. Each (deployment, node, period_start) produces at most
one Charge (unique constraint) and advances the watermark with a compare-and-set, so concurrent replicas cannot
double-charge. Settlement debits the customer, credits the provider, and records the platform fee; the
customer's balance may go below zero by at most one window, after which their deployments are stopped.
"""

import logging
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import case, func, or_, select, update
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.database import session_scope
from app.core.db_utils import rowcount
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.billing import Charge, PricingRule
from app.models.deployment import Deployment, DeploymentEvent
from app.models.deployment import DeploymentStatus as S
from app.models.node import Node
from app.models.reservation import ResourceReservation
from app.models.transaction import TransactionType
from app.models.usage import UsageRecord
from app.models.user import Customer, Provider, User
from app.services import audit_service, ledger_service
from app.services.ledger_service import money

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MB_PER_GB = Decimal(1024)
SECONDS_PER_HOUR = Decimal(3600)
MILLION = Decimal(1_000_000)


# --- Pricing rules -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def active_rule(db: AsyncSession, at: datetime | None = None) -> PricingRule | None:
    at = at or utcnow()
    query = (
        select(PricingRule)
        .where(PricingRule.effective_from <= at)
        .order_by(PricingRule.effective_from.desc(), PricingRule.version.desc())
        .limit(1)
    )
    return (await db.execute(query)).scalars().first()


async def list_rules(db: AsyncSession) -> list[PricingRule]:
    return list((await db.execute(select(PricingRule).order_by(PricingRule.version.desc()))).scalars().all())


async def create_rule(db: AsyncSession, data: dict, actor: User) -> PricingRule:
    """Add a new pricing version. Versions are immutable and cannot take effect in the past, so charges
    already rated are never re-priced."""
    now = utcnow()
    effective = data.pop("effective_from", None) or now
    if effective.tzinfo is not None:
        effective = effective.astimezone(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None)
    if effective < now - timedelta(seconds=60):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="effective_from cannot be in the past")
    latest = (await db.execute(select(func.max(PricingRule.version)))).scalar() or 0
    rule = PricingRule(
        id=uuid.uuid4(),
        version=latest + 1,
        currency=settings.BILLING_CURRENCY,
        effective_from=max(effective, now),
        created_by=actor.id,
        **data,
    )
    db.add(rule)
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=actor.id,
        action="pricing.version_created",
        resource_type="pricing_rule",
        resource_id=rule.id,
        details={"version": rule.version, **{k: str(v) for k, v in data.items()}},
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(rule)
    return rule


def hourly_resource_price(rule: PricingRule, cpu_cores: int, ram_mb: int, vram_mb: int) -> Decimal:
    return (
        Decimal(rule.cpu_core_hour) * cpu_cores
        + Decimal(rule.ram_gb_hour) * Decimal(ram_mb) / MB_PER_GB
        + Decimal(rule.vram_gb_hour) * Decimal(vram_mb) / MB_PER_GB
    )


def is_free(rule: PricingRule | None) -> bool:
    return rule is None or not any(
        Decimal(v)
        for v in (
            rule.cpu_core_hour,
            rule.ram_gb_hour,
            rule.vram_gb_hour,
            rule.input_tokens_per_million,
            rule.output_tokens_per_million,
        )
    )


async def require_prepaid(db: AsyncSession, user_id: uuid.UUID, cpu_cores: int, ram_mb: int, vram_mb: int) -> None:
    """Refuse a deployment the customer cannot afford for BILLING_MIN_PREPAID_HOURS of its reservation."""
    rule = await active_rule(db)
    if is_free(rule):
        return
    assert rule is not None
    hours = Decimal(str(settings.BILLING_MIN_PREPAID_HOURS))
    needed = money(hourly_resource_price(rule, cpu_cores, ram_mb, vram_mb) * hours)
    wallet = await ledger_service.wallet_for_user(db, user_id)
    have = await ledger_service.balance(db, wallet.id)
    if have < needed or have <= 0:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=402,
            detail={
                "code": "insufficient_balance",
                "message": f"This deployment needs at least {needed} {rule.currency} in your wallet "
                f"({settings.BILLING_MIN_PREPAID_HOURS:g} h of its reserved resources); you have {money(have)}.",
                "required": str(needed),
                "balance": str(money(have)),
                "currency": rule.currency,
            },
        )


# --- Measurement -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass
class Interval:
    start: datetime
    end: datetime
    node_id: uuid.UUID | None


def ready_intervals(events: list[DeploymentEvent], now: datetime, fallback_node: uuid.UUID | None) -> list[Interval]:
    """READY periods from the lifecycle history (state changes only, in time order)."""
    out: list[Interval] = []
    opened: tuple[datetime, uuid.UUID | None] | None = None
    for e in events:
        if e.to_status is None:
            continue  # progress note
        if e.to_status == S.READY.value and opened is None:
            opened = (e.created_at, e.node_id or fallback_node)
        elif e.to_status != S.READY.value and opened is not None:
            out.append(Interval(opened[0], e.created_at, opened[1]))
            opened = None
    if opened is not None:
        out.append(Interval(opened[0], now, opened[1]))
    return out


def _clip(intervals: list[Interval], start: datetime, end: datetime) -> dict[uuid.UUID | None, float]:
    seconds: dict[uuid.UUID | None, float] = {}
    for iv in intervals:
        lo, hi = max(iv.start, start), min(iv.end, end)
        if hi > lo:
            seconds[iv.node_id] = seconds.get(iv.node_id, 0.0) + (hi - lo).total_seconds()
    return seconds


async def _tokens(db: AsyncSession, dep_id: uuid.UUID, start: datetime, end: datetime) -> dict:
    rows = (
        await db.execute(
            select(
                UsageRecord.node_id,
                func.coalesce(func.sum(UsageRecord.input_tokens), 0),
                # Output tokens are reported by the provider's runtime. Bound them by the response bytes the
                # gateway itself counted (every token costs at least one byte), so they cannot be inflated freely.
                func.coalesce(
                    func.sum(
                        case(
                            (
                                UsageRecord.response_bytes.is_not(None)
                                & (UsageRecord.output_tokens > UsageRecord.response_bytes),
                                UsageRecord.response_bytes,
                            ),
                            else_=UsageRecord.output_tokens,
                        )
                    ),
                    0,
                ),
            )
            .where(
                UsageRecord.deployment_id == dep_id,
                UsageRecord.kind == "inference",
                UsageRecord.created_at >= start,
                UsageRecord.created_at < end,
            )
            .group_by(UsageRecord.node_id)
        )
    ).all()
    return {node: (int(i), int(o)) for node, i, o in rows}


async def _reservation(db: AsyncSession, dep_id: uuid.UUID, node_id: uuid.UUID | None) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    if node_id is None:
        return 0, 0, 0
    res = (
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(ResourceReservation)
                .where(ResourceReservation.deployment_id == dep_id, ResourceReservation.node_id == node_id)
                .order_by(ResourceReservation.created_at.desc())
                .limit(1)
            )
        )
        .scalars()
        .first()
    )
    return (res.cpu_cores, res.ram_mb, res.vram_mb) if res else (0, 0, 0)


async def _provider_user(db: AsyncSession, node_id: uuid.UUID | None) -> uuid.UUID | None:
    if node_id is None:
        return None
    return (
        await db.execute(select(Provider.user_id).join(Node, Node.owner_id == Provider.id).where(Node.id == node_id))
    ).scalar()


# --- Rating ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def price(rule: PricingRule, ready_seconds: float, cpu: int, ram_mb: int, vram_mb: int, tin: int, tout: int):
    hours = Decimal(str(ready_seconds)) / SECONDS_PER_HOUR
    resource = money(hourly_resource_price(rule, cpu, ram_mb, vram_mb) * hours)
    tokens = money(
        (Decimal(rule.input_tokens_per_million) * tin + Decimal(rule.output_tokens_per_million) * tout) / MILLION
    )
    amount = resource + tokens
    fee = money(amount * Decimal(rule.platform_fee_rate))
    return resource, tokens, amount, amount - fee, fee


async def _rules_in(db: AsyncSession, start: datetime, end: datetime) -> list[tuple[datetime, PricingRule | None]]:
    """(segment start, rule) for each pricing segment of [start, end)."""
    later = (
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(PricingRule)
                .where(PricingRule.effective_from > start, PricingRule.effective_from < end)
                .order_by(PricingRule.effective_from)
            )
        )
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )
    segments: list[tuple[datetime, PricingRule | None]] = [(start, await active_rule(db, start))]
    segments += [(r.effective_from, r) for r in later]
    return segments


async def rate_deployment(db: AsyncSession, dep: Deployment, now: datetime) -> list[Charge]:
    """Rate [metered_until, now) for one deployment and settle it. Does not commit; raises on a lost race."""
    start = dep.metered_until or dep.created_at
    events = list(
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(DeploymentEvent)
                .where(DeploymentEvent.deployment_id == dep.id, DeploymentEvent.to_status.is_not(None))
                .order_by(DeploymentEvent.created_at)
            )
        )
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )
    intervals = ready_intervals(events, now, dep.node_id)
    customer_user = (await db.execute(select(Customer.user_id).where(Customer.id == dep.customer_id))).scalar()
    charges: list[Charge] = []
    segments = await _rules_in(db, start, now)
    for i, (seg_start, rule) in enumerate(segments):
        seg_end = segments[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(segments) else now
        if rule is None or customer_user is None:
            continue  # no price in force: usage is measured but free
        seconds = _clip(intervals, seg_start, seg_end)
        tokens = await _tokens(db, dep.id, seg_start, seg_end)
        for node_id in set(seconds) | set(tokens):
            ready_s = seconds.get(node_id, 0.0)
            tin, tout = tokens.get(node_id, (0, 0))
            cpu, ram, vram = await _reservation(db, dep.id, node_id)
            resource, token_amt, amount, provider_amt, fee = price(rule, ready_s, cpu, ram, vram, tin, tout)
            if amount <= 0:
                continue
            customer_wallet = await ledger_service.wallet_for_user(db, customer_user)
            provider_user = await _provider_user(db, node_id)
            provider_wallet = await ledger_service.wallet_for_user(db, provider_user) if provider_user else None
            charge = Charge(
                id=uuid.uuid4(),
                deployment_id=dep.id,
                node_id=node_id,
                customer_wallet_id=customer_wallet.id,
                provider_wallet_id=provider_wallet.id if provider_wallet else None,
                pricing_rule_id=rule.id,
                period_start=seg_start,
                period_end=seg_end,
                ready_seconds=round(ready_s, 3),
                cpu_cores=cpu,
                ram_mb=ram,
                vram_mb=vram,
                input_tokens=tin,
                output_tokens=tout,
                resource_amount=resource,
                token_amount=token_amt,
                amount=amount,
                provider_amount=provider_amt if provider_wallet else money(0),
                platform_fee=fee if provider_wallet else amount,
                currency=rule.currency,
            )
            db.add(charge)
            await db.flush()
            await _settle_charge(db, charge, customer_wallet, provider_wallet)
            charges.append(charge)
    moved = await db.execute(
        update(Deployment)
        .where(
            Deployment.id == dep.id,
            Deployment.metered_until.is_(None) if dep.metered_until is None else Deployment.metered_until == start,
        )
        .values(metered_until=now)
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )
    if rowcount(moved) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Billing watermark for deployment {dep.id} moved concurrently")
    dep.metered_until = now
    return charges


async def _settle_charge(db: AsyncSession, charge: Charge, customer_wallet, provider_wallet) -> None:
    key = f"charge:{charge.id}"
    period = f"{charge.period_start:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M}-{charge.period_end:%H:%M} UTC"
    await ledger_service.post(
        db,
        key=f"{key}:debit",
        type=TransactionType.COMPUTE_CHARGE,
        amount=charge.amount,
        from_wallet=customer_wallet,
        reference=key,
        deployment_id=charge.deployment_id,
        description=f"Deployment usage {period}",
    )
    if provider_wallet is not None and charge.provider_amount > 0:
        await ledger_service.post(
            db,
            key=f"{key}:provider",
            type=TransactionType.PROVIDER_CREDIT,
            amount=charge.provider_amount,
            to_wallet=provider_wallet,
            reference=key,
            deployment_id=charge.deployment_id,
            description=f"Hosting {period}",
        )
    await ledger_service.post(
        db,
        key=f"{key}:fee",
        type=TransactionType.PLATFORM_FEE,
        amount=charge.platform_fee,
        reference=key,
        deployment_id=charge.deployment_id,
        description="Platform fee",
    )


async def _stop_if_exhausted(db: AsyncSession, customer_wallet_id: uuid.UUID) -> int:
    """Stop a customer's running deployments once their prepaid balance is used up."""
    from app.models.wallet import Wallet
    from app.services import deployment_lifecycle as lifecycle
    from app.services.deployment_service import _stop

    wallet = await db.get(Wallet, customer_wallet_id)
    remaining = await ledger_service.balance(db, customer_wallet_id)  # balances move in SQL, not on the ORM object
    if wallet is None or remaining > 0:
        return 0
    deps = (
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(Deployment)
                .join(Customer, Deployment.customer_id == Customer.id)
                .where(
                    Customer.user_id == wallet.user_id,
                    Deployment.status.in_([s.value for s in lifecycle.ACTIVE if s != S.STOPPING]),
                )
            )
        )
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )
    for dep in deps:
        await _stop(db, dep, actor="system", message="Stopped: the wallet balance is used up. Top up to deploy again.")
        dep.error_code = "INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS"
        dep.error_message = "The wallet balance is used up"
        audit_service.record(
            db,
            actor_id=None,
            action="deployment.stopped_insufficient_funds",
            resource_type="deployment",
            resource_id=dep.id,
            details={"balance": str(money(remaining))},
        )
    return len(deps)


async def due_deployments(db: AsyncSession, now: datetime) -> list[Deployment]:
    rows = (
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(Deployment).where(
                    Deployment.was_ready.is_(True),
                    or_(
                        Deployment.metered_until.is_(None),
                        Deployment.ended_at.is_(None),
                        Deployment.metered_until < Deployment.ended_at,
                    ),
                )
            )
        )
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )
    interval = timedelta(seconds=settings.BILLING_INTERVAL_SECONDS)
    return [d for d in rows if d.ended_at is not None or now - (d.metered_until or d.created_at) >= interval]


async def run_billing(now: datetime | None = None) -> int:
    """Rate every deployment that is due. Each deployment is its own transaction. Returns charges created."""
    now = now or utcnow()
    created = 0
    async with session_scope() as db:
        ids = [d.id for d in await due_deployments(db, now)]
    for dep_id in ids:
        async with session_scope() as db:
            dep = await db.get(Deployment, dep_id)
            if dep is None:
                continue
            try:
                charges = await rate_deployment(db, dep, now)
                for wallet_id in {c.customer_wallet_id for c in charges}:
                    await _stop_if_exhausted(db, wallet_id)
                await db.commit()
                created += len(charges)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - one bad deployment must not stop billing for the rest
                await db.rollback()
                logger.exception("Billing failed for deployment %s", dep_id)
    return created

"""Model catalog validation: which models can be deployed, on which runtimes, and with what resources.

Compatibility is explicit: a model is deployable on a runtime only through an enabled ModelArtifact for that
runtime whose source passes validation. Appearing in the catalog is never proof of deployability; the
artifact's ``last_ready_at`` records when serving it last actually worked.
"""

import math
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from fastapi import HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.ids import parse_uuid
from app.models.model import Model, ModelArtifact

# Runtimes the control plane can schedule, in default preference order (most widely available first).
RUNTIME_PREFERENCE = ("ollama", "llamacpp", "vllm")
SUPPORTED_RUNTIMES = frozenset(RUNTIME_PREFERENCE)

# Ollama model references: optional namespace, name, optional tag. No URLs, paths, or shell metacharacters.
OLLAMA_TAG_RE = re.compile(
    r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}(/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63})?(:[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,63})?$"
)
HF_REPO_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,95}/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,95}$")
HF_REVISION_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$")
GGUF_FILE_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,200}\.gguf$")
SHA256_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")

MAX_NUM_CTX = 8192
DEFAULT_NUM_CTX = 2048


class DeploymentConfig(BaseModel):
    """Allowlisted deployment options. Unknown keys are rejected rather than passed to the runtime."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    num_ctx: int = Field(DEFAULT_NUM_CTX, ge=512, le=MAX_NUM_CTX, description="Context window in tokens")
    region: str | None = Field(None, max_length=100)
    require_gpu: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResourceRequest:
    runtime: str
    cpu_cores: int
    ram_mb: int
    disk_mb: int
    vram_mb: int
    gpu_required: bool
    region: str | None = None
    community: bool = False  # unreviewed community model: only nodes whose provider opted in


def validate_model_tag(tag: str | None) -> str:
    if not tag or not OLLAMA_TAG_RE.fullmatch(tag):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Model has no valid runtime identifier")
    return tag


def artifact_problem(a: ModelArtifact) -> str | None:
    """Why an artifact cannot be deployed, or None if it is valid. Mirrors the worker's own validation."""
    if a.runtime not in SUPPORTED_RUNTIMES:
        return f"runtime '{a.runtime}' is not supported"
    if a.runtime == "ollama":
        if a.source_type != "ollama" or not OLLAMA_TAG_RE.fullmatch(a.reference or ""):
            return "invalid Ollama tag"
        return None
    if a.source_type != "huggingface" or not HF_REPO_RE.fullmatch(a.reference or ""):
        return "invalid Hugging Face repository"
    if not HF_REVISION_RE.fullmatch(a.revision or ""):
        return "Hugging Face revision must be pinned to a commit"
    if a.runtime == "llamacpp":
        if not GGUF_FILE_RE.fullmatch(a.file or "") or not SHA256_RE.fullmatch(a.sha256 or ""):
            return "llama.cpp artifacts need a GGUF file name and its SHA-256"
    if a.runtime == "vllm" and not a.gpu_required:
        return "vLLM artifacts must require a GPU"
    return None


def is_unreviewed(model: Model) -> bool:
    """A customer-imported model no operator has approved."""
    return model.owner_customer_id is not None and not model.is_approved


async def get_deployable_model(db: AsyncSession, model_id, customer_id=None) -> Model:
    """An approved catalog model, or the caller's own community model. Others' community models are 404."""
    model = await db.get(Model, parse_uuid(model_id, "Model"))
    if (
        model is None
        or model.withdrawn_at is not None
        or not (model.is_approved or (customer_id is not None and model.owner_customer_id == customer_id))
    ):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Approved model not found")
    return model


async def deployable_artifacts(db: AsyncSession, model: Model, runtime: str | None = None) -> list[ModelArtifact]:
    """Enabled, valid artifacts for ``model`` in preference order (or only ``runtime`` if given)."""
    if runtime is not None and runtime not in SUPPORTED_RUNTIMES:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422, detail=f"Unknown runtime '{runtime}'. Supported: {', '.join(RUNTIME_PREFERENCE)}"
        )
    rows = (
        (await db.execute(select(ModelArtifact).where(ModelArtifact.model_id == model.id, ModelArtifact.is_enabled)))
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )
    valid = [a for a in rows if artifact_problem(a) is None]
    offered = sorted({a.runtime for a in valid}, key=RUNTIME_PREFERENCE.index)
    if runtime is not None:
        valid = [a for a in valid if a.runtime == runtime]
    if not valid:
        if runtime is not None and offered:
            detail = f"Model is not available on runtime '{runtime}'. Available runtimes: {', '.join(offered)}"
        else:
            detail = "Model has no deployable runtime artifact"
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=detail)
    return sorted(valid, key=lambda a: RUNTIME_PREFERENCE.index(a.runtime))


def estimate_requirements(
    artifact: ModelArtifact, config: DeploymentConfig, *, community: bool = False
) -> ResourceRequest:
    """Scheduler reservation for an artifact. Catalog figures assume the default context; larger contexts
    need more KV-cache memory, approximated at 128 MB per extra 2048 tokens. These are estimates."""
    extra_ctx_mb = max(0, math.ceil((config.num_ctx - DEFAULT_NUM_CTX) / 2048)) * 128
    gpu = bool(artifact.gpu_required or config.require_gpu)
    return ResourceRequest(
        runtime=artifact.runtime,
        cpu_cores=max(1, artifact.min_cpu_cores or 1),
        ram_mb=artifact.min_ram_mb + extra_ctx_mb,
        disk_mb=artifact.min_disk_mb,
        vram_mb=(artifact.min_vram_mb or 0) + (extra_ctx_mb if gpu else 0) if gpu else 0,
        gpu_required=gpu,
        region=config.region,
        community=community,
    )


def worker_source(artifact: ModelArtifact) -> dict | None:
    """The source description sent to the worker (validated again there)."""
    if artifact.source_type != "huggingface":
        return None
    source: dict[str, Any] = {"type": "huggingface", "repo": artifact.reference, "revision": artifact.revision}
    if artifact.runtime == "llamacpp":
        source.update(file=artifact.file, sha256=artifact.sha256, size=artifact.size_bytes or 0)
    return source

"""Persisted node command queue: enqueueing and cancelling. Leasing lives in worker_service."""

from sqlalchemy import select, update
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.db_utils import rowcount as _rowcount
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.worker import CommandStatus, CommandType, NodeCommand


async def enqueue_command(db: AsyncSession, node_id, deployment_id, type_: CommandType, payload: dict) -> NodeCommand:
    """Queue a command. A STOP is not duplicated while an identical one is outstanding. Does not commit."""
    if type_ == CommandType.STOP:
        existing = (
            await db.execute(
                select(NodeCommand).where(
                    NodeCommand.deployment_id == deployment_id,
                    NodeCommand.type == CommandType.STOP.value,
                    NodeCommand.status.in_([CommandStatus.PENDING.value, CommandStatus.LEASED.value]),
                )
            )
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if existing:
            return existing
    cmd = NodeCommand(
        node_id=node_id,
        deployment_id=deployment_id,
        type=type_.value,
        payload=payload,
        status=CommandStatus.PENDING.value,
        attempts=0,
        max_attempts=settings.COMMAND_MAX_ATTEMPTS,
    )
    db.add(cmd)
    return cmd


async def cancel_undelivered(db: AsyncSession, deployment_id, type_: CommandType) -> bool:
    """Cancel a command that no worker has leased yet. Returns True if one was cancelled."""
    result = await db.execute(
        update(NodeCommand)
        .where(
            NodeCommand.deployment_id == deployment_id,
            NodeCommand.type == type_.value,
            NodeCommand.status == CommandStatus.PENDING.value,
            NodeCommand.attempts == 0,
        )
        .values(status=CommandStatus.CANCELLED.value, completed_at=utcnow())
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )
    return _rowcount(result) > 0

"""Community models: public Hugging Face GGUF files a customer imports for their own deployments.

They are private to the importing customer, served only by llama.cpp from a commit-pinned, SHA-256 verified
file, and scheduled only onto nodes whose provider opted in. Requirements are estimated from the file size.
Operators can disable an import's artifact (takedown) or approve the model into the reviewed catalog.
"""

import math
import uuid

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.ids import parse_uuid
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.deployment import Deployment
from app.models.model import Model, ModelArtifact
from app.models.user import Customer, User
from app.schemas.model import CommunityModelImport
from app.services import audit_service, huggingface
from app.services.deployment_lifecycle import TERMINAL


async def _customer(db: AsyncSession, user: User) -> Customer:
    customer = (await db.execute(select(Customer).where(Customer.user_id == user.id))).scalar_one_or_none()
    if customer is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Customer account required")
    return customer


def _active(customer_id: uuid.UUID):
    return select(Model).where(Model.owner_customer_id == customer_id, Model.withdrawn_at.is_(None))


def estimated_requirements(size_bytes: int) -> dict:
    """llama.cpp memory-maps the whole file and adds KV cache and compute buffers on top."""
    size_mb = math.ceil(size_bytes / 2**20)
    return {
        "min_ram_mb": math.ceil(size_mb * 1.2) + 512,
        "min_disk_mb": math.ceil(size_mb * 1.05) + 256,
        "min_cpu_cores": 1 if size_mb < 1024 else 2,
    }


async def preview(ref_text: str, revision: str | None) -> huggingface.RepoInfo:
    return await huggingface.fetch_repo(huggingface.parse_reference(ref_text, revision=revision))


async def import_model(db: AsyncSession, user: User, req: CommunityModelImport) -> Model:
    if not settings.COMMUNITY_MODELS_ENABLED:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Importing community models is disabled on this AgentMesh")
    customer = await _customer(db, user)
    if not req.accept_terms:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422, detail="Confirm that you may use this model under its license and AgentMesh's terms"
        )
    ref = huggingface.parse_reference(req.repo, file=req.file, revision=req.revision)
    if ref.file is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Choose which .gguf file to deploy")

    info = await huggingface.fetch_repo(ref)
    problem = huggingface.license_problem(info.license)
    if problem:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=problem)
    gguf = info.file(ref.file)
    if gguf is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"{ref.file} is not a GGUF file at this revision")
    problem = huggingface.file_problem(gguf)
    if problem:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=problem)

    source_url = f"https://huggingface.co/{info.repo}/blob/{info.commit}/{gguf.name}"
    existing: Model | None = (
        (await db.execute(_active(customer.id).where(Model.source_url == source_url))).scalars().first()
    )
    if existing:
        return existing
    count = (
        await db.execute(
            select(func.count(Model.id)).where(Model.owner_customer_id == customer.id, Model.withdrawn_at.is_(None))
        )
    ).scalar() or 0
    if count >= settings.COMMUNITY_MODELS_PER_CUSTOMER:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail=f"You already have {count} imported models; remove one before importing another",
        )

    owner, repo_name = info.repo.split("/", 1)
    need = estimated_requirements(gguf.size)
    model = Model(
        name=(f"{repo_name} {gguf.quantization}" if gguf.quantization else repo_name)[:255],
        version=info.commit[:12],
        runtime="llamacpp",
        source="huggingface",
        source_url=source_url,
        publisher=owner[:255],
        family=info.architecture,
        quantization=gguf.quantization,
        format="gguf",
        license=info.license_name or info.license,
        context_length=info.context_length,
        download_size_mb=math.ceil(gguf.size / 2**20),
        gpu_required=False,
        requirements_estimated=True,
        is_approved=False,
        owner_customer_id=customer.id,
        **need,
    )
    db.add(model)
    await db.flush()
    db.add(
        ModelArtifact(
            model_id=model.id,
            runtime="llamacpp",
            source_type="huggingface",
            reference=info.repo,
            revision=info.commit,
            file=gguf.name,
            sha256=gguf.sha256,
            size_bytes=gguf.size,
            format="gguf",
            quantization=gguf.quantization,
            min_vram_mb=0,
            gpu_required=False,
            requirements_estimated=True,
            **need,
        )
    )
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=user.id,
        action="model.community_imported",
        resource_type="model",
        resource_id=model.id,
        details={
            "repo": info.repo,
            "revision": info.commit,
            "file": gguf.name,
            "sha256": gguf.sha256,
            "license": info.license,
            "terms_accepted": True,
        },
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(model)
    return model


async def list_models(db: AsyncSession, user: User) -> list[Model]:
    customer = await _customer(db, user)
    return list((await db.execute(_active(customer.id).order_by(Model.created_at.desc()))).scalars().all())


async def get_model(db: AsyncSession, user: User, model_id: str) -> Model:
    """The caller's own community model. Anyone else's is 404 so ids cannot be probed."""
    customer = await _customer(db, user)
    model: Model | None = (
        await db.execute(_active(customer.id).where(Model.id == parse_uuid(model_id, "Model")))
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if model is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Model not found")
    return model


async def withdraw(db: AsyncSession, user: User, model_id: str) -> None:
    model = await get_model(db, user, model_id)
    if model.is_approved:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="An operator added this model to the catalog; it cannot be removed")
    running = (
        await db.execute(
            select(func.count(Deployment.id)).where(
                Deployment.model_id == model.id,
                Deployment.status.not_in([s.value for s in TERMINAL]),
            )
        )
    ).scalar() or 0
    if running:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Stop this model's deployments before removing it")
    model.withdrawn_at = utcnow()
    for artifact in model.artifacts:
        artifact.is_enabled = False
    audit_service.record(
        db, actor_id=user.id, action="model.community_withdrawn", resource_type="model", resource_id=model.id
    )
    await db.commit()

"""Deployment state machine.

    REQUESTED -> SCHEDULED -> PROVISIONING -> STARTING -> READY
    READY <-> UNHEALTHY
    PROVISIONING | STARTING | UNHEALTHY -> SCHEDULED   (moved to another node; same id and endpoint)
    READY | UNHEALTHY -> PROVISIONING                  (restart on the same node)
    any non-terminal -> STOPPING -> STOPPED (was ever READY) | CANCELLED (never READY)
    any non-terminal -> FAILED

Terminal states: STOPPED, FAILED, CANCELLED. Every transition goes through ``transition``, which applies a
compare-and-set UPDATE (so two concurrent writers cannot both move the same deployment) and appends a
DeploymentEvent row.
"""

from sqlalchemy import update
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.db_utils import rowcount as _rowcount
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.deployment import Deployment, DeploymentEvent
from app.models.deployment import DeploymentStatus as S

TERMINAL = frozenset({S.STOPPED, S.FAILED, S.CANCELLED})
ACTIVE = frozenset(set(S) - TERMINAL)
# States in which the workload may hold resources on the node.
PROVISIONED = frozenset({S.SCHEDULED, S.PROVISIONING, S.STARTING, S.READY, S.UNHEALTHY, S.STOPPING})

TRANSITIONS: dict[S, frozenset[S]] = {
    S.REQUESTED: frozenset({S.SCHEDULED, S.FAILED, S.CANCELLED}),
    S.SCHEDULED: frozenset({S.PROVISIONING, S.STARTING, S.READY, S.STOPPING, S.FAILED}),
    S.PROVISIONING: frozenset({S.SCHEDULED, S.STARTING, S.READY, S.STOPPING, S.FAILED}),
    S.STARTING: frozenset({S.SCHEDULED, S.READY, S.STOPPING, S.FAILED}),
    S.READY: frozenset({S.UNHEALTHY, S.PROVISIONING, S.STOPPING, S.FAILED}),
    S.UNHEALTHY: frozenset({S.READY, S.SCHEDULED, S.PROVISIONING, S.STOPPING, S.FAILED}),
    S.STOPPING: frozenset({S.STOPPED, S.CANCELLED, S.FAILED}),
    S.STOPPED: frozenset(),
    S.FAILED: frozenset(),
    S.CANCELLED: frozenset(),
}


class InvalidTransition(Exception):  # noqa: N818
    pass


def can_transition(current: str, new: str) -> bool:
    return S(new) in TRANSITIONS[S(current)]


async def transition(
    db: AsyncSession,
    deployment: Deployment,
    new: S,
    *,
    actor: str,
    message: str | None = None,
    error_code: str | None = None,
    **fields,
) -> bool:
    """Move ``deployment`` to ``new``. Returns False (and changes nothing) if another writer changed the
    status first. Raises InvalidTransition for transitions the state machine forbids. Does not commit."""
    current = S(deployment.status)
    if new == current:
        return True
    if not can_transition(current, new):
        raise InvalidTransition(f"{current.value} -> {new.value} is not allowed")

    now = utcnow()
    values: dict = {"status": new.value, "updated_at": now, **fields}
    if new == S.READY:
        values.setdefault("ready_at", now)
        values["was_ready"] = True
        values["error_code"] = None
        values["error_message"] = None
    if new in TERMINAL:
        values.setdefault("ended_at", now)
    if error_code:
        values["error_code"] = error_code
        values["error_message"] = message

    result = await db.execute(
        update(Deployment)
        .where(Deployment.id == deployment.id, Deployment.status == current.value)
        .values(**values)
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )
    if _rowcount(result) != 1:
        return False
    for key, value in values.items():
        setattr(deployment, key, value)
    db.add(
        DeploymentEvent(
            deployment_id=deployment.id,
            from_status=current.value,
            to_status=new.value,
            actor=actor,
            message=message,
            node_id=deployment.node_id,
        )
    )
    return True


async def record_event(db: AsyncSession, deployment: Deployment, *, actor: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Progress note without a state change (e.g. model download percentage)."""
    db.add(DeploymentEvent(deployment_id=deployment.id, from_status=None, to_status=None, actor=actor, message=message))

import uuid

from fastapi import HTTPException
from pydantic import ValidationError
from sqlalchemy import update
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.future import select

from app.core.dependencies import is_staff
from app.core.ids import parse_uuid
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.api_key import ApiKey
from app.models.deployment import Deployment, DeploymentEvent
from app.models.deployment import DeploymentStatus as S
from app.models.user import Customer, User
from app.models.worker import CommandType
from app.schemas.deployment import DeploymentCreate
from app.services import audit_service, billing_service, placement_service, worker_service
from app.services import deployment_lifecycle as lifecycle
from app.services.catalog_service import (
    DeploymentConfig,
    deployable_artifacts,
    estimate_requirements,
    get_deployable_model,
    is_unreviewed,
    worker_source,
)
from app.services.placement_service import deploy_payload
from app.services.scheduler_service import NoEligibleNode, release_reservation, schedule


async def _get_customer(db: AsyncSession, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> Customer | None:
    result = await db.execute(select(Customer).filter(Customer.user_id == user_id))
    return result.scalars().first()


async def _existing_by_idempotency_key(db: AsyncSession, customer_id, key: str | None) -> Deployment | None:
    if not key:
        return None
    result = await db.execute(
        select(Deployment).where(Deployment.customer_id == customer_id, Deployment.idempotency_key == key)
    )
    return result.scalars().first()


async def create_deployment(db: AsyncSession, deployment_data: DeploymentCreate, user_id: uuid.UUID):
    customer = await _get_customer(db, user_id)
    if not customer:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Customer account required")

    existing = await _existing_by_idempotency_key(db, customer.id, deployment_data.idempotency_key)
    if existing:
        return existing

    try:
        config = DeploymentConfig(**(deployment_data.config or {}))
    except ValidationError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=[{"loc": ["body", "config", *e["loc"]], "msg": e["msg"], "type": e["type"]} for e in exc.errors()],
        ) from None
    model = await get_deployable_model(db, deployment_data.model_id, customer.id)
    artifacts = await deployable_artifacts(db, model, deployment_data.runtime)

    deployment = Deployment(
        id=uuid.uuid4(),
        customer_id=customer.id,
        model_id=model.id,
        config=config.model_dump(),
        status=S.REQUESTED.value,
        idempotency_key=deployment_data.idempotency_key,
    )
    db.add(deployment)
    try:
        await db.flush()
    except IntegrityError:
        await db.rollback()
        existing = await _existing_by_idempotency_key(db, customer.id, deployment_data.idempotency_key)
        if existing:
            return existing
        raise
    db.add(DeploymentEvent(deployment_id=deployment.id, to_status=S.REQUESTED.value, actor="customer"))

    # Try each compatible runtime in preference order (or only the one the customer asked for).
    node = artifact = req = None
    failures: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for candidate in artifacts:
        candidate_req = estimate_requirements(candidate, config, community=is_unreviewed(model))
        try:
            node = await schedule(db, deployment.id, candidate_req)
        except NoEligibleNode as exc:
            failures[candidate.runtime] = {
                "message": exc.evaluation.explain(),
                "reasons": dict(exc.evaluation.reasons),
                "requirements": candidate_req.__dict__,
            }
            continue
        artifact, req = candidate, candidate_req
        break
    if node is None or artifact is None or req is None:
        await db.rollback()
        merged: dict[str, int] = {}
        for f in failures.values():
            for reason, count in f["reasons"].items():
                merged[reason] = merged.get(reason, 0) + count
        only = next(iter(failures.values())) if len(failures) == 1 else None
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=503,
            detail={
                "code": "no_eligible_node",
                "message": only["message"]
                if only
                else "; ".join(f"{rt}: {v['message']}" for rt, v in failures.items()),
                "reasons": merged,
                "by_runtime": failures,
                "requirements": only["requirements"] if only else None,
            },
        ) from None

    try:
        await billing_service.require_prepaid(db, user_id, req.cpu_cores, req.ram_mb, req.vram_mb)
    except HTTPException:
        await db.rollback()  # releases the reservation made above
        raise

    deployment.runtime = artifact.runtime
    deployment.model_tag = artifact.reference
    deployment.artifact_id = artifact.id
    deployment.node_id = node.id
    deployment.schedule_attempts = 1
    await lifecycle.transition(
        db, deployment, S.SCHEDULED, actor="system", message="Capacity reserved on a provider node", node_id=node.id
    )
    await worker_service.enqueue_command(
        db, node.id, deployment.id, CommandType.DEPLOY, deploy_payload(deployment, req, worker_source(artifact))
    )
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=user_id,
        action="deployment.created",
        resource_type="deployment",
        resource_id=deployment.id,
        details={"model_tag": deployment.model_tag, "runtime": deployment.runtime, "node_id": str(node.id)},
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(deployment)
    return deployment


async def list_deployments(db: AsyncSession, user_id: uuid.UUID):
    customer = await _get_customer(db, user_id)
    if not customer:
        return []
    result = await db.execute(
        select(Deployment)
        .filter(Deployment.customer_id == customer.id, Deployment.deleted_at.is_(None))
        .order_by(Deployment.created_at.desc())
    )
    return result.scalars().all()


async def get_deployment_for_user(db: AsyncSession, deployment_id: str, user: User) -> Deployment:
    """Fetch a deployment the caller is allowed to see. Non-owners receive 404 so IDs cannot be probed."""
    result = await db.execute(select(Deployment).filter(Deployment.id == parse_uuid(deployment_id, "Deployment")))
    deployment = result.scalars().first()
    if deployment and not is_staff(user):
        customer = await _get_customer(db, user.id)
        if not customer or deployment.customer_id != customer.id or deployment.deleted_at is not None:
            deployment = None
    if not deployment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Deployment not found")
    return deployment


async def _stop(db: AsyncSession, deployment: Deployment, actor: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Begin stopping a non-terminal deployment. Does not commit."""
    status = S(deployment.status)
    if status == S.STOPPING:
        return
    if status == S.REQUESTED:
        await lifecycle.transition(db, deployment, S.CANCELLED, actor=actor, message=message)
        return
    await lifecycle.transition(db, deployment, S.STOPPING, actor=actor, message=message)
    if status == S.SCHEDULED and await worker_service.cancel_undelivered(db, deployment.id, CommandType.DEPLOY):
        # The worker never received the deploy command, so there is nothing to clean up on the node.
        await lifecycle.transition(db, deployment, S.CANCELLED, actor="system", message="Cancelled before delivery")
        deployment.cleanup_status = "done"
        await release_reservation(db, deployment.id)
        return
    deployment.cleanup_status = "pending"
    await worker_service.enqueue_command(
        db, deployment.node_id, deployment.id, CommandType.STOP, {"deployment_id": str(deployment.id)}
    )


async def stop_deployment(db: AsyncSession, deployment_id: str, user: User):
    deployment = await get_deployment_for_user(db, deployment_id, user)
    if S(deployment.status) in lifecycle.TERMINAL:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"Deployment is already {deployment.status}")
    await _stop(db, deployment, actor="customer", message="Stop requested")
    audit_service.record(
        db, actor_id=user.id, action="deployment.stopped", resource_type="deployment", resource_id=deployment.id
    )
    await db.commit()
    return {"status": deployment.status}


async def restart_deployment(db: AsyncSession, deployment_id: str, user: User):
    deployment = await get_deployment_for_user(db, deployment_id, user)
    await placement_service.restart(db, deployment)
    audit_service.record(
        db, actor_id=user.id, action="deployment.restarted", resource_type="deployment", resource_id=deployment.id
    )
    await db.commit()
    return {"status": deployment.status}


async def delete_deployment(db: AsyncSession, deployment_id: str, user: User):
    """Stop the workload if needed, revoke deployment-scoped API keys, and hide the deployment. Usage and
    lifecycle records are retained for billing and audit."""
    deployment = await get_deployment_for_user(db, deployment_id, user)
    now = utcnow()
    if S(deployment.status) not in lifecycle.TERMINAL:
        await _stop(db, deployment, actor="customer", message="Deletion requested")
    await db.execute(
        update(ApiKey)
        .where(ApiKey.deployment_id == deployment.id, ApiKey.revoked_at.is_(None))
        .values(revoked_at=now)
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )
    deployment.deleted_at = now
    audit_service.record(
        db, actor_id=user.id, action="deployment.deleted", resource_type="deployment", resource_id=deployment.id
    )
    await db.commit()
    return {"status": deployment.status, "deleted": True}


async def list_events(db: AsyncSession, deployment_id: str, user: User):
    deployment = await get_deployment_for_user(db, deployment_id, user)
    result = await db.execute(
        select(DeploymentEvent)
        .where(DeploymentEvent.deployment_id == deployment.id)
        .order_by(DeploymentEvent.created_at, DeploymentEvent.id)
    )
    return result.scalars().all()

"""Read-only lookups of public Hugging Face model metadata, used to import community models.

The control plane only ever calls ``{HUGGINGFACE_URL}/api/models/<repo>/revision/<revision>`` with validated
path segments, never follows redirects, and caps the response size. Every value that ends up in a worker
command (commit, file, SHA-256, size) comes from this response, not from the customer. No access token is
sent: gated and private models are refused, as they are on workers.
"""

import json
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import quote, urlparse

import httpx
from fastapi import HTTPException

from app.core.config import settings
from app.services.catalog_service import GGUF_FILE_RE, HF_REPO_RE, HF_REVISION_RE, SHA256_RE

MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES = 10 * 2**20
REVISION_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]{0,99}$")
HF_HOSTS = frozenset({"huggingface.co", "www.huggingface.co", "hf.co"})
# Split GGUFs need every part, and mmproj files are vision projectors, not language models.
SPLIT_GGUF_RE = re.compile(r"-\d{5}-of-\d{5}\.gguf$")
QUANT_RE = re.compile(r"(?i)(?:^|[-_.])(I?Q\d(?:_[A-Z0-9]+)*|BF16|F16|F32)$")
# Hosting on AgentMesh is paid (providers earn from it), so licenses that forbid commercial use are refused.
NON_COMMERCIAL_RE = re.compile(r"(^|-)nc(-|$)|non-?commercial|research-only")

_transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None


def set_transport(transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None) -> None:
    global _transport
    _transport = transport


def _reject(detail: str, status: int = 422) -> HTTPException:
    return HTTPException(status_code=status, detail=detail)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HfReference:
    repo: str
    revision: str = "main"
    file: str | None = None


def parse_reference(text: str, file: str | None = None, revision: str | None = None) -> HfReference:
    """Accept ``owner/name`` or a huggingface.co URL to a repository, branch, or file."""
    text = text.strip()
    url_revision = url_file = None
    if "://" in text:
        parsed = urlparse(text)
        if parsed.scheme != "https" or (parsed.hostname or "").lower() not in HF_HOSTS or parsed.port:
            raise _reject("Only https://huggingface.co links are supported")
        parts = [p for p in parsed.path.split("/") if p]
        if len(parts) < 2:
            raise _reject("The link does not point to a model repository")
        text = f"{parts[0]}/{parts[1]}"
        if len(parts) >= 4 and parts[2] in ("blob", "resolve", "tree"):
            url_revision = parts[3]
            if parts[2] != "tree" and len(parts) == 5:
                url_file = parts[4]
    if not HF_REPO_RE.fullmatch(text) or ".." in text:
        raise _reject("Repository must look like owner/name")
    rev = (revision or url_revision or "main").strip()
    if not REVISION_NAME_RE.fullmatch(rev) or ".." in rev:
        raise _reject("Invalid revision")
    chosen = (file or url_file or "").strip() or None
    if chosen is not None and not GGUF_FILE_RE.fullmatch(chosen):
        raise _reject("Choose a single .gguf file from the repository root")
    return HfReference(repo=text, revision=rev, file=chosen)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GgufFile:
    name: str
    sha256: str
    size: int
    quantization: str | None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RepoInfo:
    repo: str
    commit: str
    license: str | None
    license_name: str | None
    architecture: str | None
    context_length: int | None
    files: list[GgufFile]

    def file(self, name: str) -> GgufFile | None:
        return next((f for f in self.files if f.name == name), None)


def quantization_of(file: str) -> str | None:
    match = QUANT_RE.search(file[: -len(".gguf")])
    return match.group(1).upper() if match else None


def license_problem(license_id: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not license_id or license_id.lower() in ("unknown", "none"):
        return "The model card declares no license, so AgentMesh cannot host it"
    if NON_COMMERCIAL_RE.search(license_id.lower()):
        return f"The license ({license_id}) does not allow commercial hosting"
    return None


async def _get_json(url: str) -> dict:
    timeout = httpx.Timeout(15.0)
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=timeout, transport=_transport, follow_redirects=False) as client:
            async with client.stream("GET", url, headers={"Accept": "application/json"}) as resp:
                if resp.status_code in (301, 302, 307, 308):
                    raise _reject("The repository has moved on Hugging Face; use its new name")
                if resp.status_code in (401, 403, 404):
                    raise _reject("Model not found on Hugging Face, or it is private or gated", 404)
                if resp.status_code == 429 or resp.status_code >= 500:
                    raise _reject("Hugging Face is not responding right now; try again shortly", 503)
                if resp.status_code != 200:
                    raise _reject(f"Hugging Face returned HTTP {resp.status_code}", 502)
                body = bytearray()
                async for chunk in resp.aiter_bytes():
                    body.extend(chunk)
                    if len(body) > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES:
                        raise _reject("Hugging Face response is too large", 502)
    except httpx.HTTPError:
        raise _reject("Could not reach Hugging Face; try again shortly", 503) from None
    try:
        data = json.loads(bytes(body))
    except ValueError:
        raise _reject("Hugging Face returned an unreadable response", 502) from None
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise _reject("Hugging Face returned an unexpected response", 502)
    return data


async def fetch_repo(ref: HfReference) -> RepoInfo:
    """Resolve ``ref`` to a pinned commit and list its root-level GGUF files with their LFS SHA-256."""
    base = settings.HUGGINGFACE_URL.rstrip("/")
    data = await _get_json(f"{base}/api/models/{ref.repo}/revision/{quote(ref.revision, safe='')}?blobs=true")
    if data.get("private") or data.get("disabled"):
        raise _reject("Model not found on Hugging Face, or it is private or gated", 404)
    if data.get("gated"):
        raise _reject("This model is gated on Hugging Face; AgentMesh does not send access tokens to providers")
    commit = str(data.get("sha") or "")
    if not HF_REVISION_RE.fullmatch(commit):
        raise _reject("Hugging Face did not return a commit for this revision", 502)

    card: dict = data["cardData"] if isinstance(data.get("cardData"), dict) else {}
    license_id = card.get("license")
    if isinstance(license_id, list):  # some cards list several; the first is the primary one
        license_id = license_id[0] if license_id else None
    if not isinstance(license_id, str):
        license_id = next(
            (t.split(":", 1)[1] for t in data.get("tags") or [] if isinstance(t, str) and t.startswith("license:")),
            None,
        )
    license_name = card.get("license_name") if isinstance(card.get("license_name"), str) else None

    gguf: dict = data["gguf"] if isinstance(data.get("gguf"), dict) else {}
    ctx = gguf.get("context_length")
    arch = gguf.get("architecture")

    files = []
    for s in data.get("siblings") or []:
        if not isinstance(s, dict):
            continue
        name, lfs = s.get("rfilename"), s.get("lfs")
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not GGUF_FILE_RE.fullmatch(name) or not isinstance(lfs, dict):
            continue
        sha, size = str(lfs.get("sha256") or ""), lfs.get("size")
        if SHA256_RE.fullmatch(sha) and isinstance(size, int) and size > 0:
            files.append(GgufFile(name=name, sha256=sha, size=size, quantization=quantization_of(name)))
    return RepoInfo(
        repo=ref.repo,
        commit=commit,
        license=license_id[:255] if isinstance(license_id, str) else None,
        license_name=license_name[:255] if license_name else None,
        architecture=arch[:100] if isinstance(arch, str) else None,
        context_length=ctx if isinstance(ctx, int) and ctx > 0 else None,
        files=sorted(files, key=lambda f: f.size),
    )


def file_problem(f: GgufFile) -> str | None:
    if SPLIT_GGUF_RE.search(f.name):
        return "Split GGUF files are not supported; choose a single-file quantization"
    if f.name.lower().startswith("mmproj"):
        return "This is a vision projector file, not a language model"
    if f.size > settings.COMMUNITY_MODEL_MAX_BYTES:
        return f"The file is larger than the {settings.COMMUNITY_MODEL_MAX_BYTES // 2**30} GB limit"
    return None

"""The ledger: the only code that changes wallet balances.

Rules (checked by reconciliation_service):

* A debit (``from_wallet``) applies while the entry is PENDING or SETTLED; a credit (``to_wallet``) applies
  only when SETTLED. So: balance = settled credits - (pending + settled) debits.
* Balances change with ``UPDATE ... SET balance = balance + :delta`` in the caller's transaction, never by
  read-modify-write, so concurrent postings cannot lose updates.
* Every posting carries an idempotency key (unique in the database). Posting the same key twice returns the
  existing entry and changes nothing.
* All amounts are in settings.BILLING_CURRENCY; a wallet in another currency is refused.

Nothing here commits.
"""

import uuid
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import select, update
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.db_utils import rowcount
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.transaction import Transaction, TransactionStatus, TransactionType
from app.models.wallet import Wallet

QUANTUM = Decimal("0.00000001")
DEBIT_STATES = (TransactionStatus.PENDING.value, TransactionStatus.SETTLED.value)


def money(value: Decimal | int | str | float) -> Decimal:
    return Decimal(str(value)).quantize(QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


async def wallet_for_user(db: AsyncSession, user_id: uuid.UUID, *, lock: bool = False) -> Wallet:
    """The user's wallet, created in the billing currency if missing. Does not commit."""
    query = select(Wallet).where(Wallet.user_id == user_id)
    if lock:
        query = query.with_for_update()
    wallet = (await db.execute(query)).scalars().first()
    if wallet is None:
        wallet = Wallet(id=uuid.uuid4(), user_id=user_id, balance=Decimal(0), currency=settings.BILLING_CURRENCY)
        db.add(wallet)
        await db.flush()
    return wallet


def _check_currency(wallet: Wallet | None) -> None:
    if wallet is not None and (wallet.currency or settings.BILLING_CURRENCY) != settings.BILLING_CURRENCY:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail=f"Wallet currency {wallet.currency} differs from the billing currency {settings.BILLING_CURRENCY}",
        )


async def _adjust(db: AsyncSession, wallet_id: uuid.UUID, delta: Decimal) -> None:
    await db.execute(
        update(Wallet)
        .where(Wallet.id == wallet_id)
        .values(balance=Wallet.balance + delta)
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )


async def _existing(db: AsyncSession, key: str) -> Transaction | None:
    return (await db.execute(select(Transaction).where(Transaction.idempotency_key == key))).scalars().first()


async def post(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    key: str,
    type: TransactionType,
    amount: Decimal,
    status: TransactionStatus = TransactionStatus.SETTLED,
    from_wallet: Wallet | None = None,
    to_wallet: Wallet | None = None,
    reference: str | None = None,
    description: str | None = None,
    deployment_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
) -> Transaction:
    """Record one ledger entry and apply its balance effects. Idempotent on ``key``."""
    existing = await _existing(db, key)
    if existing is not None:
        return existing
    amount = money(amount)
    if amount < 0:
        raise ValueError("Ledger amounts are never negative; the direction is given by the wallets")
    _check_currency(from_wallet)
    _check_currency(to_wallet)
    tx = Transaction(
        id=uuid.uuid4(),
        idempotency_key=key,
        type=type.value,
        status=status.value,
        amount=amount,
        from_wallet=from_wallet.id if from_wallet else None,
        to_wallet=to_wallet.id if to_wallet else None,
        reference=reference,
        description=description,
        deployment_id=deployment_id,
        settled_at=utcnow() if status == TransactionStatus.SETTLED else None,
    )
    db.add(tx)
    await db.flush()  # the unique key rejects a concurrent duplicate before balances move
    if from_wallet is not None and status.value in DEBIT_STATES:
        await _adjust(db, from_wallet.id, -amount)
    if to_wallet is not None and status == TransactionStatus.SETTLED:
        await _adjust(db, to_wallet.id, amount)
    return tx


async def settle(db: AsyncSession, tx: Transaction) -> bool:
    """PENDING -> SETTLED. The debit already applied; the credit applies now. False if not PENDING."""
    result = await db.execute(
        update(Transaction)
        .where(Transaction.id == tx.id, Transaction.status == TransactionStatus.PENDING.value)
        .values(status=TransactionStatus.SETTLED.value, settled_at=utcnow())
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )
    if rowcount(result) != 1:
        return False
    if tx.to_wallet is not None:
        await _adjust(db, tx.to_wallet, Decimal(tx.amount))
    tx.status = TransactionStatus.SETTLED.value
    return True


async def fail(db: AsyncSession, tx: Transaction) -> bool:
    """PENDING -> FAILED: the held debit is returned to the payer. False if not PENDING."""
    result = await db.execute(
        update(Transaction)
        .where(Transaction.id == tx.id, Transaction.status == TransactionStatus.PENDING.value)
        .values(status=TransactionStatus.FAILED.value)
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )
    if rowcount(result) != 1:
        return False
    if tx.from_wallet is not None:
        await _adjust(db, tx.from_wallet, Decimal(tx.amount))
    tx.status = TransactionStatus.FAILED.value
    return True


async def balance(db: AsyncSession, wallet_id: uuid.UUID) -> Decimal:
    value = (await db.execute(select(Wallet.balance).where(Wallet.id == wallet_id))).scalar()
    return Decimal(value or 0)

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.future import select

from app.core.ids import parse_uuid
from app.models.model import Model, ModelArtifact
from app.schemas.model import ModelCreate
from app.services import audit_service


async def list_models(db: AsyncSession):
    result = await db.execute(select(Model).filter(Model.is_approved.is_(True)))
    return result.scalars().all()


async def get_model(db: AsyncSession, model_id: str):
    result = await db.execute(select(Model).filter(Model.id == parse_uuid(model_id, "Model")))
    model = result.scalars().first()
    if not model or not model.is_approved:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Model not found")
    return model


async def create_model(db: AsyncSession, model_data: ModelCreate, actor_id=None):
    model = Model(**model_data.model_dump(), is_approved=False)
    db.add(model)
    await db.flush()
    if model.runtime == "ollama" and model.model_tag and model.min_ram_mb and model.min_disk_mb:
        # Older clients describe an Ollama model inline; keep that working by creating its artifact.
        db.add(
            ModelArtifact(
                model_id=model.id,
                runtime="ollama",
                source_type="ollama",
                reference=model.model_tag,
                format="ollama",
                quantization=model.quantization,
                min_ram_mb=model.min_ram_mb,
                min_disk_mb=model.min_disk_mb,
                min_vram_mb=model.min_vram_mb or 0,
                min_cpu_cores=model.min_cpu_cores or 1,
                gpu_required=model.gpu_required,
                requirements_estimated=model.requirements_estimated,
            )
        )
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=actor_id,
        action="model.created",
        resource_type="model",
        resource_id=model.id,
        details={"name": model.name, "runtime": model.runtime, "model_tag": model.model_tag},
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(model)
    return model


async def approve_model(db: AsyncSession, model_id: str, approved: bool, actor_id=None):
    model = await db.get(Model, parse_uuid(model_id, "Model"))
    if not model:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Model not found")
    model.is_approved = approved
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=actor_id,
        action="model.approved" if approved else "model.unapproved",
        resource_type="model",
        resource_id=model.id,
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(model)
    return model


async def add_artifact(db: AsyncSession, model_id: str, data, actor_id=None) -> ModelArtifact:
    from app.services.catalog_service import artifact_problem

    model = await db.get(Model, parse_uuid(model_id, "Model"))
    if not model:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Model not found")
    artifact = ModelArtifact(model_id=model.id, **data.model_dump())
    problem = artifact_problem(artifact)
    if problem:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"Invalid artifact: {problem}")
    if any(a.runtime == artifact.runtime for a in model.artifacts):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"Model already has a {artifact.runtime} artifact")
    db.add(artifact)
    await db.flush()
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=actor_id,
        action="model.artifact_added",
        resource_type="model",
        resource_id=model.id,
        details={"runtime": artifact.runtime, "reference": artifact.reference, "revision": artifact.revision},
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(artifact)
    return artifact


async def set_artifact_enabled(db: AsyncSession, model_id: str, artifact_id: str, enabled: bool, actor_id=None):
    artifact = await db.get(ModelArtifact, parse_uuid(artifact_id, "Artifact"))
    if artifact is None or str(artifact.model_id) != str(parse_uuid(model_id, "Model")):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Artifact not found")
    artifact.is_enabled = enabled
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=actor_id,
        action="model.artifact_enabled" if enabled else "model.artifact_disabled",
        resource_type="model",
        resource_id=artifact.model_id,
        details={"runtime": artifact.runtime},
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(artifact)
    return artifact
