import uuid

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.future import select

from app.core.dependencies import is_staff
from app.core.ids import parse_uuid
from app.core.security import get_password_hash, verify_node_api_key
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.node import Node, NodeHardware, NodeStatus
from app.models.user import Provider, User
from app.schemas.node import NodeCreate
from app.services import audit_service


async def register_node(db: AsyncSession, node_data: NodeCreate, user_id: uuid.UUID):
    result = await db.execute(select(Provider).filter(Provider.user_id == user_id))
    provider = result.scalars().first()
    if not provider:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Provider account required")

    api_key = f"am_node_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
    node = Node(
        owner_id=provider.id,
        name=node_data.name,
        public_key=node_data.public_key,
        region=node_data.region,
        api_key_hash=get_password_hash(api_key),
    )
    db.add(node)
    await db.flush()
    if node_data.hardware:
        db.add(NodeHardware(node_id=node.id, **node_data.hardware.model_dump()))
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(node)
    # The plaintext key is returned exactly once; only its hash is stored.
    return {"id": node.id, "node_id": node.id, "api_key": api_key, "status": node.status}


async def list_nodes(db: AsyncSession, user_id: uuid.UUID):
    result = await db.execute(select(Provider).filter(Provider.user_id == user_id))
    provider = result.scalars().first()
    if not provider:
        return []
    result = await db.execute(select(Node).filter(Node.owner_id == provider.id))
    return result.scalars().all()


async def get_node(db: AsyncSession, node_id: str | uuid.UUID) -> Node:
    result = await db.execute(select(Node).filter(Node.id == parse_uuid(node_id, "Node")))
    node = result.scalars().first()
    if not node:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Node not found")
    return node


async def get_node_for_user(db: AsyncSession, node_id: str, user: User) -> Node:
    """Return a node only if the caller owns it or is platform staff. Other callers get 404, not 403,
    so node IDs cannot be probed."""
    node = await get_node(db, node_id)
    if is_staff(user):
        return node
    result = await db.execute(select(Provider).filter(Provider.user_id == user.id))
    provider = result.scalars().first()
    if not provider or node.owner_id != provider.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Node not found")
    return node


async def process_heartbeat(db: AsyncSession, node: Node):
    if node.status == NodeStatus.SUSPENDED:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Node suspended")
    node.last_heartbeat = utcnow()
    node.status = NodeStatus.ONLINE
    await db.commit()
    return {"status": "ok"}


async def authenticate_node(db: AsyncSession, node_id: str, api_key: str) -> Node:
    try:
        node = await get_node(db, node_id)
    except HTTPException:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid node credentials") from None
    if not verify_node_api_key(api_key, node.api_key_hash):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid node credentials")
    return node


async def set_accepting_workloads(db: AsyncSession, node_id: str, user: User, accepting: bool) -> Node:
    """Pause or resume scheduling onto a node. Existing deployments keep running (drain)."""
    node = await get_node_for_user(db, node_id, user)
    node.accepting_workloads = accepting
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=user.id,
        action="node.resumed" if accepting else "node.paused",
        resource_type="node",
        resource_id=node.id,
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(node)
    return node


async def set_accepts_community_models(db: AsyncSession, node_id: str, user: User, accept: bool) -> Node:
    """Provider opt-in to unreviewed community models. Opting out stops new placements; deployments already
    running keep running until they stop or move. Only the provider can consent; staff may only opt a node out."""
    node = await get_node_for_user(db, node_id, user)
    if accept and is_staff(user):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the node's provider can opt in to community models")
    node.accepts_community_models = accept
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=user.id,
        action="node.community_models_accepted" if accept else "node.community_models_refused",
        resource_type="node",
        resource_id=node.id,
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(node)
    return node


async def revoke_node(db: AsyncSession, node_id: str, user: User) -> Node:
    """Revoke a node's credential (disconnect or compromise). Its active deployments fail immediately and
    their reservations are released; the worker can no longer authenticate."""
    from app.models.deployment import Deployment
    from app.services import deployment_lifecycle as lifecycle
    from app.services import placement_service
    from app.services.scheduler_service import release_reservation
    from app.services.tunnel import broker

    node = await get_node_for_user(db, node_id, user)
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=user.id,
        action="node.revoked",
        resource_type="node",
        resource_id=node.id,
        details={"by_role": user.role},
    )
    node.api_key_hash = None
    node.status = NodeStatus.REVOKED
    node.accepting_workloads = False
    active = (
        (
            await db.execute(
                select(Deployment).where(
                    Deployment.node_id == node.id, Deployment.status.in_([s.value for s in lifecycle.ACTIVE])
                )
            )
        )
        .scalars()
        .all()
    )
    actor = "operator" if is_staff(user) else "provider"
    for dep in active:
        if lifecycle.S(dep.status) == lifecycle.S.STOPPING:
            # Was already being stopped; the node can no longer confirm, so finish it here.
            final = lifecycle.S.STOPPED if dep.was_ready else lifecycle.S.CANCELLED
            await lifecycle.transition(db, dep, final, actor=actor, message="Node credential revoked")
            dep.cleanup_status = "pending_node"
            await release_reservation(db, dep.id)
            continue
        # A revoked worker stops all of its workloads itself, so no cleanup command is queued.
        await placement_service.fail_or_reschedule(
            db, dep, code="NODE_REVOKED", message="Node credential revoked", actor=actor, cleanup_old_node=False
        )
    await db.commit()
    await broker.close_node(node.id)
    await db.refresh(node)
    return node

"""Paystack top-ups, webhooks, and provider payouts.

Money is credited only on a verified Paystack success whose amount and currency match what we asked for, and
exactly once: the payment row moves INITIALIZED -> SUCCEEDED with a compare-and-set, and the ledger posting
has a unique idempotency key. Webhook redeliveries are recorded once in payment_events and otherwise ignored.

Payouts hold the amount (a PENDING ledger debit) when requested. The hold is released (FAILED entry) only when
Paystack says the transfer failed or was reversed, or an operator rejects it; an unknown outcome (timeout) stays
PENDING until reconciliation asks Paystack.
"""

import logging
import secrets
import uuid
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import select, update
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.db_utils import rowcount
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.billing import Payment, PaymentEvent, PaymentStatus, Payout, PayoutAccount, PayoutStatus
from app.models.transaction import Transaction, TransactionStatus, TransactionType
from app.models.user import User
from app.services import audit_service, ledger_service, paystack
from app.services.ledger_service import money
from app.services.paystack import PaystackError, from_subunits

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

OPEN_PAYMENT = (PaymentStatus.INITIALIZED.value,)
OPEN_PAYOUT = (PayoutStatus.REQUESTED.value, PayoutStatus.PENDING.value, PayoutStatus.OTP_REQUIRED.value)


def _require_payments() -> None:
    if not settings.payments_enabled:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="Payments are not configured on this AgentMesh network")


def _gateway_error(exc: PaystackError) -> HTTPException:
    return HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=f"Paystack: {exc}")


def payments_config() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "enabled": settings.payments_enabled,
        "provider": "paystack" if settings.payments_enabled else None,
        "mode": settings.payments_mode,
        "currency": settings.BILLING_CURRENCY,
        "topup_min": str(settings.TOPUP_MIN_AMOUNT),
        "topup_max": str(settings.TOPUP_MAX_AMOUNT),
        "payout_min": str(settings.PAYOUT_MIN_AMOUNT),
        "payouts_require_approval": settings.PAYOUTS_REQUIRE_APPROVAL,
        "test_credits": settings.test_credits_enabled,
    }


# --- Top-ups -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def create_topup(db: AsyncSession, user: User, amount: Decimal) -> Payment:
    _require_payments()
    amount = money(amount)
    if amount != amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01")):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Amounts can have at most 2 decimal places")
    if not settings.TOPUP_MIN_AMOUNT <= amount <= settings.TOPUP_MAX_AMOUNT:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"Top-ups must be between {settings.TOPUP_MIN_AMOUNT} and {settings.TOPUP_MAX_AMOUNT} "
            f"{settings.BILLING_CURRENCY}",
        )
    wallet = await ledger_service.wallet_for_user(db, user.id)
    payment = Payment(
        id=uuid.uuid4(),
        user_id=user.id,
        wallet_id=wallet.id,
        provider="paystack",
        reference=f"am-top-{secrets.token_hex(12)}",
        amount=amount,
        currency=settings.BILLING_CURRENCY,
        status=PaymentStatus.INITIALIZED.value,
    )
    db.add(payment)
    await db.commit()  # the reference exists before Paystack does, so a webhook can always find it
    try:
        data = await paystack.initialize_transaction(
            email=user.email,
            amount=amount,
            currency=payment.currency,
            reference=payment.reference,
            callback_url=f"{settings.FRONTEND_URL.rstrip('/')}/customer/wallet",
        )
    except PaystackError as exc:
        payment.status = PaymentStatus.FAILED.value
        payment.failure_reason = f"Checkout could not be created: {exc}"[:300]
        await db.commit()
        raise _gateway_error(exc) from None
    payment.authorization_url = str(data.get("authorization_url") or "")[:500] or None
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=user.id,
        action="payment.topup_initialized",
        resource_type="payment",
        resource_id=payment.id,
        details={"amount": str(amount), "currency": payment.currency, "reference": payment.reference},
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(payment)
    return payment


async def apply_paystack_result(db: AsyncSession, payment: Payment, data: dict[str, Any], source: str) -> str:
    """Apply a Paystack transaction record (from verify or a signed webhook) to a payment. Does not commit.
    Returns an outcome label."""
    status = str(data.get("status") or "")
    payment.provider_status = status[:30] or None
    if payment.status != PaymentStatus.INITIALIZED.value:
        return f"already_{payment.status.lower()}"
    if status == "success":
        try:
            paid = from_subunits(data.get("amount") or 0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            paid = Decimal(-1)
        currency = str(data.get("currency") or "")
        if paid != Decimal(payment.amount) or currency != payment.currency:
            payment.status = PaymentStatus.REVIEW.value
            payment.failure_reason = (
                f"Paystack reported {paid} {currency}; expected {payment.amount} {payment.currency}"
            )
            audit_service.record(
                db,
                actor_id=None,
                action="payment.amount_mismatch",
                resource_type="payment",
                resource_id=payment.id,
                details={"reported": f"{paid} {currency}", "expected": f"{payment.amount} {payment.currency}"},
            )
            return "amount_mismatch"
        return await _credit(db, payment, data, source)
    if status in ("failed", "abandoned", "reversed"):
        moved = await db.execute(
            update(Payment)
            .where(Payment.id == payment.id, Payment.status.in_(OPEN_PAYMENT))
            .values(
                status=PaymentStatus.ABANDONED.value if status == "abandoned" else PaymentStatus.FAILED.value,
                failure_reason=str(data.get("gateway_response") or status)[:300],
                verified_at=utcnow(),
            )
            .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
        )
        await db.refresh(payment)
        return status if rowcount(moved) else "already_closed"
    return f"still_{status or 'unknown'}"


async def _credit(db: AsyncSession, payment: Payment, data: dict[str, Any], source: str) -> str:
    now = utcnow()
    moved = await db.execute(
        update(Payment)
        .where(Payment.id == payment.id, Payment.status.in_(OPEN_PAYMENT))
        .values(status=PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED.value, verified_at=now, paid_at=now)
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )
    if rowcount(moved) != 1:
        return "already_credited"
    wallet = await ledger_service.wallet_for_user(db, payment.user_id)
    tx = await ledger_service.post(
        db,
        key=f"payment:{payment.reference}",
        type=TransactionType.DEPOSIT,
        amount=Decimal(payment.amount),
        to_wallet=wallet,
        reference=payment.reference,
        description=f"Paystack top-up ({settings.payments_mode} mode)",
    )
    await db.execute(
        update(Payment)
        .where(Payment.id == payment.id)
        .values(transaction_id=tx.id, channel=str(data.get("channel") or "")[:30] or None)
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=None,
        action="payment.credited",
        resource_type="payment",
        resource_id=payment.id,
        details={"amount": str(payment.amount), "via": source, "reference": payment.reference},
    )
    await db.refresh(payment)
    return "credited"


async def verify_topup(db: AsyncSession, user: User, reference: str) -> Payment:
    """Called when the customer returns from checkout: asks Paystack for the outcome."""
    _require_payments()
    payment = (
        (await db.execute(select(Payment).where(Payment.reference == reference, Payment.user_id == user.id)))
        .scalars()
        .first()
    )
    if payment is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Payment not found")
    if payment.status == PaymentStatus.INITIALIZED.value:
        try:
            data = await paystack.verify_transaction(reference)
        except PaystackError as exc:
            raise _gateway_error(exc) from None
        await apply_paystack_result(db, payment, data, source="verify")
        await db.commit()
        await db.refresh(payment)
    return payment


async def list_topups(db: AsyncSession, user: User) -> list[Payment]:
    q = select(Payment).where(Payment.user_id == user.id).order_by(Payment.created_at.desc()).limit(100)
    return list((await db.execute(q)).scalars().all())


# --- Webhooks ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def handle_webhook(db: AsyncSession, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Process one signature-verified Paystack event. Idempotent per event."""
    event = str(payload.get("event") or "")[:60]
    data = payload.get("data") or {}
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return "ignored_malformed"
    reference = str(data.get("reference") or "")[:100] or None
    key = f"{event}:{data.get('id') or reference}"[:200]
    inbox = PaymentEvent(provider="paystack", event_key=key, event_type=event or "unknown", reference=reference)
    db.add(inbox)
    try:
        await db.flush()
    except IntegrityError:
        await db.rollback()
        return "duplicate"

    if event == "charge.success" and reference:
        payment = (await db.execute(select(Payment).where(Payment.reference == reference))).scalars().first()
        outcome = await apply_paystack_result(db, payment, data, source="webhook") if payment else "unknown_reference"
    elif event.startswith("transfer.") and reference:
        payout = (await db.execute(select(Payout).where(Payout.reference == reference))).scalars().first()
        outcome = await apply_transfer_result(db, payout, data) if payout else "unknown_reference"
    else:
        outcome = "ignored"
    inbox.outcome = outcome[:60]
    inbox.processed_at = utcnow()
    await db.commit()
    return outcome


# --- Payouts -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def list_banks() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    _require_payments()
    try:
        banks = await paystack.list_banks(settings.BILLING_CURRENCY)
    except PaystackError as exc:
        raise _gateway_error(exc) from None
    return [{"name": b.get("name"), "code": b.get("code")} for b in banks if b.get("active", True) and b.get("code")]


async def get_payout_account(db: AsyncSession, user: User) -> PayoutAccount | None:
    return (await db.execute(select(PayoutAccount).where(PayoutAccount.user_id == user.id))).scalars().first()


async def set_payout_account(db: AsyncSession, user: User, account_number: str, bank_code: str) -> PayoutAccount:
    _require_payments()
    try:
        resolved = await paystack.resolve_account(account_number, bank_code)
        name = str(resolved.get("account_name") or "")[:200]
        recipient = await paystack.create_recipient(
            name=name or user.email,
            account_number=account_number,
            bank_code=bank_code,
            currency=settings.BILLING_CURRENCY,
        )
    except PaystackError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422 if exc.status and exc.status < 500 else 502, detail=f"Paystack: {exc}"
        ) from None
    details = recipient.get("details") or {}
    account = await get_payout_account(db, user) or PayoutAccount(id=uuid.uuid4(), user_id=user.id)
    account.provider = "paystack"
    account.recipient_code = str(recipient.get("recipient_code") or "")
    if not account.recipient_code:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Paystack did not return a recipient code")
    account.bank_code = bank_code
    account.bank_name = str(details.get("bank_name") or "")[:200] or None
    account.account_name = name or None
    account.account_last4 = account_number[-4:]
    account.currency = settings.BILLING_CURRENCY
    db.add(account)
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=user.id,
        action="payout.account_set",
        resource_type="payout_account",
        resource_id=account.id,
        details={"bank_code": bank_code, "account_last4": account.account_last4},
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(account)
    return account


async def request_payout(db: AsyncSession, user: User, amount: Decimal) -> Payout:
    _require_payments()
    amount = money(amount)
    if amount != amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01")):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Amounts can have at most 2 decimal places")
    if amount < settings.PAYOUT_MIN_AMOUNT:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422, detail=f"The minimum payout is {settings.PAYOUT_MIN_AMOUNT} {settings.BILLING_CURRENCY}"
        )
    account = await get_payout_account(db, user)
    if account is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Add a payout bank account first")
    wallet = await ledger_service.wallet_for_user(db, user.id, lock=True)
    available = await ledger_service.balance(db, wallet.id)
    if amount > available:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"Only {money(available)} {wallet.currency} is available")
    payout = Payout(
        id=uuid.uuid4(),
        user_id=user.id,
        wallet_id=wallet.id,
        payout_account_id=account.id,
        amount=amount,
        currency=settings.BILLING_CURRENCY,
        reference=f"am-po-{secrets.token_hex(12)}",
        status=PayoutStatus.REQUESTED.value,
    )
    db.add(payout)
    hold = await ledger_service.post(
        db,
        key=f"payout:{payout.reference}",
        type=TransactionType.PAYOUT,
        status=TransactionStatus.PENDING,
        amount=amount,
        from_wallet=wallet,
        reference=payout.reference,
        description=f"Payout to bank account ending {account.account_last4}",
    )
    # A concurrent request may have spent the same balance; the hold must not overdraw the wallet.
    if await ledger_service.balance(db, wallet.id) < 0:
        await db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Insufficient available balance")
    payout.transaction_id = hold.id
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=user.id,
        action="payout.requested",
        resource_type="payout",
        resource_id=payout.id,
        details={"amount": str(amount), "reference": payout.reference},
    )
    await db.commit()
    if not settings.PAYOUTS_REQUIRE_APPROVAL:
        return await _send(db, payout, actor=None)
    await db.refresh(payout)
    return payout


async def list_payouts(db: AsyncSession, user: User | None, status: str | None = None) -> list[Payout]:
    q = select(Payout).order_by(Payout.created_at.desc()).limit(200)
    if user is not None:
        q = q.where(Payout.user_id == user.id)
    if status:
        q = q.where(Payout.status == status)
    return list((await db.execute(q)).scalars().all())


async def _hold(db: AsyncSession, payout: Payout) -> Transaction | None:
    return await db.get(Transaction, payout.transaction_id) if payout.transaction_id else None


async def _close(db: AsyncSession, payout: Payout, status: PayoutStatus, reason: str | None) -> bool:
    """Move an open payout to a final state, settling or releasing the held funds. Does not commit."""
    moved = await db.execute(
        update(Payout)
        .where(Payout.id == payout.id, Payout.status.in_(OPEN_PAYOUT))
        .values(status=status.value, failure_reason=reason, completed_at=utcnow())
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )
    if rowcount(moved) != 1:
        return False
    hold = await _hold(db, payout)
    if hold is not None:
        if status == PayoutStatus.SUCCEEDED:
            await ledger_service.settle(db, hold)
        else:
            await ledger_service.fail(db, hold)
    await db.refresh(payout)
    return True


async def decide_payout(db: AsyncSession, payout_id: str, operator: User, approve: bool, reason: str | None) -> Payout:
    payout = await db.get(Payout, uuid.UUID(payout_id))
    if payout is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Payout not found")
    if payout.status != PayoutStatus.REQUESTED.value:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"Payout is {payout.status}, not awaiting approval")
    payout.decided_by = operator.id
    payout.decided_at = utcnow()
    audit_service.record(
        db,
        actor_id=operator.id,
        action="payout.approved" if approve else "payout.rejected",
        resource_type="payout",
        resource_id=payout.id,
        details={"amount": str(payout.amount), "reason": reason} if reason else {"amount": str(payout.amount)},
    )
    if not approve:
        await _close(db, payout, PayoutStatus.REJECTED, reason or "Rejected by an operator")
        await db.commit()
        return payout
    await db.commit()
    return await _send(db, payout, actor=operator)


async def _send(db: AsyncSession, payout: Payout, actor: User | None) -> Payout:
    """Initiate the Paystack transfer. Commits."""
    account = await db.get(PayoutAccount, payout.payout_account_id)
    moved = await db.execute(
        update(Payout)
        .where(Payout.id == payout.id, Payout.status == PayoutStatus.REQUESTED.value)
        .values(status=PayoutStatus.PENDING.value)
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )
    await db.commit()  # PENDING before calling Paystack: never send the same payout twice
    if rowcount(moved) != 1 or account is None:
        await db.refresh(payout)
        return payout
    try:
        data = await paystack.initiate_transfer(
            amount=Decimal(payout.amount),
            recipient=account.recipient_code,
            reference=payout.reference,
            reason="AgentMesh provider payout",
        )
    except PaystackError as exc:
        if exc.uncertain:
            payout.failure_reason = f"Outcome unknown, will be reconciled: {exc}"[:300]
        else:
            await _close(db, payout, PayoutStatus.FAILED, f"Paystack refused the transfer: {exc}"[:300])
        await db.commit()
        await db.refresh(payout)
        return payout
    payout.transfer_code = str(data.get("transfer_code") or "")[:100] or None
    await apply_transfer_result(db, payout, data)
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(payout)
    return payout


async def apply_transfer_result(db: AsyncSession, payout: Payout, data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Apply a Paystack transfer record (initiate response, verify, or webhook). Does not commit."""
    status = str(data.get("status") or "")
    if payout.status not in OPEN_PAYOUT:
        return f"already_{payout.status.lower()}"
    if data.get("amount") is not None and from_subunits(data["amount"]) != Decimal(payout.amount):
        payout.failure_reason = "Paystack reported a different transfer amount; needs review"
        return "amount_mismatch"
    if status == "success":
        await _close(db, payout, PayoutStatus.SUCCEEDED, None)
        return "succeeded"
    if status in ("failed", "reversed"):
        final = PayoutStatus.REVERSED if status == "reversed" else PayoutStatus.FAILED
        await _close(db, payout, final, str(data.get("reason") or data.get("gateway_response") or status)[:300])
        return status
    if status == "otp":
        await db.execute(
            update(Payout)
            .where(Payout.id == payout.id, Payout.status.in_(OPEN_PAYOUT))
            .values(
                status=PayoutStatus.OTP_REQUIRED.value,
                failure_reason="Paystack requires an OTP for transfers; disable transfer OTP for API use",
            )
            .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
        )
        await db.refresh(payout)
        return "otp_required"
    return f"pending_{status or 'unknown'}"

"""Minimal Paystack API client (https://paystack.com/docs/api).

Amounts cross this boundary in the currency's subunit (kobo for NGN): Paystack integers, never floats.
Webhooks are authenticated with HMAC-SHA512 of the raw request body keyed by the secret key.
"""

import hashlib
import hmac
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

import httpx

from app.core.config import settings

SUBUNITS = 100  # NGN, GHS, ZAR, KES and USD all use 1/100 subunits on Paystack


class PaystackError(Exception):
    """Paystack refused the request or answered unexpectedly. ``uncertain`` means the outcome is unknown
    (timeout or connection error after sending) and must be resolved by verification, not assumed failed."""

    def __init__(self, message: str, *, status: int | None = None, uncertain: bool = False):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status = status
        self.uncertain = uncertain


def to_subunits(amount: Decimal) -> int:
    value = Decimal(amount) * SUBUNITS
    if value != value.to_integral_value():
        raise ValueError(f"{amount} has more precision than the currency allows")
    return int(value)


def from_subunits(value: int | str) -> Decimal:
    return Decimal(int(value)) / SUBUNITS


def signature_valid(raw_body: bytes, signature: str | None, secret: str | None = None) -> bool:
    secret = secret if secret is not None else settings.PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY
    if not secret or not signature:
        return False
    expected = hmac.new(secret.encode(), raw_body, hashlib.sha512).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, signature.strip().lower())


# Tests replace this to route requests to a fake Paystack (httpx.MockTransport).
_transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None


def set_transport(transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None) -> None:
    global _transport
    _transport = transport


async def _call(method: str, path: str, *, json: dict | None = None, params: dict | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not settings.PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY:
        raise PaystackError("Payments are not configured (PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY is not set)", status=503)
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY}", "Accept": "application/json"}
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=settings.PAYSTACK_BASE_URL,
            timeout=settings.PAYSTACK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
            transport=_transport,
        ) as client:
            resp = await client.request(method, path, json=json, params=params, headers=headers)
    except httpx.ConnectError as exc:
        raise PaystackError(f"Could not reach Paystack: {type(exc).__name__}") from None
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        # The request may have reached Paystack; its outcome is unknown.
        raise PaystackError(f"Paystack request did not complete: {type(exc).__name__}", uncertain=True) from None
    try:
        body = resp.json()
    except ValueError:
        raise PaystackError(
            f"Paystack returned HTTP {resp.status_code} without JSON", status=resp.status_code
        ) from None
    if resp.status_code >= 500:
        raise PaystackError(f"Paystack error (HTTP {resp.status_code})", status=resp.status_code, uncertain=True)
    if resp.status_code >= 400 or not body.get("status"):
        raise PaystackError(str(body.get("message") or f"HTTP {resp.status_code}")[:300], status=resp.status_code)
    return body.get("data") or {}


async def initialize_transaction(*, email: str, amount: Decimal, currency: str, reference: str, callback_url: str):
    return await _call(
        "POST",
        "/transaction/initialize",
        json={
            "email": email,
            "amount": to_subunits(amount),
            "currency": currency,
            "reference": reference,
            "callback_url": callback_url,
            "metadata": {"purpose": "agentmesh_wallet_topup"},
        },
    )


async def verify_transaction(reference: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return await _call("GET", f"/transaction/verify/{reference}")


async def list_banks(currency: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    data = await _call("GET", "/bank", params={"currency": currency, "perPage": 200})
    return data if isinstance(data, list) else []


async def resolve_account(account_number: str, bank_code: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return await _call("GET", "/bank/resolve", params={"account_number": account_number, "bank_code": bank_code})


async def create_recipient(*, name: str, account_number: str, bank_code: str, currency: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return await _call(
        "POST",
        "/transferrecipient",
        json={
            "type": "nuban" if currency == "NGN" else "basa" if currency == "ZAR" else "mobile_money",
            "name": name,
            "account_number": account_number,
            "bank_code": bank_code,
            "currency": currency,
        },
    )


async def initiate_transfer(*, amount: Decimal, recipient: str, reference: str, reason: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return await _call(
        "POST",
        "/transfer",
        json={
            "source": "balance",
            "amount": to_subunits(amount),
            "recipient": recipient,
            "reference": reference,
            "reason": reason,
        },
    )


async def verify_transfer(reference: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return await _call("GET", f"/transfer/verify/{reference}")

"""Placement decisions after something goes wrong: move a deployment to another node, or fail it.

A deployment keeps its id, endpoint, and API keys when it moves, so customers do not need to change anything.
Only failures caused by the node are retried elsewhere. Failures caused by the model (bad tag, failed test
generation, download error after the worker's own retries) are not, because another node would fail the
same way.
"""

import logging
import uuid
from typing import Any

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.deployment import Deployment
from app.models.deployment import DeploymentStatus as S
from app.models.model import Model, ModelArtifact
from app.models.node import Node, NodeStatus
from app.models.worker import CommandType
from app.services import audit_service
from app.services import deployment_lifecycle as lifecycle
from app.services.catalog_service import (
    DeploymentConfig,
    ResourceRequest,
    estimate_requirements,
    is_unreviewed,
    worker_source,
)
from app.services.commands import cancel_undelivered, enqueue_command
from app.services.scheduler_service import NoEligibleNode, node_is_fresh, release_reservation, schedule

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Failure codes that are the node's fault and worth retrying on a different node.
RESCHEDULABLE_CODES = frozenset(
    {
        "NODE_UNRESPONSIVE",  # never picked up the deploy command
        "NODE_OFFLINE",  # stopped heartbeating while provisioning
        "NODE_REVOKED",
        "PROVISION_STALLED",
        "UNHEALTHY_TIMEOUT",
        "INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY",
        "INSUFFICIENT_DISK",
        "RUNTIME_START_FAILED",
        "RUNTIME_IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE",
        "MODEL_PULL_STALLED",
        "WORKLOAD_EXITED",
        "NODE_UNAVAILABLE",  # provider paused/drained the machine locally or its schedule ended
        "RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE",  # the node no longer offers the runtime (stale capabilities)
        "WORKER_ERROR",  # unexpected worker failure: another node may not hit it (placements are bounded)
    }
)


async def artifact_for(db: AsyncSession, dep: Deployment) -> ModelArtifact:
    artifact = await db.get(ModelArtifact, dep.artifact_id) if dep.artifact_id else None
    if artifact is None:  # deployments created before artifacts existed
        artifact = (
            await db.execute(
                select(ModelArtifact).where(
                    ModelArtifact.model_id == dep.model_id, ModelArtifact.runtime == dep.runtime
                )
            )
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if artifact is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Deployment {dep.id} has no runtime artifact")
    return artifact


async def requirements_for(db: AsyncSession, dep: Deployment) -> ResourceRequest:
    model = await db.get(Model, dep.model_id)
    return estimate_requirements(
        await artifact_for(db, dep),
        DeploymentConfig(**(dep.config or {})),
        community=model is not None and is_unreviewed(model),
    )


def deploy_payload(dep: Deployment, req: ResourceRequest, source: dict | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The only information sent to a worker: validated identifiers, a pinned model source, and limits. No
    customer credentials and no free-form runtime arguments."""
    return {
        "deployment_id": str(dep.id),
        "runtime": dep.runtime,
        "model_tag": dep.model_tag,
        "source": source,
        "num_ctx": (dep.config or {}).get("num_ctx", 2048),
        "resources": {
            "cpu_cores": req.cpu_cores,
            "ram_mb": req.ram_mb,
            "disk_mb": req.disk_mb,
            "vram_mb": req.vram_mb,
            "gpu": req.gpu_required,
        },
        "timeouts": {
            "stall_seconds": settings.PROVISION_STALL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
            "max_seconds": settings.PROVISION_MAX_SECONDS,
        },
    }


async def _stop_on_old_node(db: AsyncSession, dep: Deployment, node_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    # If the old node never received the deploy, there is nothing to clean up there.
    if not await cancel_undelivered(db, dep.id, CommandType.DEPLOY):
        await enqueue_command(db, node_id, dep.id, CommandType.STOP, {"deployment_id": str(dep.id)})


async def fail_or_reschedule(
    db: AsyncSession,
    dep: Deployment,
    *,
    code: str,
    message: str,
    actor: str,
    cleanup_old_node: bool,
) -> bool:
    """Handle a failure. Returns True if the deployment was moved to another node, False if it FAILED.
    Releases the old reservation either way. Does not commit."""
    status = S(dep.status)
    if status in lifecycle.TERMINAL:
        return False
    old_node = dep.node_id
    await release_reservation(db, dep.id)

    movable = (
        code in RESCHEDULABLE_CODES
        and status in (S.SCHEDULED, S.PROVISIONING, S.STARTING, S.READY, S.UNHEALTHY)
        and dep.deleted_at is None
        and dep.schedule_attempts < settings.MAX_SCHEDULE_ATTEMPTS
    )
    if movable:
        excluded = {uuid.UUID(str(n)) for n in (dep.excluded_node_ids or [])}
        if old_node:
            excluded.add(old_node)
        req = await requirements_for(db, dep)
        source = worker_source(await artifact_for(db, dep))
        try:
            node = await schedule(db, dep.id, req, exclude=excluded)
        except NoEligibleNode as exc:
            message = f"{message}. No other node could take it: {exc.evaluation.explain()}"
        else:
            if old_node and cleanup_old_node:
                await _stop_on_old_node(db, dep, old_node)
            note = f"{message}. Moved to another node (placement {dep.schedule_attempts + 1})"
            fields: dict[str, Any] = {
                "node_id": node.id,
                "schedule_attempts": dep.schedule_attempts + 1,
                "excluded_node_ids": sorted(str(n) for n in excluded),
                "error_code": code,
                "error_message": message,
            }
            if status == S.READY:
                # Serving deployments pass through UNHEALTHY so the history shows the outage.
                await lifecycle.transition(db, dep, S.UNHEALTHY, actor=actor, message=message)
                status = S.UNHEALTHY
            if status == S.SCHEDULED:
                # Same state, new node: record the move explicitly.
                for key, value in fields.items():
                    setattr(dep, key, value)
                dep.updated_at = utcnow()
                await lifecycle.record_event(db, dep, actor=actor, message=note)
            else:
                await lifecycle.transition(db, dep, S.SCHEDULED, actor=actor, message=note, **fields)
            await enqueue_command(db, node.id, dep.id, CommandType.DEPLOY, deploy_payload(dep, req, source))
            audit_service.record(
                db,
                actor_id=None,
                action="deployment.moved",
                resource_type="deployment",
                resource_id=dep.id,
                details={"from_node": str(old_node) if old_node else None, "to_node": str(node.id), "reason": code},
            )
            logger.info("Deployment %s moved from node %s to %s (%s)", dep.id, old_node, node.id, code)
            return True

    await lifecycle.transition(db, dep, S.FAILED, actor=actor, message=message, error_code=code)
    if old_node and cleanup_old_node:
        dep.cleanup_status = "pending"
        await _stop_on_old_node(db, dep, old_node)
    return False


async def restart(db: AsyncSession, dep: Deployment) -> None:
    """Restart a serving deployment on its current node from the cached model. Does not commit."""
    status = S(dep.status)
    if status not in (S.READY, S.UNHEALTHY):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409, detail=f"Only READY or UNHEALTHY deployments can be restarted, not {status.value}"
        )
    node = await db.get(Node, dep.node_id) if dep.node_id else None
    if node is None or node.status != NodeStatus.ONLINE or not node_is_fresh(node):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail="The node is offline. The deployment will move to another node automatically if it stays unhealthy.",
        )
    req = await requirements_for(db, dep)
    source = worker_source(await artifact_for(db, dep))
    await lifecycle.transition(
        db, dep, S.PROVISIONING, actor="customer", message="Restart requested", restart_count=dep.restart_count + 1
    )
    await enqueue_command(db, node.id, dep.id, CommandType.RESTART, deploy_payload(dep, req, source))

def recommend_price(gpu_model: str, vram: int, region: str) -> float:
    base_price = 0.5
    if "H100" in gpu_model:
        return base_price + 3.0
    elif "A100" in gpu_model:
        return base_price + 2.0
    elif "4090" in gpu_model:
        return base_price + 0.5
    return base_price


def calculate_deployment_cost(
    gpu_seconds: float, cpu_seconds: float, gpu_hour_price: float, cpu_hour_price: float
) -> float:
    gpu_cost = (gpu_seconds / 3600.0) * gpu_hour_price
    cpu_cost = (cpu_seconds / 3600.0) * cpu_hour_price
    return gpu_cost + cpu_cost

"""Reconciliation: resolve stale payments and payouts against Paystack, and check the ledger's invariants.

``run`` asks Paystack about top-ups and payouts that are still open after RECONCILE_AFTER_MINUTES and applies
the answer through the same code as webhooks. ``report`` never changes anything; it lists discrepancies:

* a wallet balance that differs from its ledger (settled credits minus pending and settled debits);
* a charge whose debit differs from its provider credit plus platform fee, or that lacks its debit;
* a SUCCEEDED top-up without exactly one matching deposit, or a deposit for a payment that did not succeed;
* a payout whose hold does not match its state.
"""

import logging
from datetime import timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.database import session_scope
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.billing import Charge, Payment, PaymentStatus, Payout, PayoutStatus
from app.models.transaction import Transaction, TransactionStatus, TransactionType
from app.models.wallet import Wallet
from app.services import payments_service, paystack
from app.services.ledger_service import DEBIT_STATES, money
from app.services.paystack import PaystackError

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

HOLD_FOR = {
    PayoutStatus.REQUESTED.value: TransactionStatus.PENDING.value,
    PayoutStatus.PENDING.value: TransactionStatus.PENDING.value,
    PayoutStatus.OTP_REQUIRED.value: TransactionStatus.PENDING.value,
    PayoutStatus.SUCCEEDED.value: TransactionStatus.SETTLED.value,
    PayoutStatus.FAILED.value: TransactionStatus.FAILED.value,
    PayoutStatus.REVERSED.value: TransactionStatus.FAILED.value,
    PayoutStatus.REJECTED.value: TransactionStatus.FAILED.value,
}


async def run(now=None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Settle stale open items with Paystack. Each item is its own transaction."""
    if not settings.payments_enabled:
        return {"skipped": "payments not configured"}
    now = now or utcnow()
    cutoff = now - timedelta(minutes=settings.RECONCILE_AFTER_MINUTES)
    results: dict[str, Any] = {"payments": {}, "payouts": {}, "errors": 0}
    async with session_scope() as db:
        payment_refs = (
            (
                await db.execute(
                    select(Payment.reference).where(
                        Payment.status == PaymentStatus.INITIALIZED.value, Payment.created_at < cutoff
                    )
                )
            )
            .scalars()
            .all()
        )
        payout_refs = (
            (
                await db.execute(
                    select(Payout.reference).where(
                        Payout.status.in_([PayoutStatus.PENDING.value, PayoutStatus.OTP_REQUIRED.value]),
                        Payout.updated_at < cutoff,
                    )
                )
            )
            .scalars()
            .all()
        )
        unconfirmed = (
            (
                await db.execute(
                    select(Payout.reference).where(
                        Payout.status.in_(
                            [PayoutStatus.SUCCEEDED.value, PayoutStatus.FAILED.value, PayoutStatus.REVERSED.value]
                        ),
                        Payout.transfer_code.is_not(None),
                        Payout.reconciled_at.is_(None),
                    )
                )
            )
            .scalars()
            .all()
        )
    for ref in payment_refs:
        async with session_scope() as db:
            payment = (await db.execute(select(Payment).where(Payment.reference == ref))).scalars().one()
            try:
                data = await paystack.verify_transaction(ref)
            except PaystackError as exc:
                if exc.status == 404 or "not found" in str(exc).lower():
                    data = {"status": "abandoned", "gateway_response": "Checkout was never completed"}
                else:
                    results["errors"] += 1
                    continue
            outcome = await payments_service.apply_paystack_result(db, payment, data, source="reconciliation")
            await db.commit()
            results["payments"][ref] = outcome
    for ref in [*payout_refs, *unconfirmed]:
        async with session_scope() as db:
            payout = (await db.execute(select(Payout).where(Payout.reference == ref))).scalars().one()
            try:
                data = await paystack.verify_transfer(ref)
            except PaystackError as exc:
                if (
                    exc.status == 404 or "not found" in str(exc).lower()
                ) and payout.status == PayoutStatus.PENDING.value:
                    # Paystack has no such transfer: it was never created, so the held funds go back.
                    data = {"status": "failed", "reason": "Transfer was not created at Paystack"}
                else:
                    results["errors"] += 1
                    continue
            outcome = await payments_service.apply_transfer_result(db, payout, data)
            await db.refresh(payout)
            remote = str(data.get("status") or "")
            local = {"success": "SUCCEEDED", "failed": "FAILED", "reversed": "REVERSED"}.get(remote)
            if local == payout.status:
                payout.reconciled_at = utcnow()
                outcome = f"{outcome}; reconciled"
            elif local and payout.status in HOLD_FOR and payout.status not in payments_service.OPEN_PAYOUT:
                outcome = f"MISMATCH: AgentMesh says {payout.status}, Paystack says {remote}"
                logger.error("Payout %s %s", ref, outcome)
            await db.commit()
            results["payouts"][ref] = outcome
    return results


async def report(db: AsyncSession) -> dict[str, Any]:
    issues: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    credits: dict[Any, Any] = {
        wallet: total
        for wallet, total in (
            await db.execute(
                select(Transaction.to_wallet, func.coalesce(func.sum(Transaction.amount), 0))
                .where(Transaction.to_wallet.is_not(None), Transaction.status == TransactionStatus.SETTLED.value)
                .group_by(Transaction.to_wallet)
            )
        ).all()
    }
    debits: dict[Any, Any] = {
        wallet: total
        for wallet, total in (
            await db.execute(
                select(Transaction.from_wallet, func.coalesce(func.sum(Transaction.amount), 0))
                .where(Transaction.from_wallet.is_not(None), Transaction.status.in_(DEBIT_STATES))
                .group_by(Transaction.from_wallet)
            )
        ).all()
    }
    wallets = (await db.execute(select(Wallet.id, Wallet.user_id, Wallet.balance))).all()
    for wallet_id, user_id, balance in wallets:
        expected = money(Decimal(credits.get(wallet_id, 0)) - Decimal(debits.get(wallet_id, 0)))
        if money(Decimal(balance or 0)) != expected:
            issues.append(
                {
                    "kind": "wallet_balance",
                    "wallet_id": str(wallet_id),
                    "user_id": str(user_id),
                    "balance": str(money(Decimal(balance or 0))),
                    "ledger": str(expected),
                }
            )

    posted = {
        (ref, t): Decimal(a)
        for ref, t, a in (
            await db.execute(
                select(Transaction.reference, Transaction.type, func.sum(Transaction.amount))
                .where(Transaction.reference.like("charge:%"))
                .group_by(Transaction.reference, Transaction.type)
            )
        ).all()
    }
    charges = (await db.execute(select(Charge))).scalars().all()
    for c in charges:
        key = f"charge:{c.id}"
        debit = posted.get((key, TransactionType.COMPUTE_CHARGE.value), Decimal(0))
        credit = posted.get((key, TransactionType.PROVIDER_CREDIT.value), Decimal(0))
        fee = posted.get((key, TransactionType.PLATFORM_FEE.value), Decimal(0))
        if (
            money(debit) != money(c.amount)
            or money(credit + fee) != money(debit)
            or money(c.provider_amount + c.platform_fee) != money(c.amount)
        ):
            issues.append(
                {
                    "kind": "charge_split",
                    "charge_id": str(c.id),
                    "amount": str(c.amount),
                    "debited": str(debit),
                    "credited": str(credit),
                    "fee": str(fee),
                }
            )

    deposits = {
        ref: (n, Decimal(a))
        for ref, n, a in (
            await db.execute(
                select(Transaction.reference, func.count(), func.sum(Transaction.amount))
                .where(Transaction.type == TransactionType.DEPOSIT.value, Transaction.reference.like("am-top-%"))
                .group_by(Transaction.reference)
            )
        ).all()
    }
    for p in (await db.execute(select(Payment))).scalars().all():
        n, amount = deposits.get(p.reference, (0, Decimal(0)))
        if p.status == PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED.value and (n != 1 or money(amount) != money(p.amount)):
            issues.append({"kind": "payment_not_credited_once", "reference": p.reference, "deposits": n})
        if p.status != PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED.value and n:
            issues.append({"kind": "deposit_without_success", "reference": p.reference, "status": p.status})
        if p.status == PaymentStatus.REVIEW.value:
            issues.append({"kind": "payment_needs_review", "reference": p.reference, "reason": p.failure_reason})

    for po in (await db.execute(select(Payout))).scalars().all():
        hold = await db.get(Transaction, po.transaction_id) if po.transaction_id else None
        want = HOLD_FOR.get(po.status)
        if hold is None or hold.status != want or money(Decimal(hold.amount)) != money(Decimal(po.amount)):
            issues.append(
                {
                    "kind": "payout_hold",
                    "reference": po.reference,
                    "status": po.status,
                    "hold_status": hold.status if hold else None,
                }
            )

    open_counts = {
        "payments_initialized": int(
            (await db.execute(select(func.count()).where(Payment.status == PaymentStatus.INITIALIZED.value))).scalar()
            or 0
        ),
        "payouts_awaiting_approval": int(
            (await db.execute(select(func.count()).where(Payout.status == PayoutStatus.REQUESTED.value))).scalar() or 0
        ),
        "payouts_in_flight": int(
            (
                await db.execute(
                    select(func.count()).where(
                        Payout.status.in_([PayoutStatus.PENDING.value, PayoutStatus.OTP_REQUIRED.value])
                    )
                )
            ).scalar()
            or 0
        ),
    }
    return {
        "ok": not issues,
        "issues": issues,
        "checked": {"wallets": len(wallets), "charges": len(charges)},
        "open": open_counts,
        "generated_at": utcnow(),
    }

"""Serves signed worker releases. The control plane never signs anything and cannot forge an update: workers
verify the manifest signature against the release key pinned in their own config."""

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

from app.core.config import settings

WHEEL_RE = re.compile(r"^agentmesh_worker-\d+\.\d+\.\d+-py3-none-any\.whl$")


def release_dir() -> Path | None:
    return Path(settings.WORKER_RELEASE_DIR) if settings.WORKER_RELEASE_DIR else None


def latest() -> dict | None:
    base = release_dir()
    if base is None or not (base / "manifest.json").is_file() or not (base / "manifest.sig").is_file():
        return None
    return {
        "manifest": (base / "manifest.json").read_text(),
        "signature": (base / "manifest.sig").read_text().strip(),
    }


def latest_version() -> str | None:
    release = latest()
    if release is None:
        return None
    try:
        version = json.loads(release["manifest"]).get("version")
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return str(version) if version else None


def wheel_path(name: str) -> Path | None:
    base = release_dir()
    if base is None or not WHEEL_RE.fullmatch(name):
        return None
    path = (base / name).resolve()
    if path.parent != base.resolve() or not path.is_file():
        return None
    return path

"""Read-only aggregates for dashboards: usage summaries (customer, provider, operator), the operator overview,
and the public network figures shown on the landing page.

Everything here is computed from stored records. Token counts are summed only where the runtime reported them;
requests without counts are reported separately and never estimated.
"""

import uuid
from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import Select, case, func, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.deployment import Deployment, DeploymentStatus
from app.models.model import Model, ModelArtifact
from app.models.node import Node, NodeStatus
from app.models.transaction import Transaction
from app.models.usage import UsageRecord
from app.models.user import Customer, Provider, User

# Nodes the scheduler may consider (see scheduler_service); used for "online" counts.
ONLINE_NODE_STATUSES = (NodeStatus.ONLINE.value, NodeStatus.AVAILABLE.value, NodeStatus.BUSY.value)


def _usage_columns() -> list:
    return [
        func.count(UsageRecord.id).label("requests"),
        func.coalesce(func.sum(case((UsageRecord.outcome == "success", 1), else_=0)), 0).label("succeeded"),
        func.coalesce(func.sum(UsageRecord.input_tokens), 0).label("input_tokens"),
        func.coalesce(func.sum(UsageRecord.output_tokens), 0).label("output_tokens"),
        func.coalesce(func.sum(case((UsageRecord.output_tokens.is_(None), 1), else_=0)), 0).label("unreported"),
    ]


def _usage_row(row: Any) -> dict[str, int]:
    requests = int(row.requests or 0)
    succeeded = int(row.succeeded or 0)
    return {
        "requests": requests,
        "succeeded": succeeded,
        "failed": requests - succeeded,
        "input_tokens": int(row.input_tokens or 0),
        "output_tokens": int(row.output_tokens or 0),
        "requests_without_token_counts": int(row.unreported or 0),
    }


async def usage_summary(db: AsyncSession, user: User, days: int, scope: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Inference usage over the last ``days`` days for the caller's ``scope``: "customer" (their deployments),
    "provider" (requests served by their nodes) or "network" (everything; staff only, checked by the caller)."""
    since = utcnow() - timedelta(days=days)
    base: Select = select().where(UsageRecord.kind == "inference", UsageRecord.created_at >= since)
    if scope == "customer":
        owned = select(Deployment.id).join(Customer, Deployment.customer_id == Customer.id)
        base = base.where(UsageRecord.deployment_id.in_(owned.where(Customer.user_id == user.id)))
    elif scope == "provider":
        owned = select(Node.id).join(Provider, Node.owner_id == Provider.id)
        base = base.where(UsageRecord.node_id.in_(owned.where(Provider.user_id == user.id)))

    totals = (await db.execute(base.add_columns(*_usage_columns()))).one()
    day = func.date(UsageRecord.created_at)
    per_day = (
        await db.execute(base.add_columns(day.label("day"), *_usage_columns()).group_by(day).order_by(day))
    ).all()
    per_dep = (
        await db.execute(
            base.add_columns(UsageRecord.deployment_id, *_usage_columns())
            .group_by(UsageRecord.deployment_id)
            .order_by(func.count(UsageRecord.id).desc())
            .limit(50)
        )
    ).all()
    return {
        "scope": scope,
        "days": days,
        "since": since,
        "totals": _usage_row(totals),
        "by_day": [{"date": str(r.day), **_usage_row(r)} for r in per_day],
        "by_deployment": [{"deployment_id": r.deployment_id, **_usage_row(r)} for r in per_dep if r.deployment_id],
        "token_source": "runtime_reported",
    }


async def _count_by(db: AsyncSession, column, *where) -> dict[str, int]:
    rows = (await db.execute(select(column, func.count()).where(*where).group_by(column))).all()
    return {str(getattr(k, "value", k)): int(n) for k, n in rows if k is not None}


async def _deployable_models(db: AsyncSession) -> int:
    has_artifact = select(ModelArtifact.model_id).where(ModelArtifact.is_enabled.is_(True))
    query = select(func.count(Model.id)).where(Model.is_approved.is_(True), Model.id.in_(has_artifact))
    return int((await db.execute(query)).scalar() or 0)


async def public_stats(db: AsyncSession) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Counts only: no node names, owners, locations, or hardware details."""
    online = (
        await db.execute(
            select(Node.runtimes, Node.allocated_vram_mb).where(
                Node.status.in_(ONLINE_NODE_STATUSES), Node.accepting_workloads.is_(True)
            )
        )
    ).all()
    runtimes = sorted(
        {
            str(r["name"])
            for rts, _ in online
            for r in (rts or [])
            if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("available") and r.get("name")
        }
    )
    ready = await db.execute(select(func.count(Deployment.id)).where(Deployment.status == DeploymentStatus.READY))
    return {
        "nodes_online": len(online),
        "gpu_nodes_online": sum(1 for _, vram in online if (vram or 0) > 0),
        "runtimes_online": runtimes,
        "models_deployable": await _deployable_models(db),
        "deployments_ready": int(ready.scalar() or 0),
        "features": {
            "test_credits": settings.test_credits_enabled,
            "payments": False,
            "provider_payouts": False,
            "confidential_computing": False,
        },
        "generated_at": utcnow(),
    }


async def operator_overview(db: AsyncSession) -> dict[str, Any]:
    since = utcnow() - timedelta(hours=24)
    usage = (
        await db.execute(
            select(*_usage_columns()).where(UsageRecord.kind == "inference", UsageRecord.created_at >= since)
        )
    ).one()
    ledger = (
        await db.execute(
            select(
                Transaction.type, Transaction.status, func.count(), func.coalesce(func.sum(Transaction.amount), 0)
            ).group_by(Transaction.type, Transaction.status)
        )
    ).all()
    stale_cutoff = utcnow() - timedelta(seconds=settings.HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
    stale = await db.execute(
        select(func.count(Node.id)).where(Node.status.in_(ONLINE_NODE_STATUSES), Node.last_heartbeat < stale_cutoff)
    )
    return {
        "nodes_by_status": await _count_by(db, Node.status),
        "nodes_paused": int(
            (await db.execute(select(func.count(Node.id)).where(Node.accepting_workloads.is_(False)))).scalar() or 0
        ),
        "nodes_heartbeat_overdue": int(stale.scalar() or 0),
        "deployments_by_status": await _count_by(db, Deployment.status, Deployment.deleted_at.is_(None)),
        "deployments_by_runtime": await _count_by(db, Deployment.runtime, Deployment.status == DeploymentStatus.READY),
        "models": {
            "total": int((await db.execute(select(func.count(Model.id)))).scalar() or 0),
            "approved": int(
                (await db.execute(select(func.count(Model.id)).where(Model.is_approved.is_(True)))).scalar() or 0
            ),
            "deployable": await _deployable_models(db),
        },
        "users_by_role": await _count_by(db, User.role),
        "usage_24h": _usage_row(usage),
        "ledger": [
            {
                "type": str(getattr(t, "value", t)),
                "status": str(getattr(s, "value", s)),
                "count": int(n),
                "amount": str(amount),
            }
            for t, s, n, amount in ledger
        ],
        "generated_at": utcnow(),
    }


async def list_nodes_with_owner(db: AsyncSession, status: str | None, limit: int) -> list[tuple[Node, str | None]]:
    query = (
        select(Node, User.email)
        .join(Provider, Node.owner_id == Provider.id)
        .join(User, Provider.user_id == User.id)
        .order_by(Node.created_at.desc())
        .limit(limit)
    )
    if status:
        query = query.where(Node.status == status)
    return [(n, e) for n, e in (await db.execute(query)).all()]


async def list_deployments_with_owner(
    db: AsyncSession, status: str | None, node_id: uuid.UUID | None, limit: int
) -> list[tuple[Deployment, str | None]]:
    query = (
        select(Deployment, User.email)
        .outerjoin(Customer, Deployment.customer_id == Customer.id)
        .outerjoin(User, Customer.user_id == User.id)
        .order_by(Deployment.created_at.desc())
        .limit(limit)
    )
    if status:
        query = query.where(Deployment.status == status)
    if node_id:
        query = query.where(Deployment.node_id == node_id)
    return [(d, e) for d, e in (await db.execute(query)).all()]

"""Resource-aware node selection and capacity reservation."""

from collections import Counter
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import select, update
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.db_utils import rowcount as _rowcount
from app.core.timeutil import utcnow
from app.models.node import Node, NodeStatus
from app.models.reservation import ResourceReservation
from app.services.catalog_service import ResourceRequest

# Reasons a node was rejected, reported back to the customer in aggregate (never per node).
REASON_UNAVAILABLE = "provider_unavailable"  # offline, stale heartbeat, paused, or suspended
REASON_RUNTIME = "unsupported_runtime"
REASON_HARDWARE = "incompatible_hardware"  # e.g. GPU required but none allocated
REASON_CAPACITY = "insufficient_capacity"
REASON_REGION = "region_mismatch"
REASON_PREVIOUSLY_FAILED = "previously_failed"  # nodes this deployment already failed on
REASON_COMMUNITY = "community_not_accepted"  # provider has not opted in to unreviewed community models

REASON_TEXT = {
    REASON_UNAVAILABLE: "nodes are offline, paused, or not reporting heartbeats",
    REASON_RUNTIME: "nodes do not offer the required runtime",
    REASON_HARDWARE: "nodes lack the required hardware (for example a GPU)",
    REASON_CAPACITY: "nodes do not have enough free CPU, memory, disk, or VRAM allocated to AgentMesh",
    REASON_REGION: "nodes are outside the requested region",
    REASON_PREVIOUSLY_FAILED: "nodes already failed this deployment",
    REASON_COMMUNITY: "nodes do not accept community models (providers must opt in)",
}


@dataclass
class Evaluation:
    eligible: list[Node] = field(default_factory=list)
    reasons: Counter = field(default_factory=Counter)

    def explain(self) -> str:
        if not self.reasons:
            return "No compute nodes are registered."
        parts = [f"{count} {REASON_TEXT[r]}" for r, count in self.reasons.most_common()]
        return "No eligible node: " + "; ".join(parts) + "."


class NoEligibleNode(Exception):  # noqa: N818
    def __init__(self, evaluation: Evaluation):
        self.evaluation = evaluation
        super().__init__(evaluation.explain())


def _free(node: Node, resource: str) -> int:
    return (getattr(node, f"allocated_{resource}") or 0) - (getattr(node, f"reserved_{resource}") or 0)


def node_is_fresh(node: Node, now: datetime | None = None) -> bool:
    now = now or utcnow()
    if node.last_heartbeat is None:
        return False
    return now - node.last_heartbeat <= timedelta(seconds=settings.HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)


def offers_runtime(node: Node, runtime: str) -> bool:
    return any(r.get("name") == runtime and r.get("available") for r in (node.runtimes or []) if isinstance(r, dict))


async def evaluate_nodes(db: AsyncSession, req: ResourceRequest, exclude: set | None = None) -> Evaluation:
    result = await db.execute(select(Node).where(Node.mode.is_not(None)))
    nodes = list(result.scalars().all())
    ev = Evaluation()
    now = utcnow()
    for node in nodes:
        if exclude and node.id in exclude:
            ev.reasons[REASON_PREVIOUSLY_FAILED] += 1
        elif (
            node.status != NodeStatus.ONLINE
            or not node.accepting_workloads
            or not node.worker_available
            or not node_is_fresh(node, now)
        ):
            ev.reasons[REASON_UNAVAILABLE] += 1
        elif req.community and not node.accepts_community_models:
            ev.reasons[REASON_COMMUNITY] += 1
        elif req.region and node.region != req.region:
            ev.reasons[REASON_REGION] += 1
        elif not offers_runtime(node, req.runtime):
            ev.reasons[REASON_RUNTIME] += 1
        elif req.gpu_required and (node.allocated_vram_mb or 0) <= 0:
            ev.reasons[REASON_HARDWARE] += 1
        elif (
            _free(node, "cpu_cores") < req.cpu_cores
            or _free(node, "ram_mb") < req.ram_mb
            or _free(node, "disk_mb") < req.disk_mb
            or _free(node, "vram_mb") < req.vram_mb
        ):
            ev.reasons[REASON_CAPACITY] += 1
        else:
            ev.eligible.append(node)
    # Prefer the node with the most free memory, then reputation. Spreads load across providers.
    ev.eligible.sort(key=lambda n: (_free(n, "ram_mb"), float(n.reputation_score or 0)), reverse=True)
    return ev


async def try_reserve(db: AsyncSession, node: Node, deployment_id, req: ResourceRequest) -> bool:
    """Atomically reserve capacity on one node. The conditional UPDATE only succeeds if the node still has
    room at the moment it executes, so concurrent requests cannot oversubscribe. Does not commit."""
    conditions = [
        Node.id == node.id,
        Node.status == NodeStatus.ONLINE,
        Node.accepting_workloads.is_(True),
        Node.worker_available.is_(True),
    ]
    if req.community:  # re-checked here so a provider opting out cannot race a reservation
        conditions.append(Node.accepts_community_models.is_(True))
    result = await db.execute(
        update(Node)
        .where(
            *conditions,
            Node.reserved_cpu_cores + req.cpu_cores <= Node.allocated_cpu_cores,
            Node.reserved_ram_mb + req.ram_mb <= Node.allocated_ram_mb,
            Node.reserved_disk_mb + req.disk_mb <= Node.allocated_disk_mb,
            Node.reserved_vram_mb + req.vram_mb <= Node.allocated_vram_mb,
        )
        .values(
            reserved_cpu_cores=Node.reserved_cpu_cores + req.cpu_cores,
            reserved_ram_mb=Node.reserved_ram_mb + req.ram_mb,
            reserved_disk_mb=Node.reserved_disk_mb + req.disk_mb,
            reserved_vram_mb=Node.reserved_vram_mb + req.vram_mb,
        )
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )
    if _rowcount(result) != 1:
        return False
    db.add(
        ResourceReservation(
            deployment_id=deployment_id,
            node_id=node.id,
            cpu_cores=req.cpu_cores,
            ram_mb=req.ram_mb,
            disk_mb=req.disk_mb,
            vram_mb=req.vram_mb,
        )
    )
    return True


async def schedule(db: AsyncSession, deployment_id, req: ResourceRequest, exclude: set | None = None) -> Node:
    ev = await evaluate_nodes(db, req, exclude)
    for node in ev.eligible:
        if await try_reserve(db, node, deployment_id, req):
            return node
        ev.reasons[REASON_CAPACITY] += 1  # lost a race for this node's capacity
    raise NoEligibleNode(ev)


async def release_reservation(db: AsyncSession, deployment_id) -> bool:
    """Release a deployment's reservation exactly once. Safe to call repeatedly. Does not commit."""
    reservation = (
        await db.execute(
            select(ResourceReservation).where(
                ResourceReservation.deployment_id == deployment_id, ResourceReservation.status == "ACTIVE"
            )
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if reservation is None:
        return False
    claimed = await db.execute(
        update(ResourceReservation)
        .where(ResourceReservation.id == reservation.id, ResourceReservation.status == "ACTIVE")
        .values(status="RELEASED", released_at=utcnow())
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )
    if _rowcount(claimed) != 1:
        return False
    await db.execute(
        update(Node)
        .where(Node.id == reservation.node_id)
        .values(
            reserved_cpu_cores=Node.reserved_cpu_cores - reservation.cpu_cores,
            reserved_ram_mb=Node.reserved_ram_mb - reservation.ram_mb,
            reserved_disk_mb=Node.reserved_disk_mb - reservation.disk_mb,
            reserved_vram_mb=Node.reserved_vram_mb - reservation.vram_mb,
        )
        .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
    )
    return True
